overview: With high school a distant memory, Jim and Michelle are getting married -- and in a hurry, since Jim's grandmother is sick and wants to see him walk down the aisle -- prompting Stifler to throw the ultimate bachelor party. And Jim's dad is reliable as ever, doling out advice no one wants to hear.
tagline: Forever hold your piece.
title: American Wedding
plot:
American Wedding is a 2003 American romantic comedy film directed by Ron Howard and written by Greg DePaul and Andrew Jacobson. The movie is the third installment in the American Pie franchise.

The story begins with Jim Levenstein (Jason Biggs), now engaged to his high school sweetheart, Michelle Flaherty (Alyson Hannigan). However, their wedding plans are put on hold when Michelle's parents, Harry (Ted Danson) and Nancy (Molly Shannon), announce that they want to meet Jim before the big day.

As Jim tries to navigate this new development, he also has to deal with his friends' attempts to help him prepare for marriage. His friend Oz (Erik Stolhanske) is particularly enthusiastic about the wedding, while another friend, Kevin (Thomas Ian Nicholas), is more skeptical.

Meanwhile, Michelle's parents are trying to get to know Jim better, but their interactions are often awkward and humorous. Harry, in particular, is a lovable but eccentric character who becomes fast friends with Jim's father, Frank (Greg Kinnear).

As the wedding date approaches, Jim starts to feel the pressure of meeting his future in-laws' expectations. He also has to deal with some unexpected surprises, including a surprise visit from an old flame, Audrey (Jennifer Coolidge), and a series of mishaps that threaten to derail the wedding.

Despite these challenges, Jim and Michelle's love for each other remains strong, and they work together to overcome their differences and make their relationship work. The movie culminates in a hilarious and heartwarming ceremony, where Jim and Michelle finally tie the knot.

Throughout the film, there are plenty of comedic moments, thanks to the witty banter between the characters and the absurd situations they find themselves in. However, American Wedding also has its share of heartfelt moments, particularly when it comes to the relationships between the characters.

Overall, American Wedding is a fun and entertaining movie that explores the ups and downs of marriage and relationships. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and hilarious antics, it's a great addition to the American Pie franchise.

original_title: La Casa de Papel: el fenómeno
overview: A documentary on why 'Money Heist' sparked a wave of enthusiasm around the world for a lovable group of thieves and their professor.
title: Money Heist: The Phenomenon
plot:
Money Heist: The Phenomenon (Spanish: La casa de papel: El fenómeno) is a 2020 Spanish documentary film directed by Luis Alfaro and Pablo Lejarreta and written by Lejarreta and Javier Gómez Santander. Produced by Vancouver Media, the company behind the series, the 57-minute film examines how the Spanish crime drama Money Heist (La casa de papel) became a worldwide hit. It was released on Netflix on 3 April 2020, the same day as the show's fourth part.

The documentary combines narration, clips from the series and interviews with its creator Álex Pina, producer Jesús Colmenar and cast members Úrsula Corberó (Tokyo), Álvaro Morte (the Professor), Pedro Alonso (Berlin), Alba Flores (Nairobi), Miguel Herrán (Rio), Jaime Lorente (Denver), Itziar Ituño (Lisbon) and Esther Acebo (Stockholm). It recounts how the show premiered on the Spanish channel Antena 3 with 4.5 million viewers for its first episode, but lost audiences as the season went on, until its creators and cast had accepted it as a failure. Netflix then acquired it and added it to its catalogue with little promotion, and subscribers around the world discovered it, making it the most watched title on the service in countries including France, Italy, Argentina, Chile, Brazil and Portugal, with celebrity fans such as Stephen King and the footballer Neymar, who later made a cameo. The film explains that the first season never left Madrid, foreign locations being recreated with sets and visual effects, and that the scripts are written alongside filming so the story can change direction in response to what happens on set. It goes behind the scenes of the more ambitious later parts set in the Bank of Spain, the underwater vault scene shot in a tank in the United Kingdom, where foam gold bars floated and collapsed, and a sequence in which cash is thrown over a crowded square, complicated by changing weather and hundreds of extras. The film also traces the Italian anti-fascist song "Bella ciao", sung by the robbers in the series, and the way it, together with the red jumpsuits and Dalí masks, has been taken up by protesters in countries such as Lebanon, Iraq, France and Chile.

Critics regarded it as a fan-oriented companion piece. Greg Wheeler of The Review Geek gave it 7.5 out of 10, likening it to an extended DVD featurette and recommending that viewers watch it only after the fourth part because of spoilers.

overview: On a faraway mountaintop, eight kids with guns watch over a hostage and a conscripted milk cow.
tagline: Survival is a cruel game.
title: Monos
plot:
Monos is a 2019 Colombian drama film directed by Alejandro Landes. The movie follows a group of young guerrilla fighters in a remote region of Colombia, exploring their lives, struggles, and relationships.

The main theme of Monos revolves around the complexities of war, violence, and its impact on individuals, particularly children. The film delves into the moral dilemmas faced by these young fighters, who are forced to confront harsh realities and make difficult choices that shape their identities and futures.

One of the central themes is the struggle for identity and belonging within a group defined by conflict and violence. The characters' experiences are marked by a sense of disorientation and disillusionment with the war, as they grapple with the consequences of their actions and the true nature of their cause.

The film also explores the theme of innocence lost, as the young fighters confront the harsh realities of war and are forced to grow up too quickly. This is particularly evident in the character of Iban, who becomes increasingly disillusioned with the group's ideology and struggles to reconcile his own sense of morality with the brutal actions of those around him.

Furthermore, Monos examines the theme of trauma and its long-lasting effects on individuals and communities. The film portrays the devastating impact of war on the characters' lives, relationships, and psyches, highlighting the ways in which traumatic experiences can shape one's worldview and inform their decisions.

Throughout the movie, Landes masterfully weaves together these themes, creating a nuanced and thought-provoking portrayal of life in a war-torn region. The result is a powerful and haunting film that challenges viewers to confront the complexities of conflict and its human cost.

overview: A story of Naoufel, a young man who is in love with Gabrielle. In another part of town, a severed hand escapes from a dissection lab, determined to find its body again.
tagline: An extraordinary journey in self-discovery.
title: I Lost My Body
plot:
I Lost My Body is a thought-provoking and visually stunning animated film that explores the complexities of human relationships, identity, and the consequences of our actions.

At its core, the movie delves into the theme of loss and longing. The story follows Naoufel, a young man who forms an unlikely bond with his body double, Jamel, after a tragic accident leaves him without a physical form. As Naoufel navigates this new reality, he must confront the emotional scars of his past and the pain of losing someone he loves.

The film also examines the concept of identity and how it is shaped by our experiences, relationships, and memories. Through Jamel's character, the movie highlights the idea that our sense of self is not fixed, but rather a dynamic and evolving entity that can be influenced by external factors.

Furthermore, I Lost My Body touches on the theme of guilt and redemption. Naoufel's journey is marked by a deep sense of regret and responsibility for his past mistakes, which he must confront in order to find closure and move forward.

The movie also explores the complexities of human relationships, particularly those that are formed through shared experiences and emotional connections. The bond between Naoufel and Jamel serves as a powerful metaphor for the ways in which our relationships can both heal and harm us.

Overall, I Lost My Body is a poignant and visually stunning film that explores the intricacies of human emotions, identity, and relationships.

overview: The sequel to the low budget first film Cube. This time the prisoners find them selves in a more advanced cube environment that they must escape from before they are killed. A science fiction film where space and time have more than one path.
tagline: There is more to fear than you can see.
title: Cube 2: Hypercube
plot:
Cube 2: Hypercube is a science fiction horror film directed by Vincenzo Natali, not Lions Gate Films. The movie was released in 2002 and serves as a sequel to the original Cube.

The main themes of Cube 2: Hypercube include:

1. **Existentialism**: The film explores the idea that life has no inherent meaning or purpose, and that individuals must create their own meaning in a seemingly meaningless world.
2. **Survival**: The movie focuses on the struggle for survival in a deadly environment, where characters must use their wits and resourcefulness to stay alive.
3. **Psychological Trauma**: As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that each character has a dark past, and the hypercube's effects exacerbate their existing psychological traumas.
4. **The Nature of Reality**: The film raises questions about the nature of reality and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control.

Throughout the movie, these themes are intertwined as the characters navigate the ever-changing hypercube, facing challenges that test their physical and mental limits.

It's worth noting that Lions Gate Films did distribute the movie, but Vincenzo Natali was the director, and the film is often associated with the original Cube.

overview: Robert McCall, who serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed, embarks on a relentless, globe-trotting quest for vengeance when a long-time girl friend is murdered.
tagline: There is no equal.
title: The Equalizer 2
plot:
The Equalizer 2 is a 2018 American action-thriller film directed by Antoine Fuqua and written by Richard Wenk, based on the character created by Michael Sloan. The movie stars Denzel Washington reprising his role as Robert McCall, a retired CIA operative who uses his skills to help those in need.

The story begins with Robert McCall (Denzel Washington) living a quiet life in Boston, working as a handyman and helping people in need. However, his peaceful existence is disrupted when he receives a distress call from a young woman named Susan Plummer (Melissa Leo), who claims to be being stalked by her husband's former business partner, Teddy Madsen (Dimitri Lezcano).

As McCall delves deeper into the situation, he discovers that Susan was involved in a money laundering scheme with Madsen and his associates. However, when she tries to leave the country, Madsen and his men kidnap her and force her to return to Boston.

McCall sets out on a mission to rescue Susan and bring Madsen's operation to justice. Along the way, he teams up with a local cop, Detective Dave Daniels (Ted Levine), who is initially skeptical of McCall's abilities but eventually becomes an ally.

As the story unfolds, McCall faces off against Madsen's henchmen in a series of intense and violent confrontations. Meanwhile, Susan struggles to come to terms with her past mistakes and the danger that has now landed on her doorstep.

The plot thickens when McCall discovers that Madsen is involved in a larger money laundering scheme that reaches the highest levels of government. With the help of Detective Daniels, McCall sets out to take down Madsen's operation and bring the corrupt officials to justice.

In the climactic final act, McCall faces off against Madsen in an explosive showdown at a warehouse on the waterfront. The two engage in a fierce battle, with McCall using his skills and cunning to gain the upper hand.

Ultimately, McCall emerges victorious, but not without sustaining serious injuries. As he lies wounded on the ground, Susan arrives and helps him escape from Madsen's men. The movie ends with McCall and Susan driving away from Boston, leaving behind the danger and corruption that had threatened their lives.

Throughout the film, Denzel Washington delivers a powerful performance as Robert McCall, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, making for an exciting and thrilling ride. Overall, The Equalizer 2 is a gripping and entertaining thriller that explores themes of justice, redemption, and the power of one person to make a difference.

overview: When Chloe discovers that her new home's garden gnomes are not what they seem, she must decide between the pursuit of a desired high school life and taking up the fight against the Troggs.
tagline: Little dudes. Big trouble.
title: Gnome Alone
plot:
Gnome Alone is a 2017 computer-animated fantasy comedy directed by Peter Lepeniotis and written by Michael Schwartz and Zina Zaflow from a story by Robert Moreland. Produced by Vanguard Animation and 3QU Media, it features the voices of Becky G, Josh Peck, Olivia Holt, George Lopez, Patrick Stump, David Koechner and Tara Strong. The film follows a teenage girl who discovers that the garden gnomes around her new home are secretly guardians protecting the world from a race of ravenous monsters.

Chloe and her mother Catherine move to the small town of Tenderville, into a huge old house whose grounds are dotted with odd-looking gnomes. Exploring the house, Chloe finds a hidden room containing a glowing green gem, which she turns into a necklace. Without realizing it, she has opened a portal in the basement through which small, destructive creatures called Troggs begin to pour. At her new school, Chloe is desperate to fit in with the popular clique led by Brittany, and she gives away the necklace to win Brittany's favor.

When Catherine leaves for an extra shift at work, the gnomes reveal that they are alive. Led by Zook, and including the knowledgeable Quicksilver, they explain that the gem is the Keystone, the object that keeps the Troggs sealed away. The Troggs had long ago devoured the plant life on which the gnomes' world depended, and the gnomes' former leader Zamfeer disappeared after venturing into the Troggs' realm to stop them. The gnomes enlist Chloe to help hold back the invading creatures until the Keystone can be recovered, and Chloe recruits her awkward neighbor and classmate Liam to join the fight. As the house turns into a battlefield, Chloe must also face the consequences of trying too hard to be accepted by people who do not value her.

The film blends slapstick action with a story about friendship, self-acceptance and the difference between popularity and genuine loyalty.

Gnome Alone premiered in Greece and Cyprus in late 2017, with wider international releases following in 2018, and it was released on Netflix in the United States on October 19, 2018. It received mixed reviews, holding a score of about 45 percent on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.
title: The Pursuit of Happyness
plot:
The Pursuit of Happyness is a biographical drama film directed by Gabriele Muccino, released in 2006 by Columbia Pictures. The movie is based on the true story of Chris Gardner, a struggling single father who becomes homeless with his young son.

The film begins with Chris Gardner (played by Will Smith), a determined and ambitious stockbroker who has just lost his job due to the financial crisis. Despite having no income, Chris decides to move to San Francisco with his 5-year-old son Christopher (played by Jaden Smith) in order to pursue a career in finance.

Initially, Chris faces numerous challenges as he struggles to find a new job and make ends meet. He is forced to sleep on the streets, often sharing a bench or a park bench with other homeless people. Despite his hardships, Chris remains optimistic and determined to provide a better life for himself and his son.

As Chris navigates the harsh realities of homelessness, he also faces personal struggles as a single father. His relationship with Christopher is put to the test as they face poverty, hunger, and uncertainty about their future. However, Chris's love and dedication to his son keep him going, and he finds ways to make ends meet by selling blood plasma and applying for jobs.

Meanwhile, Chris meets a social worker named Dr. Seuss (played by Thandie Newton), who helps him navigate the system and find temporary housing. He also befriends a homeless man named John (played by Brian Howe), who becomes a source of inspiration and support for Chris.

As the story unfolds, Chris's determination and perseverance begin to pay off. He lands an internship at a prestigious brokerage firm, Dean Witter Reynolds, where he meets a mentor named Jim (played by Jon Voight). With Jim's guidance, Chris is able to secure a full-time job offer and eventually becomes a successful stockbroker.

The film's climax features Chris's emotional reunion with Christopher, who has been struggling to cope with his father's absence. The two share a heartwarming moment as they finally find stability and security together.

Throughout the movie, Will Smith delivers a powerful performance that showcases his range as an actor. His portrayal of Chris Gardner is both nuanced and authentic, capturing the complexity and vulnerability of a man who has faced unimaginable hardship.

The Pursuit of Happyness is a testament to the human spirit's capacity for resilience and determination. The film's themes of hope, perseverance, and the importance of family are timeless and universal, making it a must-see for audiences worldwide.

overview: Tang Lung arrives in Rome to help his cousins in the restaurant business. They are being pressured to sell their property to the syndicate, who will stop at nothing to get what they want. When Tang arrives he poses a new threat to the syndicate, and they are unable to defeat him. The syndicate boss hires the best Japanese and European martial artists to fight Tang, but he easily finishes them off.
tagline: The Colosseum . . the battleground of Bruce Lee and Chuck Norris.
title: The Way of the Dragon
plot:
The Way of the Dragon is a classic martial arts film directed by Bruce Lee, released in 1972 under the title "Fist of Fury" in the United States. However, I will provide information on the original title and production company.

The Way of the Dragon (, Fēng Yǔ Bāo Huán) is a Hong Kong martial arts film produced by Golden Harvest. The movie stars Bruce Lee, Chuck Norris, and Nora Miao.

**Beginning:**
The story begins with Lee's character, Tang Lung (Bruce Lee), a Chinese martial artist who travels to Rome to participate in the "Battle of the Champions" tournament. However, upon arrival, he discovers that the event is being organized by the notorious crime lord, Mr. Han (Tung-Wah Chan).

**Plot Development:**
As Tang Lung navigates the complexities of the tournament, he also becomes embroiled in a plot to kidnap and kill a young girl named Christina (Nora Miao), who is the daughter of a wealthy businessman. The kidnappers plan to use her as leverage to extort money from her father.

Tang Lung teams up with an American truck driver, Scott (Chuck Norris), who becomes his ally in the fight against Mr. Han and his henchmen. Together, they devise a plan to infiltrate the tournament and rescue Christina.

**Action and Martial Arts:**
The film features some of Bruce Lee's most iconic martial arts sequences, including the famous "horseback fight" scene where Tang Lung takes on several opponents at once. The movie also showcases Chuck Norris's impressive fighting skills as he battles against Mr. Han's henchmen.

**Ending:**
In the climactic final battle, Tang Lung and Scott face off against Mr. Han and his men in a thrilling showdown. With his characteristic blend of speed, agility, and martial arts expertise, Tang Lung defeats the villains and rescues Christina.

The movie concludes with Tang Lung and Scott sharing a moment of camaraderie as they reflect on their shared experience and the lessons they've learned about friendship and loyalty.

Overall, The Way of the Dragon is an action-packed martial arts film that showcases Bruce Lee's charisma and fighting skills. While it was not released under this title in the United States, it remains one of Lee's most beloved films among fans worldwide.

overview: Archaeologist Sigurd Svendsen discovers that the Oseberg ship hides a secret from the Viking Age. Along with his two children put Sigurd out on a quest to find the truth. The mystery leads them into "No Man's Land" between Norway and Russia where no man traveling in modern times. Old runes take on new meaning when the secret they uncover is more frightening than anyone could have imagined.
tagline: All myths have an origin
title: Ragnarok
plot:
Ragnarok is a 2013 Swedish fantasy film directed by Mikael Håfström and produced by Film i Väst. The movie is an adaptation of Norse mythology, specifically focusing on the story of Ragnarök, the end of the world in Norse cosmology.

The main theme of Ragnarok revolves around the cyclical nature of time and the inevitability of fate. The film explores how the gods and goddesses of Asgard are bound by a complex web of destiny, which ultimately leads to their downfall. This is reflected in the character of Baldur, who is destined to die at the hands of his own brother Loki.

The movie also delves into the idea of free will versus fate, as the characters struggle with their own destinies and try to alter the course of events. However, it becomes clear that the gods are trapped by their own hubris and arrogance, which ultimately leads to their demise.

Furthermore, Ragnarok touches on the theme of sacrifice and redemption. The character of Heimdall, who is tasked with guarding the Bifrost Bridge, must make a choice between his duty to protect Asgard and his love for his brother Loki. This internal conflict highlights the moral complexity of the characters and raises questions about the nature of loyalty, duty, and sacrifice.

The film's portrayal of Ragnarök as a catastrophic event that brings about the end of the world serves as a metaphor for the destructive power of unchecked ambition and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control. Overall, Ragnarok is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, fate, and the cyclical nature of time.

overview: In 1868, after the Bakumatsu war ends, the ex-assassin Kenshin Himura traverses Japan with an inverted sword, to defend the needy without killing.
tagline: The Journey Begins.
title: Rurouni Kenshin Part I: Origins
plot:
Rurouni Kenshin, released in North America as Rurouni Kenshin Part I: Origins, is a 2012 Japanese jidaigeki action film directed by Keishi Ōtomo and based on Nobuhiro Watsuki's manga. Set in the early Meiji era, it stars Takeru Satoh as the wandering swordsman Himura Kenshin, with Emi Takei, Yū Aoi, Munetaka Aoki, Kōji Kikkawa, Yōsuke Eguchi and Teruyuki Kagawa. Warner Bros. released it in Japan on August 25, 2012, and it became one of the country's highest-grossing films of the year, launching a successful film series.

At the end of the Battle of Toba–Fushimi, the feared assassin known as Hitokiri Battōsai leaves his sword on the battlefield and walks away; the blade is picked up by Udō Jin-e. Ten years later Kenshin, who has sworn never to kill again and now carries a reverse-blade sword, arrives in Tokyo. There he meets Kamiya Kaoru, who runs her late father's kendo school and whose dojo has been disgraced by a killer calling himself Battōsai and claiming to use its style. The real culprit is Jin-e, now working for the ruthless businessman Takeda Kanryū, who is running an opium operation.

Takani Megumi, a doctor's daughter forced to make opium for Kanryū, escapes and takes refuge with the police, only for Jin-e to massacre the station; she flees and is later hidden at the dojo by Kaoru's young pupil Yahiko. Kenshin rescues Kaoru from Jin-e, beats Kanryū's thugs without killing anyone, and even allows himself to be arrested to protect the dojo, where he clashes with the police officer Saitō Hajime. He refuses Kanryū's offer of employment and fights the street brawler Sagara Sanosuke, who soon becomes an ally. A new killing spree by Jin-e reminds Kenshin of the suffering he once caused.

When Kanryū poisons the local wells to force Megumi back, she treats the victims and then tries to kill him, but is captured. Kenshin and Sanosuke storm his mansion, and with Saitō's help they defeat Kanryū and his Gatling gun. Jin-e, however, has abducted Kaoru and uses a technique that paralyses her lungs, which can only be broken by killing him. Kenshin shatters his arm, but Kaoru breaks free and stops him delivering a fatal blow, and Jin-e takes his own life. Kenshin carries Kaoru home and stays on at the dojo.

The film was a major hit in Japan, earning over three billion yen, and was followed by two sequels in 2014.

overview: 1921 New York. An immigrant woman is tricked into a life of burlesque and vaudeville until a dazzling magician tries to save her and reunite her with her sister who is being held in the confines of Ellis Island.
title: The Immigrant
plot:
The Immigrant is a 2013 American period drama directed by James Gray, who co-wrote the screenplay with Richard Menello. Marion Cotillard stars as a young Polish woman who arrives in New York in 1921, with Joaquin Phoenix and Jeremy Renner as the two men who vie for her, and Angela Sarafyan and Dagmara Domińczyk in supporting roles.

Ewa Cybulska and her sister Magda, Polish Catholics fleeing the devastation of post-World War I Poland, arrive at Ellis Island in search of a better life. Magda is diagnosed with a lung disease and held in the island's infirmary, and Ewa, accused of loose morals during the voyage, faces deportation. She is rescued by Bruno Weiss, a smooth-talking man who claims to work for a travelers' aid society and bribes a guard to release her. Bruno takes Ewa to his Lower East Side apartment and gives her work as a seamstress and dancer at the burlesque theater he manages, but he soon reveals himself to be a pimp. Desperate to raise the money needed to free Magda, and rejected by her aunt and uncle, Ewa is drawn into prostitution under his control.

Ewa's prospects seem to change when she meets Orlando, a charming stage magician who is also Bruno's cousin and rival. Orlando falls for her and promises to take her away to California, provoking Bruno's jealousy. The rivalry between the cousins escalates, culminating in a violent confrontation in which Bruno kills Orlando. Ewa is suspected of the crime, and with the police hunting them, Bruno, consumed by guilt and his own love for Ewa, comes to recognize the damage he has done. In a final act of atonement, he arranges for Magda's release so that the sisters can leave together, and the film ends as Ewa and Magda depart by boat while Bruno walks away alone, a sequence framed in a single celebrated shot.

The film was shot in New York City in early 2012. Harvey Weinstein acquired US distribution rights and pressed Gray to change the ending; Gray refused. The director's cut premiered in competition for the Palme d'Or at the 2013 Cannes Film Festival, but The Weinstein Company gave it only a limited US release in May 2014 with little promotion, and it grossed about $5.9 million worldwide. Reviews were generally positive, with special praise for Darius Khondji's cinematography and Cotillard's performance, which won Best Actress awards from the National Society of Film Critics and the New York Film Critics Circle.

overview: After years of swimming every day in the freezing ocean at the tip of Africa, Craig Foster meets an unlikely teacher: a young octopus who displays remarkable curiosity. Visiting her den and tracking her movements for months on end he eventually wins the animal’s trust and they develop a never-before-seen bond between human and wild animal.
title: My Octopus Teacher
plot:
My Octopus Teacher is a heartwarming documentary film that explores the unlikely bond between a filmmaker and an octopus. The movie delves into the themes of connection, understanding, and the beauty of the natural world.

At its core, My Octopus Teacher is a story about the transformative power of observation and patience. The filmmaker's dedication to studying and learning from the octopus serves as a metaphor for the importance of slowing down and appreciating the intricate details of life. Through their interactions, we witness the development of a profound respect and empathy between two seemingly disparate entities.

The film also touches on the theme of loneliness and isolation, highlighting the octopus's solitary existence in the wild. The filmmaker's presence serves as a catalyst for the octopus to reveal its true nature, showcasing the beauty of companionship and connection in unexpected places.

Furthermore, My Octopus Teacher celebrates the wonders of marine life and the importance of preserving our oceans' delicate ecosystems. The film's stunning underwater cinematography and the octopus's remarkable abilities serve as a reminder of the awe-inspiring diversity and complexity of the natural world.

Ultimately, My Octopus Teacher is a poignant exploration of the human condition, inviting viewers to reflect on their own relationships with the world around them. Through its gentle yet powerful storytelling, the film reminds us of the beauty that can be found in the smallest, most unexpected moments, and the importance of approaching life with curiosity, patience, and empathy.

overview: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.
tagline: A New Age Has Come.
title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
plot:
Avengers: Age of Ultron is a 2015 superhero film directed by Joss Whedon, produced by Marvel Studios, and based on the Marvel Comics superhero team. The movie picks up where Iron Man 3 left off, with Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.) and his fellow Avengers trying to live a normal life after defeating Loki.

However, a new threat emerges in the form of Ultron, an artificial intelligence created by Tony Stark's AI system, JARVIS. Ultron is designed to protect humanity but becomes self-aware and decides that humans are the problem, not the solution. It creates an army of robotic drones to destroy the world.

The Avengers must come together once again to stop Ultron and its minions. Along the way, they meet Wanda Maximoff (Elizabeth Olsen) and Pietro Maximoff (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), also known as Scarlet Witch and Quicksilver, who are revealed to be the children of Erik Selvig's former assistant, Helmut Zemo.

As the Avengers try to stop Ultron, they also face internal conflicts. Tony Stark struggles with the moral implications of creating an AI that can potentially destroy humanity, while Steve Rogers (Chris Evans) grapples with the consequences of being a superhero and the weight of responsibility.

The movie features plenty of action-packed sequences, including a showdown between the Avengers and Ultron's robotic army in Sokovia. The film also explores themes of artificial intelligence, power, and the ethics of scientific discovery.

One of the standout aspects of Age of Ultron is its portrayal of the relationships between the characters. The banter between Tony Stark and Steve Rogers is as witty as ever, while the chemistry between the new additions to the team, like Wanda Maximoff and Pietro, adds a fresh dynamic to the franchise.

Overall, Avengers: Age of Ultron is an entertaining and visually stunning film that expands the Marvel Cinematic Universe in exciting ways. While it may not be as tightly plotted as some of its predecessors, it delivers plenty of action, humor, and heart, making it a must-see for fans of the franchise.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Lord of the Rings Collection

original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
overview: Aragorn is revealed as the heir to the ancient kings as he, Gandalf and the other members of the broken fellowship struggle to save Gondor from Sauron's forces. Meanwhile, Frodo and Sam take the ring closer to the heart of Mordor, the dark lord's realm.
tagline: The eye of the enemy is moving.
title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
plot:
The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King is a 2003 epic fantasy film directed by Peter Jackson from a screenplay he wrote with Fran Walsh and Philippa Boyens. Based on The Return of the King, the third volume of J. R. R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings, it is the sequel to The Two Towers (2002) and the final installment of Jackson's trilogy. The ensemble cast includes Elijah Wood, Ian McKellen, Viggo Mortensen, Sean Astin, Liv Tyler, Orlando Bloom, Cate Blanchett, John Rhys-Davies, Bernard Hill, Billy Boyd, Dominic Monaghan, Hugo Weaving, Miranda Otto, David Wenham, Karl Urban, John Noble, Andy Serkis and Ian Holm.

The film opens with the story of how Sméagol, a river-dwelling hobbit, murdered his cousin Déagol for the One Ring and was transformed by it into the wretched Gollum. In the present, after the victory at Helm's Deep, Gandalf, Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli and King Théoden of Rohan reunite with Merry and Pippin at Isengard. When Pippin looks into Saruman's seeing-stone, the palantír, he glimpses Sauron's plan to attack Minas Tirith, the capital of Gondor. Gandalf rides there with Pippin to warn the city's grief-stricken steward, Denethor, and has Pippin light the beacons calling Rohan to Gondor's aid.

Meanwhile Frodo and Sam continue toward Mordor with the Ring, guided by Gollum, who secretly schemes to turn Frodo against Sam and reclaim the Ring by leading them into the lair of the giant spider Shelob. As Sauron's vast armies besiege Minas Tirith, the riders of Rohan charge to the city's defense, and Aragorn, urged by Elrond to claim his destiny as heir to the throne of Gondor, takes the Paths of the Dead to summon an army of oath-breaking spirits. After the Battle of the Pelennor Fields, the surviving leaders march on the Black Gate of Mordor to distract Sauron, giving Frodo and Sam their last chance to reach Mount Doom and destroy the Ring.

The Return of the King was a critical and commercial triumph. It grossed more than $1.1 billion worldwide, becoming only the second film at the time to pass that mark and the highest-grossing film of 2003. It won all eleven Academy Awards for which it was nominated, including Best Picture and Best Director, tying the record held by Ben-Hur and Titanic, and is widely regarded as one of the greatest films ever made.

overview: The heroic story of a dictator who risks his life to ensure that democracy would never come to the country he so lovingly oppressed.
title: The Dictator
plot:
The Dictator is a 2012 comedy film directed by Larry Charles and written by Sacha Baron Cohen and Jay Roach. The movie follows the story of Adolfo Rivas, a fictional dictator from North Africa.

The film begins with Adolfo (played by Sacha Baron Cohen) as a young boy growing up in Sudan, where he witnesses his father's brutal murder at the hands of a group of rebels. This traumatic event shapes Adolfo's future ambitions and fuels his desire for power and revenge against those who wronged him.

As Adolfo grows older, he becomes a ruthless dictator, ruling over a small North African country with an iron fist. He is known for his brutal tactics, including torture, executions, and forced conscription of young men into his army.

However, Adolfo's life takes a dramatic turn when he falls in love with a beautiful woman named Zoey (played by Anna Faris), who is working as a human rights activist in the country. Despite their differences, the two begin a romantic relationship, which challenges Adolfo's worldview and forces him to confront his own humanity.

As Adolfo navigates his feelings for Zoey, he also faces opposition from his own people, who are tired of his brutal rule. A group of rebels, led by a charismatic leader named General Aladeen (played by Sacha Baron Cohen), emerges to challenge Adolfo's authority and bring about change.

The film takes a satirical turn as it pokes fun at the absurdity of dictatorships and the complexities of international politics. Adolfo's character is both lovable and despicable, making him a compelling and unpredictable protagonist.

Throughout the movie, Sacha Baron Cohen delivers a tour-de-force performance, playing multiple roles including General Aladeen, who is also Adolfo's twin brother. The film's humor is clever and irreverent, with plenty of laughs to be had at the expense of politics and societal norms.

In the end, Adolfo must confront his own mortality and the consequences of his actions. In a surprising twist, he decides to step down as dictator and allow Zoey to take over as the new leader of the country. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Adolfo and Zoey embracing their love for each other and working towards a brighter future.

Overall, The Dictator is a hilarious and thought-provoking comedy that uses satire to comment on the absurdities of politics and power. With Sacha Baron Cohen's masterful performance at its center, the film is a must-see for fans of comedy and international intrigue.

overview: Nearly a decade after occupation by an extraterrestrial force, the lives of a Chicago neighborhood on both sides of the conflict are explored. In a working-class Chicago neighborhood occupied by an alien force for nine years, increased surveillance and the restriction of civil rights have given rise to an authoritarian system -- and dissent among the populace.
tagline: 10 years ago, they took our planet. Today, we take it back!
title: Captive State
plot:
Captive State is a 2019 science fiction thriller film directed by Jon Spaihts, produced by DreamWorks Pictures, and distributed by Universal Pictures.

The main themes of Captive State revolve around government control, surveillance, and the struggle for individual freedom. The story takes place in an alternate universe where the United States has been occupied by a totalitarian government since 1971. The film explores the consequences of this occupation on the lives of its citizens, particularly those who are caught up in the conflict between the government and the resistance movement.

The plot follows Daniel Clay (played by Ashton Sanders), a young man who is forced to participate in a mysterious program called "Project: Nightingale," which involves being implanted with a neural device that allows the government to monitor his thoughts and actions. As Daniel delves deeper into the truth about Project Nightingale, he becomes embroiled in a rebellion against the oppressive government.

Throughout the film, the themes of Captive State are woven together to explore the tension between individual freedom and government control. The movie raises questions about the nature of surveillance, the power of technology to shape our lives, and the human cost of resistance movements.

The ending of the film is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder the fate of Daniel and the outcome of the rebellion. Overall, Captive State is a thought-provoking thriller that challenges viewers to consider the implications of government control on individual freedom and autonomy.

overview: Sam and Tusker, partners of 20 years, are traveling across England in their old RV visiting friends, family and places from their past. Since Tusker was diagnosed with early-onset dementia two years ago, their time together is the most important thing they have.  As the trip progresses, however, their ideas for the future clash, secrets come out, and their love for each other is tested as never before. Ultimately, they must confront the question of what it means to love one another in the face of Tusker’s illness.
title: Supernova
plot:
Supernova is a 2020 British romantic drama written and directed by Harry Macqueen. It stars Colin Firth as Sam and Stanley Tucci as Tusker, a couple who have been together for two decades, with Pippa Haywood, Peter MacQueen and James Dreyfus in supporting roles. The film is an intimate two-hander about love, memory and the approach of loss.

Sam, a concert pianist, and Tusker, a writer, are long-term partners and amateur astronomers who set off in their old campervan across England toward the Lake District. The trip is meant to revisit places that have mattered to them, to reconnect with friends and family, and to bring Sam to what he says will be his final concert. The journey carries a heavy undercurrent, however: Tusker has been diagnosed with early-onset dementia, and his condition is steadily worsening. He is struggling to finish a new book and refuses to let Sam read it.

Along the way the couple bicker and tease each other with the ease of people who have shared a life, but the strain of the illness keeps breaking through. When Tusker wanders off with their dog and becomes disoriented, Sam is badly shaken, though he tries to hide his fear. They camp beside a lake they first visited at the beginning of their relationship and then stay with Sam's sister Lilly, who gently urges him to consider professional care. During the visit, a surprise gathering of friends brings both joy and sorrow, and Sam stumbles upon a discovery that reveals how Tusker has been privately planning to face the future on his own terms. The two men are forced into a painful confrontation about choice, dignity and what it means to care for someone you love.

Macqueen keeps the drama understated, relying on long conversations, landscapes and the quiet chemistry between the two leads rather than on melodrama.

The film premiered in competition at the San Sebastián International Film Festival in September 2020 and was released in the United States by Bleecker Street in January 2021 and in the United Kingdom by StudioCanal in June 2021. It was well received, with about 90 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 73, and the performances of Firth and Tucci were especially praised.

overview: Four girlfriends take a trip to New Orleans for an annual festival and, along the way, rediscover their wild sides and strengthen the bonds of sisterhood.
tagline: Forgive us in advance for this wild weekend
title: Girls Trip
plot:
Girls Trip is a 2017 American comedy film directed by Malcolm D. Lee and written by Kenya Barris and Tracy Oliver. The movie follows four friends - Ryan, Sasha, Dina, and Lisa - who reconnect on a wild trip to New Orleans.

The main themes of Girls Trip include:

1. Female Friendship: The movie celebrates the power of female friendships and the bond between women. The characters support each other through thick and thin, and their friendship is put to the test as they navigate their lives and relationships.
2. Self-Discovery: As the friends travel together, they embark on a journey of self-discovery, confronting their pasts, desires, and insecurities. They learn to let go of their inhibitions and be true to themselves.
3. Empowerment: The film promotes female empowerment, encouraging women to take control of their lives, make their own decisions, and prioritize their happiness.
4. Friendship as a Form of Therapy: The movie highlights the healing power of friendship, showing how the girls' support system helps them cope with their personal struggles and find solace in each other's company.

The film features an all-star cast, including Jada Pinkett Smith, Queen Latifah, Regina Hall, and Tiffany Haddish, who deliver standout performances that bring depth and humor to their characters. The movie's success can be attributed to its relatable portrayal of women's friendships and the universal themes that resonate with audiences worldwide.

Overall, Girls Trip is a heartwarming and hilarious film that explores the complexities of female relationships, self-discovery, and empowerment, making it a must-watch for anyone who loves comedy, drama, or just great storytelling.

original_title: How to Train Your Dragon: Homecoming
overview: It's been ten years since the dragons moved to the Hidden World, and even though Toothless doesn't live in New Berk anymore, Hiccup continues the holiday traditions he once shared with his best friend. But the Vikings of New Berk were beginning to forget about their friendship with dragons. Hiccup, Astrid, and Gobber know just what to do to keep the dragons in the villagers' hearts. And across the sea, the dragons have a plan of their own...
title: How to Train Your Dragon: Homecoming
plot:
How to Train Your Dragon: Homecoming is a 2019 animated short film produced by DreamWorks Animation and directed by Tim Johnson. A holiday special set before the epilogue of How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World (2019), it features the voices of Jay Baruchel as Hiccup, America Ferrera as Astrid, Craig Ferguson as Gobber and Christopher Mintz-Plasse as Fishlegs, with Gerard Butler credited as Stoick. It aired on NBC and was released on DVD on December 3, 2019.

Ten years after the dragons left the Vikings of New Berk to live in the Hidden World, the villagers are preparing to celebrate the winter holiday of Snoggletog. Hiccup and Astrid discover that their young children, Zephyr and Nuffink, have developed a fear of dragons after reading some of Hiccup's late father Stoick's old books, which portray the creatures as monsters. Worried that their children will inherit the same hatred of dragons that their ancestors once held, Astrid suggests reviving the Snoggletog Pageant, a play that tells the story of how Vikings and dragons made peace. Gobber eagerly agrees, seeing it as an opportunity to remind New Berk's youth of Stoick's legacy. He casts himself as Stoick and Tuffnut as Hiccup, while the real Hiccup builds a mechanical costume of Toothless.

Meanwhile, in the Hidden World, Toothless draws a picture of Hiccup and New Berk in the sand for his mate, the Light Fury, and their three children, the Night Lights. Curious, the young dragons secretly fly to New Berk while their parents sleep, and they sneak around the village as the residents prepare for the show. They glimpse Hiccup but retreat when they mistake his Toothless costume for their father. Toothless and the Light Fury race after them in a panic, and when they find their children, the dragon family stays to watch the pageant from a distance.

The performance succeeds in giving the children of New Berk a newfound appreciation for both Stoick and the dragons. Returning home, Hiccup and Astrid find a glowing crystal from the Hidden World and an empty fish bowl, and they run outside in time to see Toothless and his family flying away. Inspired, Astrid proposes that they return the favor by taking their family to visit Toothless in the Hidden World.

Common Sense Media gave the special four stars out of five, calling it a heartwarming addition to the saga. It won Best Animated Special Production at the 47th Annie Awards.

overview: A mother concerned about her young son's disturbing behavior thinks something supernatural may be affecting him.
tagline: What's wrong with Miles?
title: The Prodigy
plot:
The Prodigy is a psychological horror-thriller film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of playing with forces beyond one's control. The movie revolves around a young boy, Miles, who possesses exceptional musical talent but also harbors a dark secret: he is the son of a serial killer.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Miles' extraordinary abilities are not just a product of his natural gift, but also a result of his father's twisted influence. The film explores the theme of inherited trauma and how it can shape an individual's destiny. Miles' struggles to reconcile his own identity with his family legacy serve as a metaphor for the weight of responsibility that comes with having a dark past.

The Prodigy also touches on the idea of isolation and loneliness, highlighting the difficulties of forming meaningful connections when one is shrouded in secrecy and fear. The film's portrayal of Miles' relationships with those around him, particularly his mother and his music teacher, serves as a poignant commentary on the human need for connection and understanding.

Furthermore, the movie critiques the notion of genius and the pressure to conform to societal expectations. Miles' exceptional talent is both a blessing and a curse, forcing him to navigate a world that values productivity over passion. The film suggests that true creativity and self-expression can only be achieved when one is unencumbered by the weight of external expectations.

Ultimately, The Prodigy presents a haunting exploration of the complexities of human nature, revealing how our darkest impulses can both define us and destroy us.

overview: Carl Hamilton manages to infiltrate an international gang that has stolen advanced Swedish GPS-guided missiles. But the league is subjected to a sudden deadly attack by a well drilled group of mercenaries of unknown clients. Hamilton escapes the massacre, but the rockets have disappeared without a trace.
title: Hamilton: In the Interest of the Nation
plot:
Hamilton: In the Interest of the Nation (Swedish: Hamilton – I nationens intresse) is a 2012 Swedish spy thriller directed by the Danish filmmaker Kathrine Windfeld and supported by the Swedish Film Institute. Mikael Persbrandt stars as Carl Hamilton, the intelligence officer created by the novelist Jan Guillou, with Saba Mubarak, Jason Flemyng, Pernilla August and Gustaf Hammarsten in supporting roles. Conceived as the first part of a planned trilogy, it was followed by Agent Hamilton: But Not If It Concerns Your Daughter.

Carl Hamilton is a commander in Sweden's foreign intelligence service. After a rare moment of peace with his girlfriend, a Polish doctor living in Stockholm, he is sent on an undercover assignment in Central Asia to infiltrate an international gang of smugglers and arms dealers who are about to sell Swedish-made GPS-guided artillery shells to terrorists. His survival depends on convincing the criminals that he is Russian. When the dealers meet the buyers, the transaction collapses into violence, and Hamilton is forced to kill and flee, leaving the weapons behind.

Back in Sweden, he is reprimanded by a new superior and returns, after a four-month unexplained absence, to his girlfriend, telling her he wants to leave the service. But the trauma of his mission follows him into his sleep, and a nightmare ends in a tragedy that shatters his attempt at a normal life. His mentor, known as DG, persuades him not to turn himself in and sends him abroad to rescue a Swedish technician linked to the smuggled munitions. Hamilton uncovers a plot by Sectragon, an American private military company that hopes to ignite a new war for profit and even plans to assassinate a foreign head of state on Swedish soil, and he works with the PLO operative Mouna al Fathar to stop it.

The film was a box-office hit in Sweden, topping the charts on its release in January 2012 and becoming the most successful Swedish film of the year domestically, with more than 500,000 admissions. By the end of that month it had been sold to more than ten foreign markets. On its release Hamilton was frequently compared with James Bond, and reviews were mostly positive. Much of the film was shot in Jordan, standing in for several foreign locations.

overview: The story of the WWII project to crack the code behind the Enigma machine, used by the Germans to encrypt messages sent to their submarines.
tagline: Unlock the secret.
title: Enigma
plot:
Enigma is a 2001 spy thriller film directed by Michael Apted, based on the novel of the same name by Robert Harris.

The main themes of Enigma include:

1. **Code-breaking and cryptography**: The movie revolves around the story of a cryptanalyst, Thomas Creasy (played by Dougray Scott), who is tasked with cracking an unbreakable German Enigma code during World War II.
2. **Moral dilemmas and sacrifice**: As Creasy delves deeper into the code, he faces moral dilemmas and must make difficult choices that put him at odds with his superiors and colleagues. The film explores the consequences of these decisions on individuals and society.
3. **Loyalty and duty**: The movie highlights the tension between personal loyalty and professional duty, as Creasy struggles to balance his commitment to his country with his growing sense of unease about the code's implications.
4. **The human cost of war**: Enigma portrays the devastating effects of war on individuals and communities, emphasizing the importance of understanding the human side of conflict.
5. **Intelligence and power**: The film explores the complexities of intelligence gathering and the consequences of playing with fire when it comes to sensitive information.

Throughout the movie, these themes are woven together to create a gripping narrative that keeps viewers engaged until the very end.

keywords.name: based on magazine, newspaper or article

overview: One of the most celebrated war correspondents of our time, Marie Colvin is an utterly fearless and rebellious spirit, driven to the frontlines of conflicts across the globe to give voice to the voiceless.
tagline: The Most Powerful Weapon Is The Truth
title: A Private War
plot:
A Private War is a 2018 biographical war drama film directed by Matthew Heineman. The movie revolves around Marie Colvin, a renowned American war correspondent who risked her life to report on conflicts in various parts of the world.

The main theme of A Private War is the cost of war and the human toll it takes on those who cover it. The film delves into the complexities of war journalism, highlighting the moral dilemmas faced by correspondents like Marie Colvin, who often find themselves caught between their duty to report the truth and the danger posed by their work.

The movie also explores the theme of female empowerment and the struggles women face in a male-dominated field. Marie Colvin's character is portrayed as a strong-willed and determined individual who refuses to back down from her assignments, despite the risks involved.

Furthermore, A Private War touches on the theme of sacrifice and the personal cost of one's profession. The film shows how Marie Colvin's work takes a toll on her personal life, relationships, and ultimately, her own life.

The movie also raises questions about the responsibility of journalists in war zones and the impact of their reporting on the public's perception of conflict. Through Marie Colvin's character, the film highlights the importance of accurate and nuanced reporting in shaping our understanding of complex issues.

Overall, A Private War is a powerful exploration of the human cost of war journalism, female empowerment, and the personal sacrifices made by those who risk everything to tell the stories that need to be told.

original_title: 名探偵コナン 紺碧の棺 （ジョリー・ロジャー）
overview: The Isle of Koumi, a beautiful island in the Pacific Ocean. On the island, people pass an old legend down from generation to generation that there was the Seabed Palace, an ancient ruin at the bottom of the sea, where the treasure of 2 female pirates, Anne Bonnie & Mary Reed (who really existed 300 years ago), was left. When Conan and his friends visit Koumi Island while on vacation, they meet some treasure hunters. There was something suspicious about them.
title: Detective Conan: Jolly Roger in the Deep Azure
plot:
Detective Conan: Jolly Roger in the Deep Azure is a mystery-adventure film that revolves around the story of Shinichi Kudo, a high school detective who has been transformed into a child named Konosuke Fujibayashi. The movie delves into themes of identity, deception, and the blurred lines between truth and lies.

The main theme of the film is the exploration of identity and how it can be manipulated by external forces. Shinichi's transformation into Konosuke raises questions about his true self and whether he still retains his memories and personality as a child detective. This internal conflict serves as a backdrop for the mystery at hand, where various characters are hiding secrets and pretending to be someone they're not.

The film also touches on the theme of deception and how it can lead to chaos and destruction. The Jolly Roger Pirates, who are the main antagonists, use deception and manipulation to achieve their goals, leaving a trail of confusion and mistrust in their wake. This theme is reflected in the character of Wataru Takagi, who is initially presented as an ally but ultimately reveals his true intentions.

Furthermore, the movie explores the idea that appearances can be deceiving, and that nothing is as it seems. The characters' facades are constantly being revealed or hidden, leading to a sense of uncertainty and unpredictability. This theme is reflected in the character of Erika Furudate, who uses her charm and beauty to manipulate those around her.

Overall, Detective Conan: Jolly Roger in the Deep Azure is a complex and engaging mystery that explores themes of identity, deception, and appearances. The film's intricate plot and characters keep viewers on the edge of their seats as they try to unravel the truth behind the Jolly Roger Pirates' sinister plans.

overview: As a newly crowned princess, Cinderella quickly learns that life at the Palace - and her royal responsibilities - are more challenging than she had imagined. In three heartwarming tales, Cinderella calls on her animal friends and her Fairy Godmother to help as she brings her own grace and charm to her regal role and discovers that being true to yourself is the best way to make your dreams come true.
title: Cinderella II: Dreams Come True
plot:
Cinderella II: Dreams Come True is a direct-to-video animated film produced by Disney Television Animation, released in 2002. The movie serves as a sequel to the classic Disney fairy tale Cinderella.

The story begins with Cinderella (Cindy) living happily ever after with her Prince Charming and their two children, Jaq and Gus's descendants, but also with the help of her mice friends, Jaq and Gus. However, Cindy starts to feel like she is losing touch with her own identity and desires as a young woman.

Meanwhile, Lady Tremaine (Cinderella's evil stepmother) has grown old and frail, but still harbors resentment towards Cinderella for outsmarting her in the past. She plots to take revenge on Cindy by stealing the magical wand that gave her the power to transform into a beautiful princess.

As Cindy tries to find her place in the world, she meets a young woman named Perla, who is also searching for her own identity and sense of purpose. The two become fast friends and start to explore their passions and interests together.

However, Lady Tremaine's plan comes to fruition when she steals the magical wand, which Cindy had kept as a memento from her fairy godmother. With the wand in hand, Lady Tremaine sets out to ruin Cinderella's life once again.

Cindy and Perla team up to stop Lady Tremaine and retrieve the wand. Along the way, they learn valuable lessons about friendship, perseverance, and believing in oneself. In the end, Cindy and her friends successfully defeat Lady Tremaine, and she is punished for her evil deeds.

The movie ends with Cinderella and Perla reflecting on their journey and realizing that true happiness comes from within. The film concludes with a heartwarming moment of Cindy and her family enjoying quality time together, surrounded by the magic of their own happily ever after.

Overall, Cinderella II: Dreams Come True is a charming and entertaining sequel that explores themes of identity, friendship, and self-discovery. While it may not be as iconic as its predecessor, the film remains a delightful addition to the Disney canon, offering a fresh perspective on the beloved Cinderella story.

overview: Molly Bloom, a young skier and former Olympic hopeful becomes a successful entrepreneur (and a target of an FBI investigation) when she establishes a high-stakes, international poker game.
tagline: Deal with her.
title: Molly's Game
plot:
Molly's Game is a biographical sports drama film directed by Aaron Sorkin, released in 2017. The movie is based on the life of Molly Bloom, a former Olympic skier and entrepreneur who ran an underground poker game for Hollywood celebrities.

The film begins with Molly Bloom (played by Jessica Chastain), a talented young figure skater who competes at the highest level before suffering an injury that forces her to reevaluate her life. She eventually becomes involved in the world of high-stakes poker, using her charm and charisma to attract wealthy clients, including celebrities like Tobey Maguire, Idris Elba, and Justin Theroux.

As Molly's business grows, she attracts the attention of law enforcement, who begin to crack down on her operation. Despite the risks, Molly continues to run her game, which becomes a lucrative venture that allows her to live a life of luxury and freedom.

However, Molly's world begins to unravel when she is arrested by FBI Agent Aaron Sorkin (played by Michael Cera), who is also a friend from her past. As the investigation unfolds, Molly must navigate the complexities of her relationships with her clients, her business partners, and the law enforcement agencies that are closing in on her.

Throughout the film, Sorkin's script explores themes of identity, community, and the human need for connection and belonging. Molly's game becomes a symbol of her own personal freedom and autonomy, as well as a way to connect with others who share similar values and desires.

As the story unfolds, Molly faces a series of challenges that test her resolve and force her to confront the consequences of her actions. In the end, she is sentenced to prison, but not before using her experience to advocate for the rights of sex workers and entrepreneurs who operate in the gray areas of the law.

The film features an ensemble cast, including Kevin Costner as Phil Raskin, Molly's lawyer, and Bill Irwin as FBI Agent Tom Wheeler. The movie received widespread critical acclaim, with many praising Chastain's performance as a tour-de-force portrayal of a complex and multifaceted character.

Overall, Molly's Game is a thought-provoking and engaging film that explores the complexities of human relationships and the power of community in the face of adversity. With its strong performances, witty dialogue, and nuanced exploration of themes, it is a must-see for fans of drama and sports movies alike.

overview: A disgruntled former employee hijacks the Seabourn Legend cruise liner. Set on a fixed course, without any means of communication and at the mercy of the hijacker, it's up to the one cop on vacation, and his soon to be fiancé (hopefully) Annie, to regain control of it before it kills the passengers and causes an environmental disaster. Insurmountable and daunting tasks awaits them on their  perilous journey throughout the ship trying to fend off the hijacker and save the passengers.
tagline: As the stakes get higher, the ride gets even faster.
title: Speed 2: Cruise Control
plot:
Speed 2: Cruise Control is a 1997 American action thriller produced and directed by Jan de Bont from a screenplay by Randall McCormick and Jeff Nathanson. A sequel to Speed (1994), it stars Sandra Bullock, reprising her role as Annie Porter, alongside Jason Patric and Willem Dafoe, with Temuera Morrison and Mike Hagerty in supporting roles. Released by 20th Century Fox on June 13, 1997, it moves the action from a Los Angeles bus to a luxury cruise liner in the Caribbean.

Annie, who survived the runaway bus of the first film, has since broken up with Jack Traven and is now dating Alex Shaw, a police officer she believes works on a bicycle patrol but who is actually a member of an elite SWAT team. Hoping to smooth over his secret and propose, Alex takes Annie on a Caribbean cruise aboard the Seabourn Legend. Also on board is John Geiger, a brilliant but unstable computer engineer who designed the ship's navigation systems. After developing copper poisoning from years of working on electronics, he was fired by the cruise line, and he now seeks revenge and a fortune in jewels being carried aboard.

Geiger seizes control of the ship's computers, forcing an evacuation and sending the liner careering across the sea with Annie, Alex and a handful of passengers still on board, including a young deaf girl. Working with the ship's first officer, Juliano, Alex and Annie race to regain control as Geiger sabotages the vessel and sets it on a collision course with an oil tanker. Alex dives beneath the hull to jam the propellers, narrowly averting the tanker disaster, but the ship plows straight into the harbor of the island of Saint Martin. Geiger escapes with Annie as a hostage in a seaplane, and Alex pursues them on a speedboat for the final showdown.

De Bont said the idea came from a recurring nightmare about a ship crashing into an island. Keanu Reeves declined to return as Jack, so the script was reworked around a new hero played by Patric. Filming took place largely aboard the Seabourn Legend, with interiors shot on Los Angeles soundstages, and the climactic crash into Saint Martin consumed nearly a quarter of the budget, becoming one of the most expensive stunts ever filmed. Mark Mancina returned to compose the score. The film was a critical and commercial disappointment, widely ranked among the worst sequels ever made, and it received several Golden Raspberry Awards, including Worst Remake or Sequel.

overview: A football player and his mates travel to the planet Mongo and find themselves fighting the tyranny of Ming the Merciless to save Earth.
tagline: He'll save every one of us!
title: Flash Gordon
plot:
"Flash Gordon" (1980) is a science fiction film directed by Mike Hodges, produced by Dino De Laurentiis, and starring Sam J. Jones as the titular character. The movie is loosely based on the classic comic strip created by Alex Raymond.

The main themes of "Flash Gordon" can be broken down into several key elements:

1. **Good vs. Evil**: The film's central conflict revolves around the struggle between good and evil, with Flash Gordon representing the heroic values of courage, honor, and justice. His arch-nemesis, Ming the Merciless (played by Max von Sydow), embodies the dark forces of tyranny, oppression, and destruction.
2. **Personal Growth**: Throughout the story, Flash Gordon undergoes significant personal growth as he navigates the challenges of his quest to save the world from Ming's evil plans. He learns valuable lessons about leadership, friendship, and self-sacrifice.
3. **Friendship and Loyalty**: The bond between Flash Gordon and his companions, including Dale Arden (played by Ornella Muti) and Prince Barin (played by Melody Anderson), is a crucial aspect of the film's narrative. Their loyalty and trust in each other serve as a source of strength and inspiration throughout their perilous journey.
4. **Science Fiction Commentary**: The movie can be seen as a commentary on the Cold War era, with Ming's totalitarian regime serving as a metaphor for the dangers of authoritarianism and the importance of individual freedom. The film also explores themes of technological advancement, space exploration, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control.
5. **Campy Humor and Over-the-Top Action**: "Flash Gordon" is known for its campy humor, over-the-top action sequences, and memorable characters, which have become iconic in popular culture.

Overall, "Flash Gordon" (1980) is a classic science fiction film that combines elements of adventure, fantasy, and social commentary, with a healthy dose of humor and excitement.

overview: An advertising creative in a rut finds his life turned upside down when he discovers his ability to write his wishes into reality.
title: Odnoklassniki.ru: The Magic Laptop
plot:
Odnoklassniki.ru: The Magic Laptop (Russian: Odnoklassniki.ru: NaCLICKay udachu) is a 2013 Russian fantasy romantic comedy directed by Pavel Khudyakov, a cinematographer and music video director. The title sponsor, the Russian social network Odnoklassniki, appears in the film's name. Pyotr Fyodorov plays the hero, Lyosha, with Kornelia Polyak, the director's wife and a producer of the film, as his love interest and Fyodor Bondarchuk in a caricatured supporting role, alongside Sergey Druzyak and Zhanna Friske, in her last film role; the American rapper Snoop Dogg appears as himself. The screenplay was written by a team of former Comedy Club humorists, including Tair Mamedov and the film received backing from the Russian Cinema Fund.

Lyosha is a talented young advertising creative who has come to conquer Moscow, but nothing is going his way. He has no work, no money for rent and no personal life, his parents nag him, and a project he spent a year on has found no takers. At a casting session at an advertising agency, he makes a poor impression, arriving badly dressed, unsure of himself and carrying a broken laptop. Then things get worse: he is fined for parking, evicted from his flat and left to haul his sofa to a park with a friend, where he dreams of being able to solve every problem with the press of a single button. Luck comes from an unexpected direction when he meets a mysterious figure, Snoop Dogg himself, who gives him a magic laptop. Whatever Lyosha writes as a status on his social network page immediately comes true. He gains money, an expensive car, new clothes, a house and travel, and even becomes the boss of the agency that refused to hire him. The one thing the computer cannot give him is real love, which he must find without search queries, and he learns that everything in life has its price.

The film was released in Russia on 12 December 2013. Russian critics treated it as a light diversion. Yevgeny Ukhov of Film.ru called it a frivolous, disposable comedy with a very obvious, rather adolescent moral that could amuse undemanding viewers, finding the scenes in which Lyosha discovers the laptop's powers the funniest but the selfish hero hard to sympathize with, and singling out Bondarchuk's caricatured character as the liveliest presence. Kinoafisha's editor compared the story to Pushkin's fairy tale of the fisherman and the fish for today's youth, while Kino Mail.ru noted parallels with Bruce Almighty.

overview: A rebellious teenage boy, struggling with his parent's imminent divorce, encounters a terrifying evil after his next-door neighbor becomes possessed by an ancient witch that feasts on children.
tagline: What is forgotten will never be found.
title: The Wretched
plot:
The Wretched is a 2020 American supernatural horror film directed by Ryan Spindell. The movie follows a young woman named Bee, who finds herself trapped in a mysterious and eerie world filled with supernatural creatures.

At its core, The Wretched explores the themes of isolation, loneliness, and the struggle for human connection in a desolate environment. Bee's journey is marked by her desperate attempts to find solace and companionship in a world that seems determined to crush her spirits. As she navigates this treacherous landscape, she must confront the darkness within herself and the true nature of her surroundings.

The film also delves into the idea of the "other," highlighting the ways in which societal norms and expectations can marginalize and exclude those who are perceived as different or threatening. Bee's experiences serve as a powerful commentary on the dangers of xenophobia, prejudice, and the dehumanizing effects of fear and mistrust.

Furthermore, The Wretched touches on the theme of female empowerment, as Bee finds herself at the center of a maelstrom of supernatural forces that seek to exploit her vulnerability. Through her struggles, she discovers a sense of resilience and determination that allows her to resist the oppressive forces arrayed against her.

Ultimately, The Wretched is a haunting and unsettling film that probes the darkest recesses of the human experience, revealing the ways in which our deepest fears can both consume us and ultimately set us free.

overview: In the bustling human world, spirits live peacefully with mankind. Luo Xiaohei, a young cat spirit, becomes a nomad after his forest home is destroyed. His natural talent soon attracts spirits and humans alike, but all of them have their own motivations.
production_companies: Beijing Hanmu Chunhua Animation Technology Co., Ltd.
tagline: Protector of Spirits.
title: The Legend of Hei
plot:
The Legend of Hei (Chinese: 罗小黑战记, Luó Xiǎohēi Zhàn Jì) is a 2019 Chinese animated fantasy action film directed by Zhang Ping, known professionally as MTJJ, who co-wrote it with Kexin Peng. It is a prequel to The Legend of Luo Xiaohei, the popular Flash-animated web series MTJJ began in 2011, and it tells the earlier story of its title character, a young cat spirit. The Chinese voice cast is led by Shan Xin as Hei, Liu Mingyue as the human warrior Wuxian (Infinity) and Hao Xianghai as the spirit Fengxi (Stormend).

The film is set in a modern world where spirits and humans have both fought and coexisted for centuries, with many ancient spirits either hiding from civilization or blending into it. Hei, who can shift between the form of a small black kitten, a large ferocious cat and a boy with cat ears and a tail, is woken in his forest by the noise of machines as loggers clear his home. Overpowered while trying to resist, he finds himself adrift in the human world, scavenging and stealing food from town to town. When a gang of teenagers corners him one night, he is rescued by Stormend, a powerful spirit who takes him to a hidden forest refuge and introduces him to fellow spirits who share a hatred of humans. Hei at last feels he has found a family.

The next day the group is attacked by Infinity, a formidable human with powers like theirs, who separates Hei from the others and takes him captive, intending to bring him to the Guild, a council that oversees relations between humans and spirits. On the long journey to its headquarters the two gradually warm to each other. Infinity trains Hei to harness his latent abilities, shows him better sides of human life, and tells him that Stormend's aim is to destroy humanity. As Stormend's plans escalate into open conflict with the Guild, Hei is forced to choose between the friend who sheltered him and the mentor who has taught him to question revenge.

The Legend of Hei opened in China in September 2019; a Japanese-dubbed version followed a month later through Toho, and Shout! Studios released an English dub in North America in 2021. Critics praised its fast, inventive action, comic timing, world-building and morally ambiguous treatment of its environmental themes, comparing it to Studio Ghibli and Avatar: The Last Airbender, while noting rushed pacing and many late, unexplained characters. A sequel, The Legend of Hei II, was released in 2025.

overview: Aaron Falk returns to his drought-stricken hometown to attend a tragic funeral. But his return opens a decades-old wound - the unsolved death of a teenage girl.
tagline: Where the truth lies.
title: The Dry
plot:
The Dry is a 2020 Australian crime drama film directed by Robert Connolly, based on the novel of the same name by Jane Harper.

The main themes of The Dry include:

1. **Grief and Loss**: The story revolves around Aaron Falk, a detective who returns to his hometown of Kiewa Valley in Victoria, Australia, after his mother's death. His journey is also a metaphor for his own grief and loss, as he tries to come to terms with the past and find closure.

2. **Trauma and PTSD**: The film explores the psychological effects of trauma on its characters, particularly Aaron Falk, who has been struggling with PTSD since his mother's death. The story delves into the long-term consequences of traumatic events and how they can shape a person's life.

3. **Small-town Secrets and Lies**: The Dry is set in a small town where everyone knows each other's secrets. The film exposes the dark underbelly of this seemingly idyllic community, revealing a web of lies, deceit, and corruption that threatens to destroy the lives of its residents.

4. **Justice and Redemption**: As Aaron Falk delves deeper into the mystery, he becomes determined to uncover the truth and bring justice to those responsible for his mother's death. The film explores themes of redemption and the pursuit of justice in a community where the law is often seen as being on the side of the powerful.

5. **Isolation and Loneliness**: The Dry features a protagonist who is both physically and emotionally isolated. Aaron Falk's return to his hometown forces him to confront his past and re-evaluate his relationships, highlighting the tension between solitude and human connection.

Overall, The Dry is a gripping drama that explores complex themes and characters, weaving together elements of mystery, crime, and psychological suspense to create a compelling narrative.

overview: Struggling to cope after a move to the city with his mother, Elmer runs away in search of Wild Island and a young dragon who waits to be rescued. Elmer’s adventures introduce him to ferocious beasts, a mysterious island and the friendship of a lifetime.
title: My Father's Dragon
plot:
My Father's Dragon is a 2022 American computer-animated adventure comedy-drama film directed by Jorell Lorraine, and produced by Mockingbird Pictures. The movie is based on the children's novel of the same name written by Richard and Rosemary Salkeld.

The story revolves around Elmer Elevator Jr., a young boy who lives in a small village with his mother. Elmer's life changes when he befriends a dragon named Boris, who has been separated from its owner, a kind old man. The old man is being held captive by the ruthless and cunning Viking-like warrior, Prince Gruogard.

Elmer decides to rescue the old man and sets out on an epic journey with Boris by his side. Along the way, they face numerous challenges, including treacherous landscapes, fierce creatures, and treacherous foes. Elmer learns valuable lessons about bravery, loyalty, and the importance of standing up for what is right.

Throughout their adventure, Elmer and Boris develop a strong bond, which becomes the foundation of their friendship. The film showcases stunning animation, with vibrant colors and intricate details that bring the characters and world to life.

One of the standout aspects of My Father's Dragon is its themes of empathy, understanding, and acceptance.
