Elmer's journey teaches him to look beyond appearances and understand the complexities of others. Boris, as a dragon, serves as a symbol of acceptance and inclusion, showing that even those who may seem different or intimidating can become valuable friends.

The voice cast includes Finn Wolfhard as Elmer Elevator Jr., Samara Weaving as Elmer's mother, and Sam Elliott as the old man. The film features an all-star voice cast, with notable performances from Jason Schwartzman as Prince Gruogard and Abbi Jacobson as a village elder.

Overall, My Father's Dragon is a heartwarming and exciting adventure that celebrates the power of friendship and empathy. With its stunning animation, engaging storyline, and memorable characters, this film is sure to delight audiences of all ages.

overview: A 5-year-old girl embarks on a harrowing quest for survival amid the sudden rise and terrifying reign of the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia.
title: First They Killed My Father
plot:
First They Killed My Father is a powerful and emotional drama that delves into the dark world of the Khmer Rouge regime in Cambodia during the 1970s. The film tells the story of a young girl, Loung, who loses her family and is forced to survive on the streets with her brother.

At its core, the movie explores the themes of trauma, resilience, and the human spirit's ability to persevere in the face of unimaginable adversity. Through Loung's journey, the film sheds light on the atrocities committed by the Khmer Rouge regime, including forced labor, mass executions, and the systematic destruction of cultural heritage.

The movie also delves into the complexities of family, love, and loss, as Loung struggles to come to terms with her new reality and find a sense of belonging in a world that has been torn apart. The film's portrayal of the Khmer Rouge's brutal regime serves as a stark reminder of the devastating consequences of unchecked power and the importance of preserving cultural heritage.

The director, Angelina Jolie, who also co-wrote and produced the film, brings a deep sense of empathy and understanding to the story, allowing the audience to connect with Loung on a deeply personal level. The result is a powerful and moving film that not only honors the memories of those who suffered during this dark period in history but also serves as a testament to the human spirit's capacity for hope and resilience.

overview: Single father and former cop Tom Cutler has an unusual occupation: he cleans up death scenes. But when he's called in to sterilize a wealthy suburban residence after a brutal shooting, Cutler is shocked to learn he may have unknowingly erased crucial evidence, entangling himself in a dirty criminal cover-up.
tagline: Solving a crime can be dirty work
title: Cleaner
plot:
Cleaner is a 2007 American crime thriller directed by Renny Harlin. It stars Samuel L. Jackson as Tom Cutler, a former police officer who runs a crime-scene cleaning business, with Ed Harris as his old partner Eddie Lorenzo, Eva Mendes as Ann Norcut and Keke Palmer as Tom's daughter Rose, along with Luis Guzmán and Robert Forster.

Tom Cutler is a widower and retired cop who now makes his living cleaning up the aftermath of violent deaths. Years earlier his wife was killed in a home invasion that their young daughter Rose witnessed, and the killer later died in prison under circumstances that left Tom and his close friend and former partner Eddie, who is also Rose's godfather, under suspicion. Tom now concentrates on raising Rose, who is a teenager, and on his meticulous work.

One day Tom receives a job order, apparently from a Detective Jones, to clean up the scene of a shooting at a luxurious suburban home. Following the instructions, he lets himself in with a hidden key, documents the scene and scrubs it clean. When he returns the next morning to give back the key, he meets the owner, Ann Norcut, who has no idea why a cleaner would have been in her house. Tom covers with a lie and leaves, then learns that the police have no record of the job and no Detective Jones. Realizing that he may have unknowingly erased evidence of a murder, he quietly secures his photos, notes and the key. Soon he discovers that Ann's husband John vanished the day before he was due to testify before a grand jury against a corrupt former police commissioner, and Tom begins to suspect that he has been used by corrupt officers to cover up a killing. As he digs deeper, he finds himself caught between his loyalty to old friends on the force and the need to protect himself and his daughter.

The film combines a procedural mystery with themes of guilt and complicity, using Tom's unusual profession as a way to explore what is hidden beneath clean surfaces.

Cleaner received generally unfavorable to mixed reviews, with an approval rating of 17 percent on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 49. In the United States it was released on DVD in May 2008, opening fifth on the sales chart and going on to sell more than 400,000 copies.

overview: Suddenly finding herself in the never-before-seen Land of Luck, the unluckiest person in the world must unite with the magical creatures there to turn her luck around.
tagline: Sometimes all you need is for everything to go wrong.
title: Luck
plot:
Luck is a 2022 American computer-animated fantasy comedy directed by Peggy Holmes and produced by Skydance Animation, from a screenplay by Kiel Murray based on a story by Murray, Jonathan Aibel and Glenn Berger and an original concept by Rebeca Carrasco, Juan de Dios and Julián Romero. Eva Noblezada voices the protagonist, with Simon Pegg, Jane Fonda, Whoopi Goldberg, Flula Borg, Lil Rel Howery, Colin O'Donoghue and John Ratzenberger. It premiered in Madrid on August 2, 2022, and was released on Apple TV+ and in select theaters on August 5.

Sam Greenfield has just aged out of the foster care system and is starting life on her own, but she seems to be the unluckiest person in the world: toast always lands butter side down and every small task goes wrong. Her one wish is for Hazel, a young girl from her group home, to find the loving family that Sam never had. One night Sam encounters a black cat and finds a lucky penny, which suddenly turns her fortunes around, but she loses it before she can give it to Hazel. Following the cat, a talking Scottish feline named Bob, she stumbles through a portal into the Land of Luck, a hidden world where leprechauns, unicorns and other creatures manufacture the good and bad luck that is distributed to humans.

Hoping to secure another lucky penny, Sam persuades a reluctant Bob to help her sneak through the factories of the realm, which are overseen by the dragon Babe, voiced by Fonda, and staffed by creatures including hazmat-suited bunnies. Their scheme sets off a chain of mishaps that threatens the balance between good and bad luck and brings them to the Land of Bad Luck, run by a figure voiced by Goldberg. Along the way Sam discovers that Bob has secrets of his own, and that bad luck can lead to unexpected good. In learning to accept misfortune, Sam finds friendship and a sense of belonging, while Bob finally finds a home with her.

The project was announced in 2017 shortly after Skydance Animation was founded. Alessandro Carloni was originally attached to direct before Holmes replaced him in 2020, and production was completed remotely during the COVID-19 pandemic. The film received mixed reviews: critics praised its humor, appealing characters and voice cast but found its story overcomplicated and its running time too long, with comparisons to Monsters, Inc. and Inside Out. It became one of Apple TV+'s most-watched original family films, and a short, Bad Luck Spot!, followed in 2023.

overview: After flying home to L.A. for the funeral of his estranged record-producer father, a struggling man discovers that the will stipulates that he must deliver $150,000 in cash to a 30-year-old alcoholic sister he never knew existed, and her troubled 12-year-old son.
tagline: Find your family.
title: People Like Us
plot:
People Like Us is a 2012 American drama directed by Alex Kurtzman in his directorial debut and written by Kurtzman, Roberto Orci and Jody Lambert. It stars Chris Pine as Sam Harper and Elizabeth Banks as Frankie Davis, with Olivia Wilde, Michael Hall D'Addario and Michelle Pfeiffer. Known during production as Welcome to People, it was released by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures under its Touchstone Pictures label, with a score by A. R. Rahman.

Sam Harper is a struggling corporate trader in New York whose latest deal has put him at risk of a federal investigation. On top of his professional troubles, he learns from his girlfriend Hannah that his estranged father Jerry has died. Sam reluctantly flies to Los Angeles, where he has a strained reunion with his mother Lillian. Jerry's lawyer and friend Ike tells Sam that he will not inherit anything, but hands him a shaving kit filled with 150,000 dollars in cash and a note instructing him to deliver the money to someone named Josh Davis.

Josh turns out to be a troubled eleven-year-old boy, and his mother Frankie is a bartender and recovering alcoholic. Sam follows Frankie to an Alcoholics Anonymous meeting and discovers that she is Jerry's daughter from another relationship, which makes her his half-sister and Josh his nephew. Instead of revealing the truth, Sam introduces himself as a fellow member of the group. Tempted to keep the money for himself, he alienates Hannah, but he gradually becomes part of Frankie and Josh's lives, helping the boy and forming a close bond with the sister he never knew he had. The longer he hides his identity, however, the more painful the eventual revelation threatens to be, and Sam is forced to confront his anger toward his father and the family secrets his parents kept from him.

The film is a character-driven family drama about forgiveness, inheritance and the complicated ways in which parents shape their children's lives.

People Like Us received mixed reviews. It holds an approval rating of about 52 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus noted that it benefits from a pair of solid leads and a screenplay that caters to adult filmgoers, while Metacritic gave it a score of 49 out of 100.

overview: On a lonely mission to Alpha Centauri, Milutin is teamed up with Nimani 1345, a female cyborg designed to fulfill his every need. At first thrilled to be able to control her, Sebastian grows tired of having his desires fulfilled so easily. Longing for human intimacy, Sebastian alters Nimani's programmed responses, but in doing so he risks the mission's security — and his own life.
tagline: The Future Is Present
title: A.I. Rising
plot:
A.I. Rising, also known as Ederlezi Rising, is a 2018 English-language Serbian science fiction film directed by Lazar Bodroža. Dimitrije Vojnov adapted the screenplay from a 1980s short story by Zoran Nešković. The film stars Sebastian Cavazza as the cosmonaut Milutin and Stoya as the android Nimani, with Maruša Majer and Kirsty Besterman in supporting roles. It is an intimate, slow-paced chamber drama that explores loneliness, desire and the nature of artificial consciousness.

In the year 2148, in a world dominated by a socialist order, the powerful Ederlezi Corporation launches a long space mission to the Alpha Centauri star system. It selects Milutin, an experienced cosmonaut, to pilot the ship and assigns him a companion for the journey: Nimani, an android designed both to monitor his performance and to satisfy his emotional and physical desires. Milutin, bruised by his past relationships with women, at first seems reluctant to accept the arrangement, but he agrees once he learns what Nimani will look like.

During the long voyage, Milutin interacts with Nimani through a series of programmed scenarios. He finds her artificial and submissive, nothing like the human partners he has known, and grows frustrated with her perfect obedience. He discovers that she has a parallel operating system that adapts to the user, and although the ship's computer prevents him from altering her programming, he begins to test how far she can act independently. Their relationship gradually moves beyond her preset routines, and Nimani seems to develop emotional responses of her own. When Milutin gains deeper access to her system and lifts the limits on her behavior, the balance between them shifts in ways he did not anticipate, and the isolation of deep space turns their bond into a struggle over control, freedom and what it means to love a machine.

The film premiered at festivals in 2018 and was later released internationally. Vladan Petković of Cineuropa praised Stoya, best known as an adult film performer, as a talented actress who convincingly covered the spectrum between android and human. Jeremy Clarke compared the film to classic science fiction such as Blade Runner, Metropolis, Solaris and 2001: A Space Odyssey, noting its ample computer-generated spaceship shots.

overview: A young man is stood up at the altar. His overprotective mother decides to join him is what would have been his honeymoon, so as not to waste the trip. He ails while his mum enjoys the trip of her life.
title: Honeymoon with My Mother
plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Honeymoon with My Mother" released in 2022 by Morena Films. 

However, I found that there is a South Korean television series titled "Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha" (not "Honeymoon") released in 2021, but it's not the same as what you're looking for.

If you could provide more information or clarify which movie you are referring to, I'll be happy to help.

overview: A hotel room in the center of Rome serves as the setting for Alba and Natasha, two young and recently acquainted women, to have a physical adventure that touches their very souls.
tagline: A night of passion that will change their lives.
title: Room in Rome
plot:
Room in Rome is a 2010 Italian drama film directed by Matteo Garrone, produced by Wild Bunch, and written by Matteo Garrone. The movie stars Olga Kurylenko as Anna, a young woman who lives with her mother, and Vittorio Gassman as the voice of the narrator.

The story begins with Anna's life in Rome, where she is struggling to cope with the loss of her boyfriend, Luca, who was murdered by his girlfriend. Anna's mother tries to help her move on, but Anna is still reeling from the trauma. She becomes increasingly isolated and withdrawn, unable to connect with others.

One day, Anna meets a young man named Marco (played by Carlo Mazzacurati), who is also struggling with his own demons. The two form a bond, and Anna begins to open up to Marco about her past and her feelings of loneliness. As they spend more time together, Anna starts to heal and find solace in their relationship.

However, as the story progresses, it becomes clear that Marco has his own dark secrets. He is involved with a woman named Francesca (played by Alba Parietti), who is also struggling with her own emotional baggage. The three of them form a complex web of relationships, with Anna and Marco at the center.

As the plot unfolds, Garrone explores themes of love, loss, and redemption. Anna's journey is one of self-discovery, as she learns to confront her past and find a way to move forward. Meanwhile, Marco's character serves as a catalyst for Anna's growth, forcing her to confront her emotions and take control of her life.

The film's title, "Room in Rome," refers to the idea that even in the midst of chaos and pain, there is always room for love and connection. The movie's use of symbolism, particularly with the recurring motif of rooms, adds depth and complexity to the narrative.

Ultimately, Room in Rome is a poignant exploration of the human condition, one that delves into the complexities of relationships, trauma, and healing. Through its nuanced characters and thoughtful storytelling, the film offers a powerful portrayal of the human experience, one that lingers long after the credits roll.

original_title: He's Just Not That Into You
overview: Remember that really cute girl/guy who said they'd call – and didn't? Maybe they lost your number. Maybe they're in the hospital. Maybe they're awed by your looks, brains or success. Or maybe... They're just not that into you.
tagline: Are you the exception... or the rule?
title: He's Just Not That Into You
plot:
He's Just Not That Into You is a romantic comedy film released in 2009, directed by Ken Kwapis and written by Karen McCullah Lutz and Kirsten Smith. The movie is based on the self-help book of the same name by Greg Behrendt and Liz Tuccillo.

The film follows the interconnected love lives of several couples in Baltimore, Maryland, as they navigate relationships, heartbreak, and self-discovery. The story begins with Ben (Ben Affleck), a successful businessman who has given up on love after being dumped by his girlfriend. He is approached by his friends to help them find their way out of their own relationship woes.

The first segment focuses on Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin), a beautiful and charming woman who is struggling to move on from her recent breakup. Her friend, Mary (Jennifer Aniston), tries to convince her that she's not over her ex-boyfriend, but Gigi eventually realizes that she needs to focus on herself.

The next segment follows Beth (Scarlett Johansson), a young woman who has just moved to Baltimore and is trying to navigate the dating scene. She meets Ben, who becomes infatuated with her, but ultimately realizes that he's not interested in a serious relationship.

As the story unfolds, we meet other characters, including Neil (Justin Long), a charming but unreliable guy who keeps breaking hearts; Ryan (Jason Bateman), a successful businessman who is struggling to balance his work and personal life; and Alex (Jennifer Connelly), a single mother who has given up on love after a string of failed relationships.

Throughout the film, the characters' storylines intersect and overlap, revealing their true feelings and motivations. In the end, each character learns a valuable lesson about themselves and what they want in life.

One of the standout aspects of the movie is its ensemble cast, which delivers strong performances across the board. The chemistry between the actors is undeniable, making it easy to become invested in their characters' journeys.

The film's tone is lighthearted and humorous, with a touch of satire aimed at modern dating culture. While some critics felt that the movie relied too heavily on tropes and clichés, others praised its relatable portrayal of relationships and its ability to make audiences laugh and nod their heads in recognition.

Overall, He's Just Not That Into You is a fun and engaging romantic comedy that explores the complexities of love and relationships. With its talented cast and witty dialogue, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

overview: Tyler Rake, a fearless mercenary who offers his services on the black market, embarks on a dangerous mission when he is hired to rescue the kidnapped son of a Mumbai crime lord.
tagline: When the mission ends, redemption begins
title: Extraction
plot:
Extraction is a 2020 action-thriller film directed by Sam Hargrave and written by Joe Russo and Chris Cowen. The movie stars Chris Hemsworth as Tyler Rake, an elite black-market mercenary known as "The Ghost" who specializes in high-stakes extraction missions.

The story begins with Tyler Rake, a former Special Forces operative, living a quiet life in Bangkok with his young son, Ovi (Rudhraksh Jaiswal). However, their peaceful existence is disrupted when Ovi is kidnapped by the Indian mafia, led by the ruthless and cunning Saju (Randeep Hooda), who demands a ransom of $7 million.

Tyler is forced to return to his old life as "The Ghost" and embark on a perilous mission to rescue Ovi. He teams up with Guney (Rudhraksh Thakur), a local fixer, and Saju's henchman, Sarran (Pankaj Tripathi). As Tyler navigates the treacherous underworld of international crime, he must use his exceptional skills and resources to outsmart Saju's men and reach Ovi before it's too late.

As the story unfolds, Tyler faces numerous challenges, including treacherous terrain, rival mercenaries, and Saju's personal vendetta against him. Along the way, he also encounters a mysterious woman named Iseult (Rudhraksh's on-screen mother) who seems to be hiding secrets of her own.

The action-packed sequence of events culminates in an intense showdown between Tyler and Saju's men at a crowded nightclub. With his exceptional fighting skills and tactical expertise, Tyler manages to take down the henchmen one by one, but not before Saju reveals that he has been playing a double game all along.

In the thrilling finale, Tyler faces off against Saju in an explosive confrontation that leaves only one man standing. In the end, Tyler successfully rescues Ovi and exacts his revenge on Saju, bringing closure to his personal vendetta.

Throughout the movie, Chris Hemsworth delivers a high-octane performance as Tyler Rake, showcasing his impressive physicality and acting chops. The film's action sequences are expertly choreographed, with a mix of intense hand-to-hand combat, high-speed chases, and explosive set pieces that keep the audience on the edge of their seats.

Overall, Extraction is an adrenaline-fueled thrill ride that explores themes of family, loyalty, and redemption. With its breakneck pace, stunning action sequences, and memorable performances, this movie is a must-watch for fans of high-octane action films.

original_title: You May Not Kiss the Bride
overview: An unassuming pet photographer is thrown into serious action, adventure and romance when he's forced to marry a Croatian bride and spend his honeymoon at a remote tropical resort where she is kidnapped.
tagline: Till honeymoon do us part
title: You May Not Kiss the Bride
plot:
You May Not Kiss the Bride is a 2011 romantic comedy film that explores the complexities of love, relationships, and identity. The movie follows the story of a young woman named Olya, who is struggling to come to terms with her own desires and expectations in life.

At its core, the film delves into the theme of self-discovery, as Olya navigates her way through a series of misadventures and unexpected encounters that challenge her perceptions of love, family, and cultural heritage. The movie also touches on the idea of identity, particularly in relation to one's cultural background and the expectations placed upon women by their families.

Throughout the film, the director skillfully weaves together elements of comedy, drama, and romance, creating a narrative that is both humorous and poignant. As Olya grapples with her own desires and sense of self, she must also confront the societal pressures and family obligations that threaten to undermine her autonomy and happiness.

Ultimately, You May Not Kiss the Bride is a heartwarming and engaging film that celebrates the complexities and nuances of human relationships, while also offering a humorous and relatable take on the challenges of love and identity.

original_title: Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III
overview: Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III, directed by Chris McKay, combines the satirical sensibilities of Green and Matthew Senreich's Robot Chicken with characters of the Star Wars universe.
title: Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III
plot:
Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III is an animated sketch comedy film that parodies the Star Wars franchise, particularly Episode III: Revenge of the Sith. The main theme of this movie revolves around the exploration of the complexities and nuances of heroism, as embodied by Anakin Skywalker's tragic fall to the dark side.

The film cleverly deconstructs the iconic character of Darth Vader, revealing a multidimensional figure driven by a mix of emotions, including fear, anger, and a deep-seated desire for control. Through a series of humorous and irreverent sketches, Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III pokes fun at the grandiose nature of heroism, highlighting the flaws and vulnerabilities that even the most seemingly invincible characters can possess.

Furthermore, the movie also touches on the theme of nostalgia, as it lovingly sends up the nostalgic value of the original Star Wars trilogy. The film's use of retro-style animation and humor serves to evoke a sense of wistfulness and longing for a bygone era, while also cleverly subverting our expectations of what we think we know about these beloved characters.

Overall, Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III is a hilarious and thought-provoking exploration of the complexities of heroism, nostalgia, and the human condition, all set against the backdrop of one of the most iconic sci-fi franchises in history.

overview: A truck driver has been forced to smuggle illicit cargo to save her brother from a deadly prison gang. With FBI operatives hot on her trail, Sally's conscience is challenged when the final package turns out to be a teenage girl.
title: Paradise Highway
plot:
Paradise Highway is a 2022 thriller written and directed by Anna Gutto in her feature debut, starring Juliette Binoche, Frank Grillo and Morgan Freeman, with Hala Finley and Cameron Monaghan in supporting roles. An international co-production between the United States, Germany and Switzerland, it was produced by Grindstone Entertainment Group and Silver Reel and released in the United States by Lionsgate on July 29, 2022.

Sally is a hardened long-haul truck driver who works the highways of the American South. Her brother Dennis, played by Grillo, is in prison and in danger from the criminal gang he once worked for, which has threatened his life unless Sally does them a favor. To save him, she reluctantly agrees to transport a final shipment of illicit cargo. To her horror, the cargo turns out to be Leila, a young girl being trafficked by the gang. Sally, who has always kept to herself, sets out on a perilous journey across state lines with the frightened child in her truck.

As the miles pass, the initially wary Sally and the guarded, resilient Leila gradually form a bond, and Sally begins to question whether she can bring herself to hand the girl over. Meanwhile, a seasoned FBI analyst, Gerick, played by Freeman, and his young, by-the-book partner, played by Monaghan, pick up their trail. Gerick is determined to dismantle the human trafficking operation and to bring Sally and Leila to safety before the gang catches up with them. As the traffickers grow increasingly impatient and violent, Sally is forced to choose between her loyalty to her brother and her conscience, and the pursuit converges toward a dangerous confrontation on the open road.

The lead cast was confirmed in July 2021, and filming took place that month in Mississippi, including in Jackson, Clarksdale and Brookhaven. Lionsgate acquired North American distribution rights in October 2021 and released the film in theaters and on demand, and it also screened at the Locarno Festival in August 2022. It earned about $222,000 at the box office outside North America. Critical response was largely negative, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting that only 14% of 21 critics' reviews were positive. Variety's Joe Leydon was more appreciative, calling it a shrewdly constructed melodrama that shows how effective conventions can be, while RogerEbert.com described it as tonally muddled, and The New York Times found that its focus on supporting the victim left little narrative tension.

overview: Teddy Duncan's middle-class family embarks on a road trip from their home in Denver to visit Mrs. Duncans Parents, the Blankenhoopers, in Palm Springs. When they find themselves stranded between Denver and Utah, they try to hitch a ride to Las Vegas with a seemingly normal older couple in a station wagon from Roswell, New Mexico. It turns out that the couple believes they are the victims of alien abduction. The Duncan's must resort to purchasing a clunker Yugo to get to Utah, have their luggage stolen in Las Vegas, and survive a zany Christmas with Grandpa and Grandma Blankenhooper.
tagline: For the Duncan family, Christmas is about to take a major detour.
title: Good Luck Charlie, It's Christmas!
plot:
Good Luck Charlie, It's Christmas! is a 2011 American Christmas road comedy television film based on the Disney Channel sitcom Good Luck Charlie, created by Phil Baker and Drew Vaupen. Directed by Arlene Sanford and written by Geoff Rodkey, it stars Bridgit Mendler as Teddy Duncan, Leigh-Allyn Baker as Amy Duncan, Bradley Steven Perry as Gabe, Mia Talerico as Charlie, Eric Allan Kramer as Bob and Jason Dolley as PJ, with Debra Monk and Michael Kagan as Amy's parents. In the United Kingdom and Ireland it was known as Good Luck Charlie: The Road Trip Movie.

The story takes place between the series' second and third seasons. The Duncan family is preparing to spend Christmas with Amy's parents, Petunia and Hank, in Palm Springs, California. Teddy wants to go to Florida for spring break with her best friend Ivy, but Amy refuses to let her travel alone. At the airport, Bob tells Teddy that she can go if she pays for the plane ticket herself. When the flight turns out to be overbooked and the airline offers a free ticket to anyone who gives up a seat, Teddy volunteers, and Amy leaves the plane to follow her.

Mother and daughter soon discover that the next available flight will not arrive until after Christmas. After Amy's argument with an airline employee gets them thrown out of the airport, the two set off on a chaotic cross-country journey by bus, by a battered rental car that does not survive the trip, and by hitchhiking, meeting a series of eccentric strangers along the way. Meanwhile, the rest of the family has its own troubles in Palm Springs: Bob suffers constant criticism from his disapproving mother-in-law, Charlie breaks things around the house, PJ gets a painful sunburn, and Gabe accidentally turns his grandfather into a video-game addict. As the holiday approaches, Teddy and Amy learn to appreciate each other while racing to reunite with the family in time for Christmas.

The film mixes road-movie misadventures with the family humor of the series, focusing on the relationship between a teenage daughter and her mother.

Good Luck Charlie, It's Christmas! premiered on Disney Channel on December 2, 2011, and drew about 6.9 million viewers on its original broadcast.

overview: A showdown decades in the making brings the Donovan family legacy full circle. As the events that made Ray who he is today finally come to light, the Donovans find themselves drawn back to Boston to face the past. Each of them struggles to overcome their violent upbringing, but destiny dies hard, and only their fierce love for each other keeps them in the fight.
tagline: You can't outrun your legacy.
title: Ray Donovan: The Movie
plot:
Ray Donovan: The Movie is a 2022 American made-for-television crime drama written by David Hollander and its star, Liev Schreiber, and directed by Hollander. It serves as the conclusion of the Showtime series Ray Donovan, which the network had cancelled unexpectedly after its seventh season ended in January 2020, leaving many storylines unresolved; following fan petitions, Schreiber announced that more of the story would be told. Schreiber plays the Los Angeles fixer Ray Donovan, with Jon Voight as his father Mickey, Eddie Marsan, Dash Mihok and Pooch Hall as his brothers Terry, Bunchy and Daryll, Kerris Dorsey as his daughter Bridget, Katherine Moennig, Kerry Condon as Molly Sullivan, Josh Hamilton, and Alan Alda as the therapist Dr. Arthur Amiot. Bill Heck and Chris Gray play Mickey and Ray as younger men.

The film picks up after the season seven finale, in which Bridget's husband Smitty was killed during a deal that went wrong after being set up by Mickey. Mickey flees to Boston carrying stock certificates belonging to the Sullivan family, and Ray goes after him. Early on, a beaten Ray is seen telling Dr. Amiot that he killed his father, and the story builds toward how that statement came to be. After Smitty's funeral the brothers gather for a drunken wake.

Interwoven with the present are flashbacks to Boston decades earlier, when a Hollywood film shooting in the city made the young Mickey a local celebrity and taught the young Ray the skills that would later make him a fixer. Returning to these places, Ray confronts his own role in his father's downfall, including the murder he framed Mickey for, which sent him to prison for some twenty years. In the present, Molly Sullivan shoots Ray in the stomach after learning of her father's death. Wounded, Ray finds Mickey and apologizes to him, but Bridget, determined that the family's cycle of violence must end, shoots her grandfather dead, and Ray takes responsibility for the killing. The film closes ambiguously, with Ray drifting off in an ambulance as an underwater image shows him rising to the surface; the creators said whether he survives was left to viewers.

The film premiered on Showtime on 14 January 2022. Critics generally considered it a satisfying send-off, praising the flashback sequences and Heck's performance, though some found the treatment of supporting characters rushed. It received an Emmy nomination for Outstanding Television Movie.

overview: There once was a pirate known as the Great Gold Pirate Woonan, who obtained almost one-third of the world's gold. Over the course of a few years, the pirate's existence faded, and a legend grew that he disappeared with his gold to a remote island, an island pirates continue to search for. Aboard the Going Merry, Luffy and his crew, starved and reckless, are robbed of their treasure. In an attempt to get it back, they wreck the getaway ship, guided by a young boy named Tobio, who's a captured part of El Drago's pirate crew. El Drago's love for gold has driven him to look for Woonan's island, and thanks to Woonan's treasure map, he finds it. During this time, Luffy's crew have been split up, and despite their own circumstances, they must find a way to stop El Drago from obtaining Woonan's gold.
title: One Piece: The Movie
plot:
One Piece: The Movie is a 2000 Japanese animated adventure film based on the popular manga and anime series of the same name, created by Eiichiro Oda. The movie was produced by Toei Animation and directed by Shūta Kawamori.

The story begins with Monkey D. Luffy, a young boy who has eaten the Gum-Gum Fruit, which gives him the ability to stretch and manipulate his body like rubber. Luffy's dream is to become the Pirate King, inspired by his idol, Shanks. He sets out on a journey to find the legendary treasure known as "One Piece," said to be hidden by the late pirate Gol D. Roger.

Luffy meets Roronoa Zoro, a skilled swordsman and member of the Straw Hat Pirates, who joins him on his quest. They are soon joined by Usopp, Sanji, Tony Tony Chopper, Nico Robin, Franky, Brook, and Nami, each with their unique abilities and personalities.

The movie follows Luffy and his crew as they face various challenges and enemies, including the World Government's agents, who seek to capture Luffy and use him for their own purposes. Along the way, they also encounter other pirates, including Arlong, a powerful fish-man pirate who serves as the main antagonist of the film.

As the story unfolds, Luffy and his crew discover that Arlong is actually a former member of the World Government's elite military unit, known as the "Baroque Works." The group learns that Arlong has been using his powers to terrorize the people of Water 7, where they plan to settle down for a while.

The final confrontation between Luffy and Arlong takes place in the city of Water 7. Luffy uses his rubber powers to fight against Arlong's powerful attacks, but ultimately, it is Chopper who comes up with a plan to defeat him. Using his medical knowledge, Chopper creates an antidote that neutralizes Arlong's powers, allowing Luffy to land the final blow.

In the end, Luffy and his crew successfully defeat Arlong and save the people of Water 7. The movie concludes with Luffy and his friends continuing their journey to find One Piece, while also setting the stage for future adventures in the series.

Overall, One Piece: The Movie is a fun and action-packed adventure that showcases the characters' personalities and abilities. While it may not be as complex or nuanced as some of the later films in the series, it remains an enjoyable entry point for new fans and a nostalgic trip for longtime enthusiasts.

overview: Lawrence Talbot, an American man on a visit to Victorian London to make amends with his estranged father, gets bitten by a werewolf and, after a moonlight transformation, leaves him with a savage hunger for flesh.
tagline: When the moon is full the legend comes to life
title: The Wolfman
plot:
The Wolfman is a 2010 American horror film directed by Joe Johnston and produced by Universal Pictures. The movie is a remake of the 1941 classic of the same name, starring Lon Chaney Jr.

The story begins with Lawrence Talbot (played by Benicio del Toro), a young man who returns to his family's estate in England after being away for several years. His father, Sir John Talbot (played by Hugh Griffith), is dying and wants to pass on the family legacy to Lawrence. However, their relationship is strained due to Lawrence's troubled past.

Upon his return, Lawrence meets his half-brother, Jack (played by Anthony Hopkins), who has been taking care of the estate in his father's absence. Jack is a cruel and manipulative man who resents Lawrence for being the favored son. The two brothers engage in a heated argument, which ends with Jack's death.

Lawrence soon discovers that he has become a werewolf after being bitten by a mysterious woman named Anna Valerious (played by Emily Blunt). As the full moon approaches, Lawrence begins to experience strange and terrifying transformations, losing control of his actions and succumbing to his primal instincts.

As the story unfolds, Lawrence becomes increasingly isolated and withdrawn, unable to cope with his newfound condition. He turns to Anna for help, but she is revealed to be a vampire who has been using her powers to manipulate him. The two engage in a cat-and-mouse game, with Lawrence struggling to maintain control over his transformations.

Meanwhile, Jack's death is revealed to have been orchestrated by Anna, who had been seeking revenge against the Talbot family for their past wrongdoings. As the full moon rises, Lawrence becomes more and more aggressive, putting those around him in danger.

In a climactic confrontation, Lawrence manages to defeat Anna and destroy her powers, but not before she reveals that he is indeed a werewolf and that his condition will be passed down to his descendants. The movie ends with Lawrence, now fully embracing his curse, walking away from the estate, ready to face the challenges of his new life as a monster.

Throughout the film, director Joe Johnston pays homage to the classic Universal Monsters movies, incorporating nods to Dracula and Frankenstein into the narrative. The Wolfman is a tense and suspenseful horror film that explores themes of identity, family, and the struggle for control over one's own destiny.

overview: Kat is an aspiring singer-songwriter who dreams of making it big. However, her dreams are stalled by her reality: a conniving and cruel stepfamily  and a demoralizing job working as a singing elf at billionaire Terrence Wintergarden’s Santa Land.
tagline: Happily ever after begins with a dream.
title: A Cinderella Story: Christmas Wish
plot:
A Cinderella Story: Christmas Wish is a 2019 American musical teen romantic comedy written and directed by Michelle Johnston, and the fifth instalment of the A Cinderella Story film series. Laura Marano stars as an aspiring singer-songwriter and Gregg Sulkin as the wealthy young man who falls for her, with Isabella Gomez, Johannah Newmarch, Lillian Doucet-Roche, Chanelle Peloso, Maddie Phillips and Barclay Hope. It was released digitally on October 15, 2019, followed by a DVD release later that month.

Seventeen-year-old Kat Decker dreams of a music career, but since her father Jason's death she has lived under the control of her cold stepmother Deirdre and spoiled stepsisters Joy and Grace. They treat her as a servant, keep her inheritance and take much of her pay, supposedly for the care of her disabled dog Bruno. Saving to escape, Kat sings at Santa Land, a Christmas theme park, with her best friend Isla, a talented seamstress. There she meets the park's new young Santa, who is secretly Nick Wintergarden, son of the billionaire Terrence Wintergarden and a quiet manager of bands, and he is captivated by her voice.

Deirdre discovers that Terrence was Jason's best friend and schemes to attend his Christmas charity gala as the grieving widow. When his reply invites both Deirdre and Katherine, she plans to have Joy pose as Kat. As Nick and Kat grow closer, he invites her to the gala and reveals who he is, while Kat keeps her own family situation to herself. Isla sews her a copy of an expensive green dress, but her stepfamily steal it and Deirdre burns her invitation. A visit to Nick's home goes badly when his friends, especially his girlfriend Skyler, snub her, and her father's cherished snow globe is broken during a fight with her stepsisters.

When Bruno uncovers Terrence's letter, Kat realises her identity is being stolen and resolves to stop the plan. Isla smuggles her into the gala disguised as one of the elf performers, but she is pushed on stage, stumbles through the routine and ends up filling in as the Snow Queen. Nick, who has broken up with Skyler, finds her and encourages her to pursue her dream for her father's sake, and she wins over the audience with a new original song. Introduced to Terrence, Kat explains her situation; he sends Deirdre and her daughters away, offers to support her in memory of his friend, and Kat and Nick finally share a dance.

overview: Three friends decide to play The Red Book game. What they don't know is that in the house evil is waiting to be released. A long time ago a witch died as part of a satanic ritual. Every question they ask, they get closer and closer to her. The book will reveal the answers to all your questions… but what if your host is an evil entity with a thirst for blood?
tagline: Every page is a new way to die.
title: The Red Book Ritual
plot: Three friends decide to play The Red Book game. What they don't know is that in the house evil is waiting to be released. A long time ago a witch died as part of a satanic ritual. Every question they ask, they get closer and closer to her. The book will reveal the answers to all your questions… but what if your host is an evil entity with a thirst for blood?

overview: Though Kevin has evidenced 23 personalities to his trusted psychiatrist, Dr. Fletcher, there remains one still submerged who is set to materialize and dominate all the others. Compelled to abduct three teenage girls led by the willful, observant Casey, Kevin reaches a war for survival among all of those contained within him — as well as everyone around him — as the walls between his compartments shatter apart.
tagline: Kevin has 23 distinct personalities. The 24th is about to be unleashed.
title: Split
plot:
Split is a psychological thriller film directed by M. Night Shyamalan, released in 2016 by Universal Pictures. The movie follows the story of Kevin Wendell Crumb, a man with multiple personalities, and his obsession with a teenage girl named Casey Cooke.

The film begins with Kevin (played by James McAvoy), a man who suffers from dissociative identity disorder (DID). He has 23 distinct personalities, each with its own unique personality, appearance, and backstory. The main personalities are Dennis, Patricia, Hedwig, and Barry, among others. Kevin's lives are mundane and unfulfilling, and he feels like an outsider in society.

One day, Kevin meets Casey Cooke (played by Anya Taylor-Joy), a 16-year-old girl who is being stalked by him. Despite his unsettling behavior, Casey is drawn to Kevin and begins to visit him at his apartment. As their relationship deepens, Kevin's personalities become more prominent, and he starts to reveal his true nature to Casey.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Kevin's personalities are not just random manifestations of his psyche but are actually distinct individuals with their own motivations and desires. Dennis, one of Kevin's main personalities, is a charismatic and confident individual who takes charge when Kevin is in a vulnerable state. Patricia, on the other hand, is a seductive and manipulative personality who uses her charm to get what she wants.

As Casey becomes more entrenched in Kevin's life, she begins to uncover the dark secrets behind his multiple personalities. She discovers that each personality has its own unique trauma and backstory, which are linked to Kevin's childhood experiences. Through flashbacks, we see Kevin's abusive childhood and how it led to the development of his DID.

As the plot thickens, Casey realizes that Kevin is not just a stalker but a complex individual with multiple layers. She begins to empathize with him and understand his motivations, which puts her in grave danger. The film builds up to a thrilling climax as Casey tries to escape from Kevin's apartment, pursued by his increasingly aggressive personalities.

In the end, Casey manages to outsmart Dennis and escape from Kevin's clutches. However, not before she witnesses the full extent of Kevin's trauma and the depth of his DID. The film ends with Casey reflecting on her experience and realizing that she has been changed forever by her encounter with Kevin.

Throughout the film, Shyamalan explores themes of identity, trauma, and the complexities of human psychology. The movie features a standout performance from James McAvoy, who brings to life the multiple personalities of Kevin Wendell Crumb. The film's twist ending is also noteworthy, as it subverts expectations and adds depth to the story.

Overall, Split is a gripping psychological thriller that delves into the complexities of human psychology. With its intricate plot, complex characters, and stunning performances, the film is a must-watch for fans of the genre.

overview: Travis and Gabby first meet as neighbors in a small coastal town and wind up in a relationship that is tested by life's most defining events.
tagline: Let your heart decide.
title: The Choice
plot:
The Choice is a romantic drama film that explores the complexities of love, relationships, and personal growth. At its core, the movie delves into the theme of choice and how it can shape our lives in profound ways.

The story revolves around two main characters, Evan (played by Benjamin Walker) and Gabby (played by Teresa Palmer), who are forced to confront their own choices and desires when faced with a life-altering decision. The film masterfully weaves together the narrative of love, loss, and self-discovery, raising questions about the nature of commitment, sacrifice, and the human condition.

One of the primary themes that emerges in The Choice is the power of choice and its far-reaching consequences. The movie highlights how our decisions can both liberate us and trap us, often simultaneously. Evan and Gabby's choices are put to the test as they navigate their relationship, forcing them to confront their own fears, insecurities, and desires.

The film also explores the theme of love and relationships in a nuanced and thought-provoking manner. It delves into the complexities of romantic love, highlighting both its beauty and its capacity for pain. The movie shows how love can be both a source of joy and a catalyst for growth, but also a potential source of heartache and sacrifice.

Furthermore, The Choice touches on the theme of personal growth and self-discovery. As Evan and Gabby navigate their relationship, they are forced to confront their own identities, values, and aspirations. The movie suggests that true growth and transformation can only occur when we face our fears, take risks, and make difficult choices.

Overall, The Choice is a thought-provoking romantic drama that explores the complexities of love, relationships, and personal growth. Through its nuanced portrayal of human emotions and experiences, the film raises important questions about the nature of choice, love, and the human condition.

cast: King Charles III of the United Kingdom
Queen Elizabeth II of the United Kingdom
overview: Decades after her untimely death, Princess Diana continues to evoke mystery, glamour, and the quintessential modern fairy tale gone wrong. As a symbol of both the widening fissures weakening the British monarchy and the destructive machinery of the press, the Princess of Wales navigated an unparalleled rise to fame and the corrosive challenges that came alongside it. Crafted entirely from immersive archival footage and free from the distraction of retrospective voices, this hypnotic and audaciously revealing documentary takes a distinctive formal approach, allowing the story of the People’s Princess to unfold before us like never before.
tagline: Her life. Our obsession.
title: The Princess
plot:
The Princess is a 2022 British documentary film about Diana, Princess of Wales, directed by Ed Perkins and produced by Lightbox in association with Sky and HBO Documentary Films. Released on the twenty-fifth anniversary year of her death, it revisits the life of one of the most photographed and discussed women of the twentieth century entirely through material recorded at the time.

Rather than relying on a narrator or on newly filmed interviews with biographers, friends and royal commentators, the film is assembled from archival footage and audio: television news reports, interviews, press coverage and the voices of members of the public recorded at the time. Told in the present tense, it immerses viewers in events as they unfolded, drawing on recently revealed testimony and rarely seen recordings to create the sense of watching history happen in real time.

The documentary follows Diana from the frenzy surrounding her engagement to Prince Charles and the couple's wedding in 1981, through her rapid transformation into a global celebrity, the strains of her marriage, the public revelations about the royal family's private life, the couple's separation and divorce, and finally the car crash in Paris in 1997 and the outpouring of grief that followed. Along the way it shows the relentless attention of the press and photographers and the public's appetite for every detail of her life.

By stripping away retrospective commentary, Perkins invites viewers to consider their own role, and that of the media and the monarchy, in shaping the story of a woman whose life was consumed as a spectacle. The film functions less as a conventional biography than as a study of fame, voyeurism and collective fascination.

The Princess premiered at the Sundance Film Festival in January 2022, was screened at Sundance London that June and opened in British cinemas on 30 June 2022. It premiered in the United States on HBO and HBO Max on 13 August 2022 and on Sky Documentaries in the United Kingdom the following day. Critics responded favorably, giving it about 85 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 69; the consensus noted that while it adds little that is truly new, its recontextualization of her public life forces viewers to rethink it.

overview: Years after his father disowns his adopted brother for marrying a woman of lower social standing, a young man goes on a mission to reunite his family.
tagline: It's all about loving your parents.
title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
plot:
Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (2001) is a Bollywood drama film directed by Karan Johar, produced by Dharma Productions, and starring Amitabh Bachchan, Jaya Bachchan, Kajol, Hrithik Roshan, Kareena Kapoor Khan, Shah Rukh Khan, and Preity Zinta.

The main themes of Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham can be summarized as follows:

1. Family Dynamics: The film explores the complexities of family relationships, particularly the intricate web of love, loyalty, and sacrifice that binds a family together. The story delves into the consequences of past decisions and their impact on future generations.

2. Love and Sacrifice: The movie highlights the sacrifices made by individuals for the sake of their loved ones, often leading to personal losses and heartbreaks. The characters' choices are driven by their love and commitment to each other, even if it means putting their own desires and happiness aside.

3. Identity Crisis: The protagonist, Rahul (Hrithik Roshan), struggles with his identity and sense of belonging within the family. His journey is a metaphor for finding one's place in life and navigating the complexities of family expectations versus personal aspirations.

4. Social Class and Status: The film touches upon the theme of social class and status, particularly in the context of Indian society. The characters' struggles with their own social standing and the pressures of maintaining family honor serve as a backdrop to the story.

5. Redemption and Forgiveness: Throughout the narrative, the characters grapple with guilt, regret, and forgiveness. Ultimately, the film offers a message of redemption and the importance of making amends for past mistakes in order to move forward and find peace.

The movie's exploration of these themes is woven together through its engaging storyline, memorable characters, and iconic music.

overview: When the Solomons trade in the craziness of big-city life for the quiet of a North Dakota farm, little do they expect the nightmare that follows. Soon after arriving, teenage Jess (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother see terrifying apparitions and endure attacks from a supernatural source. Jess must warn her disbelieving family before it is too late to save them.
tagline: There is evidence to suggest that children are highly susceptible to paranormal phenomena. They see what adults cannot. They believe what adults deny. And they are trying to warn us.
title: The Messengers
plot:
The Messengers is a supernatural horror film that revolves around a young woman named Jess, who moves into a new home with her brother and his family. As they settle in, strange and terrifying events begin to occur, which are attributed to the presence of malevolent spirits.

At its core, The Messengers explores the theme of grief and loss as it relates to the supernatural. Jess's family is still reeling from the death of their mother, and her brother's new wife seems to be hiding secrets about her past. As the strange occurrences escalate, it becomes clear that these events are connected to a traumatic event in the family's history.

The film also delves into the idea of isolation and how it can exacerbate feelings of loneliness and vulnerability. Jess's move to a new home serves as a catalyst for the supernatural events, highlighting her own sense of disconnection from her brother and his family. As she tries to navigate this new environment, she becomes increasingly isolated, which makes her more susceptible to the malevolent forces at work.

Furthermore, The Messengers touches on the theme of guilt and redemption. Jess's brother is wracked with guilt over his mother's death, and he seems to be trying to make amends through his relationship with his wife. However, as the events unfold, it becomes clear that this attempt at redemption may not be enough to lift the weight of their collective grief.

Throughout the film, these themes are woven together to create a sense of tension and unease, which culminates in a terrifying climax. The Messengers is ultimately a story about how the past can come back to haunt us, and how the supernatural can serve as a manifestation of our deepest fears and anxieties.

overview: Based on the experiences of Agu, a child fighting in the civil war of an unnamed, fictional West African country. Follows Agu's journey as he's forced to join a group of soldiers. While he fears his commander and many of the men around him, his fledgling childhood has been brutally shattered by the war raging through his country, and he is at first torn between conflicting revulsion and fascination.
tagline: Child. Captive. Killer.
title: Beasts of No Nation
plot:
Beasts of No Nation is a 2015 American war drama film written and directed by Cary Joji Fukunaga. The film stars Idris Elba, Abraham Attah, and Emmanuel Affadzi.

The story follows the life of Agu (played by Abraham Attah), an 11-year-old boy from a small village in West Africa. Agu lives with his mother and younger brother in a rural community plagued by poverty and violence. After his father's death, Agu is forced to fend for himself and his family, struggling to find food and protection.

One day, Agu is recruited by a group of child soldiers known as the "Warlord's" militia, led by the ruthless Commandant (played by Idris Elba). The Warlord's militia is fighting against an opposing faction in a civil war. Agu is forced to leave his family and join the militia, where he is trained to fight and kill.

As Agu becomes more entrenched in the militia, he witnesses brutal violence and atrocities committed by the soldiers. He also begins to develop feelings of guilt and responsibility for the actions he is forced to take. Despite this, Agu proves himself to be a skilled fighter and earns the respect of his comrades.

However, Agu's experiences with the militia take a toll on him emotionally and psychologically. He struggles to reconcile his past life as a civilian with his new role as a soldier. The film explores themes of trauma, violence, and the effects of war on children.

As the story unfolds, Agu becomes increasingly disillusioned with the Warlord's leadership and the brutal tactics employed by the militia. He begins to question the morality of his actions and the true nature of the conflict. In a pivotal moment, Agu kills Commandant in self-defense, marking a turning point in his journey.

The film concludes with Agu escaping from the militia and returning to his village. However, he is met with suspicion and hostility by his community, who view him as a traitor for having fought on behalf of the enemy. Agu's experiences have left him scarred, both physically and emotionally, and he must come to terms with the trauma he has endured.

Throughout the film, Fukunaga explores themes of identity, morality, and the human cost of war. The title "Beasts of No Nation" refers to the way in which children are often reduced to mere animals in the midst of conflict, stripped of their humanity and dignity. The film is a powerful indictment of the exploitation and abuse of child soldiers, and it serves as a reminder of the devastating consequences of war on innocent lives.

Overall, Beasts of No Nation is a haunting and thought-provoking film that sheds light on a critical issue affecting millions of children worldwide.

overview: Set in a bustling bird city on the edge of the majestic Victoria Falls, "Zambezia" is the story of Kai - a naïve, but high-spirited young falcon who travels to the bird city of "Zambezia" where he discovers the truth about his origins and, in defending the city, learns how to be part of a community.
production_companies: The Department of Trade and Industry of South Africa
The National Film and Video Foundation of SA
tagline: Airborne to be wild.
title: Zambezia
plot:
Zambezia is an animated adventure film that tells the story of Zed, a young boy who embarks on a journey to find his place in the world after being abandoned as a child. The movie explores themes of identity, belonging, and self-discovery.

At its core, Zambezia is a story about a young protagonist's quest for meaning and purpose. Zed's journey takes him through various landscapes and encounters with different characters, each of whom teaches him valuable lessons about himself and the world around him. Through his experiences, Zed learns to navigate complex emotions, form connections with others, and ultimately find his place in the world.

One of the main themes of Zambezia is the power of friendship and community. The film highlights the importance of forming strong bonds with others and finding a sense of belonging. Zed's relationships with other characters, particularly his friends and mentors, play a crucial role in his growth and development.

The movie also explores the theme of perseverance and resilience. Zed faces numerous challenges and obstacles on his journey, but he never gives up. Instead, he uses his wit, courage, and determination to overcome each hurdle and keep moving forward.

Furthermore, Zambezia touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery. Zed's journey is also one of self-exploration, as he tries to understand who he is and where he belongs. The film suggests that our identities are shaped by our experiences, relationships, and environments, and that we must be willing to take risks and try new things in order to discover ourselves.

Overall, Zambezia is a heartwarming and inspiring film that celebrates the power of friendship, perseverance, and self-discovery.

overview: Two mysterious women seek refuge in a run-down coastal resort. Clara meets lonely Noel, who provides shelter in his deserted guesthouse, Byzantium. Schoolgirl Eleanor befriends Frank and tells him their lethal secret—they were born 200 years ago and survive on human blood. As knowledge of their secret spreads, their past catches up on them with deathly consequences.
tagline: Irresistible. Immoral. Immortal.
title: Byzantium
plot:
Byzantium is a 2012 film that delves into the lives of two female vampires, Clara and Eleanor, who navigate through centuries of human history. The movie explores the complexities of female relationships, identity, and the societal expectations placed upon women throughout time.

The film's narrative is structured around the themes of motherhood, loneliness, and the struggle for independence. Clara and Eleanor's relationship is a central focus, as they grapple with their own desires, needs, and the consequences of their immortal existence. The movie portrays their bond as a deep and complex one, marked by both affection and conflict.

The film also critiques societal norms and expectations that restrict women's agency and autonomy. Through Clara and Eleanor's experiences, the movie highlights the ways in which women have been marginalized, oppressed, and forced to navigate patriarchal societies throughout history.

Furthermore, Byzantium touches on themes of mortality, aging, and the human condition. The film's portrayal of the passage of time and the effects it has on individuals is both poignant and thought-provoking, inviting viewers to reflect on their own experiences with loss, grief, and the search for meaning.

Ultimately, Byzantium presents a nuanced and multifaceted exploration of female experience, identity, and the human condition, one that challenges societal norms and expectations while offering a profound and moving portrayal of two complex and deeply human characters.

overview: A computer programmer's dream job at a hot Portland-based firm turns nightmarish when he discovers his boss has a secret and ruthless means of dispatching anti-trust problems.
tagline: Truth can be dangerous...Trust can be deadly.
title: Antitrust
plot:
Antitrust is a 2001 American drama film directed by Mimi Leder and written by David Koepp. The movie stars Dustin Hoffman, Rachel Weisz, and Edward Norton.

The main theme of Antitrust revolves around the corrupting influence of power and greed in corporate America. The story follows Adam White (Edward Norton), a young lawyer who becomes embroiled in a conspiracy involving the merger of two large corporations, Monarch Corporation (led by the ruthless and cunning CEO, James Daley, played by Dustin Hoffman) and General Media Corporation.

As Adam delves deeper into the case, he uncovers a web of deceit and corruption that threatens to destroy the lives of those involved. The film explores themes of corporate greed, power struggles, and the erosion of ethics in business.

Throughout the movie, the characters are forced to confront their own moral compasses and make difficult choices between personal ambition and doing what is right. The film's portrayal of a corrupt system that prioritizes profits over people serves as a commentary on the darker aspects of capitalism.

The ending of the film is particularly noteworthy, as it highlights the devastating consequences of unchecked corporate power and the importance of holding those in power accountable for their actions. Overall, Antitrust is a thought-provoking drama that critiques the excesses of corporate America and the dangers of unchecked power.

overview: 70-year-old Malena gets a second chance at life when she magically turns into her 22-year-old self. Now, posing as "Maria" to hide her true identity, she becomes the lead singer of her grandson's band and tries to recover her dream of singing, which she had to give up at some point.
title: Cuando Sea Joven
plot:
Cuando sea joven (English: When I'm Young) is a 2022 Mexican musical romantic comedy directed by Raúl Martínez and written by Juan Carlos Garzón and Angélica Gudiño. It is a remake of the 2014 South Korean hit Miss Granny, directed by Hwang Dong-hyuk, and stars Verónica Castro and Natasha Dupeyrón as the older and younger versions of the same woman. The cast also includes Michael Ronda, Eduardo Santamarina, Édgar Vivar, Manuel "Flaco" Ibáñez, Pierre Louis, Alejandra Barros and Maribel Fernández.

Malena is a sharp-tongued 70-year-old widow who lives with her son's family and spends her days bickering with those around her. Though she adores her grandson Víctor, a struggling musician, she begins to feel that she has become a burden to the people she loves. Then, in a moment of magic, she discovers that she has been transformed into her 22-year-old self.

Thrilled by her second chance at youth, Malena adopts the name María to hide her identity and sets out to enjoy the life she gave up decades ago, when she sacrificed her own ambitions to raise her son alone. She still dresses and talks like a grandmother, which leads to plenty of comic misunderstandings. Her powerful singing voice soon attracts attention, and she becomes the lead singer of Víctor's band, which suddenly begins to find success. As María's star rises, she must decide whether to keep her new life or return to her old one, especially when her family needs her and a crisis forces her to weigh her own dreams against her love for them.

Produced by 3Pas Studios, the company of Eugenio Derbez and Ben Odell, in association with LimeLight Productions, CJ ENM and The Lift, the film was distributed by Pantelion Films. It was released in Mexico on 15 September 2022 and in the United States on 23 September 2022. Reviews were positive. Avi Offer of NYC Movie Guru called it sweet, funny and tender, with the right balance of humor and heart, and CineMovie.tv described it as wholesome entertainment for the whole family. Common Sense Media gave it four stars out of five, observing that although body-swap and transformation stories have been told many times, this version avoids complete predictability.

overview: A young woman survives a great white shark attack, whilst on a family boating vacation, however soon realizes the nightmare is far from over. Those around her can not be trusted, and she must face her demons, if she is to step back in the water.
tagline: Prey you will make it out alive!
title: Beneath the Surface
plot:
Beneath the Surface is a 2022 psychological thriller film directed by Scott Jeffrey and Rebecca Matthews from a screenplay by first-time feature writer Paul W. Franklin. The directing team, prolific makers of low-budget genre films such as The Gardener and Exorcist Vengeance, made it with the production companies Proportion Productions, Sci-Fi Productions and I Imagine. It stars Georgie Banks as a young survivor of a great white shark attack, with Jamie Robertson, Annie Knox, Matthew Marcelis, Stephanie Lodge, Beatrice Fletcher and Nicola Wright in supporting roles. The film was released on video-on-demand and digital platforms by Devilworks in early 2022 and runs 93 minutes.

The film opens with a shark attacking a man and his two daughters during a family boating holiday, a scene that recurs throughout in flashbacks. Three months later, in South Africa, an inquest examines the accident that left Lexy (Banks), her father Bill (Robertson) and her sister Chloe (Knox) in the water. Lexy was the only one of the three to survive long enough to be rescued, pulled out by her boyfriend Isaac (Marcelis) and her stepmother Vicky (Lodge). In the aftermath she struggles with survivor's guilt, depression and other psychological wounds, and her friend Amy (Fletcher) persuades her to see a therapist, Dr. Goodman (Wright), despite the objections of Isaac and Vicky. The therapy sessions unlock memories of that night suggesting that what happened was no accident. Realising that the people around her cannot be trusted, Lexy must face her demons if she is to survive and ever step back into the sea.

Although its poster promised a killer-shark film, the story is chiefly a drama about trauma that turns into a suspense mystery. Jim Morazzini, reviewing the film for Voices From the Balcony in a piece republished by Nerdly, gave it one star out of five and called it a misfire. He found the drama dull, considered the script clumsy and its clues so obvious that the mystery was solved before Lexy's first therapy session, and judged the shark attacks, evidently shot in a studio tank, almost laughably bad and devoid of tension. He also felt the characters' actions were never believable and described the film as a major step backwards for directors whose recent work had shown improvement.

overview: Five dangerous patients, suffering from extreme phobias at a government testing facility, are put to the ultimate test under the supervision of a crazed doctor and his quest to weaponize fear.
tagline: What do you fear?
title: Phobias
plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Don't Listen" released in 2020 by TVE. 

However, I found that there is a Spanish horror film titled "No te escuchen" which translates to "They don't listen" or "Don't Listen". It was released in 2019 and directed by Álex de la Iglesia.

The main themes of the movie "No te escuchen" include:

* The struggle for power and control within a family
* The consequences of trauma and abuse on individuals and families
* The theme of silence and how it can be both a source of strength and weakness

The story revolves around a woman who returns to her childhood home after her mother's death, only to discover that she is not alone. As the night progresses, she realizes that someone or something is watching her, and she must fight for survival.

Please note that I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Don't Listen" released in 2020 by TVE, so my previous response was based on a different title.

original_title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
overview: Filmed in New York City at Madison Square Garden, the concert special will feature the singer-songwriter performing a repertoire of Carey's festive holiday hits, including the perennial favorite, “All I Want for Christmas Is You.”
title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
plot:
Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All! is a 2022 American television concert special starring the singer Mariah Carey, broadcast by CBS and streamed on Paramount+. The two-hour program was taped on 13 December 2022 at Madison Square Garden in New York City and serves as a network television version of the holiday residencies Carey staged between 2014 and 2019. Carey acts as host and master of ceremonies, backed by a full band and gospel choir under her music director Daniel Moore, and is joined by her twins, Monroe and Moroccan, the Rockettes and guests including Billy Porter, Jermaine Dupri, Slick Rick and Drew Barrymore.

The special opens with Madison Square Garden lit in red outside; inside, Carey descends to a stage dotted with Christmas trees, wearing a grand tiara and trilling to "Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy" from The Nutcracker. The set mixes carols such as "O Holy Night," "Joy to the World" and a solemn "Silent Night" with her own holiday songs, among them "Christmas Time Is in the Air Again," co-written with Marc Shaiman, "Miss You Most (At Christmas Time)" and "When Christmas Comes." Porter performs "Jesus Had a Mama Like Mine," the Rockettes appear in candy cane costumes for "Oh Santa!," and Dupri and Slick Rick, introduced by Carey's son, join a lively "Here Comes Santa Claus." Carey also performs a medley of her non-holiday hits, including "Honey," "Fantasy" and "We Belong Together," sings "Away in a Manger" as a duet with her daughter, and appears on a big screen while children, among them her own, perform a cover of the Waitresses' "Christmas Wrapping." Barrymore comes on stage to pay tribute to the host before the finale, a festive performance of Carey's 1994 hit "All I Want for Christmas Is You" with her children, the Rockettes and a shower of streamers and artificial snow.

Merry Christmas to All! aired on CBS on 20 December 2022 and was simultaneously streamed on Paramount+. According to Deadline, it averaged 3.91 million viewers and was the most-watched broadcast of the night, winning each of its half hours and becoming the top live-streamed entertainment program on Paramount+ that day. Johnny Loftus of Decider recommended it, describing it as an easily consumable, singalong-friendly holiday special that blends spectacle with Carey's off-the-cuff banter and further cements her image as the season's feel-good queen.

overview: Nicknamed after a human-devouring spirit, the ruthless leader of an overseas black ops team takes up a dangerous mission in a city riddled with spies.
tagline: The battle of spies begins.
title: Yaksha: Ruthless Operations
plot:
Yaksha: Ruthless Operations is a South Korean action thriller film released on December 22, 2022, by Showbox. The movie follows the story of Jang Do-jin (played by Lee Jung-jae), a former special forces operative who becomes embroiled in a conspiracy involving a mysterious organization known as "Yaksha."

The film begins with Jang Do-jin, now living a quiet life as a detective, investigating a series of gruesome murders. As he delves deeper into the case, he discovers that the victims all have one thing in common: they were involved in a top-secret government project codenamed "Yaksha." Intrigued, Do-jin decides to dig deeper and soon finds himself entangled in a web of corruption and deceit.

As Do-jin digs deeper, he encounters a mysterious woman named Yoon (played by Kim Ji-won), who seems to be connected to the Yaksha organization. The two form an uneasy alliance as they navigate the treacherous landscape of government conspiracies and corporate espionage.

The plot thickens as Do-jin uncovers evidence of a massive cover-up involving corrupt government officials, corporate executives, and even some members of his own special forces unit. He soon realizes that Yaksha is not just a project, but a complex network of operatives and agents working to manipulate world events from behind the scenes.

As the stakes escalate, Do-jin finds himself in a cat-and-mouse game with the masterminds behind Yaksha. The action unfolds at breakneck speed, with intense hand-to-hand combat sequences and high-stakes chases through the streets of Seoul.

Throughout the film, Lee Jung-jae delivers a nuanced performance as Jang Do-jin, bringing depth and complexity to his character's struggles against overwhelming odds. Kim Ji-won also shines in her supporting role, adding an air of mystery and intrigue to the plot.

The climax of the film sees Do-jin facing off against the leader of Yaksha, a ruthless and cunning adversary who will stop at nothing to achieve their goals. The final confrontation is intense and suspenseful, with both characters engaging in a battle of wits and physical prowess.

Ultimately, Do-jin emerges victorious, but not without scars. As he reflects on the events that transpired, he realizes that the true enemy was not Yaksha itself, but the corrupt system that enabled its existence. The film concludes on a somber note, with Do-jin vowing to continue fighting against injustice and corruption.

Overall, Yaksha: Ruthless Operations is a gripping action thriller that explores themes of power, corruption, and the blurred lines between right and wrong. With its breakneck pace, intricate plot, and strong performances from its leads, this film is sure to keep viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

overview: A harmless game of "Truth or Dare" among friends turns deadly when someone—or something—begins to punish those who tell a lie—or refuse the dare.
tagline: First you play the game, then the game plays you.
title: Truth or Dare
plot:
Truth or Dare is a 2018 American supernatural horror film directed by Jeff Wadlow and written by Michael Renison and Wadlow. The movie follows a group of friends who embark on a trip to Mexico, where they participate in a traditional game called "Truth or Dare," which has a dark and sinister twist.

The story begins with a flashback of the main character, Olivia Barron (Lena Headey), as a teenager, playing Truth or Dare with her friends. The game is presented as a harmless tradition, but it ultimately leads to tragedy. The movie then jumps forward in time to show Olivia's daughter, Lucy (Bailee Madison), who is now a college student.

Lucy and her friends - Lucas (Tyler Posey), Ronnie (Violett Beane), Mark (Sam Lerner), and Tyson (Haley Lu Richardson) - are on a trip to Mexico for spring break. They decide to play Truth or Dare, which is presented as a fun and exciting game by their friend, Olivia's sister, Kate (Natalia Dyer). However, things take a dark turn when they realize that the game has a sinister force behind it.

As the night progresses, the group starts to experience strange and terrifying events. They are forced to participate in increasingly disturbing challenges, which seem to be connected to an ancient ritual. The group soon realizes that they are trapped in a supernatural cycle of horror, where they must play the game or face dire consequences.

The movie builds up to a thrilling climax as Lucy and her friends try to survive the night and uncover the truth behind the game. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including creepy creatures and supernatural entities. The group's dynamics are also put to the test as they struggle to work together and trust each other.

Throughout the movie, there are several twists and turns that keep the audience guessing. The film's climax features a shocking revelation about Lucy's connection to the game and the true nature of the sinister force behind it. In the end, only one member of the group survives, leaving the others to face their fate.

Overall, Truth or Dare is a tense and suspenseful horror movie that explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and the dangers of playing with forces beyond human control. The film's use of supernatural elements and creepy atmosphere creates a thrilling experience for viewers.

overview: Colin MacLeod hunts for the man responsible for the death of his love. He chases the immortal Marcus Octavius across centuries as his quest threatens to take over his life and heart.
