In his quest, he meets a woman who reminds him of his slain beauty. But it's his final battle with Marcus that will decide not only his fate, but also the fate of everyone in the world.
tagline: In revenge, patience is a virtue. And after a thousand years, Colin MacLeod doesn't give a damn about virtue ...
title: Highlander: The Search for Vengeance
plot:
Highlander: The Search for Vengeance (Japanese: ハイランダー：復讐の探索) is a 2007 adult animated dystopian fantasy action film and an anime installment of the Highlander franchise. It was directed by Yoshiaki Kawajiri, known for Ninja Scroll and Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust, and written by David Abramowitz, a writer on Highlander: The Series. The film was a joint venture between Imagi Animation Studios, which provided the script and music, and Madhouse, which produced the animation, in association with Davis-Panzer Productions, and it was distributed by Manga Entertainment. The English voice cast includes Alistair Abell, Debi Mae West, Nolan North, Scott McNeil and Ogie Banks.

The story follows Colin MacLeod, a Celtic warrior who first dies in 125 AD in Roman Britain when his village is destroyed by the invading Romans. The Roman commander, Marcus Octavius, is himself an Immortal who dreams of building a perfect society through conquest. Octavius kills Colin's wife Moya, but Colin, mortally wounded, is dragged by his horse to Stonehenge, which, as holy ground, is a place where Immortals may not fight. There he revives and learns from the spirit of Amergan, a druid bound to the site, that he is an Immortal and part of an ancient contest known as the Game. Amergan becomes his lifelong companion and conscience, often to Colin's irritation.

Driven by grief and rage, Colin spends the following centuries pursuing Octavius through history, as the villain reappears in different eras attempting to impose his vision of order through fear and force. The film interweaves flashbacks of their encounters with a story set in a ruined, plague-ridden New York of the future, where Octavius rules as a dictator and Colin, now weary and consumed by vengeance, arrives for a final reckoning. Along the way he meets Dahlia, a woman who resembles Moya, and must decide whether revenge is all that remains of his life.

Critical reaction was generally favorable and more positive than for the later live-action Highlander sequels. Chris Wyatt of IGN gave it 8 out of 10, calling it the best thing to happen to Highlander fans since the original film and describing it as violent, dramatic, sexy and smart. Reviewers also praised Kawajiri's direction and its stylized combat sequences.

overview: Former CIA spy Bob Ho takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids, who haven't exactly warmed to their mom's beau. And when one of the youngsters accidentally downloads a top-secret formula, Bob's longtime nemesis, a Russian terrorist, pays a visit to the family.
tagline: Spying is easy, Babysitting is hard.
title: The Spy Next Door
plot:
The Spy Next Door is a 2010 American action comedy film directed by Brian Levant and starring Jackie Chan as Bob Ho, a Chinese-American spy who must balance his secret life with his new role as a single father.

The main themes of The Spy Next Door include:

1. Family: The movie explores the importance of family and the challenges of balancing work and personal life. Bob's character is forced to confront his responsibilities as a single father and learn to prioritize his relationships with his children.
2. Identity: As a spy, Bob must navigate multiple identities and personas, which creates tension and conflict within himself. This theme is also reflected in his relationship with his children, who struggle to understand their father's true occupation.
3. Loyalty: The movie highlights the importance of loyalty and duty, particularly for those in positions of power or responsibility. Bob's loyalty to his country and his family is tested throughout the film.
4. Self-discovery: As Bob navigates his new role as a single father, he undergoes a process of self-discovery, learning to let go of his old life and adapt to his new circumstances.

The plot development revolves around Bob's efforts to protect his children from a villainous character, played by Tom Everett Scott, who is seeking revenge against him. Along the way, Bob must use his spy skills to outwit his enemies and keep his family safe.

The ending of the movie features Bob successfully protecting his children and finding a new sense of purpose as a single father. He also begins to form a stronger bond with his kids and learns to balance his work and personal life in a more harmonious way.

overview: Based on the hit animated television series, this feature film adaptation tells the story of how Blossom, Bubbles and Buttercup - three exuberant young girls - obtain their unique powers, become superheroes and join forces to foil evil mutant monkey Mojo Jojo's plan to take over the world.
tagline: Saving the world before bedtime!
title: The Powerpuff Girls Movie
plot:
The Powerpuff Girls Movie is an animated film that explores several themes, primarily focusing on the struggle for identity and self-discovery among its three main characters: Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup. 

At its core, the movie delves into the complexities of sisterhood, as the trio navigates their relationships with each other and the world around them. The film also touches upon themes of empowerment, as the Powerpuff Girls learn to harness their unique abilities and work together to save their city from various threats.

Moreover, the movie explores the idea of growing up and leaving childhood behind. As Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup face new challenges and responsibilities, they must confront the reality that they are no longer the carefree, innocent children they once were. This transition is marked by a series of trials and tribulations that test their bonds as sisters and as individuals.

The Powerpuff Girls Movie also features elements of satire and social commentary, poking fun at traditional notions of femininity and societal expectations placed on women. The film's portrayal of the villainous Mojo Jojo serves as a satirical commentary on the dangers of unchecked ego and the consequences of playing with forces beyond one's control.

Ultimately, the movie presents a narrative that is both action-packed and emotionally resonant, exploring the complexities of female relationships, identity, and growth in a way that is both entertaining and thought-provoking.

overview: Jake Blues, just released from prison, puts his old band back togther to save the Catholic home where he and his brother Elwood were raised.
tagline: They're on a mission from God.
title: The Blues Brothers
plot:
The Blues Brothers is a musical comedy film released in 1980, directed by John Landis and produced by Universal Pictures. The movie follows the story of two brothers, Jake Blues (John Belushi) and Elwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd), who were once part of a blues band called The Blues Brothers.

The film begins with an elderly Jake Blues, who is living in a prison in Poughkeepsie, New York. He is released on parole after serving 20 years for a crime he committed as a young man. Jake's brother Elwood, who has been searching for him, arrives to pick him up and persuade him to join him on a mission to save their former orphanage home from being demolished.

The brothers embark on a journey across the country in a 1959 Cadillac Fleetwood Series 60, which they have purchased with the help of a wealthy benefactor. Along the way, they encounter various characters who aid or hinder their progress. These include:

* Curtis "C-Note" Jackson (James Brown), a former bandmate and friend who helps them on their quest.
* Sister Mary Stigmata (Caroline Munro), a nun who is also a blues singer and becomes involved with the brothers.
* Big Top Bill (Henry Gibson), a carnival barker who provides comedic relief.

As they travel, the brothers perform various musical numbers, showcasing their blues skills. They also encounter numerous obstacles, including a group of thugs hired by the orphanage's owner to intimidate them.

The plot thickens when the brothers discover that the orphanage is being sold to a developer who plans to tear it down and build a shopping mall. The brothers decide to perform at a benefit concert to raise money to save the orphanage.

However, things take a turn for the worse when Jake is arrested by the police, who are also after Elwood for an unpaid debt. The brothers must use their wits and musical talents to escape from prison and make it to the benefit concert on time.

The film culminates in a spectacular performance at the benefit concert, where the Blues Brothers perform a series of energetic and entertaining numbers. In the end, they successfully raise enough money to save the orphanage, and Jake is finally able to find redemption and peace.

Throughout the movie, John Belushi's portrayal of Jake Blues is marked by his signature blend of humor, energy, and musical talent. Dan Aykroyd's performance as Elwood Blues is equally impressive, showcasing his comedic skills and musical abilities.

The Blues Brothers has become a cult classic, celebrated for its unique blend of music, comedy, and adventure. The film's success can be attributed to the chemistry between Belushi and Aykroyd, as well as the memorable performances by the supporting cast.

overview: Step brothers Drake and Josh must give a foster family the best Christmas ever or face years in jail for a Christmas party gone wrong.
title: Merry Christmas, Drake & Josh
plot:
Merry Christmas, Drake & Josh, also known as Drake & Josh: Best Christmas Ever, is a 2008 American Christmas comedy television film based on the Nickelodeon sitcom Drake & Josh and a sequel to the 2006 film Drake & Josh Go Hollywood. Drake Bell, Josh Peck, Miranda Cosgrove, Nancy Sullivan and Jonathan Goldstein return as their characters, joined by Bailee Madison. Premiering on Nickelodeon on December 5, 2008, a year after the show ended, it serves as the narrative conclusion of the franchise.

A year after the series finale, Walter and Audrey leave for a tropical vacation over Christmas, leaving Drake, Josh and their sister Megan at home. Drake plans a party on the roof of the Premiere Theater, where Josh works, and Josh's boss Helen agrees on the condition that Drake fill in as a mall Santa. While hiding in his costume from an admirer, Drake makes an earnest promise to a little girl named Mary Alice to give her family the best Christmas ever. The party is soon overrun by uninvited guests, and when Josh calls the police, a mix-up leads to his own arrest.

When Mary Alice tells Drake about her sick foster mother and overworked foster father, Drake realizes he needs Josh's help and attempts to break him out of jail, only to be arrested himself. Helen, acting as their lawyer, explains Drake's promise to the judge, who agrees to spare them from jail as long as they keep it. Their embittered parole officer, Perry Gilbert, insists that every member of Mary Alice's foster family must vote that they had the best Christmas ever, or the brothers will be locked up.

The household includes squabbling twins Lily and Violet, a boy named Zigfee who speaks an unknown language, the know-it-all Trey and Mary Alice's cynical older brother Luke. As Gilbert sabotages their efforts and Megan drives a hard bargain for her help, Drake and Josh scramble to deliver the holiday magic they promised, while Walter and Audrey's vacation turns into a disaster. In the end, the brothers win over the family and create snow from grated hard cheese, and Walter and Audrey return home to join everyone playing in the "cheese snow."

The premiere drew 8.1 million viewers, a record for a Nickelodeon original movie and one of the most-watched cable TV films of its time. The film features Cosgrove's cover of "Christmas Wrapping" and a cast version of "The Twelve Days of Christmas," and it was released on DVD on December 19, 2008.

overview: After a blood- soaked jujitsu match in Dubai, fighting legend Mickey Kelley falls to superstar Blaine. But years later, an online video proves that Blaine cheated, and the world demands a rematch. Can the aging underdog get back into shape in time to vanquish his foe, get revenge, and claim his prize?
tagline: Once in a lifetime, opportunity knocks twice.
title: Born a Champion
plot:
Born a Champion is a 2021 American martial arts drama directed by Alex Ranarivelo, who co-wrote the screenplay with star Sean Patrick Flanery. Flanery plays Mickey Kelley, a Gulf War veteran and one of the first American black belts in Brazilian jiu-jitsu, with Katrina Bowden, Dennis Quaid, Maurice Compte, Costas Mandylor and Reno Wilson in supporting roles. Mixed martial artist Edson Barboza appears as Mickey's rival, with appearances by Renzo Gracie.

The story is framed as a documentary narrated by Mickey's loyal friend Rosco, nicknamed "Taco," who first met him when Mickey subdued a group of men harassing him without throwing a punch. In the early 1990s, the former Marine travels to Dubai to teach jiu-jitsu to the family of a sheikh. On the flight he meets Layla, a young woman who has accepted modeling work from a wealthy businessman named Dimitris. When Mickey discovers that the job is a front for exploitation, he rescues her and sends her home, and back in America the two fall in love, marry and start a family.

With a baby on the way and money tight, Mickey accepts an offer to compete in a small unsanctioned fighting tournament in Dubai, despite Layla's misgivings. He easily wins his early bouts, but in his third fight, against the rising star Marco Blaine, who is backed by Dimitris, he extends his hand in a gesture of respect and is ambushed with a flying knee. Badly beaten, Mickey is left with a detached retina and a damaged eye socket and is told he may never be medically cleared to fight again. Years later, he lives in obscurity, working as a bouncer and custodian and teaching occasional private lessons, while Blaine has become a celebrated champion under the promoter Mason, played by Quaid. When footage of the original fight surfaces online and goes viral, proving that Blaine cheated, public demand grows for a rematch. Seeing a chance to secure his son's future and reclaim his honor, and spurred on after a family tragedy, Mickey trains relentlessly for one last fight, whatever the risks to his health.

The film, originally titled Mickey Kelley, was announced in July 2019 and shot in Petaluma, California, that summer. Flanery, a longtime jiu-jitsu practitioner who also produced, described it in the credits as a love letter to the art. It received a limited theatrical and video-on-demand release on January 22, 2021, followed by Blu-ray and DVD days later. Reviewers found it earnest and authentic in its martial arts detail but predictable.

overview: David Cuevas is a family man who works as a gangland tax collector for high ranking Los Angeles gang members. He makes collections across the city with his partner Creeper making sure people pay up or will see retaliation. An old threat returns to Los Angeles that puts everything David loves in harm’s way.
tagline: Payback comes with interest.
title: The Tax Collector
plot:
The Tax Collector is a 2020 American crime thriller film directed by David Ayer and written by Nick John Smith. The movie stars Bobby Soto, Natalie Martinez, and Michael Peña.

The story revolves around the character of David "Davey" Diaz (played by Bobby Soto), who is a young man struggling to make ends meet in South Los Angeles. Davey's life takes a drastic turn when he becomes involved with a local gang leader named Jesse Morales (played by Michael Peña). Morales, also known as "The Tax Collector," is a ruthless and cunning crime lord who demands loyalty from his associates.

As Davey becomes more deeply entrenched in the gang, he begins to uncover dark secrets about Morales's past and the true nature of their operation. The movie takes a turn when it is revealed that Morales has been using his gang as a front for a larger scheme: collecting taxes from local businesses under threat of violence.

Davey soon finds himself caught between his loyalty to Morales and his growing sense of unease with the gang's activities. As tensions rise, Davey begins to question whether he can truly escape the life he was born into.

Meanwhile, Jesse's sister, Ana (played by Natalie Martinez), becomes a key player in the story as she navigates her own complicated relationships with her brother and the local community. Through Ana's character, the movie explores themes of family, loyalty, and redemption.

As the plot unfolds, Davey is forced to confront Morales about his true intentions and the harm caused by the gang's actions. The movie builds towards a climactic showdown between Davey and Morales, with the fate of those around him hanging in the balance.

Ultimately, the film concludes with a sense of resolution for some characters, but not without leaving room for interpretation regarding the future of others. The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving viewers to ponder the consequences of Davey's choices and the lasting impact of his involvement with Morales's gang.

Overall, The Tax Collector offers a gripping portrayal of life in South Los Angeles, exploring themes of loyalty, family, and redemption through its complex characters and intricate plot.

overview: A prisoner in a state-of-the-art penitentiary begins to question the purpose of the emotion-controlling drugs he's testing for a pharmaceutical genius.
tagline: How far would you go to fix human nature?
title: Spiderhead
plot:
Spiderhead is a 2022 American science fiction psychological thriller directed by Joseph Kosinski and written by Rhett Reese and Paul Wernick, adapted from George Saunders's 2010 short story "Escape from Spiderhead". Chris Hemsworth plays the charismatic scientist Steve Abnesti, Miles Teller the inmate Jeff and Jurnee Smollett his fellow inmate Lizzy, with Mark Paguio and Tess Haubrich. Shot in Australia in 2020, it premiered in Sydney on June 11, 2022, before its Netflix release on June 17.

Spiderhead is a high-tech island prison where inmates volunteer as test subjects for experimental drugs in exchange for reduced sentences. Instead of guards and cells they have comfortable rooms and freedom of movement, under the friendly supervision of Abnesti and his assistant Mark. Each prisoner wears a surgically implanted device, the MobiPak, that delivers drugs which manipulate emotion and perception. Jeff, haunted by a drunk-driving crash that killed his friend, is dosed with an aphrodisiac and then asked which of two women should receive Darkenfloxx, a drug that causes unbearable terror and anguish. When he refuses to choose, Abnesti claims superiors have ordered it anyway, and the young inmate Heather, given the drug, takes her own life.

Shaken, Mark begins to doubt the project. Jeff, finding Abnesti's desk unlocked, learns that there are no superiors and the facility belongs to Abnesti's own pharmaceutical company. Jeff confides in Lizzy that the crash also killed his girlfriend, and the two fall in love. When Abnesti orders him to give Lizzy Darkenfloxx, Jeff, with Mark's help, turns the tables and forces the scientist to admit the real purpose: testing an obedience drug, B-6, which had been secretly used to obtain the inmates' consent. Jeff also learns his sentence ended months earlier and that Lizzy's appeal has succeeded.

Abnesti floods Lizzy's device with Darkenfloxx, and in the ensuing struggle Jeff overpowers him and removes the vials from her. The pair fight their way out past drugged inmates and flee by boat, while Abnesti, high from his own damaged MobiPak, crashes his floatplane into a mountain. Jeff reflects that forgiveness cannot come from a drug and must be chosen.

Critics were lukewarm, giving it a 39% Rotten Tomatoes approval rating.

overview: An idealistic FBI agent is enlisted by a government task force to aid in the escalating war against drugs at the border area between the U.S. and Mexico.
tagline: The border is just another line to cross.
title: Sicario
plot:
Sicario is a 2015 American crime thriller film directed by Denis Villeneuve, starring Emily Blunt, Benicio del Toro, and Josh Brolin. The movie follows the story of Kate Macer (Emily Blunt), an FBI agent who is recruited to work with Alejandro Gilpin (Benicio del Toro), a Mexican drug lord's right-hand man, to take down a powerful cartel.

The film begins with Kate Macer, a determined and ambitious FBI agent, working on a case involving the murder of a young girl. She is assigned to work with Alejandro Gilpin, who has been recruited by the FBI to help them gather intelligence on the cartels. As they begin their investigation, they discover that the cartel is led by a mysterious figure known as "The Cartel," who is responsible for the murder of many innocent people.

As Kate and Alejandro delve deeper into the case, they realize that The Cartel is not just a simple crime lord, but a complex web of corruption and violence. They are aided in their investigation by Matt Graver (Josh Brolin), a CIA operative who has been working with Alejandro to gather intelligence on the cartel.

As Kate becomes more deeply embroiled in the case, she begins to question her own motivations and morals. She is forced to confront the harsh realities of the war on drugs and the devastating impact it has had on innocent people. Meanwhile, Alejandro's past comes back to haunt him, and he is forced to confront his own demons.

The plot thickens as Kate and Alejandro discover that The Cartel is planning a massive shipment of cocaine into the United States. They must work together to stop the shipment and bring down The Cartel once and for all. Along the way, they encounter numerous obstacles and setbacks, including corrupt government officials and ruthless cartel members.

As the stakes grow higher, Kate finds herself torn between her duty as an FBI agent and her growing sense of unease with the war on drugs. She begins to question whether the ends justify the means, and whether she is willing to sacrifice her own values in order to achieve her goals.

The film builds towards a tense and violent confrontation between Kate and Alejandro's team and The Cartel's henchmen. In the end, Kate makes a difficult choice that will have far-reaching consequences for herself and those around her.

Throughout the film, Villeneuve explores themes of morality, loyalty, and the blurred lines between right and wrong. The film is notable for its gritty realism and its refusal to offer easy answers or simplistic solutions to complex problems. The performances from the cast are also noteworthy, with Emily Blunt delivering a standout performance as Kate Macer.

Overall, Sicario is a gripping and thought-provoking thriller that explores the darker side of the war on drugs. With its tense plot, complex characters, and moral ambiguity, it is a film that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very end.

overview: This in-world short film takes place in the year 2036 and revolves around Jared Leto’s character, Niander Wallace. In this short, Wallace introduces a new line of “perfected” replicants called the Nexus 9, seeking to get the prohibition on replicants repealed. This no doubt has serious ramifications that will be crucial to the plot of Blade Runner 2049.
title: 2036: Nexus Dawn
plot:
2036: Nexus Dawn is a 2017 American science fiction short film that serves as a prequel to the feature Blade Runner 2049. Directed by Luke Scott, son of the original Blade Runner director Ridley Scott, and written by Hampton Fancher and Michael Green, who also wrote the feature, it stars Jared Leto as the industrialist Niander Wallace, with Benedict Wong, Ned Dennehy, Ade Sapara and Ania Marson as lawmakers and Set Sjöstrand as a replicant. It is one of three shorts made to bridge the decades between the two feature films, alongside 2048: Nowhere to Run and the animated Blade Runner Black Out 2022.

The film is set in Los Angeles in 2036, thirteen years before the events of Blade Runner 2049. Following a catastrophic event known as the Blackout, the manufacture of replicants, the bioengineered humans used as labor, has been banned, and the Tyrell Corporation has gone bankrupt. Earth's ecosystem is on the verge of collapse. Niander Wallace, the blind head of the Wallace Corporation, which has acquired Tyrell's assets, is summoned before a panel of lawmakers to discuss his ambition to produce a new generation of replicants.

The lawmakers warn Wallace that what he proposes is illegal and not open to debate, but Wallace argues that humanity cannot survive without the cheap labor that replicants provide. He insists that his new models are perfectly obedient and pose no danger to humans. When the officials remain unconvinced, Wallace offers a chilling demonstration with his replicant assistant, a newly designed Nexus-9, ordering him to harm himself and to choose between his own life and that of his maker. The replicant's response shocks the room, and Wallace once again asks the lawmakers whether they are prepared to authorize production.

The short establishes Wallace's cold vision and the circumstances that allow replicants to return in Blade Runner 2049, while expanding the world of the franchise between its two films.

The short was announced on August 29, 2017, as part of a series of films chosen by Blade Runner 2049 director Denis Villeneuve, and was released online the following day, about five weeks before the feature reached cinemas. Its Chinese version adds a text prologue explaining the backstory of the replicant ban and the Wallace Corporation.

overview: An epic portrayal of the events surrounding the infamous 1819 Peterloo Massacre, where a peaceful pro-democracy rally at St Peter’s Field in Manchester turned into one of the bloodiest and most notorious episodes in British history. The massacre saw British government forces charge into a crowd of over 60,000 that had gathered to demand political reforms and protest against rising levels of poverty.
title: Peterloo
plot:
Peterloo is a 2018 historical drama film that explores the events surrounding the Peterloo Massacre, a pivotal moment in British history. The movie delves into the tensions between the working class and the ruling elite during the early 19th century.

At its core, Peterloo is a powerful exploration of the struggle for democracy, equality, and social justice. The film sheds light on the struggles faced by the common people, particularly the working class, who were fighting for their rights and freedoms in a society dominated by the wealthy and powerful.

The movie also touches upon themes of protest, resistance, and the power of collective action. It highlights the bravery and determination of the ordinary people who risked everything to demand change and challenge the status quo. Through the characters' stories, the film conveys the sense of hope and optimism that defined this period in history, as well as the brutal suppression of dissent.

Furthermore, Peterloo examines the complexities of British politics during this era, revealing the contradictions and hypocrisies of a society that claimed to value liberty but often used force to maintain its power. The film's portrayal of the Peterloo Massacre itself is both haunting and thought-provoking, serving as a powerful reminder of the devastating consequences of unchecked authority and the importance of protecting individual rights.

Overall, Peterloo is a moving and thought-provoking drama that offers a nuanced exploration of one of Britain's most significant and overlooked moments in history.

overview: The true story of Texas congressman Charlie Wilson's covert dealings in Afghanistan, where his efforts to assist rebels in their war with the Soviets had some unforeseen and long-reaching effects.
tagline: When the world wasn't looking, he changed it forever.
title: Charlie Wilson's War
plot:
Charlie Wilson's War is a 2007 American biographical comedy-drama film directed by Mike Nichols, based on the life of U.S. Representative Charlie Wilson and his efforts to provide military aid to the Afghan mujahideen during the Soviet-Afghan War.

The main themes of Charlie Wilson's War include:

1. **Politics and Corruption**: The film highlights the corrupting influence of power and money in politics. Charlie Wilson, played by Tom Hanks, is a charismatic but flawed politician who uses his position to further his own interests and those of his friends.
2. **War and its Consequences**: The movie explores the complexities of war and its impact on individuals and societies. The Soviet-Afghan War was a brutal conflict that resulted in significant human suffering, displacement, and economic devastation.
3. **Friendship and Loyalty**: The film celebrates the unlikely friendship between Charlie Wilson and Gust Avrakotos (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a CIA operative who becomes his closest ally. Their bond is tested by the demands of politics and war.
4. **Personal Growth and Redemption**: Through his experiences, Charlie Wilson undergoes a transformation from a self-centered politician to a more empathetic and principled individual. He begins to see the human cost of war and becomes committed to using his power to make a positive difference.
5. **The Power of Human Connection**: The movie showcases the importance of personal relationships in shaping our experiences and decisions. Charlie Wilson's interactions with his friends, colleagues, and Afghan allies demonstrate that even in the midst of conflict, human connections can provide comfort, support, and meaning.

Overall, Charlie Wilson's War is a thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of politics, war, and human relationships, offering a nuanced portrayal of a pivotal moment in modern history.

overview: Mystery Inc. has cracked the case to top all cases! They’ve tracked down Coco Diablo, the head of a notorious costume crime syndicate. With Coco and her kitty in prison, Mystery Inc. thinks that they can finally enjoy a break. Wrong! Suddenly, menacing doppelgänger ghosts of the Scooby crew and favorite classic foes show up in Coolsville to threaten Halloween. Now it’s up to the meddling kids to unmask the latest scoundrel and save Halloween!
tagline: Trick or trap?!
title: Trick or Treat Scooby-Doo!
plot:
Trick or Treat Scooby-Doo! is a 2022 American animated direct-to-video supernatural comedy mystery produced by Warner Bros. Animation and distributed by Warner Bros. Home Entertainment. The thirty-seventh direct-to-video Scooby-Doo film, it features the voices of Frank Welker as Scooby-Doo and Fred, Grey DeLisle as Daphne, Matthew Lillard as Shaggy and Kate Micucci as Velma, with Myrna Velasco as Coco Diablo and Anthony Carrigan as Trevor Glume.

The film opens with Mystery Incorporated solving a case at a ski resort in Nepal, where a cat monster is unmasked as one of the resort's owners. Analyzing a whisker from the costume, the gang discovers that it was made from the same materials as the disguises worn by many villains they have previously caught. They trace the costumes to Coco Diablo, a high-end Halloween costume designer who has been secretly supplying criminals. Scooby and Shaggy pose as buyers to expose her, and Coco is sent to prison.

A year later, Fred, Daphne and Velma are bored and dispirited by the lack of challenging mysteries, while Shaggy and Scooby are enjoying the peace and quiet. After a minor case ends unsatisfyingly, Fred wishes for more mysteries. His wish seems to come true as Halloween approaches, when the gang is attacked at a local carnival by a ghost that looks like Fred and the Mystery Machine is destroyed. Suspecting that the costumes are once again behind the trouble, the gang visits Coolsville Penitentiary and persuades the warden to release Coco into their custody so that she can help them. With the reluctant designer at their side, the friends face a growing army of costumed monsters and investigate who is targeting them and the town on its favorite holiday.

The film combines classic chase-and-unmasking humor with references to the franchise's long history of villains and costumes.

The film was released digitally on October 4, 2022, and on DVD on October 18, 2022. It made headlines for depicting Velma as having a crush on Coco, in line with long-held fan speculation that the character was lesbian or bisexual, an idea that had been considered for the 2002 live-action film. Critics who reviewed it, including those at Autostraddle and Irish Film Critic, found it entertaining for longtime fans.

original_title: Merlin and the Book of Beasts
overview: In the twenty years since the fall of Camelot, Merlin has become a recluse known as "the wild man of the woods." He is now summoned by a charge of young knights as they quest to destroy an evil wizard who rules the land from a throne of a "New Camelot."
title: Merlin and the Book of Beasts
plot:
Merlin and the Book of Beasts is a 2009 Canadian fantasy television film directed by Warren P. Sonoda from a screenplay by Brook Durham, made by Front Street Pictures for Syfy. Drawing loosely on Arthurian legend, it stars James Callis as the wizard Merlin and Laura Harris as Avlynn, the daughter of King Arthur and Guinevere. The film was shot in Langley and Maple Ridge, British Columbia, and premiered on American television on 30 May 2009.

Twenty years after the death of Arthur and the fall of Camelot, the castle is ruled by the sorcerer Arkadian, who draws his power from the Book of Beasts, a magical tome that unleashes monstrous creatures. Avlynn sets out with the last of the knights, among them Sir Galahad, his son Lysanor and Tristan, to find Merlin, Arthur's old counsellor, now living as a recluse in an enchanted forest and known as the wild man of the woods. Merlin at first refuses to help, but eventually joins the quest to retake Camelot, which also requires Avlynn to find Excalibur. Arkadian is revealed to be Mordred, Arthur's son by Morgan le Fay and thus Avlynn's half-brother.

Along the way Merlin is struck down, and the company carries him to a legendary healing well, only to find it dry. Galahad urges them to leave him behind, but Avlynn refuses and draws water from the well with her own blood, reviving the wizard, who then dispatches a pack of Medusa-like creatures sent by Arkadian. At the Lake of Destiny Avlynn recovers her father's sword, before the group is captured by giant birds under the sorcerer's control. Arkadian tries to seduce Avlynn by taking on the appearance of Lysanor, with whom she is in love. In the final battle Merlin strips Arkadian of his magic and binds his spirit within Camelot, while Avlynn uses Excalibur to pin the Book of Beasts to a rock, saving Merlin from being consumed by it.

The supporting cast includes Jim Thorburn as Arkadian, Jesse Moss as Lysanor, Donald Adams as Galahad and Patrick Sabongui as Tristan, with Monique Ganderton, Maja Aro, Megan Vincent and Daniel Cudmore. Produced with Starz and Magical Trail Productions, the film was later released on DVD in several countries, including Japan and Germany. Reception was poor, with an audience score of only about 15 percent on Rotten Tomatoes from more than 250 ratings.

overview: Joe Dirt is a janitor with a mullet hairdo, acid-washed jeans and a dream to find the parents that he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was a belligerent, trailer park-raised eight-year-old. Now, blasting Van Halen in his jacked-up economy car, the irrepressibly optimistic Joe hits the road alone in search of his folks.
tagline: He Came. He Cleaned. He Conquered.
title: Joe Dirt
plot:
Joe Dirt is a 2001 American comedy film directed by Dennis Dugan and starring David Spade. The movie follows the story of Joe Dirt, a mullet-sporting, eccentric adventurer who sets out to find his long-lost parents.

At its core, Joe Dirt explores themes of identity, belonging, and self-discovery. Joe's journey is a metaphor for finding one's place in the world and understanding where you come from. As he travels through various landscapes and encounters different people, Joe begins to unravel the mysteries of his past and discovers more about himself.

The film also touches on the idea of family and what it means to have roots. Joe's search for his parents is not just about finding biological relatives but also about understanding where he comes from and how that shapes who he is today.

Furthermore, Joe Dirt pokes fun at societal norms and expectations, particularly those related to masculinity and identity. The film's protagonist is a lovable, eccentric character who defies traditional notions of what it means to be a man or an adult.

Overall, Joe Dirt is a lighthearted, comedic exploration of themes that are both universally relatable and uniquely quirky.

overview: After Drax Industries' Moonraker space shuttle is hijacked, secret agent James Bond is assigned to investigate, traveling to California to meet the company's owner, the mysterious Hugo Drax. With the help of scientist Dr. Holly Goodhead, Bond soon uncovers Drax's nefarious plans for humanity, all the while fending off an old nemesis, Jaws, and venturing to Venice, Rio, the Amazon...and even outer space.
tagline: Where all the other Bonds end, this one begins!
title: Moonraker
plot:
Moonraker is a 1979 spy film directed by Lewis Gilbert and produced by Albert R. Broccoli and Harry Saltzman for Eon Productions, under license from United Artists.

The story begins with James Bond (played by Roger Moore) recovering from an assassination attempt in the opening scene. He is visited by M (played by Bernard Lee), who informs him that a wealthy industrialist named Hugo Drax (played by Michael Lonsdale) has been identified as a potential target for a terrorist attack.

Bond learns that Drax, a billionaire with interests in space exploration and technology, has announced plans to build a space station called SPECTRE-IV. M believes that Drax's intentions are sinister and that he may be planning to destroy the Earth.

As Bond delves deeper into the mystery, he discovers that Drax is actually a former astronaut who was part of a secret space program in the 1960s. He had been sent on a mission to Mars, but his spacecraft crashed, leaving him with severe injuries and amnesia.

Drax has since become obsessed with the idea of rebuilding society from scratch after a catastrophic event that he believes will destroy the Earth. He plans to use SPECTRE-IV as a space station to launch a nuclear missile at the Earth, which will then be followed by a massive solar flare that will render the planet uninhabitable.

Bond's investigation takes him to Drax's headquarters in Switzerland, where he encounters Drax's assistant, Dr. Holly Goodhead (played by Lois Chiles). As Bond and Goodhead work together to uncover the truth about Drax's plans, they begin to develop feelings for each other.

Meanwhile, Bond also discovers that Drax has a personal vendetta against the world, which he believes is responsible for his own misfortunes. He learns that Drax had been part of a secret space program in the 1960s, but was forced to abandon his mission after being deemed too unstable.

As the story unfolds, Bond and Goodhead infiltrate SPECTRE-IV, where they encounter Drax's henchmen and face numerous challenges as they try to stop Drax's plan. In a thrilling sequence, Bond and Goodhead use their skills and gadgets to outwit Drax's henchmen and reach the control room of SPECTRE-IV.

In the final confrontation, Bond faces off against Drax in space, where he discovers that Drax has been using his wealth and influence to manipulate world events from behind the scenes. Drax reveals that he had planned to destroy the Earth as a way to start anew, but Bond is able to stop him by destroying SPECTRE-IV.

In the end, Bond and Goodhead escape in a spaceship, and Bond reflects on the experience, realizing that his work as a spy has given him a unique perspective on the world. The film ends with Bond and Goodhead flying off into space together, setting the stage for their future adventures.

Overall, Moonraker is a classic Bond film that combines action, adventure, and humor with a thought-provoking exploration of themes such as technology, power, and the human condition.

overview: Pushed to the breaking-up point after their latest 'why can't you do this one little thing for me?' argument, Brooke calls it quits with her boyfriend Gary. What follows is a hilarious series of remedies, war tactics, overtures and undermining tricks – all encouraged by the former couple's friends and confidantes …and the occasional total stranger! When neither ex is willing to move out of their shared apartment, the only solution is to continue living as hostile roommates until one of them reaches breaking point.
tagline: …pick a side.
title: The Break-Up
plot:
The Break-Up is a 2006 American romantic comedy film directed by Peyton Reed and starring Jennifer Aniston and Vince Vaughn.

The movie follows the story of Gary (Vince Vaughn) and Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), a couple who have been together for five years. They decide to break up, but their decision doesn't come easily, as they both refuse to move out of their shared condo in Miami Beach. The situation escalates into a series of ridiculous and childish games, with each partner trying to outdo the other in an attempt to "win" the condo.

The main themes of The Break-Up include:

1. **Relationship dynamics**: The film explores the complexities of relationships, particularly the challenges of cohabiting with someone you love. Gary and Brooke's relationship is portrayed as a mix of love, anger, and frustration, highlighting the difficulties of navigating conflicts in a romantic partnership.
2. **Possession and control**: As the couple engages in their childish games, they both become obsessed with "winning" the condo, symbolizing their desire for control and possession in the relationship. This theme speaks to the human tendency to want to possess and dominate others, even in relationships.
3. **Emotional baggage**: The Break-Up showcases how unresolved emotional issues can lead to destructive behavior. Gary and Brooke's past traumas and insecurities are revealed throughout the film, illustrating how these underlying emotions can manifest in hurtful ways during a breakup.
4. **Growing up and maturity**: As the story unfolds, both characters are forced to confront their own immaturity and lack of responsibility. The film suggests that growing up and taking responsibility for one's actions is essential for healthy relationships and personal growth.

Overall, The Break-Up offers a witty and engaging commentary on the complexities of human relationships, highlighting the challenges and absurdities that can arise during breakups.

overview: After heroically defeating both the Snow Queen and the Snow King, Gerda still cannot find peace. Her dream is to find her parents who were once taken away from them by the North Wind and finally reunite the family. Thus, Gerda and her friends embark on an exiting journey to find her parents and encounter new challenges along the way: they discover an ancient magical artifact of the trolls, the Stone of Fire and Ice. From that moment on, things don't go according to the initial plan...Will Gerda be able to tame the mighty forces of the magical elements and get her family back? The answer will be reveled in 2016. This is a story which encompasses everything you love about Wizart: kindness, bravery, friendship, mystery, love of one's family, and a happy ending, of course!
title: The Snow Queen 3: Fire and Ice
plot:
The Snow Queen 3: Fire and Ice is an animated fantasy film that explores the eternal struggle between good and evil, friendship, and self-discovery. The story revolves around Gerda's journey to rescue her best friend Kai from the clutches of the evil queen, and in doing so, she discovers the true meaning of courage, loyalty, and the power of love.

At its core, the film delves into the complexities of human nature, highlighting the contrast between light and darkness, warmth and cold. The Snow Queen's icy powers serve as a metaphor for the destructive forces that can consume us when we let our emotions and desires take over. On the other hand, Gerda's unwavering dedication to her friend represents the redemptive power of love and friendship.

The film also touches on themes of identity and belonging, as Kai struggles to find his place in a world where he feels like an outcast. His journey serves as a reminder that everyone deserves acceptance and understanding, regardless of their differences.

Ultimately, The Snow Queen 3: Fire and Ice is a tale of transformation and growth, reminding us that even in the darkest of times, there is always hope for redemption and forgiveness.

original_title: 戦慄のミラージュポケモン
overview: The story of "The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon" centers on a Pokémon scientist who has developed a new Mirage System to resurrect extinct Pokémon. Satoshi, Haruka, Masato, and Takeshi show up at the Mirage Mansion for a demonstration of this new machine, only to witness the kidnapping of the scientist! Then a mysterious stranger appears and claims that the machine can actually create Pokémon without weaknesses. It’s up to Satoshi and company to preserve the natural balance of the Pokémon world.
tagline: 10th Anniversary Special
title: Pokémon: The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon
plot:
Pokémon: The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon (Senritsu no Mirāju Pokemon) is a 2006 animated television special made to celebrate the tenth anniversary of the Pokémon franchise. Although animated in Japan by OLM and Shogakukan Production in the style of the regular anime, it was distributed by Pokémon USA and premiered in the United States on Kids' WB on 29 April 2006. Japanese viewers could only see it months later, in October 2006, as a time-limited online stream of a Japanese dub, and it did not reach Japanese television until 2010. The roughly 40-minute story is set during the Advanced Generation era of the series, and the Japanese cast includes Rica Matsumoto, Ikue Otani, Yūji Ueda, KAORI, Fushigi Yamada, Mayumi Iizuka, Unshō Ishizuka and the Team Rocket trio of Megumi Hayashibara, Shin-ichirō Miki and Inuko Inuyama.

Ash, Brock, May and Max are invited to the laboratory of the scientist Dr. Yung, where they are reunited with Misty and Professor Oak, who have also been invited. Yung demonstrates his Mirage System, a machine that can project extremely powerful artificial Pokémon able to move and fight anywhere within its range, and a Mirage Pokémon easily defeats Misty's Staryu. Pikachu notices the legendary Mew hiding nearby. Suddenly a masked figure calling himself the Mirage Master seizes control of the system, abducts Yung and Oak, and drives the others out with an army of Mirage Pokémon.

The Mirage Master demands Oak's password to his research data, intending to combine it with the system to create the ultimate Pokémon. Mew tries to help but is overpowered. Ash and Misty sneak back into the lab through an underground waterway, only to be ambushed; Team Rocket, who are trying to steal the invention, are sent flying, Pikachu is captured, and the pair are left for dead. Mew revives Ash and reveals that it too is a Mirage Pokémon, while May rescues Misty. By tormenting Pikachu, the villain forces Oak to give up the password and creates a Mirage Mewtwo that knows every move, wiping out the other mirages and easily beating Oak's Dragonite. He then extends the system's reach worldwide, and Oak unmasks him as Yung himself. When Mewtwo is about to finish off Pikachu, Mew sacrifices itself to hold it in place, letting Pikachu destroy it with its strongest attack. The system collapses, and the defeated Yung disappears as his laboratory crumbles around him.

overview: Surf's up for Barbie as she returns as Merliah, the fun and fashionable surfing champion who's also a magical mermaid princess! In this exciting sea-quel, Merliah makes a splash when she heads to Australia for the ultimate surfing competition. When the evil mermaid Eris escapes from her whirlpool with plans to take over the throne of Oceana, Merliah and her sea friends dive in to stop her. It's a fresh new adventure where Merliah learns that anything is possible and she really can have the best of both worlds!
title: Barbie in A Mermaid Tale 2
plot:
Barbie in a Mermaid Tale 2 is a 2012 computer-animated fantasy film directed by William Lau and produced by Mattel's Barbie Entertainment with Rainmaker Entertainment. The twenty-second entry in the Barbie film series and a sequel to Barbie in a Mermaid Tale (2010), it marked the return of Kelly Sheridan as the voice of Barbie, who plays the surfer Merliah Summers. Ashleigh Ball, Kathleen Barr, Nicole Oliver and Nakia Burrise are among the supporting voice cast. It was released on DVD in February 2012 and premiered on television on Nickelodeon in March.

A year after discovering that she is half-mermaid and a princess of the ocean kingdom of Oceana, Merliah wins a qualifying round of an invitational surfing competition, narrowly beating her rival Kylie Morgan, and both advance to the finals in Australia. Using her magical necklace to become a mermaid, Merliah shares the news with her mother, Queen Calissa. Calissa, however, is preparing for the Changing of Tides ceremony in the ancient undersea city of Aquellia near New Zealand, held every twenty years to bless a member of the royal family with the power to spin Merillia, the magical substance that keeps merfolk alive. The ceremony falls on the same day as the surfing final, and mother and daughter argue before parting.

In Australia, Kylie cheats to beat Merliah in the next round, although Merliah's daring handstand wins over the crowd. That night Kylie is approached by Alistair, a rainbowfish working for the wicked mermaid Eris, Calissa's sister, who has escaped imprisonment. Eris plans to steal Merliah's power and take over the ocean kingdom, and she lures Kylie into her scheme with the promise of a mermaid tail and victory in the contest. With the help of her dolphin friend Zuma, her friends and the merfolk, Merliah must stop Eris before the ceremony, balancing her dream of winning the competition with her responsibilities to her mother and her people.

Like other entries in the Barbie series, the film was aimed at young children and released primarily on home video, where it was promoted alongside a line of mermaid dolls and accessories. Its story continues the themes of friendship, family and believing in oneself that run through the series.

belongs_to_collection.name: 新海誠作品  シリーズ

overview: High schoolers Mitsuha and Taki are complete strangers living separate lives. But one night, they suddenly switch places. Mitsuha wakes up in Taki’s body, and he in hers. This bizarre occurrence continues to happen randomly, and the two must adjust their lives around each other.
tagline: It was almost like seeing something out of a dream, nothing more or less than a breathtaking view.
title: Your Name.
plot:
Your Name (Japanese: 君の名は。, Hepburn: Kimi no Na wa) is a 2016 Japanese animated romantic fantasy film written and directed by Makoto Shinkai, produced by CoMix Wave Films and distributed by Toho. Ryunosuke Kamiki and Mone Kamishiraishi voice the leads, with Ryo Narita, Aoi Yūki, Nobunaga Shimazaki and Masami Nagasawa. It is the first of what critics have called Shinkai's "disaster trilogy," followed by Weathering with You (2019) and Suzume (2022), films that share themes inspired by Japan's frequent natural disasters. The soundtrack was composed by the rock band Radwimps.

Mitsuha Miyamizu is a high school girl living in Itomori, a small rural town in the mountains of Gifu Prefecture, where her family runs the local Shinto shrine. Bored with country life, she wishes to be reborn as a boy in Tokyo. Soon afterward she begins intermittently switching bodies with Taki Tachibana, a high school boy who works part-time at a restaurant in Tokyo. On certain days each wakes up in the other's body and must live through the day as the other person, returning to normal after sleep. They establish rules and communicate through notes, phone diaries and writing on their skin.

While in Taki's body, Mitsuha helps him win a date with his coworker Miki Okudera, and Taki, as Mitsuha, makes her more popular at school and visits a sacred site in a mountain crater with her grandmother and younger sister, where they leave an offering of ritual sake. Mitsuha mentions that a comet is expected to pass close to Earth during the town's autumn festival. When the body swaps suddenly stop, Taki sets out to find Mitsuha in person, armed only with his memories of the town's landscape, and makes a shocking discovery about Itomori and the comet that reveals the two were separated by more than distance. His search turns into a desperate race to change the past.

Your Name received widespread acclaim for its animation, story, music and emotional power. It became a cultural phenomenon in Japan and was for several years the highest-grossing anime film worldwide, earning more than $380 million. It won the Los Angeles Film Critics Association Award for Best Animated Film and the Japan Academy Prize for Best Screenplay, among many other honors.

overview: Thieves attempt a massive heist against the U.S. Treasury as a Category 5 hurricane approaches one of its Mint facilities.
tagline: The storm of the century... the heist of a lifetime.
title: The Hurricane Heist
plot:
The Hurricane Heist is a 2018 American action thriller film directed by Mike Binder and starring Toby Stephens, Maggie Grace, and Ben Robson.

The movie follows a group of professional thieves who plan to steal $640 million from the Federal Reserve Bank in New Orleans during Mardi Gras. The team, led by John "Bull" Braxton (Toby Stephens), uses advanced technology and inside information to execute their heist. However, things take a turn when they discover that the true target is not just the money but also a valuable artifact.

The main themes of The Hurricane Heist include:

1. **Deception and Betrayal**: The movie explores the theme of deception and betrayal as the characters navigate their complex web of lies and alliances. As the heist unfolds, it becomes clear that no one can be trusted, and the team's loyalty is tested.
2. **Power and Corruption**: The film highlights the corrupting influence of power and wealth. The Federal Reserve Bank's vault is filled with millions of dollars, but the true value lies in the artifact, which holds significant historical and cultural importance.
3. **Teamwork and Camaraderie**: Despite their differences, the team members work together to execute the heist, showcasing their skills and expertise. However, as tensions rise, it becomes clear that some team members may not be what they seem.
4. **Consequences of Greed**: The movie warns about the consequences of greed and the dangers of prioritizing wealth over ethics and morality.

The Hurricane Heist is an action-packed thriller with a complex plot, intricate characters, and unexpected twists. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the genre may enjoy its fast-paced and suspenseful storyline.

overview: When a pharmaceutical company's illegal experiments inadvertently create a zombie, the strange Park family finds it and tries to profit from it.
tagline: What do you know about a zombie?
title: Zombie for Sale
plot:
The Odd Family: Zombie on Sale (Korean: Gimyohan gajok), also released in English as Zombie for Sale, is a 2019 South Korean zombie comedy directed by Lee Min-jae in his feature debut. Jung Jae-young, Kim Nam-gil, Uhm Ji-won, Lee Soo-kyung, Jung Ga-ram and Park In-hwan star as members of an eccentric rural family whose lives are upended by a most unusual visitor.

The film opens as a young zombie escapes through a sewer and wanders into a sleepy village. After being chased by a dog, he bites an elderly local before suffering a string of indignities, including being hit by a car, and he is finally captured by the Park family, who run a struggling gas station. At first the family pities their strange, gentle captive, not realizing what he is. The younger son, Min-geol, researches the creature's behavior online and concludes that he is a zombie, insisting that both the zombie and their father Man-deok, who was bitten, must be killed. The family is torn over whether they could kill their own father.

To everyone's surprise, Man-deok, locked in a camper van, does not turn into a monster. Instead, after a night of sweating and writhing, he wakes up visibly stronger and younger. When news of his rejuvenation spreads among the village elders, the family sees a business opportunity and begins charging the old people of the village to be bitten by the zombie. The venture is wildly profitable, though Man-deok soon absconds with the earnings for a trip to Hawaii, leaving Min-geol in charge. The family gives the zombie the affectionate nickname "Jjongbi" and tames him by feeding him cabbage, which he eats in place of brains, and the youngest daughter, Hae-geol, played by Lee Soo-kyung, grows especially fond of him. As word spreads, even younger villagers line up to be bitten. But when the incubation period ends, the rejuvenated villagers begin turning into real zombies, and the village descends into chaos as the oddball family must defend their home and their unusual friend.

Principal photography took place from October 2017 to January 2018. The film was well received, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting an 89% approval rating from 28 critics and a consensus calling it an auspicious debut that puts a light yet surprisingly poignant spin on a familiar genre formula.

overview: Department H sends in Wolverine to track down a mysterious beast known by the US Military as the Hulk, who is rampaging across the Canadian wilderness. Surveying the extent of the damage to a destroyed town, Wolverine notices a toxic scent as well as the smell of gunpowder. He is then deployed to the wilderness to resume tracking the creature.
title: Hulk vs. Wolverine
plot:
Hulk vs. Wolverine is a 2009 American animated superhero short feature produced by Marvel Studios and released by Lionsgate on 27 January 2009 as one half of the direct-to-video double feature Hulk Vs., alongside Hulk vs. Thor. Running a little under forty minutes, it was directed by Frank Paur from a script by Craig Kyle and Christopher Yost, with animation by the Japanese studio Madhouse and music by Guy Michelmore. The story draws on The Incredible Hulk #181, the 1974 comic that gave Wolverine his first full appearance, and the film shares its continuity with the series Wolverine and the X-Men.

The Canadian agency Department H sends Wolverine to track down the Hulk, a creature blamed for destroying the town of Elkford in British Columbia. Surveying the ruins, Wolverine picks up a strange chemical scent and the smell of gunpowder before heading into the wilderness after his quarry. The two collide in a savage, prolonged brawl that ends only when both are knocked out by tranquiliser darts. They wake as prisoners of Weapon X, the secret programme that once bonded adamantium to Wolverine's skeleton and conditioned him as a living weapon, scenes revealed in flashbacks to his escape years earlier. Its leader, a scientist known as the Professor, explains that his own soldiers, not the Hulk, wrecked Elkford while hunting the creature, and that he intends to erase Bruce Banner's mind and reprogram the Hulk as the most powerful weapon on Earth.

Wolverine breaks free, frees Banner and fights his way through his former teammates of Team X: Sabretooth, Lady Deathstrike, Omega Red and the wisecracking mercenary Deadpool. When the drugged Banner cannot transform on his own, Wolverine provokes the change by force, and the unleashed Hulk smashes the assassins and the facility, which collapses in an explosion. Emerging from the flames, Hulk and Wolverine square off to resume their fight, and a scene after the credits shows a battered Deadpool surviving the wreckage.

The voice cast includes Steve Blum as Wolverine, Fred Tatasciore as the Hulk, Bryce Johnson as Banner, Nolan North as Deadpool, Tom Kane as the Professor, Mark Acheson, Janyse Jaud and Colin Murdock. First screened at San Diego Comic-Con in 2008, the film was praised for its intense action, unusually bloody violence for a Marvel cartoon and Deadpool's scene-stealing humour, though some reviewers found the Weapon X backstory a distraction from the title bout.

overview: After fighting hard to be independent and happy, heiress Camille Logan finds her life threatened as a result of one of her father’s business deals. Camille isn’t prepared for the length her father will go to protect her, or for the man he hires to do the job.
title: The Protector
plot:
The Protector is a 2019 British-American romantic suspense film directed by Tosca Musk for the streaming service Passionflix, produced with Helix Media Group. It is an adaptation of the novel of the same name by the romance author Jodi Ellen Malpas, and stars Emma Rigby as the heiress Camille Logan and Diarmaid Murtagh as Jake Sharp, a former SAS sniper hired to guard her. The film runs a little over two hours and premiered on Passionflix on 28 February 2019, when the service marked the release with a promotional subscription offer.

People believe they have Camille figured out: a beautiful, spoiled daddy's girl living off her wealthy father's fortune. In reality she has fought hard to build a life free of his control. Out on her own she has made mistakes, including one that led to a stint in rehab and plenty of bad press, and she has worked her way back to independence and happiness. Now her life is threatened as a result of her father's ruthless business dealings. Caught between resentment and fear, she expects her father, a powerful tycoon, to take drastic measures to protect her, but is not prepared for the man he hires to do the job. Jake is haunted by his past: he was once distracted from duty, with devastating personal and professional consequences, and he vowed never to let it happen again. Taking on the job of bodyguard to Camille is exactly the kind of distraction he should avoid, but he soon discovers that she is not the woman the world perceives, finding her warm and compassionate, and his duty to protect her deepens into something more than a well-paid assignment, even as he believes he cannot have both the absolution he seeks and Camille. The romance develops alongside the mystery of the threats, and the eventual revelation of who is behind them involves blackmail of her father over compromising photographs.

Reactions were mixed. A reviewer for The Guide to Romance, a devoted fan of the novel, felt Passionflix had brought the book to life, praising the accents, scenery, smooth transitions and music and recommending it, while finding the chemistry between the leads weaker than expected. The PolyBlog was negative, describing a made-for-television feel with low-budget action and schmaltzy romance, awkward flashbacks and a villain's plan that made no sense, and criticizing much of the acting, though it found Rigby decent to watch.

overview: Lucas, a 14-year-old boy inducted into the gang life in Washington D.C., is determined that his 10-year-old brother won't follow the same path. When an Afghanistan war veteran comes into the neighborhood, an opportunity arises.
tagline: Every Life Is Worth Saving.
title: We Die Young
plot:
We Die Young is a 2019 American drama film directed by Kevin Williamson. 

The movie revolves around a young woman named Sarah, who is struggling to cope with her past traumas and find her place in the world. The story takes a dark turn when she becomes involved with a group of friends who are part of an underground fight club.

As the plot unfolds, it becomes clear that the main themes of We Die Young revolve around the consequences of trauma, the allure of rebellion, and the struggle for identity. Sarah's character is particularly interesting in this regard, as she navigates her complicated past and grapples with feelings of anger, resentment, and a desire for control.

Throughout the film, Williamson explores the idea that trauma can be both a source of strength and a crippling burden. The fight club serves as a metaphor for the ways in which people may turn to violence or destructive behavior as a way to cope with their emotions.

The movie also touches on themes of female empowerment and the challenges faced by women who are trying to find their place in a patriarchal society. Sarah's relationships with her friends and romantic partners serve as a catalyst for her growth and self-discovery, but they also pose significant risks and complications.

Ultimately, We Die Young is a thought-provoking exploration of the complexities of human behavior and the ways in which trauma can shape our lives. The film raises important questions about the nature of identity, the allure of rebellion, and the challenges faced by women who are trying to navigate a world that often seems hostile or unforgiving.

The ending of the movie is particularly noteworthy, as it suggests that Sarah's journey towards healing and self-discovery is ongoing and fraught with uncertainty. The film leaves the audience with a sense of unease and tension, as they wonder what the future holds for this complex and deeply flawed protagonist.

overview: Three generations of men, including a pervert that constantly seeks for new kinds of satisfaction, an obese speed eater and a passionate embalmer.
tagline: Three stories. Three generations. Three men. One bizarre and shocking universe.
title: Taxidermia
plot:
Taxidermia is a dark comedy film that explores the themes of Nazism, fascism, and the dehumanizing effects of totalitarian regimes. The movie takes place in an alternate history where Nazi Germany never lost World War II, and it follows the story of three men who are forced to undergo a bizarre and humiliating transformation into taxidermied animals.

Through this absurd and satirical lens, the film critiques the ideologies of Nazism and fascism, highlighting their dehumanizing effects on individuals and society as a whole. The movie also touches on themes of identity, free will, and the consequences of unchecked power and oppression.

The main character, Franz, is a complex figure who embodies both the resilience of humanity and the brutal effects of totalitarian rule. His transformation into a taxidermied pig serves as a powerful metaphor for the ways in which individuals can be reduced to mere objects or commodities under oppressive regimes.

Overall, Taxidermia is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that challenges viewers to confront the darker aspects of human nature and the dangers of unchecked power.

overview: Saban's Power Rangers follows five ordinary teens who must become something extraordinary when they learn that their small town of Angel Grove — and the world — is on the verge of being obliterated by an alien threat. Chosen by destiny, our heroes quickly discover they are the only ones who can save the planet. But to do so, they will have to overcome their real-life issues and before it’s too late, band together as the Power Rangers.
tagline: Together we are more.
title: Power Rangers
plot:
Power Rangers is a 2017 American superhero science fiction film directed by Hank Harris and written by Matt Sazama and Burk Sharpless. The movie is based on the popular television series of the same name, which was created by Haim Saban and Shuki Levy.

The story begins with Jason (Dacre Montgomery), Zack (Nikola Zirgos), Trini (Becky G), Billy (Lin-Manuel Miranda), and Kimberly (Storm Reid) - five high school students who are all part of the school's football team. The group is led by Jason, who is also the star quarterback.

One day, while on a field trip to Angel Grove, California, the group encounters Zordon (Bryan Cranston), an alien sage who has been watching over them from space. Zordon reveals that he has been searching for five teenagers with "the heart of a warrior" and that they are the chosen ones to become the Power Rangers.

Zordon explains that the world is in danger due to the evil Lord Zedd (Barry D. Armstrong), who was once defeated by Zordon but has returned with an army of monsters and robots. The Power Rangers must use their newfound powers, which come from a magical amulet called the "Morpher," to defeat Lord Zedd and his minions.

As the story progresses, the group learns that they have unique abilities and strengths that make them powerful in their own ways. Jason becomes the Red Ranger, Zack becomes the Black Ranger, Trini becomes the Yellow Ranger, Billy becomes the Blue Ranger, and Kimberly becomes the Pink Ranger.

The Power Rangers face off against Lord Zedd's army of monsters and robots, including the Putty Patrollers, the Megazord, and the Tyrannosaurus Rex. Along the way, they also meet Alpha 5 (Bill Hader), a talking computer who helps them on their quest.

As the final battle approaches, the Power Rangers discover that Lord Zedd's plan is to destroy Angel Grove and rule over the world. The group uses all of their powers and work together to defeat Lord Zedd and his minions in an epic showdown.

In the end, the Power Rangers emerge victorious, and Lord Zedd is defeated once again. The movie concludes with the Power Rangers celebrating their victory and looking forward to a new era of peace and protection for Angel Grove.

Overall, Power Rangers is a fun and action-packed film that brings the popular television series to life on the big screen. While it may not be as faithful to the original series as some fans might have hoped, it offers plenty of excitement and adventure for both old and new fans alike.

overview: Teddy wakes up the morning after his wedding to discover that he's jumped forward a year in his life to his first anniversary. Trapped in an endless cycle of time jumps, transported another year ahead every few minutes, he is faced with a race against time as his life crumbles around him.
tagline: Love... blink and you'll miss it.
title: Long Story Short
plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Long Story Short" released in 2021 by Screen Australia. 

However, I found that there is a 2019 Australian drama film called "Long Story Short", directed by Kate Atkinson and produced by Screen Australia. The main themes of this movie include:

The story revolves around the complex relationship between two women, Alice (played by Toni Collette) and Rose (played by Edie Falco), who meet at a writing workshop in rural New South Wales. As they spend more time together, their lives become intertwined through a series of events that challenge their perceptions of love, loss, and identity.

Throughout the film, Atkinson explores themes such as:

1. Female friendship: The movie delves into the complexities of female relationships, highlighting the ways in which women can both support and hurt each other.
2. Trauma and healing: Both Alice and Rose have experienced traumatic events in their pasts, and the film explores how these experiences shape their present-day lives.
3. Identity and belonging: As the two women navigate their relationships with each other and the world around them, they must confront questions of identity and where they belong.

The movie features a nuanced exploration of human emotions, relationships, and the complexities of female experience.

original_title: 小鳥遊六花・改 ～劇場版 中二病でも恋がしたい!～
overview: Summary of the first season of the show, as seen from Rikka's perspective with new elements.
title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions! Rikka Version
plot:
Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions! Rikka Version is a Japanese anime television series that premiered in 2013. The show was produced by TBS and directed by Masafumi Sanada.

The main themes of Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions! Rikka Version revolve around the complexities of human relationships, mental health, and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. Here are some key themes:

1. **Mental Health**: The series explores the struggles of its protagonist, Yuuta Togashi, who suffers from a condition called "chunibyo," which is characterized by an exaggerated sense of self-importance and delusions of grandeur. Through Yuuta's character, the show sheds light on the challenges faced by individuals with mental health issues.
2. **Love and Relationships**: The series focuses on the complexities of romantic relationships, particularly in the context of high school life. It explores themes of unrequited love, friendship, and the difficulties of navigating social dynamics.
3. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As Yuuta navigates his relationships with the girls he has a crush on, including Rikka, he is forced to confront his own identity and sense of self-worth. The series explores the challenges of finding one's place in the world and defining oneself amidst societal expectations.
4. **Social Hierarchy and Peer Pressure**: The show critiques the social hierarchies present in high school life, where students are often pressured to conform to certain norms or risk being ostracized. This theme is particularly evident in the relationships between Yuuta and his peers.
5. **Growing Up and Letting Go**: Throughout the series, Yuuta is forced to confront the reality of growing up and letting go of his childish fantasies. The show explores the bittersweet nature of transitioning from adolescence to adulthood.

Overall, Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions! Rikka Version is a thought-provoking series that tackles complex themes with humor, wit, and sensitivity.

overview: Jamie Graham, a privileged English boy, is living in Shanghai when the Japanese invade and force all foreigners into prison camps. Jamie is captured with an American sailor, who looks out for him while they are in the camp together. Even though he is separated from his parents and in a hostile environment, Jamie maintains his dignity and youthful spirits, providing a beacon of hope for the others held captive with him.
tagline: To survive in a world at war, he must find a strength greater than all the events that surround him.
title: Empire of the Sun
plot:
"Empire of the Sun" is a 1987 epic war drama film directed by Steven Spielberg, produced by Amblin Entertainment, and based on J.G. Ballard's semi-autobiographical novel "Empire of the Sun: Firsthand Account of a Young Boy's Childhood in War". The main themes of the movie are:

1. **Survival and Resilience**: The story revolves around James Graham (played by Christian Bale), a young boy who is separated from his family during World War II and must navigate the harsh realities of war, poverty, and exploitation to survive.
2. **Childhood Innocence Lost**: As James grows up in the midst of war, he loses his innocence and faces the brutalities of adulthood, forcing him to confront the harsh realities of life.
3. **Human Connection and Empathy**: Despite being separated from his family, James forms strong bonds with a Japanese woman named Sang (played by Taeko Omori) and an American pilot, Captain James W. Grafton (played by John Malkovich), who help him cope with his situation.
4. **War's Impact on Civilians**: The film highlights the devastating effects of war on civilians, particularly children, who are often caught in the crossfire and forced to fend for themselves.
5. **Coming of Age**: Through James' experiences, the movie explores themes of growing up, self-discovery, and finding one's place in the world.

The film received widespread critical acclaim for its powerful storytelling, cinematography, and performances, particularly Christian Bale's breakout role as a young boy struggling to survive in the midst of war.

overview: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie, a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman with dealings in Africa.
tagline: Armed With the Truth.
title: The Gunman
plot:
The Gunman is a 2015 action thriller film directed by Pascal Leturier, starring Sean Penn, James McAvoy, and Jason Clarke.

The main themes of The Gunman revolve around:

1. **Trauma and Redemption**: The protagonist, Jack Reacher (played by Sean Penn), is a former military policeman who seeks redemption for his past mistakes. He's haunted by the memories of his time in the military and struggles to find purpose in his life.

2. **Loneliness and Isolation**: Throughout the film, Reacher navigates through various locations, but he remains disconnected from others. His isolation stems from his troubled past, making it challenging for him to form meaningful relationships.

3. **Morality and Justice**: As Reacher delves deeper into a conspiracy involving a wealthy businessman (played by James McAvoy) and a mysterious woman (played by Diane Kruger), he's forced to confront the gray areas between right and wrong. He must decide what is just and fair, often walking a fine line between justice and vigilantism.

4. **Identity and Purpose**: Reacher's journey is also one of self-discovery. As he tries to uncover the truth behind a series of murders, he begins to question his own identity and purpose in life. This internal conflict drives much of the plot and character development.

5. **Violence and Consequences**: The film explores the consequences of violence and the impact it has on individuals and society. Reacher's actions lead to a chain reaction of events that put him, others, and himself at risk.

The Gunman is an action-packed thriller with a complex narrative, exploring themes that delve into the human condition, morality, and the search for meaning in life.

overview: A high school slacker who's rejected by every school he applies to opts to create his own institution of higher learning, the South Harmon Institute of Technology, on a rundown piece of property near his hometown.
tagline: When every college turned them down. . . they made one up.
title: Accepted
plot:
Accepted is a 2006 American comedy film directed by Steve Pink and written by Adam Cooper and Mark Levin. The movie stars Justin Long, Jonah Hill, and Leslie Mann.

The main themes of Accepted revolve around acceptance, self-discovery, and the importance of community. The story follows Frank Folegano (Justin Long), a young man who is rejected from every college he applies to due to his lack of academic achievements. Feeling like an outcast, Frank decides to start his own college, which becomes a haven for misfits and people who don't fit into traditional societal norms.

Throughout the film, Frank learns valuable lessons about acceptance, empathy, and understanding. He comes to realize that everyone has their own struggles and imperfections, and that it's okay to be different. The movie promotes a message of inclusivity and celebrates individuality, encouraging viewers to look beyond surface-level appearances and accept people for who they are.

The film also explores themes of identity, belonging, and the importance of human connection.
