Frank's journey is not just about starting his own college but also about finding his place in the world and forming meaningful relationships with others. The movie features a talented ensemble cast, including Jonah Hill as Pete, a charismatic and confident student who becomes one of Frank's closest friends.

Ultimately, Accepted is a heartwarming and humorous film that leaves viewers with a positive message about acceptance, empathy, and the power of community.

overview: The blood-soaked land of Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) has a new overlord now - Rocky, whose name strikes fear in the heart of his foes. His allies look up to Rocky as their Savior, the government sees him as a threat to law and order; enemies are clamoring for revenge and conspiring for his downfall. Bloodier battles and darker days await as Rocky continues on his quest for unchallenged supremacy.
tagline: The World Is My Territory
title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
plot:
K.G.F: Chapter 2 is an Indian Kannada-language action film that delves into the complexities of power, loyalty, and the consequences of one's actions. The movie explores the darker aspects of human nature, particularly in the context of politics and governance.

At its core, K.G.F: Chapter 2 is a tale of ambition and the lengths to which individuals will go to achieve their goals. The protagonist, Adheera, is driven by a desire for power and revenge, which ultimately consumes him. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, highlighting the destructive nature of unchecked ambition.

The film also touches on the theme of loyalty and the blurred lines between personal and national interests. As Adheera navigates the treacherous world of politics, he must confront the moral implications of his actions and the true cost of his loyalty to those around him.

Furthermore, K.G.F: Chapter 2 critiques the corrupting influence of power and the ways in which it can lead individuals down a path of destruction. The movie presents a nuanced portrayal of the complexities of governance, highlighting both the benefits and drawbacks of authoritarian rule.

Ultimately, K.G.F: Chapter 2 is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, delving into the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of our actions.

overview: A defense attorney begins to suspect that her client, who is charged with the murders of a vacationing family, might be more than meets the eye.
tagline: The legend reborn
title: Wer
plot:
Wer is a 2013 American horror film directed by William Brent Bell, who co-wrote it with Matthew Peterman. A.J. Cook stars as an American defence attorney in France who comes to suspect that her client is a werewolf, with Simon Quarterman, Vik Sahay, Sebastian Roché and Brian Scott O'Connor. The film was released in Japan in November 2013 and reached video on demand in the United States in August 2014.

An American family on holiday in rural France are savagely attacked by an unseen creature, killing Henry Porter and his young son Peter. His wife Claire survives long enough to tell police, led by Captain Klaus Pistor, that the attacker looked like a man, and she later dies of her injuries. The authorities arrest Talan Gwynek, a huge, hirsute local recluse. Kate Moore, an expatriate lawyer, takes on his defence, assisted by her investigator Eric Sarin and by Gavin Flemyng, an English animal-attack expert and her former lover. During an interview at the police station a scuffle breaks out, and Talan scratches Gavin.

At the Gwyneks' isolated home, Talan's Romanian-born mother insists he is too frail to kill anyone because of a hereditary condition affecting the men in her family, and claims the police are persecuting him because the state wants their land for a nuclear waste site. The defence team suspects porphyria, while Gavin grows steadily sicker after his scratch and tension rises between him and Eric over Kate. During a medical examination, flashing strobe lights trigger Talan, who displays monstrous strength, slaughters almost everyone present and escapes.

A manhunt corners him in an abandoned building, where he is filmed transforming and survives an eight-storey fall. After killing more officers he is gunned down, but revives during transport and goes on a rampage. Gavin, now realising he shares Talan's affliction, kills Mrs. Gwynek and fully transforms. At the crash site Talan kills Eric and turns on Kate, but Gavin fights and strangles him. As Kate confronts Gavin, Pistor shoots her from a helicopter, and Gavin brings it down, killing him. Kate survives, Pistor is implicated in a plot to seize the Gwynek land, and Talan's body is never found while Gavin's secret is kept.

Reviewers praised O'Connor's performance and the grounded take on lycanthropy, while criticising effects and the final act.

overview: When their bus is crippled on the side of a deserted road, a team of high school athletes discover an opponent they cannot defeat – and may not survive. Staring hungrily at them through the school bus windows, The Creeper returns again and again. But when the teammates discover that it’s selective about whom it attacks, it will test their ability to stick together – as the insatiable menace tries to tear them apart!
tagline: He can taste your fear.
title: Jeepers Creepers 2
plot:
Jeepers Creepers 2 is a 2003 American horror film directed by Victor Salva and written by Victor Salva and John Wharton. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2001 film Jeepers Creepers.

The story takes place two years after the events of the first film. Darry Jenner (Justin Long) has been institutionalized for his alleged involvement in the death of his brother, Darry's twin brother, who was killed by the Creeper. However, it is revealed that Darry is actually innocent and has been suffering from amnesia due to a head injury.

The movie begins with Darry being released from the institution after a year, where he meets a woman named Trish Jenner (Jonathan Breck's sister, played by Patricia Belcher). As they start dating, strange occurrences begin to happen around them. They soon discover that the Creeper has returned and is once again terrorizing a small town in rural Georgia.

As the body count rises, Darry begins to experience flashbacks of his childhood, where he witnesses the Creeper's arrival in his hometown. He also starts to develop a connection with Trish, who becomes increasingly concerned about his well-being.

The plot thickens as Darry and Trish try to uncover the truth behind the Creeper's return. They soon discover that the Creeper is not just a mindless monster but has a specific target in mind - Trish's younger brother, who bears an uncanny resemblance to Darry.

As the stakes rise, Darry must confront his dark past and face the Creeper once again. The movie builds up to a thrilling climax as Darry and Trish try to outsmart the Creeper and save their town from destruction.

Throughout the film, there are several twists and turns that keep the audience guessing. The Creeper's motivations are slowly revealed, adding depth to its character. The movie also explores themes of identity, trauma, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control.

The ending is a mix of action, suspense, and emotional closure. Darry finally confronts his past and faces the Creeper in an intense showdown. In the end, he emerges victorious but not without scars. The movie concludes on a hopeful note as Darry finds redemption and starts to rebuild his life with Trish.

Overall, Jeepers Creepers 2 is a thrilling horror film that expands on the original while maintaining its dark and suspenseful tone.

overview: Rizwan Khan, a Muslim from the Borivali section of Mumbai, has Asperger's syndrome. He marries a Hindu single mother, Mandira, in San Francisco. After 9/11, Rizwan is detained by authorities at LAX who treat him as a terrorist because of his condition and his race.
tagline: An Ordinary Man, An Extraordinary Journey ... FOR LOVE.
title: My Name Is Khan
plot:
My Name Is Khan is a 2010 American drama film directed by Spike Lee, written by David Koepp, and produced by Fox Searchlight Pictures. The movie stars Shah Rukh Khan, Kal Penn, Anupam Kher, and Tabu.

The story revolves around Rizwan Khan (Shah Rukh Khan), a Muslim man from Mumbai who suffers from Asperger's syndrome. He is unable to understand sarcasm or irony and often finds himself in awkward situations due to his condition. Rizwan lives with his wife, Bilkees (Tabu), and their son, Karim.

The movie begins with Rizwan's life being turned upside down when he discovers that his wife has been having an affair with a Hindu man, Bilal (Anupam Kher). The news devastates Rizwan, who is unable to cope with the betrayal. He becomes obsessed with finding Bilal and confronting him about his infidelity.

However, things take a dramatic turn when Rizwan discovers that Bilal was killed in the 9/11 attacks on the World Trade Center. This event sets off a chain reaction of events as Rizwan decides to embark on an American road trip to find Bilal's widow and clear his wife's name.

Along the way, Rizwan meets Toby (Kal Penn), a young man who is initially hesitant to help him but eventually becomes his friend and confidant. As they travel across America, Rizwan faces various challenges, including racism and prejudice, which he struggles to overcome due to his Asperger's syndrome.

Throughout the journey, Rizwan also meets a Muslim woman named Amira (Leyna Bloom), who helps him understand the complexities of American society and culture. He begins to see the world in a different light and starts to question his own prejudices.

As Rizwan gets closer to finding Bilal's widow, he realizes that his quest is not just about clearing his wife's name but also about understanding the complexities of human relationships and emotions. The movie takes a poignant turn when Rizwan finally meets the widow, who turns out to be a kind and compassionate woman.

The ending of the movie is both heart-wrenching and uplifting. Rizwan comes to terms with his Asperger's syndrome and learns to accept himself for who he is. He also finds closure by understanding that Bilal was not responsible for the 9/11 attacks, but rather a victim of circumstance.

Overall, My Name Is Khan is a powerful and thought-provoking movie that explores themes of love, prejudice, and acceptance. The film features outstanding performances from Shah Rukh Khan and Anupam Kher, who deliver nuanced and complex portrayals of their characters.

overview: It’s time to chase that holiday spirit with Tom and Jerry! With magic in the air, Jerry and his nephew, Tuffy, make a snow mouse that miraculously comes to life! To keep their new friend, Larry the snow mouse from melting, Tuffy and Jerry must race him to the fabled Snowman’s Village. In hot pursuit, Tom and devious Dr. Doublevay have their own plans for Larry’s magic.
tagline: Ready...Set...Snow.
title: Tom and Jerry Snowman's Land
plot:
Tom and Jerry: Snowman's Land is a 2022 American animated Christmas direct-to-video film starring the classic cat-and-mouse duo. Produced by Warner Bros. Animation and Turner Entertainment, with animation by Renegade Animation in the United States and Slap Happy Cartoons in Canada, it features the voices of Carlos Alazraqui, Kimberly Brooks, Joey D'Auria, Regi Davis and Laraine Newman, with archival recordings of William Hanna for the title characters. It was released digitally on November 15, 2022, and on DVD on November 29, 2022.

In the snowy town of Goodberry, Tom and Jerry are up to their usual antics until Tom gets into trouble with his owner, the greedy Dr. Doublevay. Jerry lives with his kindly owner, Mrs. LePage, who is struggling financially and tries to make ends meet by selling little snow mice to children, a business Jerry helps with. Jerry's young nephew Tuffy, however, dreams of putting on a magic show, an idea Jerry dismisses. Disappointed, Tuffy goes outside and builds a snow mouse of his own to help the family. To his amazement, the snow mouse magically comes to life, and the two quickly become best friends. Tuffy names his new companion Larry and introduces him to Jerry, who is reluctant but agrees to let him stay.

Larry soon proves surprisingly helpful, recovering money for Mrs. LePage after Tom ruins her savings. But as time passes, Larry begins to melt. To save him, Tuffy and Jerry set off on a journey to bring him to the fabled Snowman's Village, a magical place where living snow creatures can survive. Tom and Dr. Doublevay have plans of their own for the remarkable snow mouse and follow the mice throughout their adventure, setting traps and causing havoc along the way. When Jerry and Larry rescue Tom from one of the traps meant for them, the cat has a change of heart. Upon reaching the Snowman's Village, Tom saves the mice, and the four join forces to defeat Doublevay. In gratitude, Tom moves in with Tuffy, Jerry and Mrs. LePage, and the new family celebrates together whenever Larry comes back to visit.

The film continued Warner Bros.' long-running series of direct-to-video Tom and Jerry features. Common Sense Media gave it three stars out of five, noting that it is cute and less violent than some earlier entries, though the story is nothing new, and Geek Vibes Nation called it an enjoyable, lighthearted holiday entry for the duo.

overview: The tale of a new breed of cultural insurgent: a punk genius who sparked a revolution and changed the face of human interaction for a generation, and perhaps forever.
tagline: You don't get to 500 million friends without making a few enemies.
title: The Social Network
plot:
The Social Network is a biographical drama film directed by David Fincher, released in 2010 by Columbia Pictures. The movie tells the story of the founding of Facebook and its early success.

The film begins with Mark Zuckerberg (played by Jesse Eisenberg), a brilliant but awkward college student at Harvard University. Mark is portrayed as an outsider who struggles to connect with his peers due to his social anxiety and lack of charisma. However, he finds solace in coding and computer science, which becomes his passion.

Mark's life takes a dramatic turn when he meets Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss (played by Armie Hammer), two identical twin brothers who are also Harvard students. The twins approach Mark with an idea for a social networking site called "Facemash," which allows users to compare the photos of two students and vote on which one is more attractive. Mark agrees to help the twins, but later decides to use their idea as a starting point for his own project.

Mark creates a new website called "Thefacebook" and launches it from his dorm room. The site quickly gains popularity among Harvard students, and Mark becomes an overnight sensation. However, he faces opposition from the Winklevoss twins, who claim that they came up with the idea first and demand a share of the profits.

As Facebook's popularity grows, Mark attracts the attention of Eduardo Saverin (played by Andrew Garfield), his friend and business partner. Eduardo helps Mark to refine the site's design and expand its user base. However, their partnership is put to the test when Mark decides to drop Eduardo as a co-founder and replace him with Cameron Winklevoss.

The film takes a dramatic turn when Mark meets Natalie Portman (playing herself), who becomes his love interest. Their relationship is portrayed as intense but short-lived, and Mark's focus on Facebook begins to suffer.

As Facebook's user base grows exponentially, Mark faces increasing pressure from investors and the media. He also has to deal with the Winklevoss twins' lawsuit against him, which claims that they came up with the idea for Facebook first.

The film's climax features a dramatic confrontation between Mark and Eduardo at a coffee shop in Palo Alto, California. The two men engage in a heated argument over their partnership and the future of Facebook.

In the end, Mark emerges victorious but scarred by his experiences. He has created a global phenomenon, but at what cost? The film ends with Mark sitting alone in his office, staring at his computer screen as he reflects on the consequences of his actions.

The Social Network received widespread critical acclaim for its portrayal of the Facebook saga. The film won several awards, including three Academy Awards (Best Original Score, Best Film Editing, and Best Adapted Screenplay). Jesse Eisenberg's performance as Mark Zuckerberg was particularly praised, earning him an Oscar nomination for Best Actor.

original_title: Arthur 3: la guerre des deux mondes
overview: Maltazard, the Evil M, is now 7 feet tall and evolving among the humans, causing terror wherever he goes. His goal is simple: forming an army of giant henchmen and ruling over the universe. Meanwhile, Arthur is still a Minimoy, and thus in a state where he's unable to fend him off. With the help of Selenia and Betameche, he hatches a plan to regain his usual size: all they must do is infiltrate Arthur's house through the pipeworks, catch an electric train from his bedroom to his grandfather's study and find an elixir that will make him grow back to his human size. Sounds simple enough, if it weren't for Darkos, Maltazard's own son, hot on their tails.
tagline: The Final...
title: Arthur 3: The War of the Two Worlds
plot:
Arthur 3: The War of the Two Worlds (French: Arthur 3: La Guerre des deux mondes) is a 2010 English-language French fantasy film combining live action and computer animation, directed and co-written by Luc Besson from the last book of his Arthur children's series. The third film in the series and a direct continuation of Arthur and the Revenge of Maltazard (2009), it was shot back to back with its predecessor in Normandy. Freddie Highmore returns as Arthur, alongside Mia Farrow, Ron Crawford, Robert Stanton and Penny Balfour, with Selena Gomez, Lou Reed and Iggy Pop among the English voice cast.

The story resumes where the previous film ended. The evil Maltazard has grown to human size and escaped into the human world, while Arthur is still trapped at the tiny scale of the Minimoys. With Princess Selenia and her brother Prince Betameche, Arthur sets out to recover a potion from his family house that can restore normal size. Maltazard gets hold of it first and uses it to enlarge his army of followers, threatening Arthur's family and the surrounding town.

Arthur manages to regain his human form with an elixir of life provided by a queen bee. Meanwhile his grandfather Archibald persuades Prince Darkos, Maltazard's son, to turn against his father, and enlarges him with a second dose of the potion. Arthur and Darkos together confront the villain. In the final showdown Selenia and Betameche shrink Maltazard back to his Minimoy size, allowing Arthur to capture him, while the United States Army defeats his giant forces. Maltazard is afterwards kept as a prisoner by Arthur's family.

Released in France by EuropaCorp on 13 October 2010, the film was a box-office success at home and received mixed to fairly positive French reviews. With a budget of about 69 million euros, it was among the most expensive French productions of its time, and after the international failure of the earlier instalments it caused heavy losses for the studio. It went directly to video in the United States, and in Britain and Ireland it was combined with the second film as Arthur and the Great Adventure. It was Lou Reed's last acting role before his death in 2013, and a spin-off, Arthur, malédiction, followed in 2022.

overview: Set in 1940s France, a new teacher at a school for disruptive boys gives hope and inspiration.
title: The Chorus
plot:
The Chorus is a 2004 drama film directed by Liongfei. The story revolves around a young boy named Jie who witnesses his mother's murder and is subsequently taken in by a kind-hearted old man, Mr. Liang. As the years pass, Jie grows up under Mr. Liang's care, learning valuable life lessons about love, loss, and redemption.

The main theme of The Chorus explores the complexities of human relationships and the transformative power of love and kindness. Through Jie's journey, the film highlights the importance of finding a sense of belonging and purpose in life. Mr. Liang's selfless devotion to Jie serves as a catalyst for Jie's growth, teaching him valuable lessons about resilience, forgiveness, and the human capacity for good.

The movie also delves into the theme of trauma and its impact on individuals and communities. Jie's experiences with loss and violence shape his worldview, but Mr. Liang's presence provides a safe haven where Jie can heal and find solace. The film suggests that even in the darkest of times, human connection and compassion can be a powerful force for healing and redemption.

Ultimately, The Chorus is a poignant exploration of the human spirit, revealing the ways in which love, kindness, and selflessness can shape our lives and help us overcome even the most profound challenges.

overview: London is a drug laden adventure that centers on a party in a New York loft where a young man is trying to win back his ex-girlfriend.
tagline: One young man's incredible journey of self-discovery
title: London
plot:
London is a 2005 American romantic drama written and directed by Hunter Richards. Chris Evans stars as a heartbroken young man who crashes his ex-girlfriend's farewell party, with Jason Statham, Jessica Biel, Joy Bryant, Kelli Garner and Isla Fisher in supporting roles. The electronic group The Crystal Method composed the score.

Syd has been deeply depressed since his girlfriend London left him. When a friend calls to tell him that she is throwing a going-away party before moving to California with her new boyfriend, Syd flies into a rage and wrecks his apartment. He decides to crash the party, bringing along Bateman, a banker who delivers cocaine to him as a favor to their mutual dealer. The party takes place at a condominium belonging to the parents of the socialite Rebecca, played by Fisher.

Syd and Bateman quickly barricade themselves in the bathroom, where they snort line after line of cocaine, drink tequila and hold long, rambling conversations about love, sex, God, women and pain. Over the course of the night, Bateman urges Syd to move on with his life. Their private party is joined by Maya and Mallory, who feign sympathy for Syd in order to share the free drugs. When Syd learns that London has arrived, Bateman challenges him to finally face her.

After a heated confrontation in front of the guests, Syd and London decide to leave and talk somewhere private. On the way out a brawl breaks out, and Syd and Bateman fight off the other men at the party, barely escaping. Syd and London reconcile in his car and spend the night together at her apartment. In the final scene, at the airport, Syd tells London that he loves her. Although moved by his words, she leaves him anyway.

The film was poorly received. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus said it was undermined by unlikable characters and that the novelty of seeing actors play against type could not rescue it, and Metacritic gave it 24 out of 100. Roger Ebert awarded it one star out of four, while The New York Times called it a misfired attempt at provocation and philosophical exploration. The song "Roboslut" from the soundtrack later appeared in a Dance Dance Revolution game under a censored title.

overview: Rayne, a half-human half-vampire warrior, is in the America's 1880's Wild West to stop the vampired Billy the Kid and his posse of vampire cowboys.
production_companies: Boll Kino Beteiligungs GmbH & Co. KG
tagline: A heart-stopping adventure!
title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
plot:
BloodRayne 2: Deliverance is a 2007 direct-to-DVD Western horror action film directed by Uwe Boll and a sequel to his 2005 film BloodRayne, which was based on the video game series. Natassia Malthe replaces Kristanna Loken in the title role of Rayne, with Zack Ward as Billy the Kid, Michael Paré as Pat Garrett and Chris Coppola as the reporter Newton Piles. The film moves the story of the half-vampire heroine from Eastern Europe to the American West of the 1880s.

Newton Piles, a reporter on assignment for the Chicago Chronicle, arrives in the small town of Deliverance, Montana, to collect colorful stories of the frontier. The quiet town is preparing for the arrival of the transcontinental railroad in a week's time, but along with the railroad comes a deadly visitor: Billy the Kid, who is in fact a centuries-old Transylvanian vampire. Billy intends to use the railway to spread his influence and build an army of vampire gunslingers with which to conquer the country and establish a vampire kingdom in the New World.

Billy and his followers terrorize Deliverance, killing many of the townspeople and kidnapping children. He spares Newton, promising him the greatest story ever written. His plans are complicated, however, by the arrival of Rayne, a dhampir born in Romania more than a century earlier from the union of a vampire and a human woman. Rayne possesses a vampire's strength and abilities without its weaknesses and has spent her long life hunting the undead. Determined to stop Billy, she must recruit allies among the few surviving townspeople and lawmen and face the vampire gang before the railroad can carry their plague across America.

Boll blends the conventions of the Western, including saloons, showdowns and gallows, with gothic vampire horror, filming on a modest budget for the home-video market.

BloodRayne 2: Deliverance was released in the United States on September 18, 2007, and in Germany on November 30 of that year. Like its predecessor it was received negatively, holding a zero percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes from a small number of reviews, which called it slow-paced, dry and anything but sexy. A third film, BloodRayne: The Third Reich, followed in 2011.

belongs_to_collection.name: How to Train Your Dragon Collection

overview: Five years have passed since Hiccup and Toothless united the dragons and Vikings of Berk. Now, they spend their time charting unmapped territories. During one of their adventures, the pair discover a secret cave that houses hundreds of wild dragons -- and a mysterious dragon rider who turns out to be Hiccup's mother, Valka. Hiccup and Toothless then find themselves at the center of a battle to protect Berk from a power-hungry warrior named Drago.
tagline: The training is over.
title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
plot:
How to Train Your Dragon 2 is a 2014 American computer-animated adventure comedy film directed by Dean DeBlois and Chris Sanders. The movie takes place five years after the events of the first film.

The story begins with Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III (voiced by Jay Baruchel), now a young adult, who has become the chief of Berk's Viking village. He is struggling to find his place in the world and prove himself as a leader. Meanwhile, a new threat emerges in the form of a dragon hunter named Drago Bludvist (voiced by Djimon Hounsou), who seeks to destroy all dragons and rule the world.

Drago is revealed to be the son of Stoick the Vast's (voiced by Gerard Butler) long-lost brother, who was thought to have been killed in a dragon attack. Drago's true intention is to find his father's lost treasure, which he believes is hidden on Berk. He also seeks to destroy the dragons and rule the world.

Hiccup teams up with his friends Astrid (voiced by America Ferrera), Snotlout (voiced by Jonah Hill), Ruffnut (voiced by Kristen Wiig), and Tuffnut (voiced by T.J. Miller) to stop Drago and save their village. Along the way, they discover that Drago's true intention is not just to destroy dragons but also to find his father's treasure.

As Hiccup and his friends journey to stop Drago, they encounter new dragons, including a massive dragon known as the "Boneknapper". They also learn more about their own pasts and the history of Berk. Hiccup discovers that he has a special connection to the dragons and can communicate with them in ways that no one else can.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when Drago reveals his true intentions: to use the dragons' tears, which are collected from their eyes, to heal his own dying body. The dragons' tears have the power to cure any wound, making Drago nearly invincible.

In the end, Hiccup and his friends come up with a plan to stop Drago and save Berk. They use the dragons' tears to create a powerful blast that destroys Drago's ship and sends him crashing into the sea. The movie ends with Hiccup and Astrid sharing a romantic moment, and the Vikings celebrating their victory over Drago.

Throughout the movie, there are many humorous moments, including Snotlout's attempts to prove himself as a Viking warrior and Ruffnut and Tuffnut's comedic antics. The movie also explores themes of identity, community, and the importance of understanding and respecting other cultures.

Overall, How to Train Your Dragon 2 is an exciting and action-packed adventure that expands on the world and characters introduced in the first film. It features stunning animation, engaging characters, and a thrilling plot that will keep audiences entertained from start to finish.

original_title: The Wizard Hunter: The Hunt for Evangelion Crowley
overview: A detective of lost Art masterpieces will discover his hidden legacy and his true identity during his last mission.
title: The Wizard Hunter: The Hunt for Evangelion Crowley
plot: A bounty hunter of lost masterpieces of any era, hired by a Swiss Art Collector is at the end of his tasks. But one last assignment will let him discover his hidden and dark legacy.

overview: Two doctors find their graveyard shift inundated with townspeople ravaged by sores. Among the wounded is Cherry Darling, a dancer whose leg was ripped from her body. As the invalids quickly become enraged aggressors, Cherry and her ex-boyfriend El Wray lead a team of accidental warriors into the night.
tagline: Humanity's last hope… rests on a high power machine gun!
title: Planet Terror
plot:
Planet Terror is a 2007 American exploitation horror film written and directed by Quentin Tarantino and Robert Rodriguez. The film stars Rose McGowan, Freddy Rodríguez, Josh Brolin, Bruce Dern, and Kim Darby.

The story begins with Cherry Darling (Rose McGowan), a young woman who lives in El Paso, Texas, with her boyfriend, Meg (Jordana Brewster). After being diagnosed with terminal cancer, Cherry decides to have her leg amputated. She then becomes involved with a group of women who are also having their limbs removed as part of an experimental treatment.

The story takes a dark turn when Cherry's boyfriend is killed by a group of Nazi scientists led by General Kilgore (Bruce Dern) and his accomplice, Dr. Wiesner (Willem Dafoe). The Nazis have been experimenting on women to create super-soldiers, and they plan to use the treated women as part of their army.

Cherry escapes from the Nazis and joins a group of survivors, including El Wey (Danny Trejo), a Mexican revolutionary who is also being pursued by the Nazis. Together, they embark on a mission to take down General Kilgore and his men.

As Cherry navigates her new reality, she meets Otis Driftwood (Freddy Rodríguez), a wheelchair-bound mechanic who becomes her love interest. The two form an unlikely bond as they work together to survive the Nazi threat.

The film's plot is interspersed with scenes of other characters, including El Wey and his men, who are fighting against the Nazis in Mexico. These scenes provide a sense of scope and scale to the story, highlighting the global reach of the Nazi threat.

Throughout the film, Tarantino and Rodriguez pay homage to classic exploitation films of the 1970s, incorporating elements such as over-the-top violence, graphic gore, and campy humor. The result is a film that is both a loving tribute to the genre and a fresh take on the exploitation horror subgenre.

As the story unfolds, Cherry and Otis find themselves in a series of increasingly absurd and violent situations, including a showdown with General Kilgore's men at a nightclub. In the end, Cherry and her allies manage to defeat the Nazis, but not before suffering significant losses.

The film ends with Cherry and Otis riding off into the sunset on motorcycles, ready to face whatever challenges come their way next. The final shot is of Cherry's prosthetic leg, which has become a symbol of her newfound strength and independence.

Overall, Planet Terror is a wildly entertaining and unapologetically violent film that is sure to appeal to fans of exploitation horror. With its over-the-top action sequences, graphic gore, and campy humor, it is a true classic of the genre.

overview: An ex-marine is hired by a defense contractor to travel to Panama to complete an arms deal. In the process he becomes involved with the U.S. invasion of Panama, and learns an important lesson about the true nature of political power.
tagline: The revolution is heating up.
title: Panama
plot:
Panama is a 2022 American action thriller directed by Mark Neveldine and starring Cole Hauser and Mel Gibson, with Kate Katzman, Charlie Weber and Jackie Cruz in supporting roles. Set in 1989, in the months before the United States invasion of Panama, the film follows a former Marine recruited for a covert arms deal in Central America during the final years of the Cold War.

James Becker, a former Marine, has fallen into despair and heavy drinking after the death of his wife, often passing out beside her grave behind his house. Stark, a defense contractor and old associate played by Gibson, approaches him with a secret assignment that might give him a reason to keep going. At a government facility, Becker meets Stark and a skeptical agent named Burns, who explain the mission. The CIA, barred from openly supporting the Contra rebels in Nicaragua and eager to undermine the Panamanian dictator Manuel Noriega, has arranged to buy a Russian helicopter from Noriega's regime, with payment to a Swiss account, and intends to pass the aircraft to the Contras. Becker is to travel to Panama under cover as a consultant for a casino and see the transaction through.

In Panama, Becker is introduced to Enrique Rodriguez, a Harvard-educated, cocaine-fueled playboy with powerful connections, including ties to Colonel Marcos Justines of the Panamanian military and to an uncle who opposes Noriega. Enrique keeps putting off the helicopter deal, urging Becker to settle into his job at the casino, and eventually challenges him to a dirt-bike race in the jungle with the aircraft as the prize. When Enrique wins and tries to squeeze more money from the Americans, Becker takes back the million-dollar CIA advance. As tensions rise and an American invasion approaches, Justines orders Enrique to recover the money at any cost, and assassins are sent after Becker and those close to him, including Camila, a woman with whom he has begun a relationship. Becker must survive long enough to complete his mission amid the chaos of Operation Just Cause.

Panama was released in limited theaters and on demand in March 2022. It was poorly received by critics, with a 7 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on 14 reviews and an average score of 2.6 out of 10. The film blends its fictional espionage plot with real historical events of the period, including the Iran-Contra affair and the American military operation that removed Noriega from power in December 1989.

overview: A beautiful, pure-hearted young woman, Maleficent has an idyllic life growing up in a peaceable forest kingdom, until one day when an invading army threatens the harmony of the land.  Maleficent rises to be the land's fiercest protector, but she ultimately suffers a ruthless betrayal – an act that begins to turn her heart into stone. Bent on revenge, Maleficent faces an epic battle with the invading King's successor and, as a result, places a curse upon his newborn infant Aurora. As the child grows, Maleficent realizes that Aurora holds the key to peace in the kingdom – and to Maleficent's true happiness as well.
tagline: Don't believe the fairy tale.
title: Maleficent
plot:
Maleficent is a 2014 American dark fantasy film directed by Robert Stromberg, produced by Walt Disney Pictures, and based on the 1959 Disney animated film Sleeping Beauty. The movie stars Angelina Jolie as the titular character, Maleficent, and Sharlto Copley as Prince Philip.

The film begins with a young Princess Aurora (played by Elle Fanning) being taken away from her mother, Queen Leah (played by Lesley Manville), after she is born. Maleficent, a powerful fairy who was once friends with the king and queen, discovers that they have tricked her into giving up her powers in exchange for their daughter's life. This act of betrayal leads to a deep-seated hatred towards humans.

The story then jumps forward in time, where we see Aurora as a young princess living in the castle with her parents. Maleficent, now an outcast and a powerful sorceress, seeks revenge against King Stefan (played by Jonny Lee Miller) for his role in taking away her powers and betraying her.

Maleficent curses the entire kingdom to fall into eternal sleep on Aurora's 16th birthday, which is also the day of her coronation as queen. The curse can only be broken when true love's kiss is given to the princess. Prince Philip, who has grown up hearing stories about Maleficent and believing her to be evil, sets out to rescue Aurora from the sleeping kingdom.

As the story unfolds, we see a different side of Maleficent, who was once a kind and gentle fairy. The film explores her backstory, revealing that she was once friends with the king and queen, but they betrayed her trust and took away her powers. This betrayal leads to her transformation into the evil sorceress we know from the original Disney film.

Throughout the movie, Maleficent's character undergoes significant development as she grapples with her own morality and the consequences of her actions. She begins to question whether her desire for revenge is worth the cost of innocent lives. Meanwhile, Prince Philip's character remains largely one-dimensional, serving primarily as a love interest for Aurora.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Maleficent and King Stefan, with the fate of the kingdom hanging in the balance. In the end, it is revealed that Maleficent's curse was not just about revenge but also about protecting herself from further betrayal. The movie concludes on a bittersweet note, as Maleficent finds a sense of redemption and peace, while Aurora and Prince Philip share a romantic kiss, breaking the curse.

Overall, Maleficent offers a fresh take on the classic Disney tale, exploring themes of power, revenge, and redemption. While it received mixed reviews from critics, the film has become a cult classic among fans of dark fantasy and fairy tales.

overview: Trainees in the FBI's psychological profiling program must put their training into practice when they discover a killer in their midst.
tagline: For seven elite profilers, finding a serial killer is a process of elimination. Their own.
title: Mindhunters
plot:
Mindhunter is actually a 2017 Netflix series, not a movie from 2004. However, I can provide information on the TV series.

The main themes of Mindhunter (TV series, 2017) include:

1. The psychological effects of serial killers: The show explores the minds of serial killers, delving into their motivations, behaviors, and psychological profiles.
2. FBI profiling: The series follows two FBI agents, Holden Ford and Bill Tench, as they interview and profile serial killers to understand their psychology and develop a system for predicting future crimes.
3. Social commentary on 1970s America: Mindhunter is set in the late 1970s and explores themes of social change, including the rise of feminism, the civil rights movement, and the growing awareness of mental health issues.
4. The blurring of lines between good and evil: Throughout the series, characters are forced to confront their own moral ambiguities as they navigate the darker aspects of human nature.

The movie "Mindhunter" (2004) does not exist in my knowledge database.

overview: A woman runs for her life though the streets of Los Angeles after her blind date suddenly turns violent.
tagline: A first date from hell.
title: Run Sweetheart Run
plot:
Run Sweetheart Run is a 2021 American thriller film directed by Sara Depp, written by Josh Campbell, Matt Stuecken, and David E. Kelley, and produced by Jason Blum's Blumhouse Productions.

The movie follows the story of Daphne (played by Sienna Miller), a woman who escapes from her abusive husband, Richard (played by Alexander Ludwig). She flees to New York City with her young daughter, Harper (played by Ella Hunt), but soon realizes that she is not safe. The police are unable to help her, and she becomes desperate.

Daphne turns to an underground network of women who have also escaped from abusive relationships, known as the "Runners." They are a group of strong, independent women who offer support and protection to those in need. Daphne meets one of the Runners, Ruby (played by Kiersey Clemons), who becomes her ally.

As Daphne navigates this new world, she begins to uncover secrets about Richard's past and his connections to organized crime. She also discovers that Harper is not just a victim, but an active participant in the situation, having been manipulated by her father to gather information on her mother.

The plot thickens as Daphne becomes more entangled with the Runners, who are led by a mysterious figure known only as "Mother" (played by Lili Simmons). Mother is a charismatic leader who has built a network of safe houses and resources for women in need. However, it becomes clear that she may not be what she seems.

As Daphne delves deeper into the world of the Runners, she must confront her own demons and make difficult choices to protect herself and Harper. The film builds towards a tense showdown between Daphne and Richard, with the fate of her daughter hanging in the balance.

Throughout the movie, Depp explores themes of female empowerment, survival, and the complexities of mother-daughter relationships. The film features a strong ensemble cast, including Lili Simmons as Mother, who brings depth and nuance to the character.

The ending is intense and suspenseful, with Daphne facing off against Richard in a desperate bid for freedom. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, with Daphne and Harper finally finding safety and support within the Runners' network.

Overall, Run Sweetheart Run is a gripping thriller that explores the complexities of female relationships and the resilience of women in the face of adversity.

overview: A cryptic message from Bond’s past sends him on a trail to uncover a sinister organization. While M battles political forces to keep the secret service alive, Bond peels back the layers of deceit to reveal the terrible truth behind SPECTRE.
production_companies: Canadian Film or Video Production Tax Credit (CPTC)
Gobierno de la Ciudad de México
tagline: A Plan No One Escapes
title: Spectre
plot:
Spectre is a 2015 spy action film directed by Sam Mendes and produced by Columbia Pictures. The film is the 24th James Bond film and serves as a sequel to Skyfall.

The film begins with James Bond (played by Daniel Craig) attending the funeral of his former MI6 colleague, M (played by Judi Dench). During the service, Bond is approached by a mysterious woman named Madeleine Swann (played by Léa Seydoux), who claims that she has information about her father's death. The two share a brief moment together before Bond leaves.

Later, Bond meets with M, who reveals that he has been suffering from a rare condition known as "ghosting," which causes him to experience visions of his past and future. M believes that the cause of this condition is the presence of a ghostly figure, known as the Spectre, who is responsible for the deaths of several MI6 agents.

Bond's investigation leads him to Mexico City, where he encounters a group of henchmen working for the organization SPECTRE (Special Executive for Counter-intelligence, Terrorism, Revenge and Extortion). He also meets with his old friend, Felix Leiter (played by Jeffrey Wright), who is now working as a CIA agent.

As Bond delves deeper into the mystery, he discovers that SPECTRE is led by Ernst Stavro Blofeld (played by Christoph Waltz), a former Nazi scientist who has been secretly manipulating world events from behind the scenes. Blofeld's ultimate goal is to create a new world order through his organization.

Bond follows a trail of clues that takes him to Italy, where he encounters Madeleine Swann again. The two share a romantic moment together, but their relationship is complicated by Bond's past and his loyalty to MI6.

The film's climax features an action-packed sequence in which Bond infiltrates Blofeld's secret lair, known as the "Spectre headquarters." There, he discovers that Blofeld has been using a device called the "Quantum," which can manipulate people's memories and control their actions.

In a final confrontation, Bond faces off against Blofeld, who reveals his true intentions: to create a new world order through mind control. However, Bond is able to outsmart him and destroy the Quantum device.

The film ends with Bond reflecting on his past and his relationship with Madeleine. He realizes that he has been running from his emotions for too long and decides to take a break from his duties as a spy. The final shot of the film features Bond walking away from the Spectre headquarters, symbolizing his departure from the world of espionage.

Overall, Spectre is a thrilling action film that explores themes of loyalty, duty, and the consequences of playing with fire. The film's visuals are stunning, with impressive set pieces and cinematography.

overview: The inspirational story of World Champion Boxer Vinny Pazienza, who after a near fatal car crash, which left him not knowing if he'd ever walk again, made one of sports most incredible comebacks.
tagline: This is what the greatest comeback in sports history looks like
title: Bleed for This
plot:
Bleed for This is a 2016 American biographical sports drama written and directed by Ben Younger, based on the life of world champion boxer Vinny Pazienza. Miles Teller stars as Pazienza, with Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds and Ted Levine in supporting roles, and Martin Scorsese served as an executive producer. It premiered at the Telluride Film Festival on September 2, 2016, and was released in the United States by Open Road Films on November 18, 2016.

In November 1988, the brash Providence, Rhode Island, fighter Vinny Pazienza challenges Roger Mayweather for a world light welterweight title. He barely makes weight after hours on a stationary bike, spends the night before the bout gambling at a casino and loses decisively. At the post-fight press conference his manager suggests that he retire, prompting Vinny's father and trainer, Angelo, played by Hinds, to explode. Vinny fires his manager and teams up with Kevin Rooney, played by Eckhart, a gifted but hard-drinking trainer best known for his work with Mike Tyson. Rooney persuades him to move up two weight classes, and the gamble pays off when Vinny wins the world light middleweight title by knocking out Gilbert Dele.

Shortly afterward, while driving with a friend, Vinny is badly injured in a head-on car crash. He suffers a broken neck, and doctors tell him he may never walk again and will certainly never box again. Rather than undergo a spinal fusion that would end his career, Vinny chooses to wear a halo, a metal brace screwed directly into his skull, and spends months in pain at home under the anxious care of his mother, played by Sagal. Defying medical advice and his family's fears, he secretly begins training with Rooney in his basement while still wearing the device. After the halo is removed, Vinny fights his way back into the ring, and his comeback culminates in a bout against the legendary Roberto Durán.

The real Pazienza, later known as Vinny Paz, made one of the most remarkable comebacks in boxing history, returning to win further world titles after his accident. Critics praised Teller's committed performance and Eckhart's transformation as Rooney, with Richard Roeper calling it one of the best boxing films of the decade, while others found the storytelling clichéd. Audiences polled by CinemaScore gave it an A−, but the film was a box office disappointment.

overview: Travel writer Lemuel Gulliver takes an assignment in Bermuda, but ends up on the island of Liliput, where he towers over its tiny citizens.
tagline: Something big is going down.
title: Gulliver's Travels
plot:
Gulliver's Travels is a 2010 American fantasy adventure comedy directed by Rob Letterman, in his live-action debut, and written by Joe Stillman and Nicholas Stoller. Loosely based on the first part of Jonathan Swift's 1726 novel but set in the present day, it stars Jack Black as Lemuel Gulliver, with Jason Segel, Emily Blunt, Amanda Peet, Billy Connolly, Chris O'Dowd, T.J. Miller, James Corden and Catherine Tate. 20th Century Fox released it in the United States on December 25, 2010.

Gulliver works in the mail room of a New York newspaper and secretly adores the travel editor, Darcy Silverman. Trying to impress her, he submits a travel piece cobbled together from plagiarised material, and Darcy rewards him with an assignment to investigate the Bermuda Triangle. Sailing into the Triangle, he falls asleep at the helm, is caught by a storm and a waterspout, and washes up on Lilliput, an island of tiny people whose society resembles old Europe.

Treated as a monster, he is imprisoned in a cave, where he meets Horatio, a commoner jailed by General Edward for loving Princess Mary, whom Edward wants for himself. Gulliver rescues Mary from raiders of the rival island Blefuscia and puts out a fire threatening King Theodore, and is hailed as a hero. Claiming to be the President of Manhattan, he lives in luxury and stages Lilliputian versions of films and his own boasts, while advising Horatio on wooing Mary. The humiliated Edward sabotages the island's defences, and when Gulliver single-handedly defeats the Blefuscian fleet, Edward defects.

Using plans from a video game manual Gulliver lost, Edward pilots a giant robot that leads a Blefuscian invasion, forces Gulliver to confess he is just a mail-room worker, and banishes him to Brobdingnag, where a giant girl keeps him as a doll. Horatio finds him and reveals that Darcy, who followed him into the Triangle, is being held by the Blefuscians. Gulliver escapes, defeats Edward in a duel with Horatio's help, and ends the war by persuading both sides to make peace, before returning home with Darcy as a genuine travel writer.

Critics were dismissive, with a 19% Rotten Tomatoes approval. Made for about $112 million, the film flopped in North America but grossed $237 million worldwide.

overview: An Interpol-issued Red Notice is a global alert to hunt and capture the world's most wanted. But when a daring heist brings together the FBI's top profiler and two rival criminals, there's no telling what will happen.
tagline: Pro and cons.
title: Red Notice
plot:
Red Notice is a 2021 American action comedy written and directed by Rawson Marshall Thurber, starring Dwayne Johnson, Ryan Reynolds and Gal Gadot, with Ritu Arya and Chris Diamantopoulos in supporting roles. It is Thurber's third collaboration with Johnson after Central Intelligence and Skyscraper. Originally developed at Universal Pictures, the film was acquired by Netflix, which gave it a limited theatrical release on November 5, 2021, before streaming it on November 12.

According to legend, the Roman general Mark Antony gave Cleopatra three jeweled eggs as a wedding gift; two were rediscovered in 1907, but the third was lost for centuries. In the present, FBI profiler John Hartley, working with Interpol inspector Urvashi Das, investigates the theft of one of the eggs from the Castel Sant'Angelo in Rome by the world's most wanted art thief, Nolan Booth. Hartley tracks Booth to his hideout in Bali and arrests him, but Booth's chief rival, the elusive thief known as the Bishop, steals the egg and frames Hartley, who ends up locked in a remote Russian prison alongside Booth.

To clear his name, Hartley proposes an uneasy alliance with Booth to catch the Bishop. The pair escape and race to Valencia to steal the second egg from the arms dealer Sotto Voce during a masquerade ball, but the Bishop, who has teamed up with Voce, outmaneuvers them and forces Booth to reveal the location of the third egg. Booth lies, sending her to Egypt, while the true location, hidden in a watch that belonged to his father, leads to a secret Nazi bunker in the Argentine jungle. As Das and the police close in, a series of double-crosses ensues, culminating in the revelation that Hartley is not an FBI agent at all but a con man who shares the Bishop identity with his partner, leaving Booth to decide whether to join forces with them.

Netflix reported that Red Notice was the most-watched film in its debut weekend and that it remained the most-watched film in the platform's history for several years. Critics were generally unimpressed with its plot and derivative script but praised the stars' chemistry, the action sequences and the humor. Two sequels were announced, planned to be shot back to back.

overview: Two mismatched security guards are thrown together to bust a smuggling operation.
tagline: They only look like cops.
title: National Security
plot:
National Security is an action-comedy film that revolves around the story of two mismatched agents, Gabe Walker and Samson, who are forced to work together to stop a terrorist threat. The movie explores several themes, primarily focusing on the idea of unlikely partnerships and the power of human connection in the face of adversity.

At its core, National Security is a film about the importance of trust and communication in relationships. The two main characters, Gabe and Samson, are polar opposites who initially clash due to their vastly different backgrounds and approaches to their work. However, as they navigate the complex web of international espionage, they learn to put aside their differences and rely on each other to save the day.

The movie also touches on the theme of redemption and personal growth. Gabe, in particular, is a character who has been haunted by his past mistakes and is desperate to make amends. Through his partnership with Samson, he is forced to confront his demons and learn to trust others again.

Furthermore, National Security explores the tension between individuality and teamwork. The film's protagonist, Gabe, is a lone wolf who prefers to work alone, but ultimately comes to realize that sometimes, it takes a team effort to achieve success. This theme is reflected in the unlikely partnership between Gabe and Samson, who must learn to put aside their differences and work together to save the world from destruction.

Overall, National Security is a lighthearted, entertaining film that uses humor and action to explore themes of trust, redemption, and the power of human connection.

overview: The story of how Richard Williams served as a coach to his daughters Venus and Serena, who will soon become two of the most legendary tennis players in history.
tagline: Venus, Serena and a plan for greatness.
title: King Richard
plot:
King Richard is a biographical sports drama film directed by Reinaldo Marcus Green and written by Zach Baylin. The movie stars Will Smith as Richard Williams, a former tennis player who trains his daughters Venus and Serena Williams to become professional tennis players.

The film begins with Richard (Will Smith) living in Compton, California, with his wife, Oracene (Aunjanue Ellis), and their two young daughters, Venus (Saniyya Sidney) and Serena (Demi Singleton). The family is struggling financially, but Richard has a vision for his daughters' futures. He believes that with hard work and dedication, they can become professional tennis players.

Richard's unorthodox training methods, which include hitting the ball against walls and using makeshift rackets, are met with skepticism by Oracene and the girls at first. However, as they begin to see progress, they start to believe in Richard's vision. The family moves to Florida, where Richard sets up a tennis academy for his daughters.

As Venus and Serena grow older, they face numerous challenges on and off the court. They encounter racism and sexism from their opponents, coaches, and even some of their own family members. Despite these obstacles, the sisters persevere and begin to make a name for themselves in the tennis world.

The film's plot development is marked by several pivotal moments, including a dramatic match between Venus and her opponent, Zina Garrison (Nia Long), which showcases the sisters' growing skills and confidence. Richard's relationship with his daughters also deepens, as he becomes more than just a coach but a mentor and a father figure.

As Serena begins to rise through the ranks of professional tennis, she faces increasing pressure from her family and coaches to perform. The film culminates in a dramatic match between Serena and Martina Navratilova (played by actress Kate Winslet), which marks a turning point in Serena's career.

The movie ends with Richard watching his daughters achieve their dreams on the court, while also acknowledging the sacrifices he made for them along the way. Will Smith delivers a powerful performance as Richard Williams, capturing the complexity and nuance of this remarkable man. The film is a testament to the power of family, perseverance, and determination in overcoming adversity.

Overall, King Richard is a heartwarming and inspiring film that celebrates the achievements of two tennis legends. With outstanding performances from its cast, including Will Smith, Saniyya Sidney, and Demi Singleton, the movie is a must-see for sports fans and anyone interested in underdog stories.

overview: Two brothers living a hard life of manual labor in rural Mexico have a simple dream: saving enough money to build their mother her dream house. But fate has other plans. A friendly game of soccer leads to first Rudo, then to Cursi being taken on by the nation’s top talent scout. Suddenly, they find themselves living the high life of star athletes: fame, fortune, fast cars and beautiful women.
tagline: Even when your luck runs out, some things never change.
title: Rudo & Cursi
plot:
Rudo y Cursi is a 2008 Mexican sports drama film directed by Alfonso Cuarón. The movie tells the story of two brothers, Rudo and Cursi, who are both talented soccer players but have vastly different personalities and approaches to the game.

The main theme of Rudo & Cursi revolves around the complexities of sibling relationships and the struggles that come with growing up and finding one's identity. The film explores how the brothers' contrasting personalities - Rudo is a hot-headed, aggressive player who often clashes with his brother, while Cursi is more laid-back and strategic - affect their relationship and ultimately impact their lives.

Through the lens of soccer, the movie delves into themes of ambition, sacrifice, and the consequences of one's actions. As the brothers navigate their individual paths in the world of professional soccer, they must confront the harsh realities of their own desires and the sacrifices that come with pursuing success.

The film also touches on the idea of identity and how it is shaped by our experiences, relationships, and passions. Rudo and Cursi's struggles to find their place in the world serve as a metaphor for the universal human quest to discover one's purpose and belonging.

Ultimately, Rudo & Cursi is a poignant exploration of the complexities of family dynamics, personal growth, and the power of sports to shape our lives and relationships.

overview: A single mother's life is thrown into turmoil after her struggling, rarely-seen younger brother returns to town.
tagline: Family first. Love always.
title: You Can Count on Me
plot:
You Can Count on Me is a poignant and introspective drama that explores the complexities of human relationships, identity, and the struggles of everyday life. The film delves into the emotional landscape of its protagonist, Sam, a single mother struggling to cope with her own demons and find stability in her life.

At its core, the movie is a nuanced portrayal of the fragility of human connection and the ways in which our relationships can both heal and harm us. Through Sam's story, the film sheds light on the intricate web of emotions that bind us together, revealing the beauty and pain that can arise from these connections.

The movie also touches on themes of loneliness, isolation, and the search for meaning in a chaotic world. Sam's struggles to balance her own needs with those of her son, Toby, serve as a powerful metaphor for the universal human quest for connection and belonging.

Through its thoughtful pacing and nuanced character development, You Can Count on Me offers a deeply moving exploration of the human experience, one that is both deeply personal and universally relatable.

overview: When a viking mercenary finds himself in the middle of a battle between the old gods and the new, he decides that neither side deserves to win. And so begins an epic battle between good and evil that will decide the fate of a nation.
tagline: The battle begins…
title: Viking Blood
plot: When a viking mercenary finds himself in the middle of a battle between the old gods and the new, he decides that neither side deserves to win. And so begins an epic battle between good and evil that will decide the fate of a nation.

overview: Two friends in Mexico discover the Lament Configuration and unleash Pinhead, but one decides to try to survive by swapping himself with someone else. Once they go missing, family members go in search of them, but find Pinhead instead.
tagline: The Return of Pinhead.
title: Hellraiser: Revelations
plot:
Hellraiser: Revelations is a 2011 American horror film written by Gary J. Tunnicliffe and directed by Víctor Garcia, the ninth installment in the Hellraiser series based on the work of Clive Barker. It stars Steven Brand, Nick Eversman and Tracey Fairaway, with Stephan Smith Collins as Pinhead, the leader of the sadomasochistic otherworldly beings known as the Cenobites.

Best friends Nico Bradley and Steven Craven run away from home and travel to Mexico, where they film themselves partying for days before vanishing without a trace. The Mexican authorities later return their belongings to their families, including a videotape recorded by Steven and an ornate puzzle box. A year later, the two families gather for an uneasy dinner. Steven's sister Emma, who was also Nico's girlfriend, is frustrated by the lack of answers and demands to know what is on the tape that her mother Sarah has been watching in secret.

When Emma views the footage, the story of the boys' final days begins to emerge in flashbacks. In Mexico, Nico killed a young woman they had picked up in a bar and used the crime to force Steven to keep traveling with him. Nico was then given the puzzle box by a vagrant who promised him unimaginable pleasures. At the house, Emma finds the box and tries to work it, and Steven suddenly reappears, bloodied and terrified. The families find themselves unable to leave as Steven warns that the Cenobites are coming, and the secrets and desires of everyone in the house come to the surface as the demons arrive to claim what they are owed.

The film was produced in a matter of weeks because Dimension Films needed to release a new Hellraiser film to retain the rights to the franchise. Because of the rushed schedule, longtime star Doug Bradley declined to take part, making it the first entry in which he did not play Pinhead.

Revelations received a single theatrical screening in March 2011, ostensibly open to the public, before being released on DVD on October 18, 2011. Reviews were overwhelmingly negative: none of the critics counted by Rotten Tomatoes gave it a positive review, and Dread Central wrote that it made all the earlier sequels look great by comparison.

overview: Fired from his band and hard up for cash, guitarist and vocalist Dewey Finn finagles his way into a job as a fifth-grade substitute teacher at a private school, where he secretly begins teaching his students the finer points of rock 'n' roll. The school's hard-nosed principal is rightly suspicious of Finn's activities. But Finn's roommate remains in the dark about what he's doing.
production_companies: MFP Munich Film Partners GmbH & Company I. Produktions KG
tagline: He just landed the gig of his life: 5th grade.
title: School of Rock
plot:
School of Rock is a 2003 musical comedy film directed by Richard Linklater and produced by Paramount Pictures.

The movie follows Dewey Finn (played by Jack Black), a struggling rock musician who poses as a substitute teacher at a prestigious prep school to make ends meet. He forms a class of misfit students into a rock band, teaching them how to play music and find their own voice.

The main themes of School of Rock include:

1. **Embracing individuality**: The film celebrates the uniqueness of each character, encouraging them to express themselves and find their place in the world.
2. **Music as empowerment**: Music is a powerful tool for self-expression, creativity, and social change. Dewey's passion for rock music inspires his students to tap into their own talents and passions.
3. **Redemption and second chances**: Dewey, who has hit rock bottom, finds a new sense of purpose through teaching and mentoring his students. He also gets a chance to redeem himself as a musician and a person.
4. **The importance of friendship and community**: The film highlights the bonds that form between Dewey and his students, as well as among the students themselves. They come together to support each other and create something beautiful through music.
5. **Overcoming adversity**: Despite facing numerous challenges, including financial struggles and personal doubts, the characters in School of Rock persevere and ultimately achieve their goals.

The movie features a talented cast, including Joan Cusack, Mike White, and Miranda Cosgrove, among others. The soundtrack includes original songs by Jack Black and Mike White, which have become iconic and memorable.

Overall, School of Rock is a heartwarming and entertaining film that celebrates the power of music, creativity, and self-expression.

original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙英雄記
overview: One day Doraemon, Nobita, Shizuka, Gian and Suneo were shooting a film as space heroes. When they were shooting the film in the open lot a boy called Aron comes and alerts them of aliens attacking his planet. They agree to help him by turning into real superheroes, but it isn't as easy as it looks.
title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Space Heroes
plot:
Doraemon: Nobita and the Space Heroes is an animated science fiction film that revolves around the adventures of Nobita Nobi, a young boy who travels through time with his robotic cat companion, Doraemon. The movie explores themes of friendship, teamwork, and the importance of believing in oneself.

The story delves into the idea of overcoming one's fears and doubts to achieve greatness. Nobita, along with his friends Shizuka, Suneo, and Gian, embark on a perilous journey through space to rescue their teacher, Mr. Oshoji, who has been kidnapped by an alien named Zeta. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles and challenges that test their courage and resolve.

Through Nobita's character development, the film highlights the significance of perseverance and determination in the face of adversity. As he navigates through the unknown territories of space, Nobita learns to trust himself and his abilities, ultimately discovering a newfound sense of confidence and self-worth.

The movie also touches on the theme of friendship and camaraderie, showcasing the strong bonds between Nobita's friends as they work together to overcome their challenges. The film's portrayal of teamwork and cooperation serves as a powerful reminder that when individuals come together with a shared goal in mind, they can achieve remarkable things.

Overall, Doraemon: Nobita and the Space Heroes is a heartwarming and action-packed adventure that celebrates the power of friendship, self-discovery, and determination.

overview: In a future where an adult Gwen Tennyson is president and the world is being taken over by the alien horde known as the Xerge, a disillusioned Ben 10000 is called out of retirement to recruit his 10-year old version from the past.
title: Ben 10: Ben 10,010
plot: In a future where an adult Gwen Tennyson is president and the world is being taken over by the alien horde known as the Xerge, a disillusioned Ben 10,000 is called out of retirement to recruit his 10-year-old version from the past. Based on the 2016 reboot.

overview: Oh, Ramona! seeks the transformation of Andrew from a teenager into an adult who lives candidly and selflessly his first love story, innocent and uninvolved, alternating with the second, intense and insane story, incapable of making a choice. Oh, Ramona! is the cinematic rewriting of Andrei Ciobanu's book "Suge-o, Ramona!".
tagline: A fost odata... ...si inca o data!
title: Oh, Ramona!
plot:
Oh, Ramona! is a 2019 Indian Tamil-language drama film directed by Zazu Film. The movie revolves around the life of Ramona, a young woman who lives in a small town and struggles to find her place in the world.

The main theme of Oh, Ramona! explores the complexities of female identity, particularly in rural India. The film delves into Ramona's inner turmoil as she navigates societal expectations, family pressures, and personal desires. Through Ramona's character, the movie sheds light on the struggles faced by women in patriarchal societies, where they are often expected to conform to traditional roles.

The film also touches upon themes of loneliness, isolation, and the human desire for connection. Ramona's relationships with others, particularly her family members, are a central focus of the movie. The film portrays the intricate web of emotions that exist within these relationships, highlighting both the love and the pain that can be present in them.

Furthermore, Oh, Ramona! explores the tension between tradition and modernity, as Ramona grapples with the constraints of her rural upbringing versus her own aspirations for a more fulfilling life. The movie raises questions about the role of women in society, their agency, and their right to make choices that align with their desires.

Overall, Oh, Ramona! is a poignant exploration of the human experience, delving into themes that are both deeply personal and universally relatable.

overview: Hayley’s a smart, charming teenage girl. Jeff’s a handsome, smooth fashion photographer. An Internet chat, a coffee shop meet-up, an impromptu fashion shoot back at Jeff’s place. Jeff thinks it’s his lucky night. He’s in for a surprise.
tagline: Strangers shouldn't talk to little girls.
title: Hard Candy
plot:
Hard Candy is a psychological thriller film directed by David Slade, released in 2005 by Vulcan Productions, not Vulcan Productions.

The main themes of Hard Candy include:

1. **Childhood trauma and exploitation**: The movie explores the dark side of childhood, where a young girl, Hayley Stark (Ellen Page), is manipulated and exploited by an adult, Jeff Kohlver (Patrick Wilson). This theme highlights the vulnerability of children and the need for protection.

2. **Power dynamics and control**: The film showcases the power struggle between Hayley and Jeff, as she tries to assert her authority over him. This theme is reflected in their cat-and-mouse game, where Jeff's attempts to manipulate Hayley are met with her growing determination to outsmart him.

3. **Moral ambiguity and gray areas**: Hard Candy blurs the lines between good and evil, making it difficult for the audience to categorize characters as purely right or wrong. This moral complexity adds depth to the story, leaving viewers questioning their own perceptions of justice and morality.

4. **Coming-of-age and self-discovery**: Through Hayley's character, the film explores her journey from a vulnerable child to a confident individual who takes control of her life. This theme is reflected in her interactions with Jeff, as she learns to assert herself and set boundaries.

5. **The darker side of technology and online anonymity**: The movie touches on the theme of online anonymity and the potential dangers that come with it. Jeff's use of his online persona to manipulate Hayley serves as a cautionary tale about the risks of hiding behind screens.

Overall, Hard Candy is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes and moral gray areas, making it a compelling watch for audiences interested in psychological thrillers.

overview: Spenser, a former Boston patrolman who just got out from prison, teams up with Hawk, an aspiring fighter, to unravel the truth behind the death of two police officers.
tagline: The law has limits. They don't.
title: Spenser Confidential
plot:
Spenser Confidential is a 2020 American action comedy film directed by Peter Berg and starring Mark Wahlberg as the titular character. The movie is based on the novel "Robert B. Parker's Wonderland" by Ace Atkins, but it takes creative liberties with the source material.

The main themes of Spenser Confidential include:

1. Redemption: Spenser, a former Boston cop, is trying to redeem himself after being fired from the police department. He sees this job as an opportunity to prove himself and make amends for past mistakes.
2. Loyalty: Throughout the movie, Spenser forms strong bonds with his colleagues, including Hawk (Winston Duke) and Teddy (Megan Fox). These relationships are built on trust, loyalty, and mutual respect.
3. Identity: As a former cop turned private investigator, Spenser struggles to find his place in the world. He's no longer part of the police department, but he still wants to make a difference. This theme is reflected in his complicated past and his desire for redemption.
4. Corruption: The movie explores the theme of corruption within law enforcement agencies. Spenser's former colleagues are involved in a massive conspiracy, which leads him to question everything he thought he knew about his job.

The plot follows Spenser as he teams up with Hawk, a tough-as-nails bodyguard, to solve a murder case involving a wealthy businessman. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including corrupt cops and rival gangs. As they dig deeper, they uncover a complex web of deceit and corruption that threatens to destroy everything.

The ending is action-packed, with Spenser and Hawk facing off against their enemies in a thrilling showdown. In the end, Spenser finds redemption by taking down the corrupt officials and bringing justice to those who have been wronged.

Overall, Spenser Confidential explores themes of redemption, loyalty, identity, and corruption, set against the backdrop of an action-packed mystery.

overview: In St. Jude, drug dealers and corrupt cops have destroyed an urban neighborhood. But newcomer, Hong, has the fighting skills and moral vision to save this town from itself.
title: Dragon Eyes
plot:
Dragon Eyes is a 2012 American martial arts action film directed by John Hyams and starring Cung Le, Jean-Claude Van Damme and Peter Weller. It was the second collaboration between Van Damme and Hyams after Universal Soldier: Regeneration (2009) and was one of the first titles from After Dark Action, a genre label formed by After Dark Films and Dark Castle. The cast also includes Crystal Mantecón as Rosanna, Danny Mora as Grandpa George, Luis da Silva as the gang leader Dash and Dan Henderson as a police officer.

St. Jude Square, a neighborhood in New Orleans, lives in fear and despair. Two rival gangs, run by the local kingpins Dash and Antoine, terrorize its streets, and residents have given up hope. Into this setting comes Ryan Hong, a quiet stranger seeking a second chance and a way to atone for the violence of his past. Calling on the teachings of Tiano, the mentor he met in prison, who is seen in flashbacks with a tragic history of his own, Hong begins to confront the gangs and cleverly plays one against the other, robbing and humbling both and earning a measure of respect on the streets.

Just as he begins to bring the neighborhood under control, Hong attracts the attention of Victor Swan, known as Mr. V, the corrupt police chief who has been using the gangs to advance his own crooked agenda. At first Mr. V is impressed by Hong's skill and sees a chance to turn him into a far more valuable weapon than either gang. He soon recognizes, however, that the newcomer threatens his regime. The two men become locked in a head-to-head struggle that pits the fear and corruption of Mr. V's rule against the fresh start Hong represents for the people of St. Jude Square, building to a series of violent confrontations.

The film was released in the United States in May 2012 as part of the After Dark Action slate, and G2 Pictures issued it on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on 9 April 2012. Reviews were mixed. Critics generally praised Hyams's dark, moody direction and the forceful, well-choreographed fight scenes, which make the most of the performers' martial arts skills, but found the story thin and clichéd. Gabe Toro of IndieWire wrote that the threadbare narrative ran out of steam around the hour mark and that Le lacked a leading man's charisma, though he felt the older Van Damme brought real gravitas to his small, largely superfluous part, and concluded that the film worked best as a demonstration of Hyams's promise as an action director.

overview: A young man finds out that he holds the key to restoring hope and ensuring survival for the human race, while an alien species called the Drej are bent on mankind's destruction.
tagline: When Earth Ends, The Adventure Begins.
title: Titan A.E.
plot:
Titan A.E. is an animated science fiction film that explores the human condition through its narrative and characters. The movie delves into the consequences of technological advancements on humanity, as well as the importance of preserving cultural heritage.

The story revolves around Cale, a young man who embarks on a perilous journey to save humanity from extinction. Along the way, he encounters various characters, including a wise and aged mentor figure, who guide him in his quest. The film's themes are deeply rooted in its exploration of identity, community, and the struggle for survival.

One of the primary concerns of Titan A.E. is the impact of technological progress on human relationships and society. The movie portrays a world where humans have become increasingly reliant on technology, leading to a decline in face-to-face interactions and a sense of disconnection among individuals. This theme is reflected in Cale's journey, as he navigates through a desolate landscape and encounters various remnants of human civilization.

The film also explores the importance of preserving cultural heritage and the value of tradition in a rapidly changing world. The character of Maet, a wise and aged mentor figure, serves as a symbol of this theme.
