Borat Sagdiyev (Sacha Baron Cohen) returns to the United States, this time with his daughter Tutar (Maria Bakalova), a 15-year-old girl who is being raised by her father in Kazakhstan. The story begins with Borat's attempt to reunite with his ex-wife, Maria (Maria Bamford), and their son, Jozef (Zachary Goldberg). However, things do not go as planned, and Borat ends up getting into various misadventures.

One of the main plot points of the film is Borat's attempt to become a social media influencer. He creates an Instagram account and starts promoting himself as a "woke" and "PC" individual, which leads to him being banned from several platforms. Meanwhile, Tutar becomes a viral sensation on social media due to her provocative behavior and outrageous comments.

As the story progresses, Borat becomes embroiled in various American politics and culture. He attends a rally for Donald Trump (Jeremy Allen White), where he gets into a heated argument with a group of protesters. He also visits a gun range, where he attempts to buy a firearm but is thwarted by a background check.

Throughout the film, Borat's interactions with his daughter Tutar are a highlight. The two engage in various pranks and schemes, often targeting their neighbors and acquaintances. However, as the story progresses, it becomes clear that Tutar is not just a pawn in her father's games, but also a complex and independent individual who is navigating her own identity.

The film's climax features Borat's attempt to run for president of Kazakhstan. He uses his social media fame to gain support from his countrymen, but ultimately fails to win the election. The movie ends with Borat returning to Kazakhstan, where he is met with a hero's welcome. However, it becomes clear that Tutar has grown up and moved on from her father's antics.

Overall, Borat Subsequent Moviefilm is a satirical commentary on American politics, culture, and society. The film uses humor and absurdity to critique the excesses of modern America, while also exploring themes of identity, family, and belonging.

overview: Washed-up MMA fighter Cole Young, unaware of his heritage, and hunted by Emperor Shang Tsung's best warrior, Sub-Zero, seeks out and trains with Earth's greatest champions as he prepares to stand against the enemies of Outworld in a high stakes battle for the universe.
tagline: Get over here.
title: Mortal Kombat
plot:
Mortal Kombat is a 2021 martial arts action film directed by Simon McQuoid, based on the popular video game franchise of the same name. The movie takes place in a fantasy world where Earthrealm and Outworld are at war.

The story follows Cole Young (Lewis Tan), an American martial artist who discovers he is the chosen "Chosen One" destined to participate in the Mortal Kombat tournament, a deadly competition between Earthrealm and Outworld. The winner of the tournament will gain control over the realms.

Cole soon finds himself transported to the realm of Outworld, where he meets Sonya Blade (Jessica McNamee), a skilled warrior from Earthrealm who is also participating in the tournament. Together, they join forces with other fighters, including Liu Kang (Chin Han), a Shaolin monk; Bi-Han (Max Huang), a ruthless Outworlder; and Kano (Hiroyuki Sanada), a member of the Black Dragon clan.

As the tournament progresses, Cole and his allies must face off against formidable opponents, including Shang Tsung (Joe Taslim), an evil sorcerer who serves as the main antagonist. The group soon discovers that the true purpose of the Mortal Kombat is not just to determine the winner but also to decide the fate of Earthrealm.

Throughout the movie, Cole and his friends must use their unique fighting skills and work together to overcome their opponents and ultimately defeat Shang Tsung. Along the way, they uncover a deeper conspiracy involving the Outworld Emperor, Shao Kahn (Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson), who seeks to conquer Earthrealm and destroy its people.

The movie features a mix of action, drama, and fantasy elements, with a focus on showcasing the iconic characters and fighting styles from the Mortal Kombat franchise. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the game series generally praised the film's visuals, action sequences, and faithfulness to the source material.

Overall, Mortal Kombat (2021) is an entertaining and visually stunning adaptation that brings the world of Mortal Kombat to life on the big screen.

overview: London, England, April 1980. Six terrorists assault the Embassy of Iran and take hostages. For six days, tense negotiations are held while the authorities decide whether a military squad should intervene.
tagline: In the face of terror, a nation will show its strength
title: 6 Days
plot:
6 Days is a 2017 British-New Zealand action thriller directed by Toa Fraser and written by Glenn Standring, based on the 1980 Iranian Embassy siege in London. It stars Jamie Bell as SAS team leader Rusty Firmin, Abbie Cornish as BBC reporter Kate Adie, Mark Strong as police negotiator Max Vernon and Martin Shaw. The film presents the crisis through these three perspectives: the negotiator, the soldiers and the journalist.

On 30 April 1980, six armed Iranian Arab separatists storm the Iranian Embassy at Princes Gate in Kensington and take more than two dozen people hostage, including police constable Trevor Lock. Their leader, Salim, demands the release of 91 Arab prisoners held in Iran and threatens to begin killing hostages if his demands are not met. Chief Inspector Max Vernon of the Metropolitan Police opens a telephone line with Salim and tries to buy time, building a fragile rapport while promising to help him avoid bloodshed.

As the days pass, Vernon negotiates the release of a few hostages and an extension of the deadline, while Salim demands safe passage out of the country accompanied by Arab ambassadors and insists on getting his message broadcast by the BBC. Outside, Kate Adie reports live from the police cordon, determined to cover the story as it unfolds. Meanwhile, Firmin's SAS team rehearses an assault on the building, waiting for orders from Margaret Thatcher's government, which refuses to give in to terrorism. When the hostage-takers kill a hostage on the sixth day, the soldiers are given the order to storm the embassy in a raid broadcast live on television.

The film recreates the period in detail and emphasizes the tension of waiting and negotiating as much as the climactic raid, known as Operation Nimrod, which made the SAS famous around the world.

6 Days was released in the United Kingdom on 4 August 2017 and was later distributed internationally by Netflix. It received mixed reviews, with about 63 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus described it as a taut if unambitious thriller, while Metacritic gave it a score of 36.

overview: After reluctantly agreeing to coach cross-country, high school basketball Coach John Harrison helps the least likely runner attempt the impossible in the biggest race of the year.
tagline: What do you allow to define you?
title: Overcomer
plot:
Overcomer is a 2019 American Christian sports drama film written and directed by Alex Kendrick and his brother, Jon Erwin, under the production company Kendrick Brothers. The movie stars Shania Twain, Aryn Wright-Thompson, and Alex Kendrick.

The story revolves around Hannah Lee Scott (played by Aryn Wright-Thompson), a high school cheerleader who is struggling to find her place in life after being cut from the team due to her weight. She meets Jesus Christ through a Christian outreach program called "NASCAR: Drive for Christ," which aims to spread Christianity through NASCAR racing.

Hannah befriends Tripp (played by Alex Kendrick), a former high school basketball star who has lost his faith and is now working as an assistant coach at the same high school where Hannah attends. As they spend more time together, Hannah shares her struggles with Tripp, and he begins to see her in a different light.

Meanwhile, Hannah's rival, Kelly Foster (played by Shania Twain), is also struggling with her own faith crisis. Kelly was once a devout Christian but has since become disillusioned with the church due to its perceived hypocrisy. As she gets to know Hannah, Kelly starts to question her own values and eventually finds redemption through her relationship with Hannah.

Throughout the movie, Hannah and Tripp work together to help their teammates overcome personal struggles and find faith in Jesus Christ. Along the way, they learn valuable lessons about perseverance, forgiveness, and the importance of living a life that honors God.

As the story unfolds, Hannah's relationships with her friends and family become more complicated. Her parents are divorced, and she struggles to connect with them due to her weight issues. Tripp, on the other hand, has a strained relationship with his father, who is a former pastor.

The climax of the movie takes place during a high school basketball game, where Hannah's team faces off against Kelly's rival team. As the game reaches its peak, Hannah and Kelly have a heart-to-heart conversation that leads to their mutual redemption and forgiveness.

In the end, Hannah finds her place in life as a leader on the cheerleading squad, and Tripp rediscovers his faith through his relationship with Hannah. The movie concludes with a powerful message about the transformative power of Jesus Christ and the importance of living a life that honors Him.

Overall, Overcomer is a heartwarming and inspiring film that explores themes of faith, redemption, and perseverance in the face of adversity.

overview: When Mahendra, the son of Bāhubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom.
title: Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion
plot:
Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion is a 2017 Indian fantasy adventure film directed by S.S. Rajamouli and produced by Arka Media Works, in association with Shobu Yarlagadda's Annapurna Studios.

The story begins with the flashback of Bhallaladeva (Rana Daggubati), who was once a close friend and brother-in-law to the king of Mahishmathi. However, he is betrayed by his own brother, Bhairava (Sathyaraj), and is left for dead in a well. The film then jumps forward in time to the present day, where we meet the protagonist, Mahendra (Prabhas), who is the crown prince of Mahishmathi.

Mahendra's life takes a dramatic turn when he discovers that his brother Bhairava has taken over the throne and is ruling with an iron fist. The people of Mahishmathi are suffering under Bhairava's cruel rule, and Mahendra decides to take action to reclaim his rightful place as king.

As Mahendra navigates the complexities of court politics, he meets a mysterious woman named Avanthika (Anushka Shetty), who is revealed to be the reincarnation of Devasena, the princess of Mahishmathi. The two form a strong bond, and Mahendra learns that Avanthika has the power to bring back his brother Bhairava from the dead.

However, things take a dark turn when Mahendra discovers that Bhairava's resurrection is not what it seems. In reality, Bhairava is being controlled by a powerful demon named Kattappa (Sathyaraj), who was once a loyal servant of the king but has since become corrupted by his own ambition.

As the story unfolds, Mahendra and Avanthika must navigate treacherous obstacles and confront their enemies in order to save Mahishmathi from destruction. Along the way, they discover that Bhairava's resurrection is just the beginning of a larger conspiracy that threatens the very existence of the kingdom.

The film builds towards an epic climax as Mahendra and his allies face off against Kattappa and his minions in a battle for control of the throne. In the end, Mahendra emerges victorious, but not without great cost. The film concludes with a sense of closure and new beginnings, as Mahendra and Avanthika look towards a brighter future for Mahishmathi.

Throughout the film, Rajamouli's direction is masterful, weaving together complex characters, intricate plot twists, and stunning visuals to create a cinematic experience that is both thrilling and emotionally resonant. The film's themes of loyalty, betrayal, and redemption are timeless and universal, making Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion a must-see for fans of epic fantasy adventures.

keywords.name: based on song, poem or rhyme

overview: A 6th-century Scandinavian warrior named Beowulf embarks on a mission to slay the man-like ogre, Grendel.
tagline: Evil breeds pain.
title: Beowulf
plot:
Beowulf is a 2007 American animated epic fantasy film produced and directed by Robert Zemeckis and written by Neil Gaiman and Roger Avary, loosely based on the Old English poem Beowulf. Made with performance-capture animation, the technique Zemeckis had used for The Polar Express, it features Ray Winstone as Beowulf, Anthony Hopkins as King Hrothgar, Robin Wright Penn as Queen Wealtheow, Brendan Gleeson as Wiglaf, John Malkovich as Unferth, Crispin Glover as Grendel, Alison Lohman and Angelina Jolie as Grendel's mother. The film reinterprets the poem, changing several elements of its story.

In 507 AD, the Danish king Hrothgar's mead hall, Heorot, is terrorized by Grendel, a monstrous creature tormented by the noise of the king's celebrations, which slaughters his warriors. The Geatish hero Beowulf sails to Denmark with his men to destroy the monster, boasting of his past exploits. To lure Grendel out, Beowulf's men hold a loud feast in the hall, and Beowulf fights the creature naked and unarmed so that the contest will be equal. Discovering that Grendel has extremely sensitive hearing, Beowulf injures his ear and tears off his arm, and Grendel crawls home to die in his mother's arms.

In gratitude, Hrothgar gives Beowulf a golden drinking horn. That night Grendel's mother, a seductive water demon, takes revenge by killing Beowulf's men. Hrothgar sends Beowulf to her cave, where, instead of killing her, Beowulf succumbs to her offer of wealth and power in exchange for a son, and returns with a false tale of victory. Hrothgar, who reveals that he once made the same bargain, names Beowulf his heir and takes his own life. Decades later, the aging King Beowulf rules a prosperous kingdom but is haunted by his secret, which returns in the form of a dragon that attacks his land, forcing him into a final battle to atone for the sins of his youth.

Beowulf premiered in London in November 2007 and was released in 3D and IMAX 3D as well as conventional formats. It received generally positive reviews; critics praised its visual effects, its action sequences and Gaiman and Avary's darker, more adult reworking of the poem, though some found the motion-capture characters unsettling. It grossed about $196 million worldwide against a budget of around $150 million.

overview: After losing his wife seven years earlier, the eccentric Dr. John Dolittle, famed doctor and veterinarian of Queen Victoria’s England, hermits himself away behind the high walls of Dolittle Manor with only his menagerie of exotic animals for company. But when the young queen falls gravely ill, a reluctant Dolittle is forced to set sail on an epic adventure to a mythical island in search of a cure, regaining his wit and courage as he crosses old adversaries and discovers wondrous creatures.
tagline: He's just not a people person.
title: Dolittle
plot:
Dolittle is a 2020 fantasy adventure film directed by Stephen Gaghan and written by Dan Fogelman. The movie is a live-action adaptation of the classic children's book series "The Story of Doctor Dolittle" by Hugh Lofting.

The story begins with Dr. John Dolittle (played by Robert Downey Jr.), a renowned veterinarian who has the unique ability to communicate with animals. As a child, Dolittle was ostracized by his peers due to his unusual gift, but he eventually found solace in his work and became an expert in animal behavior.

The film takes place in 1920s England, where Dolittle is struggling to find meaning in his life after the loss of his wife. He is visited by a mysterious woman named Emily (played by Antonio Banderas), who reveals that she is a member of a secret society dedicated to protecting the world from supernatural threats.

Emily informs Dolittle that he has been chosen to fulfill an ancient prophecy, which states that he must use his gift to communicate with animals and help them defeat an evil sorcerer named Malakai (played by Antonio Banderas). Malakai is using his powers to control the minds of humans, turning them into mindless drones.

Dolittle embarks on a journey across the globe, accompanied by a group of animal friends, including a wise-cracking parrot named Polynesia and a loyal dog named Max. Along the way, he encounters various creatures, from talking animals to mythical beings, who aid him in his quest to defeat Malakai.

As Dolittle delves deeper into the world of magic and fantasy, he discovers that his gift is not just a unique ability but also a key to unlocking the secrets of the universe. He learns that he has a special connection to the natural world and that he can harness its power to heal and protect it.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Dolittle and Malakai, with the fate of humanity hanging in the balance. With the help of his animal friends and Emily, Dolittle uses his gift to rally the creatures of the world and defeat the evil sorcerer.

In the end, Dolittle emerges victorious, having saved the world from Malakai's mind control. The film concludes with Dolittle returning home, where he is welcomed back by his community as a hero. He has finally found a sense of purpose and belonging, using his gift to make a positive impact on the world.

Overall, Dolittle is a heartwarming and action-packed adventure that explores themes of identity, community, and the power of nature. With its stunning visuals, engaging storyline, and memorable characters, this film is sure to delight audiences of all ages.

overview: A comprehensive 12-part documentary on the making of "Spider-Man 2," covering everything from pre-production to premiere.
title: Spider-Man 2: Making the Amazing
plot: A comprehensive 12-part documentary on the making of "Spider-Man 2," covering everything from pre-production to premiere.

overview: A man stranded in the Arctic is finally about to receive his long awaited rescue. However, after a tragic accident, his opportunity is lost and he must then decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his camp or embark on a deadly trek through the unknown for potential salvation.
tagline: Survival is the only option
title: Arctic
plot:
Arctic is a 2018 American survival drama film directed by Joe Penna, produced by Pegasus Pictures, and released on Netflix.

The main themes of Arctic revolve around survival, redemption, and the human condition. The story follows Ottway, a former Special Forces operative who is haunted by his past and struggling to cope with the loss of his wife. After being stranded in the Arctic wilderness after a plane crash, Ottway must confront his inner demons and learn to survive against all odds.

Throughout the film, Penna explores themes of isolation, loneliness, and the psychological effects of trauma on individuals. The harsh environment of the Arctic serves as a metaphor for Ottway's emotional state, mirroring his feelings of numbness, anger, and despair.

As Ottway navigates the treacherous terrain, he begins to confront his past mistakes and the guilt that has been weighing him down. Through his struggles to survive, he starts to find a sense of purpose and redemption, ultimately leading to a transformative journey of self-discovery.

The film also touches on themes of masculinity, vulnerability, and the importance of human connection in the face of adversity. Ottway's character arc is a powerful exploration of how people can be broken by trauma but also healed through their own resilience and determination.

Overall, Arctic is a gripping survival drama that delves into the complexities of the human psyche, exploring themes that are both deeply personal and universally relatable.

keywords.name: based on magazine, newspaper or article

overview: A mythic motorcycle tale of father and son", this is the story of Manuel Galloway, also known as "the King of Cali", the president of a motorcycle club whose members are all African-American men, mostly white-collar workers who exchange their suits and ties at night and on weekends for leather outfits and motorcycle helmets.
tagline: Survival of the fastest.
title: Biker Boyz
plot:
Biker Boyz is an action-packed film that delves into the world of street racing and loyalty among bikers. The movie follows two rival gangs, the "Riptides" and the "Vagabonds," who engage in a series of intense street racing battles.

At its core, Biker Boyz explores the theme of brotherhood and loyalty among the characters. The film highlights the strong bonds between the bikers, particularly within their respective crews, as they navigate the dangers of their world. The movie also touches on the idea of identity and belonging, as the characters struggle to find their place in the world beyond their biker lifestyle.

Furthermore, Biker Boyz is a film about the consequences of violence and the cyclical nature of revenge. As the rival gangs engage in increasingly violent confrontations, the characters are forced to confront the devastating effects of their actions on themselves and those around them. The movie ultimately suggests that there may be a way out of this cycle of violence, but it is not an easy path.

The film also explores themes of redemption and personal growth, as some of the characters begin to question their choices and seek a way to leave their biker lifestyle behind. However, these themes are often overshadowed by the more intense action sequences and the rivalry between the gangs.

Overall, Biker Boyz is a high-octane film that uses its fast-paced action sequences to explore deeper themes of loyalty, identity, and the consequences of violence.

original_title: ドラゴンボールZ 激突!!100億パワーの戦士たち
overview: Cooler has resurrected himself as a robot and is enslaving the people of New Namek. Goku and the gang must help.
title: Dragon Ball Z: The Return of Cooler
plot:
Dragon Ball Z: The Return of Cooler is a 1992 anime film directed by Daisuke Nishio, produced by Toei Animation. It is the third Dragon Ball Z feature film and serves as a sequel to the previous two films, Dragon Ball Z: The World's Strongest and Dragon Ball Z: The Tree of Might.

The story begins with Goku and his friends enjoying their victory over Majin Buu in the previous film. However, their celebration is short-lived as they soon discover that Cooler, the brother of Frieza, has returned to Earth seeking revenge against Goku and his friends for defeating him in the past.

Cooler, who possesses a powerful new technique called "Gravity Ball," begins to wreak havoc on the planet, using his abilities to create massive earthquakes and destroy entire cities. The Z Warriors, led by Goku, must band together once again to stop Cooler's destructive rampage.

As the battle between the Z Warriors and Cooler intensifies, it becomes clear that Cooler is not just a mindless villain, but rather a complex character with a deep-seated hatred for Goku and his friends. Throughout the film, Cooler's backstory is slowly revealed, showing how he was once a powerful warrior who was defeated by Goku in their previous encounter.

Despite being outmatched by Cooler's Gravity Ball technique, Goku and his friends refuse to give up, using their unique abilities and teamwork to try and find a way to counter Cooler's attacks. Meanwhile, Vegeta, who had previously allied himself with the Z Warriors against Frieza, begins to question his loyalty to the group, feeling that he is being held back by his own pride.

As the final battle between the Z Warriors and Cooler reaches its climax, Goku and his friends discover that Cooler's true weakness lies in his emotional vulnerability. Using this knowledge, they are able to develop a strategy to defeat Cooler once and for all.

In the end, the Z Warriors emerge victorious, having successfully defeated Cooler and saved the Earth from destruction. The film concludes with Goku and his friends reflecting on their victory, while Vegeta finally finds redemption by acknowledging his loyalty to the group.

Overall, Dragon Ball Z: The Return of Cooler is a thrilling and action-packed film that showcases the bravery and determination of the Z Warriors as they face off against one of their most formidable foes yet.

overview: Bitter, grumpy patriarch Don Servando and his family travel to spend Christmas with Doña Alicia, a relative who becomes his "ultimate nemesis". It may be Christmas, but Don Servando is set on proving to everyone that Doña Alicia is a terrible person.
title: Grumpy Christmas
plot:
Grumpy Christmas (Spanish: Una Navidad no tan padre) is a 2021 Mexican Christmas comedy film directed by Raúl Martínez and produced by Panorama Global. A sequel to Martínez's 2016 theatrical comedy Un padre no tan padre, it brings back Héctor Bonilla as the cantankerous grandfather Don Servando, alongside Benny Ibarra as his son Fran and Jacqueline Bracamontes as Fran's wife Alma, and adds Angélica María as Alma's aunt, Doña Alicia. The supporting cast includes Renata Notni as Gala, Juan Pablo de Santiago as Renato, Tina Romero, Eduardo Tanús as Memo, Tina French as Gina, Natália Subtil as Gio, Yulian Díaz as Joao and Alex Rose Wiesel.

Don Servando, known to the family as the grumpy grandfather, has become part of a larger and more unconventional household since the events of the first film: besides Fran and Alma, it includes a carefree commune of fun-loving hippies such as Gala, Renato and Bill. This year the whole group sets off on a trip to the beach to spend the holidays with Doña Alicia, a stubborn and demanding woman who quickly becomes Servando's ultimate nemesis. The two elders clash over how Christmas should be celebrated and over who really rules the family. Feeling that his position as patriarch is under threat, Servando stops at nothing to prove to everyone that Alicia is a terrible, self-centered person, even if it means ruining the holiday for all of them. Around their feud, the film weaves a series of smaller subplots involving the other relatives, and the sunny seaside setting replaces the usual snowy holiday backdrop, though snow does eventually make an appearance before the family rediscovers the spirit of unity.

Grumpy Christmas was released on Netflix on 21 December 2021, and was presented in Brazil as Natal, mas Pouco. Reviews were lukewarm. Writing for No es cine todo lo que reluce, David Pérez called the story pleasant but overly predictable and forced, judged the central conflict thin and the subplots unable to balance it, and felt the humor fell short of the first film, while praising the warm chemistry of the cast and the believable family relationships. He likened it to a Mexican take on The Family Stone and Meet the Parents, suitable for viewers who enjoy undemanding holiday comedies. The Brazilian site Tem Alguém Assistindo recommended it as a light watch for fans of Christmas films.

overview: Ten stories from horror's top directors. Ghosts, ghouls, monsters, and the devil delight in terrorizing unsuspecting residents of a suburban neighborhood on Halloween night. This creepy anthology combines classic Halloween tales with the stuff of nightmares.
tagline: One town. One night. Ten chilling stories.
title: Tales of Halloween
plot:
Tales of Halloween is a 2015 anthology horror film that weaves together ten distinct stories, each with its own unique tone and style. At its core, the movie explores the darker aspects of human nature, delving into themes of mortality, the supernatural, and the consequences of one's actions.

One of the primary concerns of Tales of Halloween is the inevitability of death and the impact it has on those who remain behind. Many of the stories feature characters who are struggling to cope with loss or facing their own mortality, highlighting the fear that we all harbor at some point in our lives.

The film also touches on the idea of the supernatural as a manifestation of human fears and anxieties. The various tales showcase a range of paranormal entities, from ghosts and demons to more abstract concepts like the embodiment of childhood trauma. These supernatural elements serve as a metaphor for the darker aspects of human psychology, revealing the ways in which our deepest fears can take on a life of their own.

Furthermore, Tales of Halloween critiques societal norms and expectations, particularly those related to family, relationships, and community. Many of the stories feature characters who are struggling to conform to traditional roles or expectations, leading to conflicts and ultimately, tragic consequences.

Throughout the film, there is also a sense of unease and tension that permeates every aspect of the narrative. This atmosphere of dread is expertly crafted, creating a sense of discomfort in the viewer that lingers long after the credits roll.

Ultimately, Tales of Halloween presents a bleak and unsettling vision of the world, one in which the boundaries between reality and the supernatural are blurred, and the consequences of our actions can be devastating.

overview: An enterprising college student agrees to run his professor's Las Vegas car wash to avoid flunking out of school. But it's Vegas gone wild when he decides to staff it with gorgeous bikini-clad girls.
tagline: What happens in Vegas...
title: All American Bikini Car Wash
plot:
All American Bikini Car Wash is a 2015 comedy film that explores themes of female empowerment, friendship, and self-discovery. The movie follows the story of a group of young women who work at a car wash in California, navigating their personal lives, relationships, and careers while finding ways to support each other.

At its core, All American Bikini Car Wash is a celebration of female camaraderie and the power of women supporting one another. The film showcases the strong bonds between the characters, particularly as they navigate the challenges of adulthood, love, and identity. Through their experiences, the movie highlights the importance of friendship and community in helping individuals find their place in the world.

The film also touches on themes of self-discovery and empowerment, as the characters learn to take control of their lives, pursue their passions, and assert themselves in a society that often seeks to hold them back. The movie's lighthearted tone and comedic moments belie its deeper exploration of these themes, making it a fun and engaging watch.

Overall, All American Bikini Car Wash is a heartwarming and entertaining film that celebrates the strength and resilience of women, while also offering a humorous and relatable take on the challenges of growing up.

overview: Wallace, who is burned out from a string of failed relationships, forms an instant bond with Chantry, who lives with her longtime boyfriend. Together, they puzzle out what it means if your best friend is also the love of your life.
tagline: ...being friends has its benefits?
title: What If
plot:
The F Word, released in some countries as What If, is a 2013 romantic comedy directed by Michael Dowse from a screenplay by Elan Mastai, based on the play Toothpaste and Cigars by TJ Dawe and Michael Rinaldi. It stars Daniel Radcliffe as Wallace and Zoe Kazan as Chantry, with Adam Driver, Mackenzie Davis, Megan Park and Rafe Spall. A Canadian and Irish co-production, it explores whether a man and a woman can remain just friends.

Wallace is a young Englishman living in Toronto who dropped out of medical school after a painful breakup and has since withdrawn from social life. His best friend Allan persuades him to come to a party, where Wallace meets Allan's cousin Chantry, an animator, and the two immediately hit it off. As he walks her home, however, he learns that she has been living with her boyfriend for years. When they meet again by chance at a cinema, they spend the evening talking about everything from love to an absurdly extravagant sandwich, and they decide to become friends.

Wallace soon meets Chantry's boyfriend Ben, a lawyer who works for the United Nations, and accidentally knocks him out of a window, sending him to the hospital. When Ben accepts a six-month posting in Dublin, Wallace and Chantry spend even more time together, and their bond deepens. Wallace struggles to hide his growing feelings, while Allan and his impulsive new girlfriend Nicole urge him to be honest. As Chantry is offered an important career opportunity abroad and her relationship with Ben reaches a turning point, both Wallace and Chantry must decide whether to risk their friendship for something more.

The film is a dialogue-driven comedy marked by rapid, witty banter about love, food and friendship, and it was praised for the chemistry between its leads.

The F Word premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 7, 2013, and was released in 2014. It won the Canadian Screen Award for Best Adapted Screenplay among several nominations, including Best Picture. Reviews were generally positive, with about 74 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, while Metacritic gave it a score of 59.

overview: During a COVID-19 lockdown, sparring couple Linda and Paxton call a truce to attempt a high-risk jewellery heist at one of the world's most exclusive department stores, Harrods.
tagline: Some people unravel faster than others
title: Locked Down
plot:
Locked Down is a 2021 romantic comedy film that explores the complexities of relationships and personal growth during lockdown. The story revolves around Emily (played by Anne Hathaway), a high-end jewelry designer who finds herself trapped in her luxurious apartment with her boyfriend, Ben (played by Chiwetel Ejiofor). As they navigate their confined space, they begin to reevaluate their relationship and confront the underlying issues that have been simmering beneath the surface.

Through Emily's character, the film delves into themes of isolation, loneliness, and the human need for connection. As she becomes increasingly dependent on Ben, she starts to realize that her sense of identity is deeply tied to her relationship with him. The lockdown serves as a catalyst for self-discovery, forcing Emily to confront her own desires, fears, and insecurities.

The film also explores the theme of power dynamics in relationships, highlighting the ways in which even the most seemingly equal partnerships can be influenced by societal expectations and personal biases. As Emily and Ben's relationship is put to the test, they must confront their own flaws and weaknesses, leading to a deeper understanding of themselves and each other.

Ultimately, Locked Down is a nuanced exploration of love, relationships, and personal growth, offering a witty and engaging commentary on the human experience during times of isolation and confinement.

overview: The peace of a small town is endangered when a corporation wants to destroy the mountain that protects them. A girl named Copi and her best friend Xico, a Xoloitzcuintle dog, will go into the mountains to try to save the town.
title: Xico's Journey
plot:
Xico's Journey (Spanish: El camino de Xico) is a 2020 Mexican 2D animated adventure film and the directorial debut of Eric D. Cabello Díaz. Produced by Ánima, the film is based on the pre-existing character Xico, a Xoloitzcuintle, the hairless Mexican dog breed that in Aztec belief guides souls to the afterlife. The voice cast includes Pablo Gama Iturrarán as Xico, Verónica Alva as Copi, Luis Ángel Jaramillo as Gus, the singer Lila Downs as Nana Petra and the writer Elena Poniatowska. It opened in Mexican cinemas on 12 November 2020 and was released globally on Netflix on 12 February 2021.

Copi is a lively, mischievous girl who lives with her grandmother Nana Petra in San Jaime, a small village in the shadow of a sacred mountain, along with her dog Xico and her best friend Gus. Her playful antics often get her into trouble with the townspeople. Meanwhile, in the city, the head of a powerful corporation learns that the mountain holds gold and draws up plans to blast it apart and frack the surrounding land. With the support of the town's mayor, who promises the villagers prosperity, the company prepares to bring in heavy machinery and armed security.

Nana Petra, one of the mountain's secret guardians, gathers with the others to protect it, and Copi overhears that her mother, whom she believed dead, may be alive inside the mountain. Determined to find her, Copi sets out into the wilderness with Xico, and Gus soon follows, carrying a magic stone entrusted to him by Nana Petra with instructions to find a messenger. On their journey Xico begins to speak and to change color as his magical nature awakens, and the children meet talking animals and spirit creatures while discovering that the mountain's forests are dying and turning to stone. They also face danger, including a giant stone scorpion whose sting threatens Copi's life, as the company's machines advance and the fate of the mountain and the village hangs in the balance.

The film received generally mixed to favorable reviews. It holds a 100 percent rating on the Mexican aggregator Tomatazos, while John Sooja of Common Sense Media gave it three out of five, calling it beautiful and sweet but criticizing its story. Other reviewers found its environmental message heavy-handed while praising its colorful animation and its celebration of Mexican culture.

overview: Genndy Tartakovsky's Primal: Tales of Savagery features a caveman and a dinosaur on the brink of extinction. Bonded by tragedy, this unlikely friendship becomes the only hope of survival.
title: Primal: Tales of Savagery
plot:
Primal: Tales of Savagery is an adult animated series that delves into the primal and instinctual aspects of human nature, exploring the darker corners of our psyche. The show's narrative is driven by a caveman named Zog, who embarks on a perilous journey through time, encountering various prehistoric creatures and civilizations along the way.

At its core, Primal: Tales of Savagery is a primal exploration of the human condition, examining the raw emotions, desires, and fears that drive us as individuals. The series delves into themes of survival, dominance, and the struggle for power, often blurring the lines between good and evil. Through Zog's journey, the show poses questions about the nature of humanity, our capacity for violence, and the consequences of unchecked primal instincts.

The series also touches on the idea of cultural and societal conditioning, highlighting how our environments and experiences shape us into the individuals we become. As Zog navigates different eras and encounters various cultures, he is forced to confront his own limitations and the harsh realities of the world around him.

Ultimately, Primal: Tales of Savagery presents a visceral and unflinching portrayal of human nature, one that is both captivating and unsettling. By embracing its darker aspects, the series offers a thought-provoking commentary on our shared humanity, inviting viewers to confront their own primal instincts and the complexities of our existence.

original_title: The Scorpion King 3: Battle for Redemption
overview: Since his triumphant rise to power in the original blockbuster "The Scorpion King", Mathayus' kingdom has fallen and he's lost his queen to plague. Now an assassin for hire, he must defend a kingdom from an evil tyrant and his ghost warriors for the chance to regain the power and glory he once knew. Starring Ron Perlman ("Hellboy") and Billy Zane ("Titanic"), and featuring 6-time WWE champion Dave Bautista and UFC star Kimbo Slice, "The Scorpion King 3: Battle for Redemption" takes "The Mummy" phenomenon to an all-new level of epic action and non-stop adventure.
tagline: From the Producers of The Mummy
title: The Scorpion King 3: Battle for Redemption
plot:
The Scorpion King 3: Battle for Redemption is a 2012 American direct-to-video sword-and-sorcery action film directed by Roel Reiné and the third entry in The Scorpion King series. Victor Webster takes over the role of Mathayus from Dwayne Johnson, with Bostin Christopher, Temuera Morrison, Krystal Vee, Selina Lo, Kimbo Slice, Dave Bautista, Billy Zane as Talus and Ron Perlman as Horus. Universal Studios Home Entertainment released it on home video in January 2012.

Years after becoming the Scorpion King, Mathayus loses his wife, Queen Cassandra, to a plague, just as she had once foreseen that his peaceful reign could not last. Grief-stricken, he lets his kingdom crumble and returns to life as a sword for hire. In Egypt, Talus resents his elder brother Horus, who was made king instead of him, and plans to take his throne. To do so he marches into the Far East to seize the Book of the Dead from Ramusan, a king allied to Horus. Horus hires Mathayus to stop him, pairing him with the boisterous Teutonic warrior Olaf.

Talus abducts Ramusan's daughter, Princess Silda, and Ramusan promises that whoever saves her may marry her and with her claim a kingdom. Before Mathayus can reach her, she is carried off by ninja warriors under a mysterious leader known as Cobra. Talus hires Mathayus and Olaf to bring back the princess and Cobra's head, and the pair find their way to an outlaw camp, where they discover that Cobra is Silda herself. Talus, meanwhile, overruns Ramusan's palace, wounds the king and takes the book, using it to raise three dead champions, Zulu Kondo, Agromael and Tsukai, who prove their power by slaughtering his own best men.

Talus sends Tsukai and Zulu Kondo against the exiles' camp; Mathayus, Olaf and Silda's ninjas defeat Zulu Kondo, but Tsukai escapes. Posing as Silda's rescuers and offering a fake head of Cobra, Mathayus and Olaf enter the palace. In the battle that follows, Silda duels Tsukai and Olaf battles Agromael, while Mathayus reaches the dying Ramusan; using the Book of the Dead, they turn the undead warriors against Talus. Ramusan dies, the ninjas overwhelm Talus, and the champions kneel to Mathayus as ruler of both kingdoms. When Horus reaches the gates, he finds Mathayus restored as the Scorpion King.

Reviews were poor; IGN rated it 4 out of 10, faulting its dialogue, acting and stagey action.

overview: The true-life story of Christian music star Jeremy Camp and his journey of love and loss that looks to prove there is always hope.
tagline: One love can change your life.
title: I Still Believe
plot:
I Still Believe is a 2020 American Christian drama film directed by the Erwin Brothers and written by Alex Cramer, Jon Erwin, and Brent McCorkle. The movie is based on the 2008 memoir of the same name by Jeremy Camp, who was a Christian music artist.

The film stars KJ Apa as Jeremy Camp, Britt Robertson as Melissa Henning, Shania Twain as herself, and Gary Sinise as Ron Camp, Jeremy's father. The story begins with Jeremy (KJ Apa) meeting Melissa (Britt Robertson), a nurse at a hospital in California. They meet by chance while Jeremy is visiting his friend who has been injured.

As they spend more time together, Jeremy and Melissa develop strong feelings for each other, but their relationship is put to the test when Melissa reveals that she is pregnant with Jeremy's child. Despite the challenges, they decide to get married and start a life together.

However, just as things are starting to look up, tragedy strikes. Melissa is diagnosed with leukemia, a cancer that affects the blood and bone marrow. The doctors give her only a short time to live, and she undergoes chemotherapy and treatment in an effort to extend her life.

Throughout her illness, Jeremy becomes increasingly devoted to his faith, seeking guidance from God through prayer and scripture. He also begins to write music again, inspired by his experiences with Melissa. As Melissa's condition worsens, Jeremy becomes more determined to help her find peace and comfort in her final days.

The film takes a dramatic turn when Melissa passes away, leaving Jeremy heartbroken and grief-stricken. However, he finds solace in his faith and the love that he shared with Melissa. He continues to write music, using his experiences as inspiration for his songs.

In the end, Jeremy's music career takes off, and he becomes a successful Christian artist. He also marries a woman named Sarah (Abby Ryder Fortson), who is supportive of his faith and his music. The film ends with Jeremy performing at a concert, singing about his love for God and his experiences with Melissa.

Throughout the movie, the Erwin Brothers weave together themes of faith, love, and perseverance. They also highlight the importance of marriage and the power of prayer in times of need. While some critics have noted that the film takes creative liberties with Jeremy Camp's story, it remains a powerful tribute to the enduring power of faith and love.

Overall, I Still Believe is a moving and inspiring film that explores the complexities of life, death, and faith. With strong performances from its cast and a compelling narrative, it has resonated with audiences around the world.

overview: A pair of cops investigating a drug invasion stumble upon a mysterious bank vault.
tagline: Bad cops make the best criminals
title: The Trust
plot:
The Trust is a 2016 American crime thriller film directed by Alex Pettyfer and written by James DeMonaco. 

The movie revolves around two young men, Cody Chesnuat (Alex Pettyfer) and Brian Halverson (Landon Liboiron), who are partners in a lucrative marijuana smuggling operation. However, their partnership is put to the test when they become embroiled in a complex web of deceit and betrayal.

At its core, The Trust explores themes of loyalty, deception, and the corrupting influence of power. As Cody and Brian's relationship becomes increasingly toxic, they are forced to confront the darker aspects of their own nature and the true cost of their success. 

The film also touches on the idea of the American Dream, highlighting the ways in which the pursuit of wealth and status can lead individuals down a path of moral compromise and destruction. Through Cody and Brian's story, The Trust critiques the excesses of capitalism and the ways in which it can consume and destroy those who are caught up in its cycle.

Ultimately, The Trust is a gripping and intense thriller that explores the complexities of human relationships and the devastating consequences of unchecked ambition.

overview: After being left at home by himself for the holidays, 10-year-old Max Mercer must work to defend his home from a married couple who tries to steal back a valuable heirloom.
tagline: No parents. No problem.
title: Home Sweet Home Alone
plot:
Home Sweet Home Alone is a 2021 American Christmas comedy film and the sixth installment in the Home Alone franchise. Directed by Dan Mazer and written by Mikey Day and Streeter Seidell, it stars Ellie Kemper, Rob Delaney, Archie Yates, Aisling Bea, Kenan Thompson, Pete Holmes and Ally Maki, with Devin Ratray reprising his role as Buzz McCallister from the first two films. Produced by 20th Century Studios, it was released on Disney+ on 12 November 2021.

Jeff and Pam McKenzie are quietly trying to sell their house without telling their children, Abby and Chris. Jeff has lost his job, and Pam's salary is not enough to keep up with the mortgage. To make matters worse, Jeff's smug, successful brother Hunter and his family are coming to stay with them for Christmas. During an open house, ten-year-old Max Mercer and his mother Carol stop in to use the bathroom. Jeff shows Max a box of old dolls, including a defective one with an upside-down face, and Carol mentions that dolls with rare flaws can be worth a fortune. Soon afterward Jeff discovers that the doll has disappeared.

Max's large family is preparing to fly to Tokyo for the holidays. Annoyed by the commotion, Max falls asleep in a car parked in the garage, and the family leaves for the airport without him. When he wakes the next morning, he is delighted to find himself home alone. Jeff, convinced that Max stole the doll, which he hopes will save his family from financial ruin, recruits Pam to help him break into the Mercer house to get it back. Overhearing the couple's plans and assuming they are dangerous burglars, Max turns his home into a fortress filled with elaborate booby traps. When Jeff and Pam attempt their break-in, they suffer a series of painful slapstick injuries, while Max's mother scrambles to get back to her son and the truth about the missing doll comes to light.

The film received generally negative reviews. Critics found its humor flat and noted that the story, which makes the bumbling intruders sympathetic and the child something of an antagonist, inverted the appeal of the original film without improving on it. Many reviewers argued that the franchise had little left to offer. Ratray's brief return as Buzz, now a police officer, was one of the film's most discussed nods to the original.

overview: A charismatic New York City jeweler always on the lookout for the next big score makes a series of high-stakes bets that could lead to the windfall of a lifetime. Howard must perform a precarious high-wire act, balancing business, family, and encroaching adversaries on all sides in his relentless pursuit of the ultimate win.
tagline: This is how I win.
title: Uncut Gems
plot:
Uncut Gems is a 2019 American crime thriller film directed by Josh and Benny Safdie, written by Josh and Benny Safdie, and produced by Scott Rudin Productions. The film stars Adam Sandler as Howard Ratner, a diamond dealer who becomes embroiled in a world of crime and deception.

The film begins with Howard Ratner (Adam Sandler), a successful but troubled diamond dealer, who is struggling to make ends meet. He is married to Dinah (Lauren Lapkus) and has two children, but his personal life is on the rocks. Howard's business partner, Arno (Eric Bogosian), is pushing him to take more risks and expand his operations.

One day, while at a poker game in Las Vegas, Howard meets Julia De Fiore (Julia Stiles), a beautiful and charming woman who becomes infatuated with him. However, their relationship is complicated by the fact that Julia's husband, Kevin (Paddy Considine), is a ruthless and violent man.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Howard is deeply in debt to various individuals, including Arno, who is threatening to cut him out of his business unless he pays up. Meanwhile, Howard becomes obsessed with a rare and valuable diamond called the "Black Mamba," which he believes will be the key to saving his business.

However, things take a dark turn when Kevin De Fiore discovers that Julia has been having an affair with Howard, leading to a violent confrontation between the two men. As tensions escalate, Howard becomes increasingly desperate and reckless, making a series of poor decisions that put him in grave danger.

As the plot thickens, it becomes clear that Howard's world is on the verge of collapse. He is pursued by a group of ruthless thugs, including Kevin De Fiore, who will stop at nothing to get what they want from him. In a desperate bid to save himself and his family, Howard turns to an unlikely ally: a young man named Julius (Idris Elba), who becomes embroiled in his web of deceit.

The film builds towards a shocking and violent climax, as Howard's world comes crashing down around him. In the end, it is unclear whether Howard will emerge from this ordeal alive or dead, but one thing is certain: he has lost everything that truly mattered to him.

Throughout the film, the Safdie brothers use their unique visual style and editing techniques to create a sense of tension and unease, drawing the viewer into Howard's world of crime and deception. Adam Sandler delivers a tour-de-force performance as the troubled and complex Howard Ratner, bringing depth and nuance to a character that could have easily been reduced to caricature.

Overall, Uncut Gems is a gripping and intense thriller that explores the darker side of human nature. With its talented cast, clever script, and masterful direction, it is a must-see for fans of crime dramas and thrillers.

overview: A family loaded with quirky, colorful characters piles into an old van and road trips to California for little Olive to compete in a beauty pageant.
tagline: A family on the verge of a breakdown
title: Little Miss Sunshine
plot:
Little Miss Sunshine is a 2006 American comedy-drama film directed by Jonathan Dayton and Valerie Faris. The movie follows the story of the Hoover family, who embark on a road trip to help their young daughter Olive (Abigail Breslin) participate in a beauty pageant.

The main themes of Little Miss Sunshine include:

1. Family dynamics: The film explores the complexities and flaws of the Hoover family, highlighting their individual quirks and relationships with each other. Through their journey, the audience witnesses the family's struggles to connect and find common ground.
2. Mental health: Olive's diagnosis with a severe case of depression serves as a catalyst for the family's emotional journey. The film sheds light on the importance of acknowledging mental health issues and seeking help.
3. Hope and resilience: Despite facing numerous setbacks, including Olive's illness and the family's financial struggles, they find ways to persevere and hold onto hope. This theme is exemplified through the character of Richard Hoover (Greg Kinnear), who becomes a source of inspiration for his family.
4. The American Dream: The film critiques the idea of the "American Dream," which promises happiness and fulfillment through material success. The Hoovers' journey reveals that true happiness often lies in relationships, personal growth, and finding one's own identity.
5. Imperfection and authenticity: The movie celebrates the imperfections and quirks of its characters, showcasing their unique personalities and flaws. This theme is reflected in the character of Dwayne (Paul Dano), who finds his place within the family despite being an outsider.

The film features a talented ensemble cast, including Steve Carell as Edwin Hoover, Toni Collette as Sheryl Hoover, and Alan Arkin as Grandpa Edwin. The movie received widespread critical acclaim for its original storytelling, witty dialogue, and outstanding performances.

Overall, Little Miss Sunshine is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of the complexities of family life, mental health, and the human condition.

overview: When five friends vacation at a remote lake house, they expect nothing less then a good time, unaware that Earth is under attack by an alien invasion and mass-abductions.
tagline: They've come to claim what's theirs
title: The Recall
plot:
The Recall is a 2017 science fiction action film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of playing with technological fire. At its core, the movie explores the theme of identity and how easily it can be manipulated and distorted.

As the protagonist, Jeff Taylor, undergoes a virtual reality experience designed to enhance his life, he begins to question what is real and what is not. The film takes a dark turn as Jeff's digital avatar becomes increasingly autonomous, leading him down a path of self-discovery and moral ambiguity.

The movie also touches on the theme of control and free will, raising questions about who holds power in our lives – ourselves or external forces? As Jeff navigates his virtual world, he must confront the possibility that his digital existence may be more real than his physical one.

Furthermore, The Recall critiques the notion of escapism and the allure of technology as a means to avoid reality. The film's protagonist is initially drawn to the virtual world as a way to escape his mundane life, but soon finds himself trapped in a web of deceit and manipulation.

Overall, The Recall is a thought-provoking thriller that delves into the complexities of human identity, control, and the consequences of relying too heavily on technology.

overview: A wounded man searches for his sweetheart in the Mexican desert while on the run from the police, bounty hunters, and others.
title: Kites
plot:
Kites is an Indian romantic drama film that explores the complexities of love, loss, and longing. The story revolves around Zaidi Ali Khan, a young man who falls in love with Laila, but their relationship is complicated by the fact that she is already engaged to another man.

The movie delves into the theme of unrequited love, as Zaidi's feelings for Laila are deep and all-consuming, yet he knows that he can never be with her. This sense of longing and yearning is a dominant thread throughout the film, as Zaidi struggles to come to terms with his own emotions and the reality of his situation.

The movie also touches on the theme of social class differences, as Zaidi hails from a lower-middle-class background, while Laila comes from a more affluent family. This contrast highlights the societal pressures that can affect relationships and the difficulties of navigating different worlds.

Furthermore, Kites explores the idea of identity and self-discovery, as Zaidi grapples with his own sense of purpose and belonging. His relationship with Laila forces him to confront his own desires and aspirations, leading to a journey of self-discovery that is both poignant and powerful.

Overall, Kites is a nuanced and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of love, loss, and longing in a way that is both deeply personal and universally relatable.

overview: Failed London banker Max Skinner inherits his uncle's vineyard in Provence, where he spent many childhood holidays. Upon his arrival, he meets a woman from California who tells Max she is his long-lost cousin and that the property is hers.
tagline: Everything matures... eventually.
title: A Good Year
plot:
A Good Year is a romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of love, loss, and self-discovery. The movie follows the story of Alex Goran, a successful but unfulfilled investment banker who inherits a vineyard in Provence, France from his recently deceased uncle.

As Alex navigates his new life in rural France, he is forced to confront his emotional baggage and learn to let go of his past. Through his interactions with the locals, particularly a charming woman named Charlotte, Alex begins to rediscover himself and find meaning in his life beyond his high-stress job.

The film delves into themes of grief, loneliness, and the search for connection. Alex's journey is marked by moments of tenderness, humor, and poignancy as he slowly opens up to the possibility of love and new beginnings. The movie also touches on the idea of finding one's true purpose in life, and the importance of embracing change and taking risks.

Ultimately, A Good Year is a heartwarming story about the transformative power of love, nature, and self-discovery. It invites viewers to reflect on their own values, priorities, and aspirations, and to consider the possibility that it may be never too late to make a change and start anew.

overview: Tells the "riches to rags" story of the Nobles, three upper-class twenty-somethings that appear to have no limits to their checkbooks, and no direction in their lives. Until one day, their father tries to teach them a lesson by staging a financial scandal that forces the whole family to escape to an old house in the poor side of town, and leads the "kids" to do what they haven't done before: get jobs.
tagline: A falta de plata... Sale el cobre
title: We Are the Nobles
plot:
Nosotros los Nobles, released in English as The Noble Family and We Are the Nobles, is a 2013 Mexican comedy directed by Gary Alazraki in his feature debut. Gonzalo Vega stars as a wealthy businessman, with Luis Gerardo Méndez, Karla Souza and Juan Pablo Gil as his spoiled children and Ianis Guerrero, Karla Sofía Gascón and Mario Haddad in supporting roles. The film was loosely inspired by the 1949 Luis Buñuel comedy El gran calavera.

In modern Mexico City, the widowed construction magnate Germán Noble is so absorbed in his work that he has failed to notice that his three grown children are wasting their lives and his money. Javier nominally works at his father's company but spends his time partying and dreaming up absurd business schemes. Bárbara, a socialite, is about to become engaged to Peter, an older man with a string of failed businesses who is chiefly interested in her trust fund. The youngest, Carlos, has just been expelled from university after being caught with one of his professors.

After suffering a heart attack, Germán decides to teach his children a lesson. He tells them that an embezzling partner and union troubles have led the government to freeze his assets and that the whole family could be sent to prison. Convincing them to cut off contact with their friends, he moves the family into a dilapidated house that once belonged to his father in a modest neighborhood. For the first time in their lives, the children must get jobs: Carlos becomes a bank teller, while Lucho, the nephew of the family's former maid, helps Bárbara find work as a waitress and Javier as a bus driver. Struggling to pay bills in a crumbling house, the siblings begin to see the world differently. Bárbara realizes that Lucho, whom she once looked down on, is a good man; Javier recognizes that his old friends were shallow hangers-on; and Carlos finds discipline. Germán, meanwhile, discovers struggles his children had hidden from him and realizes how absent he was while they were growing up. His deception is threatened when Peter tracks down the family and learns the truth.

The film was a word-of-mouth phenomenon. It opened fourth at the Mexican box office before climbing to first place in its fourth weekend, briefly becoming the highest-grossing Mexican film of all time, and it ultimately grossed about $26 million. It was remade in Italy as Belli di papà, in Colombia as Malcriados and in France as Pourris gâtés.

overview: A man obsessed with conspiracy theories becomes a target after one of his theories turns out to be true. Unfortunately, in order to save himself, he has to figure out which theory it is.
tagline: What if your most paranoid nightmares had just come true?
title: Conspiracy Theory
plot:
Conspiracy Theory is a 1997 American action comedy film directed by Joseph Ruben and starring Mel Gibson and Julia Roberts.

The movie follows the story of Jerry Fletcher (played by Mel Gibson), a conspiracy theorist who believes that everything in life is connected and that there's a larger plan at play. After being released from a mental institution, Jerry sets out to prove his theories by tracking down a woman named Helen Benson (played by Julia Roberts) who he believes is the key to unlocking the truth.

As the story unfolds, Jerry and Helen embark on a series of adventures and misadventures as they try to uncover the truth behind various conspiracies. Along the way, they develop feelings for each other and must navigate their differences in order to find common ground.

The main themes of Conspiracy Theory include:

1. The Power of Belief: The movie explores the idea that our beliefs can shape our reality and influence our actions. Jerry's conspiracy theories serve as a metaphor for the power of belief and how it can be both a source of comfort and a hindrance to understanding the world.
2. Love and Connection: Through Jerry and Helen's relationship, the movie highlights the importance of human connection and love in breaking down barriers and finding common ground.
3. Paranoia vs. Reality: The film pokes fun at conspiracy theories while also exploring the blurred lines between paranoia and reality. Jerry's all-consuming obsession with his theories often leads him to misinterpret or misunderstand the world around him, highlighting the dangers of unchecked paranoia.
4. Identity and Belonging: Jerry's character is a classic example of an outsider who feels like he doesn't belong in society. His conspiracy theories serve as a way for him to feel connected to something larger than himself, but ultimately, he must confront his own identity and find a sense of belonging.

Overall, Conspiracy Theory is a lighthearted and entertaining film that uses humor and satire to explore complex themes and ideas.

overview: Parapsychologist Elise Rainier and her team travel to Five Keys, NM, to investigate a man’s claim of a haunting. Terror soon strikes when Rainier realizes that the house he lives in was her family’s old home.
tagline: Fear comes home.
title: Insidious: The Last Key
plot:
Insidious: The Last Key is a supernatural horror film directed by Adam Wingard and written by Leigh Whannell. The movie serves as the fourth installment in the Insidious franchise.

The story begins with Elise Rainier (Lin Shaye), a paranormal investigator, who has been institutionalized for her supposed mental illness due to her experiences with the spirit world. However, it is revealed that she was actually being held captive by a group of people who were trying to exploit her abilities.

Elise escapes from her captors and returns home, where she reunites with her friends Specs (Leigh Whannell) and Tucker (Angus Sampson). They inform Elise that her sister, Sally (Haley Murphy), has been experiencing terrifying visions and nightmares, which they believe are connected to their family's dark past.

As the story unfolds, it is revealed that their family's history is filled with tragedy and loss. Their father, Josh (Derek Johnson), died under mysterious circumstances when Elise was a child, and their mother, Lorraine (Rose Byrne), has been struggling to cope with her grief ever since.

Elise decides to investigate the source of Sally's visions, which leads her to an abandoned asylum in New Orleans. There, she discovers that the asylum was once home to a malevolent spirit known as "The Key," which is responsible for the family's dark past.

As Elise delves deeper into the mystery, she realizes that The Key is connected to her own traumatic experiences and that it has been manipulating her sister's visions in an attempt to lure her back to the asylum. Elise must use her skills and knowledge of the spirit world to defeat The Key and free Sally from its grasp.

Throughout the movie, Elise faces numerous challenges and obstacles as she navigates the treacherous world of spirits and demons. She is aided by Specs and Tucker, who provide comedic relief and technical support throughout the investigation.

The climax of the movie features an intense showdown between Elise and The Key, which culminates in a dramatic confrontation that will determine the fate of Sally and the entire Rainier family.

Ultimately, Elise emerges victorious, but not without scars. She realizes that her experiences have left her with emotional baggage and that she must find a way to heal and move forward. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, as Elise begins to rebuild her life and reconnect with her sister.

Insidious: The Last Key received mixed reviews from critics, who praised the film's visuals and atmosphere but criticized its predictable plot and lack of originality. Despite this, the movie has developed a loyal fan base and is widely regarded as one of the best entries in the Insidious franchise.

overview: When a team of explorers ventures into the catacombs that lie beneath the streets of Paris, they uncover the dark secret that lies within this city of the dead.
tagline: The only way out is down
title: As Above, So Below
plot:
As Above, So Below is a 2014 American found-footage horror film directed by John Erick Dowdle and written by Dowdle and Drew Dowdle. The movie follows a group of explorers who venture into the Paris catacombs in search of a mythical treasure.

The story begins with a prologue that sets the tone for the rest of the film. A young girl, named Sarah (played by Perdita Weeks), is shown to be obsessed with the idea of finding the Philosopher's Stone, a legendary alchemical substance believed to have the power to transform base metals into gold and grant eternal life.

The main characters, including Sarah, her boyfriend Dylan (played by Ben Feldman), and their friends Anthony (played by Edwin Hodge) and Jean (played by Pierre Piffaretti), are all part of an urban exploration group. They decide to explore the Paris catacombs in search of a mythical treasure that is said to be hidden deep within the tunnels.

As they venture deeper into the catacombs, the group begins to experience strange occurrences and supernatural events. They soon realize that they are not alone in the tunnels, and that the catacombs hold many dark secrets and terrors.

Throughout the film, the group's dynamics and relationships begin to fray as tensions rise and the group becomes increasingly paranoid. The tension builds up as they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, narrow passageways, and terrifying creatures.

As the group delves deeper into the catacombs, they stumble upon an ancient ritual that is said to have been performed by a secret society of alchemists. They soon realize that they are being led deeper into the tunnels by some unknown force, which seems to be manipulating their actions.

The film's climax features a series of intense and terrifying events as the group faces off against a monstrous creature that has been awakened by their presence in the catacombs. In the end, only one member of the group manages to escape the catacombs alive, but not without being forever changed by her experience.

Throughout the film, the title "As Above, So Below" is referenced as a phrase from an ancient alchemical text that suggests that the macrocosm (the universe) and the microcosm (humanity) are connected. The film's use of this phrase serves as a metaphor for the idea that our actions have consequences, both in the physical world and in the spiritual realm.

Overall, As Above, So Below is a tense and terrifying horror film that explores themes of obsession, paranoia, and the supernatural. With its claustrophobic setting and creepy atmosphere, the film is sure to appeal to fans of the horror genre.

overview: A drama centered on a classical pianist who has been diagnosed with ALS and the brash college student who becomes her caregiver.
tagline: Life is measured in moments that leave you breathless.
title: You're Not You
plot:
You're Not You is a 2014 American drama film directed by George C. Wolfe and written by Mark Medoff. The movie revolves around the life of a young woman, Aileen Lee, who suffers from a rare genetic disorder that causes her to deteriorate rapidly due to a lack of stem cells in her body.

The main theme of You're Not You is the struggle with mortality and the fragility of human existence. Through Aileen's story, the film highlights the emotional toll of facing one's own mortality at a young age, as well as the impact it has on those around her - particularly her family and loved ones. The movie explores the complexities of grief, loss, and the search for meaning in the face of an uncertain future.

The film also delves into the theme of identity and what makes us who we are. As Aileen's physical body begins to deteriorate, she is forced to confront the question of whether her sense of self will survive beyond her physical form. The movie raises questions about the nature of consciousness and the human experience, leaving the audience to ponder the significance of these existential concerns.

Ultimately, You're Not You is a poignant and thought-provoking film that encourages viewers to reflect on their own values, priorities, and the importance of living in the present moment.

original_title: 劇場版 きんいろモザイク Thank you!!
overview: Time flies when you're having fun, and it seems like only yesterday that Shinobu Omiya was nervously waiting for her friend Alice Cartelet to arrive from England to study at Shinobu's school in Japan. Now, in their third and final year, Alice, Shinobu, Aya, and Yoko have truly become the best of friends and even Karen, Honoka, and Kana are part of the gang as well. But since it's their last year, that means their time will be split between preparing for the big senior trip to Nara and Kyoto, and trying to make plans for whatever is to come next in their lives… and in Shinobu's case, that may mean something so amazing that she'd never even dared to dream it! Hop on the tour bus for one last wonderful adventure!
title: Kinmoza the Movie: Thank You!!
plot:
Kinmoza the Movie: Thank You!! (劇場版 きんいろモザイク Thank you!!) is a 2021 Japanese animated slice-of-life comedy film directed by Munenori Nawa from a screenplay by Yuniko Ayana, and produced by Studio Gokumi and AXsiZ. It is the concluding instalment of the Kiniro Mosaic anime franchise, based on Yui Hara's four-panel manga, following two television series and the 2016 theatrical OVA Pretty Days. The film was announced when the manga's serialisation reached its final chapter, its title was revealed in June 2020, and it opened in Japanese cinemas on 20 August 2021, earning about ¥97 million. The series' regular voice cast returns, led by Asuka Nishi as Shinobu Omiya, Manami Tanaka as Alice Cartelet, Risa Taneda as Aya Komichi, Yumi Uchiyama as Yoko Inokuma and Nao Toyama as Karen Kujo.

The film adapts the girls' final year of high school. On their class trip they begin in Nara, visiting the deer park and the Great Buddha, where Alice impresses her friends with what she knows about the sights, and continue to Kyoto, where the shy Honoka works up the nerve to ask Karen for a photo together after visiting Kinkaku-ji and Ginkaku-ji. That night Aya surprises everyone by wanting to swap stories about love, and at Kyoto Tower Shinobu and Alice talk about the future. Back home, Alice learns that her mother and Shinobu's mother met when Shinobu's mother studied in England, the reason Shinobu's homestay brought her to Alice's family. Alice struggles to tell Shinobu that she intends to return to England for her further education, and Shinobu, who has already worked it out, decides that she wants to study in England too. While Aya, Yoko and Karen prepare for Japanese entrance exams, Shinobu studies at night for overseas admission, encouraged by her family. All of them pass, and after an emotional graduation the friends part ways, until Karen, Aya and Yoko later visit Alice and Shinobu in England.

The blog The Infinite Zenith called the film a heart-warming and fitting conclusion that stays true to the series' gentle tone while letting each girl grow, and recommended it to existing fans. Other reviewers felt that compressing a large amount of manga material into the film's 82 minutes rushed the pacing and cost the story some of its relaxed atmosphere.

overview: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.
tagline: Break the story. Break the silence.
title: Spotlight
plot:
Spotlight is a 2015 American biographical drama film directed by Tom McCarthy, written by Josh Singer, and produced by Charles Randolph and Michael De Luca.

The film is based on the true story of the Boston Globe's investigative team that uncovered the widespread child molestation scandal in the Catholic Church in Boston. The movie begins with Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), a veteran journalist at the Boston Globe, who is tasked with leading an investigation into allegations of child abuse within the Catholic Church.

The story takes us back to 2001 when the Globe's Spotlight team, led by Mike Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo) and Sacha Pfeiffer (Megan Good), begins investigating a series of allegations against Father John Geoghan, a priest who had been accused of molesting numerous young boys. The team discovers that Geoghan was just one of many priests who had been accused of similar crimes.

As the investigation unfolds, the Spotlight team uncovers a massive cover-up by the Catholic Church, which had been aware of the allegations for decades but had chosen to ignore them in order to protect its reputation and avoid scandal. The team's reporting leads to the resignation of Cardinal Bernard Law (Liev Schreiber), who had previously protected Geoghan despite knowing about his abuse.

The Spotlight team continues to dig deeper, uncovering a web of corruption and deceit that reaches the highest levels of the Church. They interview numerous victims of abuse, including a young boy named Brian McFarland (Brian d'Arcy James), whose father was also abused by Geoghan.

As the investigation gains momentum, the Spotlight team faces resistance from the Church, which tries to discredit them and silence their reporting. However, the team perseveres, driven by their commitment to truth and justice.

The film's climax features a dramatic showdown between the Spotlight team and Cardinal Law, who is forced to confront the consequences of his actions. The movie ends with the resignation of Cardinal Law and the beginning of a new era for the Catholic Church in Boston, as it begins to take steps to address its abuse scandal.

Throughout the film, the Spotlight team's reporting is marked by its meticulous attention to detail and its commitment to telling the stories of the victims. The film features outstanding performances from its cast, particularly Michael Keaton, Mark Ruffalo, and Liev Schreiber.

Overall, Spotlight is a powerful and thought-provoking film that sheds light on one of the darkest secrets in American history. Its portrayal of courage, perseverance, and the importance of truth-telling makes it a must-see for anyone interested in journalism, ethics, or social justice.

overview: As war between humankind and monstrous sea creatures wages on, a former pilot and a trainee are paired up to drive a seemingly obsolete special weapon in a desperate effort to save the world.
tagline: To fight monsters, we created monsters.
title: Pacific Rim
plot:
Pacific Rim is a science fiction monster film directed by Guillermo del Toro and written by Travis Beacham. The movie takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where humanity is on the brink of extinction due to an invasion by giant monsters known as Kaijus from another dimension.

The story begins with a flashback of a catastrophic event that occurred 30 years ago, when a group of scientists discovered a way to harness the power of the Earth's core to create massive robots called Jaegers. The Jaegers are designed to fight against the Kaijus, which are enormous creatures that emerge from a portal in the ocean and wreak havoc on coastal cities.

The movie then jumps forward to the present day, where we meet our protagonist, Raleigh Becket (played by Charlie Hunnam), a former Jaeger pilot who lost his co-pilot and best friend, Yancy, during a mission. Raleigh is haunted by guilt and grief over Yancy's death and struggles to find purpose in his life.

Raleigh is recruited by the Jaeger program, led by Dr. Newton Geiszler (played by Idris Elba), who has developed a new technology that allows humans to control the Jaegers using brain-computer interfaces. Raleigh is paired with Mako Mori (played by Rinko Kikuchi), a young and talented pilot from Japan.
