In the end, Jonas and his team devise a plan to lure the Meg into a trap using a giant underwater drone. The plan is successful, but not without sacrifices. In a thrilling finale, Jonas faces off against the Meg in an epic battle that will determine the fate of humanity.

The ending is action-packed and suspenseful, with Jonas emerging victorious after outsmarting the creature. However, the film concludes on a bittersweet note as Jonas finally finds redemption for his past mistakes but also loses one of his team members to the Meg's wrath.

Overall, The Meg is an entertaining and thrilling ride that combines stunning visual effects with a gripping storyline. While it may not be a masterpiece of cinematic storytelling, it delivers plenty of excitement and suspense for fans of monster movies.

overview: Beneath Bruce Garrett's under-confident, overweight exterior, the passionate heart of a salsa king lies dormant. Now, one woman is about to reignite his Latin fire.
tagline: All's fair in Love & Salsa
title: Cuban Fury
plot:
Cuban Fury is a 2014 British romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of grief, redemption, and self-discovery through the lens of a former breakdancer's journey. The movie delves into the emotional turmoil of its protagonist, Jude, as he navigates his way through a painful past and confronts his inner demons.

At its core, Cuban Fury is a story about the transformative power of dance and movement. Through Jude's experiences with breakdancing, the film illustrates the therapeutic benefits of physical expression and the cathartic release that comes from embracing one's passion. The movie also touches on themes of grief, loss, and the struggle to come to terms with the past.

As Jude reconnects with his old crew and rekindles his love for dance, he begins to confront the emotional baggage that has been holding him back. Through this process, he learns to let go of his anger and resentment, embracing a more positive and empowered version of himself.

The film also explores the theme of redemption, as Jude seeks to make amends with those who have wronged him in the past. His journey is marked by moments of vulnerability, self-awareness, and ultimately, forgiveness – both towards others and himself.

Overall, Cuban Fury is a heartwarming and uplifting story about finding one's way back to oneself, embracing passion, and learning to forgive.

overview: The extraordinary tale of Harriet Tubman's escape from slavery and transformation into one of America's greatest heroes. Her courage, ingenuity and tenacity freed hundreds of slaves and changed the course of history.
tagline: Be free or die
title: Harriet
plot:
Harriet is a biographical drama film directed by Kasi Lemmons, released in 2019 by Focus Features. The movie tells the story of Harriet Tubman, an American abolitionist and former slave who became one of the most prominent conductors on the Underground Railroad.

The film begins with Harriet (played by Cynthia Erivo) as a young girl, born into slavery on a plantation in Maryland. She is subjected to physical and emotional abuse by her owner, Edward Brodess (played by Clarke Peters), and his wife, Luana (played by Vanessa Williams). Despite the harsh conditions, Harriet finds solace in music and spirituality, which becomes a source of strength for her.

As Harriet grows older, she begins to realize that she is destined for something more. She meets John Tubman (played by Janelle James), a former slave who has escaped to freedom in Canada, and he shares with her the stories of the Underground Railroad. Inspired by his tales, Harriet decides to take matters into her own hands and escape from slavery herself.

The film follows Harriet's perilous journey north, where she faces numerous challenges, including treacherous terrain, harsh weather conditions, and encounters with slave catchers. Along the way, she meets other escaped slaves who join her on her mission to help others gain freedom.

Once in Canada, Harriet becomes a prominent figure in the abolitionist movement, using her skills as a conductor to help hundreds of enslaved individuals escape to freedom. She also becomes involved in the fight for women's suffrage and civil rights, working closely with prominent figures such as Frederick Douglass (played by Leslie Odom Jr.).

As Harriet's fame grows, so does her notoriety. She is pursued by slave catchers who seek to capture her and return her to slavery. In a dramatic confrontation, Harriet is forced to flee for her life, but ultimately finds refuge in the home of abolitionist William Still (played by Joe Mazzello).

The film culminates with Harriet's decision to return to the United States and continue her work as an abolitionist. Despite facing numerous challenges and setbacks, she remains committed to her cause, using her experiences as a former slave to inspire others to fight for freedom and equality.

Throughout the film, Cynthia Erivo delivers a powerful performance as Harriet Tubman, bringing depth and nuance to the character's story. The supporting cast, including Leslie Odom Jr. and Janelle James, also deliver strong performances that add to the film's emotional impact.

Overall, Harriet is a powerful and inspiring film that tells an important chapter in American history. With its strong performances, gripping storyline, and themes of freedom and equality, it is a must-see for anyone interested in biographical dramas or the history of the Underground Railroad.

overview: A mild-mannered college professor discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.
production_companies: Canadian Film or Video Production Tax Credit (CPTC)
tagline: You can’t escape Yourself!
title: Enemy
plot:
Enemy is a psychological thriller film directed by Denis Villeneuve, released in 2013. The movie follows the story of Adam Bell (played by Jake Gyllenhaal), an academic who teaches at a university in Toronto.

The film begins with Adam's mundane life as he lectures to his students and navigates his relationships with his colleagues and friends. He is particularly close to his colleague, Mary Svevo (played by Mélanie Laurent). However, their friendship seems unfulfilling, and Adam feels an emptiness within himself.

One day, while walking down the street, Adam encounters a man who bears an uncanny resemblance to him - Anthony St. Claire (also played by Jake Gyllenhaal). The doppelganger is charming, confident, and seemingly more fulfilled than Adam. Despite initial reservations, Adam becomes fascinated with Anthony and starts to secretly meet him.

As their relationship deepens, Adam begins to question his own identity and sense of self. He becomes increasingly obsessed with Anthony, who represents a life that Adam feels he has never truly lived. The two men start to swap lives, with Adam taking on Anthony's persona and vice versa.

The plot thickens as Adam starts to notice discrepancies between his life and Anthony's. He discovers that Anthony is married to Mary Svevo, which further complicates their relationship. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Anthony is not just a doppelganger but also a representation of Adam's darker impulses and desires.

Throughout the film, Villeneuve masterfully explores themes of identity, duality, and the human condition. The cinematography is stunning, with a muted color palette that adds to the overall sense of unease and tension.

As the story reaches its climax, Adam is forced to confront the consequences of his actions. He must choose between embracing his true self or continuing to live a life that is not authentic to him. In the end, Adam makes a decision that will change his life forever.

The ending of Enemy is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder the nature of identity and reality. The film's final shot of Adam walking away from Anthony's apartment suggests that he has finally found a sense of self-acceptance, but the viewer is left wondering if this is truly the case.

Overall, Enemy is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores the complexities of human psychology. With its masterful direction and outstanding performances, it is a must-see for fans of psychological thrillers.

overview: When mankind beams a radio signal into space, a reply comes from ‘Planet G’, in the form of several alien crafts that splash down in the waters off Hawaii. Lieutenant Alex Hopper is a weapons officer assigned to the USS John Paul Jones, part of an international naval coalition which becomes the world's last hope for survival as they engage the hostile alien force of unimaginable strength. While taking on the invaders, Hopper must also try to live up to the potential that his brother, and his fiancée's father—an Admiral—expect of him.
tagline: The Battle for Earth Begins at Sea
title: Battleship
plot:
Battleship is a 2012 science fiction action film directed by Peter Berg and produced by Universal Pictures. The movie is based on the popular board game of the same name, which was created by Ted Lewin.

The story begins with Commander Stone Hopper (played by Taylor Kitsch), a hot-headed but skilled naval officer who is struggling to find his place in the world after being kicked out of the Navy. He is now working as a security consultant for a private company called Global Defense Systems (GDS).

Meanwhile, Lieutenant Alex Hoppner (played by Brooklyn Decker) is a brilliant and beautiful engineer who works for GDS. She is also the daughter of Admiral Shane Hopper (played by Liam Neeson), Stone's father and a high-ranking naval officer.

When an alien armada appears in the skies above Earth, both the Navy and GDS scramble to respond. The aliens are revealed to be from the planet Krill, who have been searching for Earth as their next target. The humans are able to fend off the initial attack using advanced technology provided by GDS, but it becomes clear that the aliens will not be easily defeated.

As the battle rages on, Stone and Alex find themselves at the center of the action. They team up with a group of sailors from the USS Defiance, including Petty Officer Cora Raikes (played by Rihanna), to take down the alien armada. Along the way, they discover that the aliens are using advanced technology to control the minds of humans, making them more susceptible to attack.

As the stakes grow higher, Stone and Alex must put aside their differences and work together to save humanity from extinction. They use their unique skills and knowledge to outsmart the aliens and develop a plan to defeat them once and for all.

The final battle is intense and action-packed, with both sides suffering heavy losses. In the end, Stone and his team are able to destroy the alien armada using a combination of advanced technology and old-fashioned ingenuity. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with humanity having survived the attack and looking forward to rebuilding and recovering.

Throughout the movie, there is plenty of action, suspense, and humor, making Battleship an entertaining ride for fans of science fiction and adventure films. While it received mixed reviews from critics, the movie has its fans and is a fun, if not entirely faithful, adaptation of the popular board game.

overview: Meeting a man on the Internet, Julia decides to see him in person, only to get abducted and branded with the letter "x" by that guy. A game of cat and mouse follows, but the story has an unexpected twist.
title: Julia X
plot:
Julia X (released in 3D as Julia X 3D) is a 2011 American horror thriller with darkly comic touches, directed by P.J. Pettiette, who devised the story, from a screenplay by Matt Cunningham, and produced by Dixie Theatrical Corporation on a budget of about $4 million. It stars Valerie Azlynn as Julia, Kevin Sorbo as a serial killer known only as the Stranger, and Alicia Leigh Willis as her sister Jessica, with Joel David Moore and Ving Rhames. It premiered on 24 September 2011.

Julia meets a man she has been chatting with online for a date at a restaurant but, uneasy, cuts the evening short. As she heads home he overpowers her in her car and forces her to drive to his lair, where he strings her up from a hook in his garage. She briefly frees herself and hides, but he catches her and brands her with the letter X, the mark he leaves on his victims. Bound in the back of his van, she discovers the body of a previous victim, branded W; while he is burying it she gets hold of the keys to her handcuffs and escapes, fleeing through fields and swamp to a derelict house and then an abandoned school building. There she ambushes him and knocks him out, and her sister Jessica drives up to collect her.

The tables turn. The sisters, it emerges, are predators themselves who lure men like him, and they take the unconscious Stranger home, tie him to a chair with barbed wire and torment him. Flashbacks reveal their abusive childhood, and tension grows between protective Julia and Jessica, who resents always playing second fiddle and wants to be the bait for once. When Jessica kidnaps Sam, a young mechanic from across the street, the situation spirals: the Stranger breaks free and a frantic chase through the house follows. In the end Jessica betrays her sister, stabbing Julia, killing the Stranger and setting the house on fire, then resumes the game under the name Julia Y, while a final shot suggests Julia may have survived.

Joel David Moore plays Sam and Ving Rhames appears in a role credited simply as The Man. In Germany the film ran into trouble with the ratings board, which refused it a theatrical certificate, and the uncut version was later placed on the country's index of media harmful to minors. Critic Christian Ihle of the taz praised its socio-political subtext and its entertaining middle section but found the opening chase dreadful.

original_title: The Land Before Time XII: The Great Day of the Flyers
overview: As the Great Day of the Flyers nears, the Great Valley's flying youngsters are eager to participate in the annual exhibition to show off their skills. Everyone, that is, except free-spirited pterodactyl Petrie, whose individualism causes problems when it comes to staying in formation. Enter his dinosaur pals Littlefoot, Cera, Spike and Ducky, who encourage Petrie to embrace his uniqueness.
title: The Land Before Time XII: The Great Day of the Flyers
plot:
The Land Before Time XII: The Great Day of the Flyers is a 2006 American animated musical film, the twelfth instalment of The Land Before Time series, produced for Universal Studios Home Entertainment. It was first shown on television in December 2006 and released on DVD on February 27, 2007, with sing-along and game extras. Its voice cast includes John Ingle, Nick Price, Frank Welker, Aria Noelle Curzon and Rob Paulsen, and it was the final film role of Kenneth Mars, who retired afterwards.

In the Great Valley, the young flyers are preparing for the Day of the Flyers, a ceremony in which they must perform a precise formation flight to show they are ready to fly with the adults. Petrie, always a nervous and clumsy flier, struggles badly to keep pace with his siblings in the tight group manoeuvres, and fears that he will fail in front of everyone. At the same time a strange newcomer turns up in the valley: Guido, a small, feathered creature who has no idea what kind of dinosaur he is. Littlefoot and his friends set out to help him discover his identity and eventually learn that he is a Microraptor, a gliding dinosaur.

Cera has her own worries. Her gruff father and his new mate, Tria, are expecting a hatchling, and Cera feels uncertain about her place in the family. When the baby, Tricia, arrives, Cera gradually warms to her and begins to grow close to her little sister.

The various storylines collide on the eve of the ceremony. Guido begins to sleepwalk and glide, and Petrie and the others follow him, unwittingly leading the whole group out of the valley into the dangerous Mysterious Beyond. When Guido wakes up, the friends find themselves face to face with a hungry Spinosaurus that chases them. Working together, they trap the predator by wedging it between two rocks and make their way safely home.

On the Day of the Flyers, Petrie takes Guido's advice to be himself and performs his own distinctive style of flying, which inspires the other young flyers to follow his lead. During the festivities, little Tricia tumbles into a river and is carried towards a waterfall. Guido, Petrie and his siblings swoop in to rescue her, and when they lose their grip, Cera catches her sister before she falls back into the water. Tricia then speaks her first word, "Cera", and the family celebrates together while the other dinosaurs look on.

overview: Annie's life is a mess. But when she finds out her lifetime best friend is engaged, she simply must serve as Lillian's maid of honor. Though lovelorn and broke, Annie bluffs her way through the expensive and bizarre rituals. With one chance to get it perfect, she’ll show Lillian and her bridesmaids just how far you’ll go for someone you love.
tagline: Save the date.
title: Bridesmaids
plot:
Bridesmaids (2011) is a comedy film directed by Paul Feig and written by Kristen Wiig and Annie Mumolo. The movie follows Annie Walker (played by Kristen Wiig), a single woman who is struggling to come to terms with her own life after being dumped by her boyfriend.

The main themes of Bridesmaids include:

* Friendship: The movie explores the complexities of female friendships, particularly between Annie and her maid-of-honor, Lillian (played by Maya Rudolph). Their relationship is put to the test as they navigate the challenges of planning a wedding.
* Female empowerment: Through Annie's journey, the film promotes female empowerment and self-discovery. Annie learns to let go of her insecurities and find her own identity outside of her relationships.
* Humor and satire: The movie uses humor and satire to poke fun at societal norms and expectations surrounding women, particularly in regards to marriage and motherhood.
* Identity crisis: Annie's struggles with her own life serve as a catalyst for the story. She must confront her own insecurities and find a new sense of purpose outside of her relationships.

The film also explores themes of:

* Class differences: The movie highlights the class differences between Annie and Lillian, who come from different socioeconomic backgrounds.
* Motherhood: The character of Helen (played by Rose Byrne) serves as a foil to Annie's struggles with motherhood. Helen is portrayed as a perfect, put-together mother, which serves to highlight Annie's own insecurities.

Overall, Bridesmaids is a comedy that uses humor and satire to explore themes of female empowerment, friendship, and identity crisis.

overview: Set in a 19th century village, a young man studying under a local doctor joins a team of hunters on the trail of a wolf-like creature.
title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
plot:
Werewolf: The Beast Among Us is a 2012 Italian horror film directed by Fabrizio Rongione, not CC Capital Arts Entertainment SRL. 

The movie follows the story of a werewolf who terrorizes a small town in Italy, and it explores several themes:

1. **Fear of the unknown**: The film taps into the fear of the unknown, using the werewolf as a metaphor for the uncontrollable forces that lurk in the shadows.
2. **Violence and aggression**: The movie portrays a violent and aggressive protagonist, highlighting the destructive power of unchecked emotions and primal instincts.
3. **Isolation and loneliness**: The werewolf's isolation from society serves to amplify its sense of loneliness and disconnection, making it an even more formidable and terrifying creature.
4. **Supernatural horror**: The film relies on traditional horror tropes, using the supernatural elements to create a sense of unease and fear in the audience.

The movie received mixed reviews from critics, with some praising its atmospheric tension and others criticizing its predictable plot and lack of character development.

overview: A pampered dog named Trouble must learn to live in the real world while trying to escape from his former owner's greedy children and must learn how to survive on the big-city streets.
tagline: From the silk sheets... to the mean streets...
title: Trouble
plot:
Trouble, also known as Dog Gone Trouble, is a 2019 computer-animated comedy directed by Kevin Johnson and written by Rob Muir from a story by Muir and Jordan Katz. It features the voices of Big Sean as Trouble, Pamela Adlon as Rousey and Lucy Hale as Zoe Bell, with Wilmer Valderrama, Marissa Winokur, Joel McHale, Damon Wayans Jr., Olivia Holt and Betty White, in what became her final film role. The film was dedicated to the memory of executive producer Conrad Vernon's dog, Linus.

Trouble is a pampered dog who lives in luxury in a mansion with his wealthy elderly owner, Mrs. Sarah Vanderwhoozie, cared for by her loyal butler James. When Mrs. Vanderwhoozie dies of natural causes, her greedy niece and nephew, the twins Claire and Norbert, arrive to claim her fortune. While clearing out the house, they carelessly get rid of Trouble, only to learn from their aunt's lawyer that they can inherit only if they prove they can take care of the dog within a few days. Desperate, they hire Thurman Sanchez, an eccentric animal tracker, to bring him back.

Meanwhile, Trouble finds himself lost in the city with no collar, after a gang of nut-obsessed squirrels steals it in revenge for a mishap. Having never fended for himself, he must learn to survive on the streets. He meets Rousey, a tough but kind-hearted stray pit bull, and accidentally causes a chase through a restaurant that costs Zoe, a pizza delivery girl and aspiring singer, one of her deliveries. As Trouble struggles to adjust to life without his comforts, he finds friendship among other dogs, forms a bond with Zoe and begins to discover what home and family really mean, while Thurman and the twins close in on him.

The film includes cameo appearances by personalities such as dog trainer Cesar Millan and chef Ludo Lefebvre, and blends slapstick chases with a story about loyalty and belonging.

Completed in 2019, Trouble was distributed worldwide by Netflix on May 28, 2021. It received largely negative reviews; Chris Azzopardi of The New York Times wrote that while home is at the center of the story, the film itself is nothing to write home about.

original_title: Monster High: Welcome to Monster High
overview: Monsters once lived in hiding—even from each other—because they were afraid they would be in danger if humans knew they existed. But Draculaura, the daughter of Dracula, along with her best ghoulfriends, dreamt of a school where everyone was welcome and accepted for who they are. Determined to make their dream come true, the ghouls travel the world on an epic adventure to recruit new students. But even in this amazing place, there's drama: a villainess zombie is spreading trouble rather than friendship, and every student must live with the fear that their secret will be revealed. Now the ghouls must save their school so that every monster has a place where they belong and their uniqueness is celebrated!
tagline: Welcome to the most clever, quirky and exciting monster-filled school imaginable!
title: Monster High: Welcome to Monster High
plot:
Monster High: Welcome to Monster High (also titled Welcome to Monster High: The Origin Story) is a 2016 American computer-animated fantasy film that rebooted Mattel's Monster High franchise with redesigned characters and a new origin story. Directed by Stephen Donnelly, Olly Reid and Jun Falkenstein from a screenplay by Donnelly, Dana Starfield and Shane Amsterdam, it was the first second-generation special and was animated by the British studio Flaunt Productions, with music by Paul Robb and Michael Kotch. It received a limited US theatrical release on 27 August 2016 before arriving on streaming and DVD that September.

Draculaura, the daughter of Count Dracula, has spent her life in her father's mansion, forbidden to mingle with humans and dreaming of friends and a normal life. One night Frankie Stein, daughter of Frankenstein's creature, knocks at the door, having seen Draculaura turn into a bat. The two decide to open a school for monsters, who have always lived in hiding, even from one another. In the forest they recruit the werewolf Clawdeen Wolf, whose mother and brothers move in, and the mansion is converted into Monster High. Draculaura's blog, posted on the secret Monster Internet, draws thousands of followers, and with a magical amulet that teleports them to any monster whose name they know, the ghouls travel the world, recruiting the mummy Cleo de Nile in Egypt, Lagoona Blue in Australia, Deuce Gorgon and Venus McFlytrap.

Draculaura and Frankie run for student council presidents, promising a world where humans and monsters can coexist and rashly vowing to bring Draculaura's favourite pop star, Tash, to the school dance. Their rival is Moanica D'Kay, a zombie who commands an army of "Zomboyz" and wants monsters to rule over humans. She mocks the girls' dream, and Tash rejects Draculaura in horror at the sight of her fangs. Draculaura and Frankie nonetheless win the election, but Moanica crashes the dance with Tash as her hostage, planning to turn her into a zombie. Draculaura defeats Moanica in bat form, and when Moanica lunges at the singer and passes straight through her, Tash reveals that she is in fact a ghost named Ari Hauntington, who had disguised herself to live among humans, and she finally accepts being a monster.

The voice cast includes Debi Derryberry as Draculaura, Cassandra Lee Morris as Frankie, Salli Saffioti as Clawdeen and Cleo, Cristina Milizia as Moanica, Michael Sorich as Dracula and Jonquil Goode as Tash.

belongs_to_collection.name: South Park the Streaming Wars Collection

original_title: South Park the Streaming Wars Part 2
overview: A drought has brought the town of South Park to the brink of disaster.
title: South Park the Streaming Wars Part 2
plot:
"South Park: The Streaming Wars Part 2" is a 2022 American adult animated television special written and directed by Trey Parker, who voices most of the characters with co-creator Matt Stone. The fourth South Park special and the 319th episode overall, it was released on Paramount+ on July 13, 2022, and concludes the story begun in "South Park: The Streaming Wars", in which a severe drought grips Colorado and the eccentric water-park owner Pi Pi plans to profit from it.

As the drought worsens, Cartman takes his mother Liane to court, while his friends testify that he spent their earnings on breast implants; the case is thrown out. Randy Marsh wakes on a bench, terrifying onlookers, and is tranquillised by police, who explain that he went "full nuclear Karen". Remorseful, he abandons his marijuana farm and returns to his old career as a geologist to tackle the water shortage. Tolkien searches the abandoned home of the late Robert Cussler for clues to the whereabouts of his missing father, Steve, while Cartman convinces himself that Tolkien is sleeping with his mother.

At a Denver council meeting, Pi Pi pitches a plan to run the whole state on urine, backed by celebrities who previously promoted cryptocurrency and NFTs. Randy instead proposes a desalination plant, which the city adopts, so Pi Pi orders his enforcers, including ManBearPig, to get rid of him. Detective Harris tells the boys that ManBearPig is being coerced because Pi Pi is holding his mate, PigBearGirl, and their offspring, Chuck Chuck. Steve, injured, wakes in a sewer after the creatures have tended his wounds. Cartman, Butters and Tolkien sneak into the water park, find Chuck Chuck and are captured, as Pi Pi reveals his scheme to them.

When ManBearPig wrecks the desalination plant, Randy's family persuade him to become Karen again with a strain of marijuana Sharon had kept. He storms the water park and exposes Pi Pi in the middle of a commercial shoot, allowing the boys to escape with the help of PigBearGirl and Chuck Chuck. Tolkien is reunited with his father, and ManBearPig, freed from coercion, decapitates Pi Pi. Randy persuades Cartman and other people with breast implants to drain their saline to supply the plant, which brings water back to Denver, and the creature family returns to the woods.

Critics responded well, with ComingSoon.net rating it 9 out of 10 and calling it a step up from the first part.

overview: After a bloody invasion of the BOPE in the High-Security Penitentiary Bangu 1 in Rio de Janeiro to control a rebellion of interns, the Lieutenant-Colonel Roberto Nascimento and the second in command Captain André Matias are accused by the Human Right Aids member Diogo Fraga of execution of prisoners. Matias is transferred to the corrupted Military Police and Nascimento is exonerated from the BOPE by the Governor.
title: Elite Squad: The Enemy Within
plot:
Elite Squad: The Enemy Within (Portuguese: Tropa de Elite 2: O Inimigo Agora É Outro) is a 2010 Brazilian action thriller directed and co-produced by José Padilha, who co-wrote it with Bráulio Mantovani and Rodrigo Pimentel. A sequel to Elite Squad (2007), it continues the semi-fictional story of BOPE, the special operations battalion of the Rio de Janeiro Military Police, now focusing on the links between police and politics. Wagner Moura reprises his role as Nascimento, with Irandhir Santos, André Ramiro and Maria Ribeiro. It was released in Brazil on October 8, 2010.

Thirteen years after the first film, Lieutenant Colonel Roberto Nascimento is ambushed as he leaves a hospital, and as his car is riddled with bullets he narrates the events that led there. Four years earlier, he led BOPE in suppressing a riot at the Bangu prison complex, where the human rights activist Diogo Fraga, now married to Nascimento's ex-wife Rosane, was negotiating with the inmates. The operation ends in a bloodbath, and although Nascimento is officially removed from command, public support for his hard line leads the state government to promote him to undersecretary of intelligence for public security.

With increased resources, Nascimento expands BOPE and wages a relentless war on drug trafficking in the favelas. But as the dealers are driven out, a new enemy fills the vacuum: corrupt police officers organized into militias, which seize control of the communities and extort residents for protection, utilities and votes. Nascimento gradually realizes that his campaign has served the interests of these militias and of the politicians who depend on them for electoral support, including members of the state government and a television host turned legislator. As his former protégé Matias is killed and Fraga's investigations put him in danger, his relationship with his son also suffers. Turning against the system he once served, Nascimento joins forces with Fraga and testifies before a parliamentary inquiry, exposing a web of corruption that reaches all the way to the national capital.

The film was a critical and commercial triumph, becoming the most-watched and highest-grossing film ever released in Brazil at the time, surpassing Dona Flor and Her Two Husbands and Avatar. Metacritic gave it 71 out of 100. It was selected as Brazil's submission for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.

overview: A small unit of U.S. soldiers, alone at the remote Combat Outpost Keating, located deep in the valley of three mountains in Afghanistan, battles to defend against an overwhelming force of Taliban fighters in a coordinated attack. The Battle of Kamdesh, as it was known, was the bloodiest American engagement of the Afghan War in 2009 and Bravo Troop 3-61 CAV became one of the most decorated units of the 19-year conflict.
tagline: The mission was survival.
title: The Outpost
plot:
The Outpost is a 2019 American war film directed by Rod Lurie and based on the 2012 nonfiction book The Outpost: An Untold Story of American Valor by Jake Tapper. It depicts the Battle of Kamdesh in Afghanistan and stars Scott Eastwood as Staff Sergeant Clint Romesha, Caleb Landry Jones as Specialist Ty Carter and Orlando Bloom as Captain Ben Keating, with Jack Kesy, Cory Hardrict, Milo Gibson, Jacob Scipio and Taylor John Smith. Several veterans of the battle, including Ty Carter and Daniel Rodriguez, appear in the film.

The story is set at Combat Outpost Keating, a small American base built at the bottom of a deep valley in eastern Afghanistan and surrounded by steep mountains, which leaves it exposed to constant attack. Romesha and a group of new soldiers arrive under the command of Captain Keating, who tries to win over local elders by offering money for infrastructure projects in exchange for peace. Daily life at the post alternates between boredom, tension and sudden Taliban fire from the heights above.

As commanders come and go, including after deaths among the officers, the soldiers grow increasingly aware of how vulnerable their position is. Warnings from the base's Afghan interpreter about a large-scale assault are dismissed, and news that the outpost will soon be closed does little to ease the pressure. On October 3, 2009, hundreds of Taliban fighters launch a massive coordinated attack. Outnumbered and pinned down, the small group of American soldiers and their Afghan allies fight for hours to hold the outpost, rescue wounded comrades and retake lost ground, in a battle that would leave eight Americans dead.

The film is noted for its long, immersive and chaotic depiction of the battle, and it honors the unit that became one of the most decorated of the war, with Romesha and Carter each receiving the Medal of Honor.

The Outpost premiered at the Thessaloniki International Film Festival in November 2019 and was released in the United States on premium video on demand and in select theaters on July 3, 2020, by Screen Media Films, topping the iTunes rental chart. It was acclaimed by critics, with 93 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 71.

original_title: Pooh's Grand Adventure: The Search for Christopher Robin
overview: Pooh gets confused when Christopher Robin leaves him a note to say that he has gone back to school after the holidays. So Pooh, Piglet, Tigger, Eeyore and Rabbit go in search of Christopher Robin which leads to a big adventure.
title: Pooh's Grand Adventure: The Search for Christopher Robin
plot:
Pooh's Grand Adventure: The Search for Christopher Robin is a heartwarming and nostalgic film that explores the complexities of growing up, friendship, and the power of imagination. At its core, the movie delves into the bittersweet theme of childhood nostalgia, as Pooh and his friends in the Hundred Acre Wood struggle to come to terms with the departure of their dear friend Christopher Robin.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Christopher Robin's growing up is not just a physical transition, but also an emotional one. He is leaving behind the carefree world of childhood, where imagination knows no bounds and friendship is paramount. The film poignantly captures the pain and longing that comes with this transition, as Pooh and his friends grapple with the idea of losing their dear friend to the demands of adulthood.

Throughout the movie, the theme of imagination is also expertly woven, highlighting the importance of holding onto one's sense of wonder and curiosity. The film shows how Christopher Robin's imagination has been a source of inspiration for the animals in the Hundred Acre Wood, and how his departure threatens to extinguish this spark.

Ultimately, Pooh's Grand Adventure: The Search for Christopher Robin is a poignant exploration of the human experience, reminding us that growing up is not just about physical change, but also about emotional growth and letting go. The film's themes are timeless and universal, making it a beloved classic among both children and adults alike.

overview: Electricity titans Thomas Edison and George Westinghouse compete to create a sustainable system and market it to the American people.
tagline: Power changes everything
title: The Current War
plot:
The Current War is a historical drama inspired by the 19th-century rivalry between Thomas Edison and George Westinghouse over which electrical system would power the United States, known as the "war of the currents." Directed by Alfonso Gomez-Rejon from a screenplay by Michael Mitnick, with Martin Scorsese and Steven Zaillian among the executive producers, it stars Benedict Cumberbatch as Edison, Michael Shannon as Westinghouse, Nicholas Hoult as Nikola Tesla and Tom Holland as Samuel Insull, alongside Katherine Waterston, Tuppence Middleton and Matthew Macfadyen.

In the 1880s, Edison is already famous as the inventor of the practical incandescent light bulb and is racing to electrify American cities with his direct current system. The industrialist Westinghouse, convinced that alternating current is cheaper and able to carry power over far greater distances, enters the business as Edison's rival after Edison snubs him. The competition soon turns personal and ruthless. Edison, struggling to balance his ambition with his devotion to his wife Mary and their children, launches a public campaign to brand alternating current as deadly, staging electrocutions of animals to frighten the public. Meanwhile, the brilliant Serbian immigrant Tesla, who briefly works for Edison before leaving in frustration, struggles to fund his own inventions until Westinghouse acquires his designs for an alternating current motor.

The contest escalates through patent battles and secret dealings, including Edison's covert involvement in the development of the electric chair, which is used for the first time to execute a man with alternating current. The rivalry comes to a head with the competition to light the 1893 World's Columbian Exposition in Chicago, a showcase of the future in which the winner will define how the nation is powered.

The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September 2017, but its release was derailed when The Weinstein Company collapsed amid the sexual abuse allegations against Harvey Weinstein. Lantern Entertainment acquired the film and sold US rights to 101 Studios, and Gomez-Rejon, with Scorsese's backing, carried out reshoots and trimmed the running time. This director's cut was released in the United States in October 2019. Reviewers judged it an improvement over the festival version; Metacritic gave it 55 out of 100.

overview: A beautiful island is home to thousands of species of aquatic life. Now there is a new species: the 5-Headed Shark is all heads and teeth. Shaped like a demented starfish, this monster terrorizes the open ocean before invading the beaches of Puerto Rico, endangering the once peaceful island paradise.
tagline: YOU CAN'T SURVIVE THE FIVE!
title: 5 Headed Shark Attack
plot:
"5 Headed Shark Attack" is a campy, over-the-top thriller that explores the theme of chaos and anarchy in the face of nature's fury. The movie takes a straightforward premise - a massive shark attack on a beach town - and amplifies it to absurd levels, creating a sense of pandemonium that permeates every aspect of the story.

At its core, "5 Headed Shark Attack" is a film about the breakdown of societal order in the face of catastrophic events. The shark's arrival sets off a chain reaction of panic, destruction, and mayhem, as the characters struggle to cope with the sheer scale of the disaster unfolding before them.

The movie also touches on the theme of human hubris and the dangers of underestimating nature. The scientists and experts who initially dismiss the shark as a minor threat are ultimately proven wrong, highlighting the limitations of human knowledge and the unpredictability of the natural world.

Furthermore, "5 Headed Shark Attack" can be seen as a commentary on the voyeuristic tendencies of modern society. The characters' fascination with the shark's attacks serves as a metaphor for our own morbid curiosity about violence and disaster, which can often lead to a sense of detachment and disconnection from the consequences of our actions.

Overall, "5 Headed Shark Attack" is a tongue-in-cheek, B-movie thriller that uses its absurd premise to explore themes of chaos, anarchy, and the dangers of underestimating nature.

overview: Inspired by the true story of Vince Papale, a man with nothing to lose who ignored the staggering odds and made his dream come true. When the coach of Papale's beloved hometown football team hosted an unprecedented open tryout, the public consensus was that it was a waste of time – no one good enough to play professional football was going to be found this way.
tagline: Dreams are not lived on the sidelines
title: Invincible
plot:
Invincible is a 2006 American biographical sports drama directed by Ericson Core. It tells the true story of Vince Papale, played by Mark Wahlberg, a part-time bartender and substitute teacher from South Philadelphia who earned a place on the Philadelphia Eagles in 1976. Greg Kinnear plays Eagles head coach Dick Vermeil, with Elizabeth Banks as Janet Cantrell and Michael Rispoli as one of Papale's friends.

In 1976, Philadelphia is struggling with layoffs and labor unrest, and its football team, the Eagles, has endured years of losing seasons. Vince Papale is a thirty-year-old substitute teacher who loves playing pickup football with his friends. His life is falling apart: he loses his teaching job, and his wife leaves him, convinced that he will never amount to anything. At the bar where he works part-time, he hears that the Eagles' new coach, Dick Vermeil, is holding open tryouts for anyone who wants a shot at the team.

Encouraged by his friends, Papale attends the tryout along with hundreds of other hopefuls, and he impresses Vermeil enough to be invited to training camp. Older than most players and without professional experience, he endures grueling workouts, mockery and hostility from professional players who see him as a publicity stunt. Meanwhile, he begins a tentative romance with Janet, a new bartender who is a fan of the rival New York Giants. Against the advice of his assistants, Vermeil gives Papale the final roster spot, and he becomes a hero to the working-class fans of the city as he fights to prove that he belongs in the NFL and to help a struggling team regain its pride.

The film is an underdog story that ties Papale's personal journey to the spirit of a blue-collar city, with authentic period detail of 1970s Philadelphia.

Invincible was released in the United States on August 25, 2006, and topped the box office in each of its first two weekends, opening with about 17 million dollars. It received generally positive reviews, with 71 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 63, and critics praised its authenticity and its heartfelt, uplifting message.

overview: The story of former Hollywood star Grace Kelly's crisis of marriage and identity, during a political dispute between Monaco's Prince Rainier III and France's Charles De Gaulle, and a looming French invasion of Monaco in the early 1960s.
title: Grace of Monaco
plot:
Grace of Monaco is a 2014 biographical drama film that tells the story of Princess Grace Kelly's life, from her early days as an actress to her marriage to Prince Rainier III of Monaco and her subsequent rise to royal status. The main themes of the movie revolve around the tension between personal identity and public duty.

The film explores how Princess Grace struggled with the constraints of royal protocol and the expectations placed upon her as a member of the royal family, while also trying to maintain her own sense of self and artistic passion. As she navigates the complexities of palace life, she must confront the sacrifices she has made for her marriage and her role as a princess.

The movie also delves into the theme of feminism, highlighting Princess Grace's determination to forge her own path in a world dominated by men. Her character's journey is marked by moments of quiet defiance and subtle rebellion against the patriarchal norms that seek to constrain her.

Furthermore, the film touches on the idea of love and sacrifice, as Princess Grace must weigh her own desires against the needs of her husband and their future children. The movie raises questions about the nature of true love and whether it can survive the pressures of royal life.

Overall, Grace of Monaco is a nuanced exploration of the complexities of royal life, personal identity, and the challenges faced by women in positions of power.

overview: When a shadowy CIA agent uncovers damning agency secrets, he's hunted across the globe by a sociopathic rogue operative who's put a bounty on his head.
title: The Gray Man
plot:
The Gray Man is a 2022 American action thriller directed by Anthony and Joe Russo from a screenplay by Joe Russo, Christopher Markus and Stephen McFeely, adapted from Mark Greaney's 2009 novel. Ryan Gosling plays the CIA operative Sierra Six and Chris Evans the mercenary hunting him, with Ana de Armas, Jessica Henwick, Regé-Jean Page, Wagner Moura, Julia Butters, Dhanush, Alfre Woodard and Billy Bob Thornton. Produced by AGBO, it opened in a limited theatrical release on July 15, 2022, and arrived on Netflix a week later.

In 2003 the CIA official Donald Fitzroy visits Court Gentry in a Florida prison, where he is serving time for killing his abusive father to protect his brother, and offers him freedom in return for joining Sierra, a secret programme of deniable assassins. Eighteen years later, working as Sierra Six with agent Dani Miranda, he is sent to kill a target in Bangkok during the Songkran festival. The dying man reveals that he was Sierra Four and hands Six an encrypted drive containing evidence of corruption by Denny Carmichael, the official who ordered the hit.

Six refuses to come in, sends the drive to his former handler Margaret Cahill in Prague and asks the now-retired Fitzroy for help. Carmichael turns to Lloyd Hansen, a sadistic ex-CIA operative turned contractor, who kidnaps Fitzroy's niece Claire, whom Six once protected, and holds her at a Croatian estate while posting a huge bounty that draws assassins from around the world. Carmichael's deputy Suzanne Brewer is sent to keep Lloyd under control.

Betrayed in Vienna by the forger Laszlo Sosa, Six survives Lloyd's team with Miranda's help, and the two decrypt the drive in Prague before the dying Cahill blows up her home to cover their escape. A massive gunfight follows across the city, including a battle on a tram. The hired killer Lone Wolf seizes the drive for Lloyd, but Six and Miranda follow him to the estate. Fitzroy is killed during the rescue, Lone Wolf hands the drive to Miranda in disgust at Lloyd's methods, and Six fights Lloyd in a hedge maze until Brewer shoots Lloyd dead. Brewer then uses the evidence to protect the agency rather than punish Carmichael, keeping Claire as leverage, until Six escapes and drives away with her.

With a reported budget of about 200 million dollars, it was one of Netflix's most expensive films. Critics were divided, giving it a 45% Rotten Tomatoes approval, but it was popular with viewers and a sequel was announced.

overview: Jackie Chan stars as a hardened special forces agent who fights to protect a young woman from a sinister criminal gang. At the same time, he feels a special connection to the young woman, like they met in a different life.
tagline: The Fate of Mankind Lies in the Heart of One
title: Bleeding Steel
plot:
Bleeding Steel is a 2017 Chinese science fiction action film written and directed by Leo Zhang and starring Jackie Chan as Lin Dong, with Ouyang Nana, Show Lo, Erica Xia-Hou, Callan Mulvey and Tess Haubrich. Largely set and filmed in Sydney, Australia, the cyberpunk-styled story combines gunfights and martial arts with themes of biotechnology and cybernetic enhancement.

Hong Kong special agent Lin Dong is racing to the hospital to see his young daughter Xixi, who is critically ill with leukemia, when he is called away to protect Dr. James, a scientist and key witness in danger. As his unit escorts the doctor, who has injected himself with an experimental substance, they are ambushed by soldiers in black armor led by the monstrous Andre. Most of the unit is killed, and Lin is badly wounded before he manages to stop Andre with a massive explosion. While he lies injured, he learns that his daughter has died.

Thirteen years later in Sydney, author Rick Rogers publishes a novel called Bleeding Steel about a soldier implanted with a mechanical heart. A young hacker, Li Sen, breaks into Rogers's hotel suite to steal information about the book, but a mysterious woman in black arrives and tortures the author to learn the source of his story. The trail leads to Nancy, a young woman plagued by nightmares about laboratory experiments, who is being hunted by Andre, now a cyborg, and his forces. Lin Dong, who has been secretly watching over Nancy, must protect her, uncover the truth behind her visions and her connection to his past, and confront the enemy he thought he had destroyed, in a series of chases and fights that culminate in a climactic battle in Sydney.

The film was one of several Chinese productions seeking to blend Hollywood-style science fiction with Chan's trademark stunt-driven action.

Bleeding Steel was released in China on 22 December 2017 and in the United States by Lionsgate Premiere in theaters and on video on demand on 6 July 2018. It received mostly negative reviews, with 22 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes; the South China Morning Post called it a new low for Chan. It grossed about 48.8 million dollars worldwide and was considered a box-office disappointment.

overview: The story of the last Seal Child’s journey home. After their mother’s disappearance, Ben and Saoirse are sent to live with Granny in the city. When they resolve to return to their home by the sea, their journey becomes a race against time as they are drawn into a world Ben knows only from his mother’s folktales. But this is no bedtime story; these fairy folk have been in our world far too long. It soon becomes clear to Ben that Saoirse is the key to their survival.
production_companies: MEDIA Programme of the European Union
tagline: Let the song of the sea sway your heart...
title: Song of the Sea
plot:
Song of the Sea is a 2014 Irish-French animated fantasy film directed by Tomm Moore and Nora Twomey. The movie follows the story of Ben, a young boy who sets out on a journey to save his sister Saoirse from the spirit world.

The main themes of Song of the Sea include:

1. **Identity and Belonging**: The film explores the theme of identity and belonging, particularly in the context of cultural heritage and tradition. Saoirse, the protagonist, is caught between her human and fairy worlds, symbolizing the struggle to find one's place in the world.
2. **Family and Love**: The movie highlights the importance of family and love in overcoming adversity. Ben's journey is motivated by his desire to protect his sister, demonstrating the depth of their bond and the sacrifices made for loved ones.
3. **Cultural Heritage and Tradition**: Song of the Sea celebrates Irish folklore and mythology, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of Ireland. The film encourages appreciation and respect for traditional stories and customs.
4. **Growing Up and Letting Go**: As Ben navigates the spirit world, he must confront his own fears and limitations, ultimately learning to let go of childhood and embracing adulthood. This theme is reflected in Saoirse's journey as well, as she begins to assert her independence and find her own path.
5. **Environmentalism and Stewardship**: The movie touches on environmental themes, highlighting the importance of preserving natural habitats and respecting the interconnectedness of all living things.

The film's beautiful animation, engaging storyline, and memorable characters have made Song of the Sea a beloved classic among audiences worldwide.

overview: A legendary but retired hit man lives in peace and isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.
tagline: You can't outrun the past
title: Cold Blood
plot:
Cold Blood, also released as Cold Blood Legacy, is a 2019 English-language action thriller written and directed by the French filmmaker Frédéric Petitjean. Jean Reno stars as a retired contract killer living in seclusion, with Sarah Lind as the young woman who enters his life, and Joe Anderson, David Gyasi, Ihor Ciszkewycz and Samantha Bond in supporting roles. Set in a snowbound wilderness, the film was released on 15 May 2019.

Henry, a professional assassin, has withdrawn to a remote cabin in the snowbound forests near the Canadian border, where he lives in silence and solitude, fishing on the frozen lake. One day he comes across a crashed snowmobile and a badly injured young woman, who tells him her name is Melody. He drives off a pack of wolves that close in on her, carries her back to the cabin and treats her injuries with what little he has, pulling out splinters and shards of wood embedded in her body.

As she recovers, Henry grows wary. She has no identification and no phone, and the circumstances of the crash do not add up, so he examines the scene and tells her she must leave as soon as she can. One day, seeing him sitting outside with his back to her, apparently fishing, she assembles a pistol hidden in her pack and shoots him in the head, only to discover that she has hit a straw dummy. Henry overpowers and questions her.

She admits that her real name is Charlie and that she came to kill him in revenge for his murder of her father, a wealthy man who largely ignored her but whose memory she still wanted to honour. Henry reveals that he already knew who she was, and that the contract he accepted had also required him to kill her. He releases her into the wilderness, but she comes back to the cabin. When one of her father's former bodyguards arrives to rescue her, Henry kills him in a gunfight.

Weary of his life as a killer, Henry calls the police on himself the next morning. Charlie strikes him, and when he raises his gun, he shoots a wolf behind her and then appears to aim at her before dropping the cartridge. The arriving officers shoot him dead. Charlie later returns to the cabin and finds that he has left her his copy of The Art of War and the phone number of the person who ordered her death.

Critics were dismissive, with Variety calling it instantly forgettable despite its striking snowy setting.

overview: A prep-school student accidentally films the drug-related deaths of two classmates, then is asked to put together a memorial video.
tagline: There's always someone watching…
title: Afterschool
plot:
Afterschool is a 2008 American drama film directed by Anthony Bregman. The movie revolves around Eric (played by Frankie Muniz), a high school student struggling to cope with his father's death and the pressures of adolescence.

The main theme of Afterschool is the exploration of grief, loss, and the complexities of growing up. Through Eric's character, the film delves into the emotional turmoil that often accompanies the loss of a loved one, particularly when it happens during formative years. The movie also touches on the theme of identity crisis, as Eric navigates his relationships with family members, friends, and romantic interests.

Moreover, Afterschool critiques the societal expectations placed on teenagers, particularly those who have experienced trauma or loss. The film highlights the difficulties of finding one's place in the world when faced with adversity, and the struggle to reconcile past experiences with present-day realities.

The movie also explores the theme of escapism, as Eric turns to his passion for photography as a means of coping with his emotions. Through this lens, the film offers a poignant commentary on the human need to find solace in creative expression during times of turmoil.

Overall, Afterschool is a thought-provoking drama that tackles complex themes with sensitivity and nuance, offering a powerful exploration of the human experience during adolescence.

overview: Haruto Asakura falls in love with hairdresser Misaki Ariake and asks her out. Watching Misaki Ariake work hard to achieve what she wants, Haruto Asakura, who almost gave up his dream to become a photographer, begins to pursue his dream again, but Misaki Ariake is diagnosed with a disease that ages her 10x faster than normal.
title: Love Like the Falling Petals
plot:
Love Like the Falling Petals (Japanese: 桜のような僕の恋人, Sakura no Yō na Boku no Koibito) is a 2022 Japanese romantic drama film directed by Yoshihiro Fukagawa and written by Tomoko Yoshida, based on Keisuke Uyama's 2017 novel of the same name. Kento Nakajima stars as Haruto Asakura, with Honoka Matsumoto as Misaki Ariake, Kento Nagayama as her older brother Takashi and Jun Kaname as her doctor. The film was released worldwide on Netflix on 24 March 2022.

Haruto, an aspiring photographer who has drifted away from his ambitions, goes for a haircut and is instantly smitten with the young hairdresser who cuts his hair, Misaki, who tells him that he is her very first customer. Wanting to impress her, he introduces himself as a professional photographer, stretching the truth. He keeps returning to the salon, and the two grow closer. When he finally tries to ask her out during a haircut, he moves his head and she accidentally nicks his earlobe, causing him to bleed and faint. Mortified, Misaki meets him to apologize and agrees to go out with him, despite the disapproval of her protective older brother.

On their first outing, to see the cherry blossoms, Haruto confesses that he is not really working as a photographer and does not know what to do with his life. Misaki is angered that he has given up on his dream so easily and urges him not to quit just because things are difficult. Taking her words to heart, he gets a job at a photo studio and works hard to become someone she can be proud of, and their relationship blossoms into a serious romance.

Their happiness is shattered when Misaki falls ill and is diagnosed with a rare progeroid syndrome, a disease that causes her body to age at an extraordinary speed and leaves her with very little time. Devastated and unwilling to let Haruto see her change, she withdraws from him, quits her job at the salon and eventually tells him that she has found someone else, breaking his heart. Cared for by her brother, who desperately searches for a cure, Misaki faces her rapid decline in seclusion, while Haruto, unaware of the truth, throws himself into his photography. The film follows both of them through the seasons as their separate paths move toward a final, bittersweet reckoning, with cherry blossoms serving as a recurring symbol of fleeting beauty and impermanence.

overview: Bachelor football star Joe Kingman seems to have it all. He is wealthy and carefree, and his team is on the way to capturing a championship. Suddenly, he is tackled by some unexpected news: He has a young daughter, the result of a last fling with his ex-wife. Joe must learn to balance his personal and professional lives with the needs of his child.
tagline: Half his size, twice the trouble ... and she's moving in.
title: The Game Plan
plot:
The Game Plan is a 2007 American sports comedy film directed by Adam Shankman and produced by Walt Disney Pictures.

The movie follows the story of Joe Kingman (played by Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson), a successful NFL quarterback who has it all - fame, fortune, and a beautiful girlfriend named Gloria (played by Roselyn Sánchez). However, despite his outward success, Joe is emotionally unavailable and lacks any real connection with those around him.

On the eve of the biggest game of his career, Joe's life takes an unexpected turn when he discovers that he has a 8-year-old daughter, Peyton (played by Kyra Sedgwick), whom he never knew existed. Gloria reveals to Joe that she is Peyton's mother and that Joe is her father.

Initially, Joe is hesitant to accept his new role as a single father, but eventually, he decides to take on the responsibility of raising Peyton. As they spend more time together, Joe begins to learn about the importance of family and what it means to be a good parent.

However, things become complicated when Gloria tries to win back Joe's affections, and Joe finds himself torn between his love for her and his growing bond with Peyton. Meanwhile, Peyton struggles to adjust to her new life with her father, who is still learning the ropes of being a single parent.

As the story unfolds, Joe learns valuable lessons about family, love, and what truly matters in life. He also discovers that he has a lot to learn from Peyton, who teaches him about the importance of kindness, empathy, and understanding.

Throughout the movie, The Rock delivers his signature charm and charisma, making Joe a lovable and relatable character. The supporting cast, including Kyra Sedgwick and Roselyn Sánchez, add depth and humor to the story.

The Game Plan is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of family, love, and identity. With its lighthearted tone and engaging storyline, it's no wonder why this movie became a box office hit.

overview: A strange old woman allows a teenage runaway and a young orphan to stay in an abandoned house that overlooks the sea. However, when a menacing entity threatens their new home, they must band together and face their fears to save it.
title: The House of the Lost on the Cape
plot:
The House of the Lost on the Cape (Japanese: Misaki no Mayoiga) is a 2021 Japanese animated fantasy drama directed by Shinya Kawatsura and produced by David Production, based on the novel by Sachiko Kashiwaba, which won the Noma Children's Literature Award. Reiko Yoshida wrote the screenplay and Yuri Miyauchi composed the score, with the closing song "Mayoiga" performed by Hitsujibungaku. Part of a project marking the tenth anniversary of the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami, it features the voices of Mana Ashida as Yui, Sari Awano as Hiyori and Shinobu Otake as Kiwa, with Takuya Tasso, Sally Amaki, Mikio Date, Shohei Uno and Takeshi Tomizawa.

In the aftermath of the tsunami of 11 March 2011, two girls who do not know each other find themselves without a home. Seventeen-year-old Yui has run away from her abusive father, who blamed her for her mother leaving the family, while eight-year-old Hiyori lost her parents in a car accident and has not spoken since; the relatives who took her in lost their house in the disaster. At an evacuation shelter they meet Kiwa, a strange but kind old woman who takes pity on them and invites them to live with her as her granddaughters in an old, somewhat dilapidated house on a cape overlooking the sea, a mayoiga, which legend says looks after lost travelers. Although they followed Kiwa on impulse, the girls find comfort in the house and in her warm hospitality, and their wounded hearts gradually begin to heal. Then strange phenomena appear: curious beaked creatures that Kiwa calls "fushigitto" gather around the house, frightening Hiyori at first before proving harmless, while a black snake with red eyes seems malevolent. With help from friendly spirits of local folklore, including kappa, a zashiki-warashi, komainu guardian statues and jizō, Kiwa and the girls confront demons that feed on people's grief after the disaster.

The film opened in Japan on 27 August 2021 and won the Best Animation Film award at the Mainichi Film Awards. Eleven Arts released it in North America in September 2022, and it screened at the Annecy festival before a French release in 2023. French critics were largely positive: Les Fiches du cinéma called it a beautiful, delicate film about resilience and Télérama praised its subtle emotions, while Le Monde found the script somewhat predictable and Le Figaro considered it an underwhelming therapy film.

overview: A lawyer conducts business from the back of his Lincoln town car while representing a high-profile client in Beverly Hills.
tagline: This Case is a Dangerous Game of Life and Death.
title: The Lincoln Lawyer
plot:
The Lincoln Lawyer is a 2011 American crime thriller film directed by Brad Furman, based on the novel of the same name by Michael Connelly.

The movie follows the story of Mick Haller (played by Matthew McConaughey), a defense attorney who operates out of the back of his Lincoln Town Car. Mick takes on cases that other lawyers won't touch, often representing clients who are guilty but need a way to avoid prison time. When he's hired by a wealthy client named Louis Roulet (played by Ryan Phillippe) to defend him against charges of assaulting a prostitute, Mick agrees to take the case despite his initial reservations.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Mick is not just representing Louis for money, but also because he believes in his innocence. Through a series of twists and turns, Mick uncovers evidence that suggests Louis may be telling the truth about being framed by a woman named Maggie McPherson (played by Marisa Cohn).

The main themes of The Lincoln Lawyer include:

1. **The struggle for justice**: Mick's character is driven by his desire to uncover the truth and bring justice to his clients, even if it means going against the system.
2. **The blurred lines between right and wrong**: Throughout the movie, Mick is forced to confront his own moral ambiguities as he navigates the complexities of the case and the motivations of those around him.
3. **The power dynamics at play**: The film explores the ways in which power can be used to manipulate and control others, particularly in situations where there is a significant wealth disparity between the parties involved.
4. **Redemption and personal growth**: As Mick delves deeper into the case, he begins to confront his own demons and undergoes a process of personal growth and redemption.

Overall, The Lincoln Lawyer is a gripping thriller that explores themes of justice, morality, and power dynamics through the complex character of Mick Haller.

original_title: The Anthrax Attacks: In the Shadow of 9/11
overview: Days after 9/11, letters containing fatal anthrax spores spark panic and tragedy in the US. This documentary follows the subsequent FBI investigation.
title: The Anthrax Attacks: In the Shadow of 9/11
plot:
The Anthrax Attacks: In the Shadow of 9/11 is a documentary film that explores the 2001 anthrax attacks in the United States, which occurred after the September 11 attacks. The main themes of this documentary include:

1. **Terrorism and Fear**: The film delves into the psychological impact of the anthrax attacks on the American public, particularly in the aftermath of the 9/11 attacks. It examines how the government's response to the attacks was influenced by a desire to prevent another terrorist attack.

2. **Government Cover-up**: The documentary raises questions about whether the US government knew more about the anthrax attacks than they let on. It suggests that there may have been a cover-up, and that the true extent of the government's knowledge is still not fully known.

3. **Biological Warfare**: The film explores the use of biological warfare as a tool of terrorism, and how it can be used to create fear and panic. It also examines the potential consequences of such attacks on public health and national security.

4. **Investigation and Justice**: The documentary follows the investigation into the anthrax attacks, including the work of FBI agents and scientists who were tasked with identifying the source of the attacks. It raises questions about whether justice was served in the case, and whether those responsible for the attacks were held accountable.

5. **9/11 Connection**: The film also explores the connection between the anthrax attacks and the 9/11 attacks, including how the two events may have been linked by a common perpetrator or ideology.

Overall, The Anthrax Attacks: In the Shadow of 9/11 is a thought-provoking documentary that sheds light on a significant event in American history, and raises important questions about terrorism, government accountability, and public safety.

original_title: トワノクオン 第一章 泡沫の花弁
overview: This story follows a boy named Quon and his friends, who are "Attractors". Attractors are human beings who have awakened and have supernatural powers. Quon is determined to save them all. But a secret organization is hunting them...
title: Towa no Quon 1: The Ephemeral Petals
plot:
Towa no Quon 1: The Ephemeral Petals is an anime film that delves into the complexities of human emotions, particularly in the context of grief, loss, and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The story revolves around a young boy named Shun, who struggles to cope with the sudden death of his mother.

As the narrative unfolds, it becomes clear that Shun's perception of reality is fragile and susceptible to manipulation by external forces. His emotional state is further complicated by the presence of Quon, a mysterious entity that seems to embody both comfort and terror. Through Quon's interactions with Shun, the film explores the idea of how our emotions can be both a source of solace and a catalyst for chaos.

The movie also touches on the theme of isolation and loneliness, as Shun finds himself disconnected from the world around him. His relationships with others are shallow and unfulfilling, leaving him feeling adrift and uncertain about his place in the world.

Ultimately, Towa no Quon 1: The Ephemeral Petals is a poignant exploration of the human experience, one that grapples with the complexities of grief, loss, and the fragility of the human psyche. Through its use of fantasy and surrealism, the film creates a dreamlike atmosphere that both disturbs and fascinates, leaving the viewer to ponder the nature of reality and the human condition.

overview: Frustrated with the direction of the church, Cardinal Bergoglio requests permission to retire in 2012 from Pope Benedict. Instead, facing scandal and self-doubt, the introspective Pope Benedict summons his harshest critic and future successor to Rome to reveal a secret that would shake the foundations of the Catholic Church.
title: The Two Popes
plot:
The Two Popes is a 2019 biographical comedy-drama film that explores the unlikely friendship between Pope Benedict XVI and Pope Francis. At its core, the movie delves into the complexities of faith, power, and identity.

One of the primary themes of The Two Popes is the struggle for relevance in an ever-changing world. Both Pope Benedict and Pope Francis grapple with the challenges of modernity, from the rise of secularism to the growing influence of technology on society. As they navigate their respective roles as spiritual leaders, they must confront the question: how can one maintain faith and tradition in a rapidly shifting landscape?

The film also examines the tension between tradition and progress. Pope Benedict, representing the more conservative wing of the Catholic Church, is seen as a symbol of continuity with the past. In contrast, Pope Francis embodies the spirit of reform and renewal, seeking to modernize the Church's teachings and practices. This dichotomy serves as a backdrop for their unlikely friendship, highlighting the complexities of navigating opposing views within an institution.

Furthermore, The Two Popes touches on the theme of identity and self-discovery. Both popes are portrayed as complex individuals with rich inner lives, each struggling to reconcile their own desires and aspirations with their duties as spiritual leaders. As they navigate their relationships with one another, they must confront the masks they wear and the expectations placed upon them.

Ultimately, The Two Popes presents a nuanced exploration of faith, power, and identity, inviting viewers to consider the complexities of leadership, tradition, and personal growth.

overview: Determined to learn about her boyfriend's past relationships, Stacy -- who works for a talk show -- becomes a bona fide snoop. With her colleague, Barb, Stacy gets the names of Derek's ex-lovers and interviews them, supposedly for an upcoming show. But what she learns only adds to her confusion, and her plans begin to unravel when she befriends one of the women.
tagline: Have you ever been tempted to look inside his...
title: Little Black Book
plot:
Little Black Book is a 2004 romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of female friendships and relationships. The movie follows the story of Liz Curran, a young woman who discovers her boyfriend's infidelity on their one-year anniversary.

At its core, Little Black Book delves into the theme of female empowerment and the importance of surrounding oneself with supportive and loving relationships. Through Liz's journey, the film highlights the challenges women face in navigating complex social dynamics, particularly when it comes to friendships and romantic relationships.

The movie also touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery, as Liz grapples with her own sense of self-worth and purpose after being betrayed by those she trusted. The film's portrayal of a group of strong, independent women who come together to support each other serves as a powerful counterpoint to the toxic relationships that often plague women's lives.

Furthermore, Little Black Book explores the theme of forgiveness and healing, as Liz learns to let go of her anger and resentment in order to move forward. The film suggests that true growth and transformation can only occur when we confront our pain and allow ourselves to be vulnerable with others.

Overall, Little Black Book is a nuanced exploration of the complexities of female relationships, identity, and personal growth, offering a powerful message about the importance of nurturing and prioritizing one's own well-being.

overview: History -- make that high school -- may repeat itself when Marni learns that Joanna, the mean girl from her past, is set to be her sister-in-law. Before the wedding bells toll, Marni must show her brother that a tiger doesn't change its stripes. On Marni's side is her mother, while Joanna's backed by her wealthy aunt.
tagline: What doesn't kill you... is going to marry your brother.
title: You Again
plot:
You Again is a 2010 American comedy directed by Andy Fickman and written by Moe Jelline. Kristen Bell stars as a young woman who discovers that her brother is marrying her high school tormentor, with Jamie Lee Curtis, Sigourney Weaver, Odette Yustman, James Wolk, Victor Garber, Kristin Chenoweth and Betty White in supporting roles. It was released by Touchstone Pictures on September 24, 2010.

In 2002, in the fictional town of Ridgefield, California, the awkward teenager Marni Olsen is relentlessly bullied by the popular girl JJ, while her brother Will, the school's basketball star, remains oblivious, even when JJ humiliates Marni during an important game. Eight years later, Marni has become a successful public relations executive in Los Angeles and has just been promoted to her firm's New York office. She returns home for Will's wedding to a woman named Joanna, whom she has never met, and is horrified to discover that Joanna is JJ. Her family adores the bride-to-be, who appears not to remember Marni at all, and Marni sets out to expose what she believes is an act.

The rivalry soon spreads to the older generation. Joanna's aunt Ramona, played by Weaver, wealthy and glamorous, turns out to have been the high school best friend turned nemesis of Marni and Will's mother Gail, played by Curtis. As the wedding approaches, the two mothers revive their decades-old feud, competing for attention with escalating one-upmanship, while Marni's wisecracking grandmother Bunny, played by White, offers commentary from the sidelines. Marni's attempts to reveal Joanna's past lead to a series of disasters and alienate her from her brother. Eventually both pairs of women confront the old wounds behind their rivalries, Joanna faces up to her past behavior, and apologies lead to reconciliation in time for the wedding.

The film was panned by critics, many of whom found its premise thin despite its talented cast, though some enjoyed its slapstick, musical numbers and surprise cameos. It opened at number five and grossed about $32 million worldwide against a $20 million budget. It was Betty White's last live-action feature film role before her death in 2021.

overview: Bolt is the star of the biggest show in Hollywood. The only problem is, he thinks it's real. After he's accidentally shipped to New York City and separated from Penny, his beloved co-star and owner, Bolt must harness all his "super powers" to find a way home.
tagline: Fully Awesome. Ridonculous. Let It Begin.
title: Bolt
plot:
Bolt is a 2008 American animated comedy-adventure film produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie follows the story of Bolt, a white dog who plays a superhero on a popular television show called "It's in Your Paws to Save the World."

The film begins with Bolt (voiced by John Travolta) living a life of luxury and fame as the star of his own TV show. He is convinced that he has superpowers, which allow him to save the world from various threats. However, it is revealed that Bolt's powers are actually just special effects created for the TV show.

One day, Bolt's owner Penny (voiced by Miley Cyrus) leaves him behind in Los Angeles while she travels to New York City. Bolt sets out on a journey to find her, accompanied by his trusty sidekick, Rhino (voiced by Malcolm McDowell). Along the way, they meet Dr. Calico (voiced by Gary Oldman), a sinister villain who is also after Penny.

As Bolt and Rhino navigate through the city, they encounter various obstacles and dangers. They also meet Mittens (voiced by Susie Essman), a stray cat who becomes their ally. Through his adventures, Bolt begins to question his own identity and the nature of his powers.

Meanwhile, Dr. Calico's true intentions are revealed: he plans to use Penny as leverage to get his hands on the secret formula for Bolt's superpowers. As Bolt and Rhino close in on Dr. Calico, they also discover that Penny is not just a damsel in distress but a skilled agent who has been working undercover.

In the climactic final act, Bolt and Rhino face off against Dr. Calico in an epic battle. With the help of Mittens and Penny, Bolt is able to overcome his doubts and harness his true potential. He discovers that his powers are not just special effects but a manifestation of his own heart and spirit.

The movie ends with Bolt returning to New York City, where he is reunited with Penny. However, instead of being hailed as a hero, Bolt realizes that his true purpose is not to save the world but to be loved and accepted for who he is. The film concludes on a heartwarming note, with Bolt finding happiness and fulfillment in his relationship with Penny.

Throughout the movie, the animation is vibrant and colorful, with a mix of live-action and CGI elements. The voice cast delivers memorable performances, bringing depth and humor to their characters. Overall, Bolt is a charming and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, friendship, and the power of believing in oneself.

overview: Bruiser is the story of a man who has always tried to fit in. He keeps his mouth shut, follows the rules, and does what he's supposed to do.
