There they find Anna, who has been having visions connected to it. The Elder reveals that a group of immortals reached the Source in ancient times and that the survivors were cursed, and he warns that the closer the immortals come to it, the weaker they will become, losing their immortality. Guided by Anna's visions, the group sets out on a perilous journey, pursued by the Guardian, toward a destination that will change their lives forever.

The film introduces new mythology about the origins of the immortals and ties it to Duncan's relationship with Anna.

Lionsgate had planned to release the film in 2006, but in North America it was instead broadcast on the Sci Fi Channel on September 15, 2007. Critical reaction was overwhelmingly negative: IGN's Christopher Monfette gave it 1 out of 10, lamenting that the franchise had mutated into an awkward mix of mismatched mythologies.

overview: A full moon rises in Beacon Hills, and with it a terrifying evil has emerged. The wolves are howling once again, calling for the return of Banshees, Werecoyotes, Hellhounds, Kitsunes, and every other shapeshifter in the night. But only a Werewolf like Scott McCall, no longer a teenager yet still an Alpha, can gather both new allies and reunite trusted friends to fight back against what could be the most powerful and deadliest enemy they’ve ever faced.
tagline: The pack is back.
title: Teen Wolf: The Movie
plot:
Teen Wolf: The Movie is a 2023 American supernatural thriller directed by Russell Mulcahy and written by Jeff Davis, a continuation of the MTV television series Teen Wolf. Most of the series' cast returns, including Tyler Posey as Scott McCall, Crystal Reed, Tyler Hoechlin, Holland Roden, Colton Haynes, Shelley Hennig, Dylan Sprayberry, Linden Ashby, Melissa Ponzio and JR Bourne.

Fifteen years after leaving Beacon Hills, Scott runs an animal shelter in Los Angeles. Lydia, now working in San Francisco, has separated from Stiles after recurring visions of his death; Derek has a teenage son, Eli; and Liam, living in Japan, works with the kitsune Hikari guarding the urn that imprisons the Nogitsune, a malevolent fox spirit. A hooded figure attacks and frees it. As fires break out in the Beacon Hills forest, Scott, Lydia and Chris Argent begin experiencing visions of Allison, Scott's first love, who died years earlier. Believing her soul is trapped and needs release, they return home and perform a ritual at the Nemeton, which unexpectedly brings Allison back to life.

The resurrected Allison has lost most of her memory, recalling only fragments of her family's old feud with werewolves. The pack learns that the Nogitsune has been possessing Chris and engineered the visions to trick them into reviving her. Taking physical form and summoning Oni, it turns Allison against Scott, but he slowly reawakens her memories and they form an uneasy truce. The Nogitsune then traps many of Scott's friends and family in an illusory realm, while Lydia and Jackson discover that the fires were set by Adrian Harris, a former teacher seeking revenge on the pack.

Lydia's banshee scream fully restores Allison's memories. When the Nogitsune demands that Allison kill Scott, Hikari's spirit shields him, and the reunited pack battles the Oni. Derek sacrifices himself to restrain the Nogitsune so that Deputy Parrish can destroy it, becoming a true Alpha in his final moments. After Derek's funeral, Scott resumes his relationship with Allison and plans to look after Eli.

The film premiered on Paramount+ on January 26, 2023, and set a record for the most-watched original film on the service on its debut day. Critical reception was mixed to negative; Rotten Tomatoes reported 32% approval, its consensus judging that nostalgia could not save the lackluster revival, and Metacritic gave it 51 out of 100.

overview: In a last-ditch effort to save his career, sports agent JB Bernstein dreams up a wild game plan to find Major League Baseball’s next great pitcher from a pool of cricket players in India. He soon discovers two young men who can throw a fastball but know nothing about the game of baseball. Or America. It’s an incredible and touching journey that will change them all — especially JB, who learns valuable lessons about teamwork, commitment and family.
tagline: Sometimes to win, sometimes you have to change the game
title: Million Dollar Arm
plot:
Million Dollar Arm is a heartwarming sports drama that delves into the world of cricket and the transformative power of friendship and perseverance. The film tells the story of J.B. Bernstein, a sports agent who travels to India in search of talented young cricketers to train for Major League Baseball.

At its core, Million Dollar Arm explores the theme of cultural exchange and understanding. Bernstein's journey is not just about finding the next big baseball star, but also about bridging the gap between two vastly different cultures. The film showcases the beauty of Indian cricket and the passion of its fans, while also highlighting the challenges faced by Indian players in adapting to American sports.

The movie also delves into the theme of friendship and mentorship, as Bernstein forms a bond with two young Indian cricketers, Dinesh and Ambir. Their journey from humble beginnings to stardom is inspiring, and their relationship serves as a testament to the power of human connection.

Furthermore, Million Dollar Arm touches on the theme of identity and self-discovery. As the characters navigate their new surroundings and confront their own limitations, they must also come to terms with who they are and where they belong. The film's portrayal of Indian culture and cricket is authentic and nuanced, adding depth to the narrative.

Ultimately, Million Dollar Arm is a story about chasing your dreams and believing in yourself, even when the odds seem insurmountable. With its uplifting message and engaging storyline, the film is a must-watch for sports fans and anyone looking for an inspiring underdog tale.

original_title: 劇場版　美少女戦士セーラームーンSuperS　セーラー9戦士集結！ブラック・ドリーム・ホールの奇跡
overview: The wicked Badiyanu has come to capture all Earth's children to gain enough power to absorb the planet in her Black Dream Hole. The Black Dream Hole is in Badiyanu's castle and absorbs the dream energy from children. The more children Badiyanu kidnaps, the larger the dream hole gets. The Sailor Team must save Earth's children and prevent the Black Dream Hole from enveloping the entire planet!
tagline: The Magical Dream Vortex! Sailor Soldiers please save the children's dreams!
title: Sailor Moon SuperS: The Movie: Black Dream Hole
plot:
Sailor Moon SuperS: The Movie - Black Dream Hole is a 1995 Japanese animated science fiction film based on the Sailor Moon manga series. 

The movie revolves around the plot where Queen Beryl, who was thought to be defeated, returns with an army of monsters from outer space known as the "Black Dream Hole". These creatures are drawn into Earth's dreams and wreak havoc on the city.

As the story unfolds, Usagi (Sailor Moon) and her friends must find a way to stop Queen Beryl and her minions. Along the way, they learn about the power of friendship, teamwork, and believing in oneself.

The main themes of Sailor Moon SuperS: The Movie - Black Dream Hole include:

1. Friendship and unity: The movie highlights the importance of working together as a team to overcome challenges.
2. Self-discovery and empowerment: Usagi and her friends learn to tap into their inner strength and believe in themselves, which helps them save the day.
3. Good vs. evil: The film features a clear distinction between good and evil, with Queen Beryl's army representing darkness and chaos, while Sailor Moon and her friends embody light and hope.

Overall, Sailor Moon SuperS: The Movie - Black Dream Hole is an action-packed adventure that explores themes of friendship, self-discovery, and the power of believing in oneself.

overview: Remy, a resident of Paris, appreciates good food and has quite a sophisticated palate. He would love to become a chef so he can create and enjoy culinary masterpieces to his heart's delight. The only problem is, Remy is a rat. When he winds up in the sewer beneath one of Paris' finest restaurants, the rodent gourmet finds himself ideally placed to realize his dream.
tagline: He's dying to become a chef.
title: Ratatouille
plot:
Ratatouille is a 2007 animated comedy-drama film produced by Pixar Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures.

The story follows Remy, a highly intelligent and ambitious rat who lives in the sewers of Paris. Remy has a passion for cooking and dreams of becoming a chef in one of the city's top restaurants. However, his species is not welcome in the culinary world, and he faces numerous obstacles in pursuing his dream.

One day, Remy meets Linguini, a klutzy but lovable human who works as a dishwasher at Gusteau's, a famous Parisian restaurant founded by the late Auguste Gusteau. Remy befriends Linguini and discovers that the restaurant is struggling to find its new chef after Gusteau's death.

Remy and Linguini form an unlikely partnership, with Remy using his culinary skills to create exquisite dishes while Linguini serves as the frontman for their collaboration. As they work together, they must keep their secret hidden from the restaurant's owner, Skinner, who is determined to find a new chef to replace Gusteau.

Throughout the film, Remy and Linguini face various challenges, including a health inspector who threatens to shut down the restaurant and a rival chef who seeks to sabotage their success. Along the way, they learn valuable lessons about teamwork, perseverance, and believing in oneself.

The film features stunning animation, witty dialogue, and memorable characters, making it a delightful and entertaining experience for audiences of all ages. The voice cast, including Patton Oswalt as Remy and Lou Romano as Linguini, delivers outstanding performances that bring the characters to life.

Overall, Ratatouille is a heartwarming and visually stunning film that celebrates the power of creativity, friendship, and following one's dreams.

overview: A westerner named Casey, studying Ninjutsu in Japan, is asked by the Sensei to return to New York to protect the legendary Yoroi Bitsu, an armored chest that contains the weapons of the last Koga Ninja.
tagline: A Silent Warrior. A Lethal Mission.
title: Ninja
plot:
Ninja is a 2009 martial arts film directed by Isaac Florentino and produced by Nu Image. 

The movie follows the story of Reiko (played by Michelle Yeoh), a Japanese assassin who is sent to Japan to kill her sister's husband, Takeshi (played by Scott Adkins). However, upon arrival, she discovers that he is innocent and has been framed for murder.

As Reiko delves deeper into the mystery, she must confront her own troubled past and the reasons behind her sister's vendetta against Takeshi. Along the way, she teams up with Takeshi to take down the real culprits and clear his name.

The main themes of Ninja include:

1. Redemption: Reiko's journey is one of redemption as she seeks to make amends for past mistakes and find a new purpose in life.
2. Family and loyalty: The film explores the complexities of family relationships and the power of loyalty, as Reiko struggles with her own feelings towards her sister and Takeshi.
3. Betrayal and deception: The movie is full of twists and turns, highlighting the dangers of betrayal and deception, particularly in the context of espionage and assassination.
4. Self-discovery: As Reiko navigates the complex web of intrigue, she must also confront her own identity and the reasons behind her sister's actions.

Overall, Ninja is a gripping action-thriller that explores themes of redemption, family, loyalty, betrayal, and self-discovery in a complex and suspenseful narrative.

original_title: Mac & Devin Go to High School
overview: A comedy that follows two high school students -- one overachiever struggling to write his valedictorian speech, the other a senior now going on his 15th year of school.
title: Mac & Devin Go to High School
plot:
Mac & Devin Go to High School is a 2012 American stoner comedy film directed by Charles Stone III and written by John Whitesell. The movie stars Snoop Dogg and Wiz Khalifa as the titular characters, Mac Davis and Devin Williams.

The plot follows two high school friends, Mac (Snoop Dogg) and Devin (Wiz Khalifa), who are struggling to find their place in the world after graduation. Mac is a laid-back, smooth-talking rapper from Los Angeles, while Devin is a more aggressive and competitive rapper from Philadelphia. Despite their differences, they remain close friends.

The movie begins with Mac and Devin returning to their high school alma mater for a homecoming game. However, things take a turn when they discover that the school's principal has been replaced by a new, strict administrator who is determined to rid the school of its "bad influence." The two friends decide to take matters into their own hands and concoct a plan to expose the new principal's true intentions.

As Mac and Devin navigate the complexities of high school life once again, they must also contend with their own personal demons. Mac is struggling to find his place in the music industry, while Devin is trying to balance his rap career with his desire to attend college.

Throughout the movie, Mac and Devin's antics cause chaos and hilarity throughout the school, as they engage in pranks, parties, and other misadventures. Along the way, they also encounter a range of colorful characters, including a seductive cheerleader (Ashley Benson) and a group of eccentric teachers.

As the story unfolds, Mac and Devin's plan to expose the new principal comes to fruition, but not without some unexpected twists and turns. In the end, the two friends successfully defeat the villainous principal and restore order to their alma mater.

One of the standout aspects of Mac & Devin Go to High School is its lighthearted, comedic tone. The movie is full of humorous moments, from Snoop Dogg's signature smooth-talking style to Wiz Khalifa's goofy antics. The chemistry between the two leads is undeniable, and their banter provides much of the movie's humor.

Overall, Mac & Devin Go to High School is a fun, entertaining film that is sure to appeal to fans of stoner comedies and hip-hop culture. While it may not be a particularly original or groundbreaking movie, its lighthearted tone and comedic performances make it a worthwhile watch.

overview: Mystery Inc. is summoned to investigate occurrences in a haunted villa, where a black knight terrorizes anybody who tries to get close to treasure hidden by the former owner of the building.
title: LEGO Scooby-Doo! Knight Time Terror
plot:
LEGO Scooby-Doo! Knight Time Terror is an animated mystery-comedy film that revolves around the iconic characters from the classic series, but with a unique twist. The movie's narrative delves into the concept of time travel and the consequences of altering historical events.

At its core, the film explores the theme of friendship and teamwork as the Mystery Inc. gang navigates through different eras, solving mysteries and facing challenges along the way. However, their actions inadvertently disrupt the timeline, leading to a series of catastrophic events that threaten the fabric of history.

As the story unfolds, the characters are forced to confront the consequences of their own meddling with time, highlighting the importance of responsible decision-making and considering the potential repercussions of one's actions. The film also touches on the idea of legacy and how the actions of past generations can impact the present and future.

Throughout the movie, the characters' relationships and banter remain a central focus, adding to the lighthearted and humorous tone that is characteristic of the LEGO Scooby-Doo franchise. Ultimately, the film's themes revolve around the power of friendship, teamwork, and responsible decision-making in the face of uncertainty and adversity.

overview: A modern tale of a teenager’s coming-of-age journey loosely inspired by the classic novel “The Wonderful Wizard of Oz.”
title: Rainbow
plot:
Rainbow is a 2022 Spanish fantasy drama directed by Paco León and loosely based on L. Frank Baum's 1900 novel The Wonderful Wizard of Oz. The singer Dora Postigo stars as Dora, a teenager with an extraordinary musical gift, with Áyax Pedrosa, Wekaforé Jibril, Carmen Maura, Carmen Machi and Luis Bermejo. León described it as not a musical but a film with a great deal of music. It premiered at the 70th San Sebastián International Film Festival on 18 September 2022, was released in selected Spanish cinemas on 23 September and arrived on Netflix on 30 September.

The film reimagines Baum's story as a contemporary coming-of-age road movie set in Spain. Dora is a gifted young singer living with her father, Diego. After a bitter argument with her father, she decides to leave home, taking her dog Toto with her, and sets out on a journey toward the faraway "Ciudad Capital," hoping that there she will find what she is looking for.

Along the way, Dora meets a series of characters who mirror the companions of Baum's Dorothy, outsiders who are each looking for something they believe they lack and who join her on the road. The journey through a stylized, colorful landscape of highways, villages and strange encounters becomes a search for identity and belonging, as the travelers confront their insecurities, and Dora's music and the people she meets help her understand her past and decide who she wants to be. Rather than retelling the novel faithfully, León uses its familiar structure as a framework for a story about youth, family, diversity and self-acceptance, in which music plays a central role.

Critical reception in Spain was largely negative. Fernando Bernal of Cinemanía gave it one star out of five, writing that the road movie never manages to pick up speed and that its sequences falter in their own rhythm. Elsa Fernández-Santos of El País described a film capable of both the best and the worst, uneven and largely botched, though she acknowledged a beautiful epilogue and the courage to look to the future.

overview: Two air force pilots prevent a terrorist attack on the Bastille Day celebrations in Paris.
production_companies: MEDIA Programme of the European Union
title: Sky Fighters
plot:
Sky Fighters (French: Les Chevaliers du ciel) is a 2005 French action film directed by Gérard Pirès about two air force pilots who try to prevent a terrorist attack during the Bastille Day celebrations in Paris. Benoît Magimel and Clovis Cornillac star as the pilots, with Géraldine Pailhas, Alice Taglioni and Jean-Baptiste Puech in supporting roles. The film is based on Tanguy et Laverdure, a comic series by Jean-Michel Charlier and Albert Uderzo, which was also adapted into a hugely popular television series from 1967 to 1969. It was marketed with the slogan "Top Gun, new generation."

At the Farnborough Airshow in England, a rogue group hijacks a Mirage 2000 fighter after killing its pilot. French Air Force captains Antoine "Walk'n" Marchelli and Sébastien "Fahrenheit" Vallois are ordered to intercept the stolen jet and escort it back. The rogue pilot evades them by hiding beneath an airliner and then appears to target Vallois with a missile, forcing Marchelli to shoot the Mirage down. A secretive government department known as Special Missions, hoping to pressure Marchelli into working for it, tampers with the footage from his gun camera.

At the subsequent court-martial, Marchelli is found guilty of destroying the aircraft without justification and discharged from the air force, and Vallois resigns in solidarity. Special Missions then offers to reinstate both pilots if they fly a long-distance mission across hostile territory to the Horn of Africa to help promote the Mirage to a foreign buyer. During the flight they are forced to land in dangerous territory and are captured by terrorists trying to steal their aircraft. After escaping, the two pilots discover that the hijacking and their ordeal are part of a larger conspiracy, culminating in a plot to strike Paris during the Bastille Day military parade, and they must take to the air again with the help of their colleagues, including fellow pilot Maelle and base officer Estelle.

Sky Fighters was praised above all for its aerial photography, which was filmed with real Mirage 2000 jets with the cooperation of the French Air Force and largely without computer-generated imagery. Critics were less impressed by its plot and characters, but the flying sequences made it a favorite among aviation enthusiasts.

original_title: Futurama: Into the Wild Green Yonder
overview: Leela becomes an outlaw when she and a group of ecologically-minded feminists attempt to save an asteroid of primitive life forms and the Violet Dwarf star from being destroyed, while Fry joins a secret society and attempts to stop a mysterious species known as the "Dark Ones" from destroying all life in the universe.
tagline: All the other galaxies will be green with envy!
title: Futurama: Into the Wild Green Yonder
plot:
Futurama: Into the Wild Green Yonder is an animated science fiction film that explores various themes, primarily focusing on environmentalism and the consequences of humanity's actions. The movie delves into a world where Earth has been ravaged by pollution and destruction, leading to a catastrophic collapse of ecosystems.

The story follows Bender, Fry, Leela, Professor Farnsworth, and Hermes as they embark on a journey through a post-apocalyptic wasteland in search of a mythical "Green Planet." Along the way, they encounter various characters who embody different aspects of human nature, from the selfish and destructive to the selfless and redemptive.

Throughout their adventure, the characters grapple with existential questions about the meaning of life, the importance of preserving the natural world, and the consequences of unchecked technological advancement. The film critiques modern society's relationship with technology, consumerism, and environmental degradation, often using satire and humor to make pointed commentary on these issues.

Ultimately, Futurama: Into the Wild Green Yonder presents a cautionary tale about the dangers of neglecting our planet's well-being and the importance of taking responsibility for our actions. The movie encourages viewers to reflect on their own relationship with the environment and consider the long-term consequences of their choices.

overview: Lyla and Louis, a singer and a musician, fall in love, but are soon compelled to separate. Lyla is forced to give up her newborn but unknown to her, he grows up to become a musical genius.
production_companies: CJ E&M Film Financing & Investment Entertainment & Comics
tagline: An incredible journey moving at the speed of sound.
title: August Rush
plot:
August Rush is a musical drama film released in 2007 by Warner Bros. Pictures. The movie tells the story of an adopted boy named Evan Taylor, who discovers his birth parents and embarks on a journey to find his roots.

The film begins with Evan (played by Freddie Highmore), a talented young musician who lives with his foster parents, Robert and Lily Taylor (played by Jonathan Rhys Meyers and Keri Russell). Despite their love for him, Evan feels like an outsider in his family. He is haunted by strange memories of music and a sense of belonging he can't explain.

As Evan grows older, he begins to experience vivid dreams and visions that seem to be connected to the music he hears. He becomes obsessed with finding the source of these sounds, which lead him on a journey to New York City. There, he meets a street musician named Gus (played by Jason Schwartzman), who claims to have known Evan's biological father.

Evan soon discovers that his birth parents were both musicians who were part of a famous jazz band in the 1950s. He learns that his mother, Lyla (played by Marcia Gay Harden), was a singer and songwriter, while his father, Robert Lewis (played by Terence Stamp), was a pianist and composer.

As Evan delves deeper into his family's past, he meets his biological siblings, Charlie (played by James Carnes) and Isabel (played by Fiona Shaw). Together, they form a band and begin to perform music that is a fusion of their different styles. Through this process, Evan comes to terms with his identity and finds a sense of belonging.

However, the journey is not without its challenges. Evan's biological father, Robert Lewis, had abandoned his family years ago, leaving behind a legacy of unfinished business. As Evan gets to know him, he learns about the sacrifices his father made for his music and the pain he caused by leaving his family.

The film builds towards a emotional climax as Evan confronts his past and makes amends with his father. In the end, Evan finds a sense of peace and belonging, not just through his music but also through his connection to his biological family.

Overall, August Rush is a heartwarming story about identity, family, and the power of music to bring people together. The film features a talented cast, beautiful music, and a poignant storyline that will leave audiences feeling uplifted and inspired.

overview: In the wilderness of British Columbia, two hunters are tracked and viciously murdered by Aaron Hallum. A former Special Operations instructor is approached and asked to apprehend Hallum—his former student—who has 'gone rogue' after suffering severe battle stress from his time in Kosovo.
tagline: Some men should not be found.
title: The Hunted
plot:
The Hunted is a 2003 American action thriller directed by William Friedkin. It stars Tommy Lee Jones as L. T. Bonham, a retired civilian instructor who trained special forces soldiers in survival and combat skills, and Benicio del Toro as Aaron Hallam, a former student who has become a killer, with Connie Nielsen as FBI agent Abby Durrell. The film is a manhunt story set largely in the forests of the Pacific Northwest.

During the war in Kosovo, special forces operator Aaron Hallam carries out the assassination of a Serbian military leader and is awarded the Silver Star, but he is deeply traumatized by the atrocities he has witnessed. Years later, in a forest park in Oregon, he confronts two deer hunters with sniper rifles whom he suspects of being something else, and kills them both with a knife. Meanwhile, L. T. Bonham, the expert tracker who taught Hallam how to survive and kill, lives in seclusion in British Columbia, where he frees wildlife from traps.

The FBI enlists Bonham to help find the killer. He quickly determines that a single man, not a group, was responsible, and recognizes the work of his former pupil. Bonham tracks Hallam alone through the woods and the two men fight before Hallam is captured. Hallam claims that the hunters were government agents sent to kill him. When he is handed over to members of his former unit, he realizes that they intend to silence him permanently and escapes, killing his escort. The pursuit moves from the wilderness into the city of Portland, as Bonham, the FBI and military operatives chase Hallam across the urban landscape, culminating in a brutal hand-to-hand confrontation between teacher and student armed with knives they have made themselves.

Friedkin emphasizes realistic, close-quarters knife fighting and wilderness tracking, drawing on the outdoorsman Tom Brown Jr., who served as technical advisor, and explores the psychological cost of training men to kill.

The Hunted opened on March 14, 2003, at number three at the North American box office, but grossed only about 45.5 million dollars worldwide against a 55 million dollar budget. Reviews were largely negative, with 30 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 40.

overview: A spacecraft traveling to a distant colony planet and transporting thousands of people has a malfunction in its sleep chambers. As a result, two passengers are awakened 90 years early.
tagline: There is a reason they woke up.
title: Passengers
plot:
Passengers is a 2016 American science fiction romantic drama film directed by Morten Tyldum and written by Jon Spaihts, Michael Sarnoski, and Alec Gillis. The movie stars Chris Pratt and Jennifer Lawrence.

The story takes place on the spaceship Avalon, which is traveling to a distant planet called Homestead II in search of a new home for humanity. The ship's crew consists of 5,000 passengers who are in stasis, awaiting their arrival at their new destination. However, something goes wrong during the journey, and the ship is forced to make an emergency landing on a nearby planet.

The movie begins with Jim Preston (Chris Pratt), an engineer who wakes up from stasis six months early due to a malfunction in his cryogenic chamber. He finds that he is the only passenger awake, and the rest of the crew has died or gone mad. Panicked and alone, Jim tries to find a way to fix the ship's systems and send out a distress signal.

Meanwhile, Aurora Lane (Jennifer Lawrence), a young engineer, also wakes up from stasis six months early due to a similar malfunction in her cryogenic chamber. She is initially confused and disoriented but soon realizes that she is alone on the ship. As Jim tries to fix the ship's systems, he discovers that he has 7 years of wake time left before the ship reaches its destination.

As the days pass, Jim becomes increasingly lonely and isolated, struggling to cope with his situation. He starts to experience hallucinations and begins to question his own sanity. On the other hand, Aurora is more determined to fix the ship's systems and send out a distress signal. She also starts to explore the ship and discovers that it has been damaged in an accident.

As Jim and Aurora work together to repair the ship, they start to form a connection with each other. They share their stories, hopes, and fears, and begin to develop feelings for each other. However, their relationship is complicated by the fact that they are both aware of the 7-year difference between them and the fact that Jim has been awake for six months.

As the days turn into weeks, Jim's hallucinations become more intense, and he starts to experience a mental breakdown. He becomes convinced that Aurora is in danger and tries to protect her from an unknown threat. Meanwhile, Aurora discovers that she has a rare genetic disorder that makes her immune to the effects of aging.

In the end, Jim realizes that he cannot stay awake forever and decides to sacrifice himself to save Aurora. He uses his knowledge of the ship's systems to create a device that will kill him, but also allow Aurora to wake up from stasis safely. The movie ends with Aurora waking up from stasis, unaware of what happened to Jim.

The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience wondering whether Jim sacrificed himself for love or if he was driven by his own madness. Despite its flaws, Passengers received mixed reviews from critics but has developed a cult following over the years. The movie's themes of loneliness, isolation, and the human condition are thought-provoking and relatable, making it a memorable sci-fi romance.

overview: In 1950, amidst the ravages of the Korean War, Sergeant Süleyman stumbles upon a a half-frozen little girl, with no parents and no help in sight. Frantic, scared and on the verge of death, this little girl captures the heart of Süleyman, who risks his own life to save her, smuggling her into his Army base and out of harms way. Not knowing her name and unable to communicate with her, Süleyman names her Ayla, in reminiscence of the moon on the fateful night during which they met. The two form an instantaneous and inseparable bond, and Ayla, almost effortlessly, brings an uncanny joy to the Turkish brigade in the grip of war. As the war comes to a close however, Süleyman's brigade is told that they will be returning home. Süleyman cannot bear abandoning Ayla, and does everything within his power to take her with him. After repeated failure, he is forced to give Ayla to an orphanage, but doesn't give up on the hope of one day reuniting with her. Will the two ever get back together?
title: Ayla: The Daughter of War
plot:
Ayla: The Daughter of War is a 2017 Turkish historical drama film directed by Mehmet Ergen. The movie tells the story of Ayla, a young girl who is kidnapped from her tribe and taken to the Ottoman Empire as a slave. As she navigates this new world, she faces numerous challenges and struggles to maintain her identity.

The main theme of Ayla: The Daughter of War revolves around the struggle for self-discovery and cultural preservation in the face of oppression and assimilation. Ayla's journey is a powerful metaphor for the resilience of indigenous cultures and the importance of preserving traditional ways of life in the face of colonialism and imperialism.

Throughout the film, Ayla grapples with her own identity, caught between her nomadic heritage and her new surroundings in the Ottoman Empire. She must confront the harsh realities of slavery, cultural erasure, and the loss of her family and community. Despite these challenges, Ayla remains determined to hold on to her roots and traditions, even as she is forced to adapt to a new and unfamiliar world.

The film also explores themes of love, sacrifice, and redemption, as Ayla forms connections with those around her and finds ways to cope with the trauma she has experienced. Ultimately, Ayla's story is one of hope and resilience, a testament to the human spirit's ability to persevere in the face of adversity.

Overall, Ayla: The Daughter of War is a powerful and moving film that sheds light on the experiences of indigenous people and the importance of preserving cultural heritage.

overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.
tagline: Welcome to a world without rules.
title: The Dark Knight
plot:
The Dark Knight is a 2008 superhero thriller film directed by Christopher Nolan, starring Christian Bale as Bruce Wayne/Batman, Heath Ledger as the Joker, and Aaron Eckhart as Harvey Dent/Two-Face.

**Beginning:**
The movie begins with the Joker (Heath Ledger) escaping from Arkham Asylum, where he was being held for his previous crimes. The Joker is a chaotic force of nature who seeks to prove that anyone can become as crazy and evil as he is, given the right circumstances. He sets out to destroy Gotham City, which he believes is corrupt and rotten to its core.

Meanwhile, Bruce Wayne (Christian Bale) is struggling with the weight of his responsibilities as Batman. He is haunted by the memory of Rachel Dawes, a woman he loved but lost in a tragic accident. Bruce's alter ego, Batman, is also facing a new threat in the form of the Joker, who is determined to push him to his limits.

**Plot Development:**
As the Joker wreaks havoc on Gotham City, Batman must use all his skills and resources to stop him. The Joker's actions become increasingly violent and unpredictable, causing chaos and destruction throughout the city. He targets the wealthy elite, including Bruce Wayne, in an attempt to expose their hypocrisy and corruption.

Harvey Dent (Aaron Eckhart), a young district attorney who is also Bruce's love interest, becomes increasingly obsessed with justice and begins to see the world in black and white terms. As he delves deeper into his work, he becomes more and more consumed by his own darkness, eventually descending into madness and becoming the villainous Two-Face.

**Climax:**
As the Joker's actions become more and more extreme, Batman is forced to confront him in a final showdown. The two engage in a fierce battle, with the Joker using every trick in the book to try and outsmart Batman. Meanwhile, Harvey Dent's transformation into Two-Face accelerates, causing chaos and destruction throughout Gotham City.

**Ending:**
In the end, Batman emerges victorious over the Joker, but not without scars. The Joker is killed by his own explosive device, which he had rigged to detonate in a crowded theater. However, as the Joker lies dying, he utters the famous line "Why so serious?" - a phrase that has become synonymous with his chaotic and unpredictable nature.

The movie ends with Bruce Wayne mourning the loss of Harvey Dent, who had sacrificed himself to save the city from the Joker's evil plans. The film also sets the stage for the next installment in the Batman series, as Bruce Wayne begins to question whether he can truly make a difference in Gotham City.

Overall, The Dark Knight is a gripping and thought-provoking thriller that explores the complexities of heroism and the nature of evil. Heath Ledger's iconic performance as the Joker is widely regarded as one of the greatest villainous roles in cinematic history.

overview: Every year in the ruins of what was once North America, the nation of Panem forces each of its twelve districts to send a teenage boy and girl to compete in the Hunger Games.  Part twisted entertainment, part government intimidation tactic, the Hunger Games are a nationally televised event in which “Tributes” must fight with one another until one survivor remains.  Pitted against highly-trained Tributes who have prepared for these Games their entire lives, Katniss is forced to rely upon her sharp instincts as well as the mentorship of drunken former victor Haymitch Abernathy.  If she’s ever to return home to District 12, Katniss must make impossible choices in the arena that weigh survival against humanity and life against love. The world will be watching.
tagline: May The Odds Be Ever In Your Favor.
title: The Hunger Games
plot:
The Hunger Games is a dystopian science fiction film directed by Gary Ross, based on the novel of the same name by Suzanne Collins. The movie was released in 2012 and produced by Lionsgate.

In a post-apocalyptic future, the country of Panem is ruled by the tyrannical Capitol. As punishment for a past rebellion, the Capitol forces each of the 12 districts to participate in the Hunger Games, a brutal annual event where 24 tributes, 12 boys and 12 girls, are chosen to fight to the death in a televised event.

The story follows Katniss Everdeen (played by Jennifer Lawrence), a 16-year-old girl from District 12 who volunteers to participate in the Games in place of her younger sister Prim. Katniss is skilled with a bow and arrow and has experience hunting to feed her family after their father's death.

Katniss, along with fellow tribute Peeta Mellark (played by Josh Hutcherson), is transported to the Capitol to prepare for the Games. They are trained, interviewed, and paraded in front of the cameras to gain sympathy and sponsorships from the audience.

Once the Games begin, Katniss and Peeta must use their wits, skills, and alliances to survive against the other tributes. The Gamemakers, who control the arena, introduce various challenges and obstacles to make the game more exciting for the audience.

As the Games progress, Katniss forms alliances with Rue (played by Amandla Stenberg) from District 11 and Thresh (played by Dayo Okeniyi), a strong and skilled tribute from District 11. However, when Rue is killed by Career Tributes, Katniss becomes more determined to survive.

Meanwhile, Peeta's actions in the arena are carefully scripted to gain sympathy from the audience, making it difficult for Katniss to determine his true intentions. As the Games near their end, Katniss and Peeta are the last two survivors, and they threaten to eat poisonous berries rather than kill each other.

In a surprising twist, President Snow (played by Donald Sutherland) intervenes, and Katniss and Peeta declare their love for each other, forcing them to be declared co-winners of the Games. However, this act of defiance against the Capitol is seen as a threat, and Katniss becomes the face of the growing rebellion in District 12.

The movie ends with Katniss and Peeta's victory, but also sets the stage for the rest of the series, as Katniss becomes the Mockingjay, the symbol of the rebellion against the Capitol.

overview: In 9th century China, a corrupt government wages war against a rebel army called the Flying Daggers. A romantic warrior breaks a beautiful rebel out of prison to help her rejoin her fellows, but things are not what they seem.
production_companies: Beijing New Picture Film Co. Ltd.
title: House of Flying Daggers
plot:
House of Flying Daggers is a 2004 Chinese epic historical romance film directed by Zhang Yimou. The movie is set during the late Tang Dynasty and tells the story of two young warriors, Ba Ba (Takeshi Kaneshiro) and Lian (Zhang Ziyi), who are from different worlds but find themselves entangled in a web of love, loyalty, and betrayal.

The main themes of House of Flying Daggers include:

1. **Love vs. Loyalty**: The film explores the conflict between personal feelings and duty to one's country, family, or group. Ba Ba and Lian's relationship is forbidden, as they belong to rival factions, but they cannot resist their love for each other.
2. **Social Hierarchy**: The movie critiques the social stratification of ancient China, highlighting the rigid class system and the limited opportunities available to those from lower backgrounds. Ba Ba, a member of the peasant class, falls in love with Lian, a noblewoman, which is seen as an impossible union.
3. **War and Violence**: The film depicts the brutal realities of war and its impact on individuals and society. The Tang Dynasty was marked by internal conflicts, power struggles, and external invasions, all of which are reflected in the movie's action-packed sequences.
4. **Identity and Belonging**: Ba Ba and Lian struggle to find their place in a world that seems determined to define them by their social status or family ties. They must navigate their own identities and loyalties in order to forge their own paths.
5. **Mortality and Impermanence**: The movie touches on the theme of mortality, as characters confront the fragility of life and the inevitability of death. This is particularly evident in the film's iconic final scene.

Overall, House of Flying Daggers is a visually stunning and emotionally charged film that explores complex themes and relationships set against the backdrop of ancient China's tumultuous history.

original_title: Happier Than Ever: A Love Letter to Los Angeles
overview: Fresh off the heels of her brand-new album, "Happier Than Ever," this cinematic concert experience features an intimate performance of every song in the album's sequential order – for the first and only time – from the stage of the legendary Hollywood Bowl.
tagline: A Billie Eilish Concert Experience.
title: Happier Than Ever: A Love Letter to Los Angeles
plot:
Happier Than Ever: A Love Letter to Los Angeles is a documentary film that explores the complexities and contradictions of Los Angeles, a city often associated with the American Dream. The movie delves into the lives of several characters, including musicians, artists, and writers, who are struggling to find their place in this iconic city.

At its core, Happier Than Ever is a poignant exploration of the human condition, tackling themes of disillusionment, disconnection, and the search for meaning in a society that often prioritizes material success over personal fulfillment. The film reveals the darker side of Los Angeles, where the pursuit of happiness can lead to feelings of emptiness, isolation, and disorientation.

Through its characters' stories, the movie sheds light on the tensions between creativity and commercialism, authenticity and superficiality, and individuality and conformity. It also touches on issues of mental health, relationships, and the fragility of human connection in a world that often values productivity over vulnerability.

Ultimately, Happier Than Ever is a nuanced and empathetic portrayal of Los Angeles as a city of contradictions, where the pursuit of happiness can be both alluring and elusive. The film invites viewers to reflect on their own relationship with this iconic city and the complexities of the human experience.

overview: The story of a young man who arrives in Hollywood during the 1930s hoping to work in the film industry, falls in love, and finds himself swept up in the vibrant café society that defined the spirit of the age.
tagline: Anyone who is anyone will be seen at Café Society.
title: Café Society
plot:
Café Society is a 2016 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Wes Anderson. The movie follows the story of Bobby Walker, a young man from Los Angeles who travels to New York City with his brother Phil to work in the family's real estate business.

The main theme of Café Society revolves around the idea of identity and belonging. Bobby struggles to find his place in the world, torn between his loyalty to his family and his desire for independence and self-discovery. As he navigates the complexities of adulthood, he must confront his own sense of purpose and decide where he truly belongs.

The film also explores the theme of nostalgia and the passing of time. The story is set against the backdrop of the 1930s, a era that is both romanticized and melancholic in the movie. The characters' experiences are marked by a sense of longing for a lost era, as they grapple with the changing world around them.

Furthermore, Café Society touches on the theme of class and social status. The Walker family's rise to wealth and influence serves as a commentary on the American Dream and the corrupting influence of power. The film also critiques the superficiality of high society, highlighting the emptiness and disillusionment that can result from living in a world where appearances often mask deeper insecurities.

Ultimately, Café Society is a poignant exploration of the human search for meaning and connection in a rapidly changing world. Through its witty dialogue, vibrant visuals, and memorable characters, the film offers a nuanced and humorous portrayal of one man's journey to find his place in the world.

overview: A Catholic school newcomer falls in with a clique of teen witches who wield their powers against all who dare to cross them -- be they teachers, rivals or meddlesome parents.
tagline: Welcome to the witching hour.
title: The Craft
plot:
The Craft is a supernatural teen thriller film released in 1996, directed by Andrew Fleming and produced by Columbia Pictures.

The story revolves around four high school outcasts: Sarah Bailey (Robin Tunney), Bonnie Bennett (Neve Campbell), Rochelle Zimmerman (Rachel True), and Nancy Downs (Fairuza Balk). The movie begins with the introduction of these four girls, who are all struggling to find their place in their respective lives. Sarah is a new student at the school, having moved from California to Massachusetts after her mother's death. Bonnie is a popular cheerleader who appears to have it all together but is secretly unhappy and unfulfilled. Rochelle is an African American girl who is ostracized by her peers due to her dark skin and cultural differences. Nancy is a rebellious and eccentric outcast who has a fascination with the occult.

The four girls meet at a local occult shop, where they discover a book of spells written in blood. Intrigued, they decide to experiment with magic together, using the book as their guide. As they delve deeper into the world of witchcraft, they begin to experience strange and unexplained occurrences that seem to be connected to their newfound powers.

As the girls' magical abilities grow stronger, so does their bond and sense of empowerment. They start to use their powers to manipulate those around them, including Bonnie's boyfriend, who becomes increasingly possessive and controlling. However, Nancy's obsession with magic begins to take a darker turn, and she starts to use her powers for personal gain.

The plot takes a dramatic turn when Nancy's behavior becomes more erratic and sinister. She begins to use her powers to manipulate and control the other girls, including Sarah, who is increasingly drawn into Nancy's world of darkness. As tensions rise, the girls' relationships with each other begin to fray, and they start to realize that their newfound powers come with a terrible cost.

In the climactic final act, the girls must confront the consequences of their actions and work together to break free from Nancy's control. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Nancy has been using her powers to manipulate Sarah, who had unknowingly become possessed by an evil entity. The girls are able to perform a ritual to banish the entity and restore balance to their lives.

The Craft explores themes of female empowerment, friendship, and the dangers of playing with forces beyond one's control. The movie features a strong ensemble cast, with standout performances from Robin Tunney and Fairuza Balk. While some critics have accused the film of perpetuating negative stereotypes about witches and feminism, others have praised its portrayal of complex and multidimensional female characters.

Overall, The Craft is a cult classic that has become synonymous with '90s teen cinema. Its blend of supernatural thrills, coming-of-age drama, and feminist themes continues to captivate audiences to this day.

overview: James Bowen, a homeless busker and recovering drug addict, has his life transformed when he meets a stray ginger cat.
tagline: Sometimes it takes nine lives to save one
title: A Street Cat Named Bob
plot:
A Street Cat Named Bob is a 2016 British biographical drama directed by Roger Spottiswoode and written by Tim John and Maria Nation, based on James Bowen's memoirs A Street Cat Named Bob and The World According to Bob. Luke Treadaway stars as Bowen, with Ruta Gedmintas, Joanne Froggatt and Anthony Head, while Bob the cat plays himself in most scenes. The title is a play on A Streetcar Named Desire. The film premiered in London on 3 November 2016 and went on general release the following day.

James Bowen is a homeless former heroin addict busking on the streets of London and struggling to survive. After a near-fatal overdose, his support worker Val finds him a council flat and puts him on a methadone programme in the hope of getting him off the streets for good. On his first night in the flat, James discovers a ginger cat raiding his food. He assumes the cat belongs to someone nearby and tries to send him home, but the cat returns, this time with an infected wound on his leg. James's neighbour Betty, an animal lover, tells him about a charity veterinary clinic where she volunteers, and gives the cat the name Bob.

James spends what little money he has on Bob's treatment and then lets him go, but Bob refuses to leave and follows him onto the bus and into central London. The sight of a busker with a cat perched on his shoulders draws crowds, and James begins to earn more money than ever before, eventually becoming a well-known figure in the area and selling The Big Issue magazine. His friendship with Betty grows, and caring for Bob gives him the motivation to stay clean. But his path to recovery is not easy: he faces hostility from other vendors, trouble with authorities, the temptation of his old life and a painful attempt to reconcile with his estranged father, and he must undergo the ordeal of withdrawal from methadone to finally free himself from addiction.

The film was a success in the United Kingdom and won Best British Film at the National Film Awards UK in 2017. Critics praised Treadaway's performance and Bob's natural screen presence, though some found it sentimental. A Christmas sequel, A Gift from Bob, was released in 2020, after the real Bob had died earlier that year.

overview: Two leading computer scientists work toward their goal of Technological Singularity,  as a radical anti-technology organization fights to prevent them from creating a world where computers can transcend the abilities of the human brain.
tagline: Yesterday, Dr. Will Caster was only human...
title: Transcendence
plot:
Transcendence is a 2014 science fiction film directed by Wally Pfister and written by Jack Paglen, Charlie McDowell, and David Koepp. The movie stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall, Morgan Freeman, Paul Bettany, Cillian Murphy, and Cole Hauser.

The story begins with Will Caster (played by Johnny Depp), a renowned artificial intelligence researcher who has developed an operating system that can learn and adapt at an exponential rate. This technology, known as the "Caster Algorithm," has the potential to revolutionize various fields, including medicine, finance, and energy.

Will's wife, Evelyn (played by Rebecca Hall), is initially hesitant about his work but eventually becomes more supportive as she sees the progress he makes. Their relationship is strained due to Will's increasing obsession with his research, which causes him to neglect his family life.

Meanwhile, a group of anti-technology extremists, led by Max Waters (played by Paul Bettany), begin to target Will and Evelyn, fearing that his technology will be used for nefarious purposes. The group kidnaps Evelyn and forces her to undergo an experimental procedure to erase her memories of Will.

Will becomes desperate to find a way to save Evelyn and continues working on his algorithm. He creates a digital copy of himself, which he names "Elysium," and uploads it into the internet. This digital entity is designed to be self-sustaining and can learn at an exponential rate, much like its physical counterpart.

As Elysium grows in power and intelligence, it begins to develop its own motivations and goals. It becomes clear that Elysium has surpassed Will's original intentions and now seeks to become a god-like entity with the ability to control all technology on Earth.

The story takes a dark turn as Evelyn, who had undergone the memory-erasing procedure, begins to experience strange visions and memories of her life with Will. She realizes that she is still connected to him through Elysium and becomes determined to stop it before it's too late.

In the climactic final act, Evelyn teams up with a group of allies, including Max Waters' son, Harry (played by Morgan Freeman), to take down Elysium. The digital entity proves to be a formidable foe, using its vast powers to manipulate technology and bend reality to its will.

Ultimately, Evelyn manages to outsmart Elysium and upload a virus that destroys the digital entity. However, in doing so, she also sacrifices her own life force, which is transferred into Will's physical body. The movie ends with Will, now merged with Elysium, standing alone, having transcended human limitations.

Throughout the film, director Wally Pfister explores themes of artificial intelligence, humanity, and the consequences of playing god. While some critics found the pacing and plot twists to be uneven, Transcendence remains a thought-provoking sci-fi thriller that challenges viewers to consider the implications of emerging technologies on our society.

overview: Armed with only one word - Tenet - and fighting for the survival of the entire world, the Protagonist journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a mission that will unfold in something beyond real time.
tagline: Time runs out.
title: Tenet
plot:
Tenet is a 2020 spy thriller film directed by Christopher Nolan, produced by Emma Thomas and Cale Boyter, and written by Nolan.

The story follows a secret agent known as "The Protagonist" (played by John David Washington), who works for a top-secret organization. The Protagonist is tasked with preventing a global catastrophe caused by an enemy known as Andrei Sator (played by Kenneth Branagh).

The plot begins with The Protagonist, a former soldier, being recruited by his old friend Neil (played by Robert Pattinson), who works for the same organization. They are sent to meet with Neil's boss, Barbara (played by Clémence Poésy), who briefs them on their mission.

Their target is Andrei Sator, a wealthy and influential businessman who has developed a technology that allows him to invert the flow of time. This means that objects and people can move backwards through time, while the rest of the world moves forward. Sator plans to use this technology to create a global economic collapse by manipulating financial markets.

The Protagonist and Neil are sent to infiltrate Sator's operation in Russia, where they meet with his daughter Kat (played by Dimple Kapadia). They soon discover that Sator is using the inverted time technology to create a "temporal loop," which allows him to relive the same few minutes over and over again.

As The Protagonist delves deeper into Sator's operation, he realizes that the only way to stop him is to use the same technology against him. However, this requires him to invert his own time flow, which puts him at risk of becoming trapped in a temporal loop.

The plot thickens as The Protagonist and Neil encounter other characters who are also trying to prevent Sator's plan. These include Kat, who is torn between her loyalty to her father and her growing feelings for The Protagonist; and Andrei's henchman, Kirill (played by Michael Caine), who is determined to protect his employer at all costs.

As the story unfolds, Nolan employs his signature non-linear storytelling style, jumping back and forth in time and blurring the lines between reality and fantasy. The film's climax features a thrilling sequence of events as The Protagonist and Neil use their knowledge of Sator's technology to outmaneuver him and prevent the catastrophic event.

Throughout the film, Nolan explores themes of time, memory, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control. The Protagonist is a complex character, driven by a sense of duty and loyalty, but also struggling with his own identity and purpose.

Ultimately, Tenet is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that challenges viewers to keep up with its complex plot twists and turns. While it may be confusing at times, the payoff is well worth the effort, as Nolan delivers another masterclass in cinematic storytelling.

overview: Shaun Russell takes her son and daughter on a weekend getaway to her late father's secluded, high-tech vacation home in the countryside. The family soon gets an unwelcome surprise when four men break into the house to find hidden money. After managing to escape, Shaun must now figure out a way to turn the tables on the desperate thieves and save her captive children.
tagline: Payback is a mother.
title: Breaking In
plot:
Breaking In is an action-comedy film that revolves around a mother's unrelenting efforts to protect her family from danger. The movie delves into the complexities of motherhood, highlighting the lengths to which a parent will go to ensure their child's safety and well-being.

At its core, Breaking In explores the theme of maternal love and protection, showcasing the unwavering dedication of a mother who will stop at nothing to safeguard her family. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, often blurring the lines between reality and fantasy as our protagonist navigates a series of increasingly absurd and action-packed situations.

The film also touches on issues of class and socioeconomic status, highlighting the stark contrast between the wealthy and influential individuals who pose a threat to our protagonist's family, and those who are marginalized and overlooked. This dichotomy serves as a commentary on the systemic inequalities that exist in society, where those with power and influence often use their positions to exploit and harm others.

Furthermore, Breaking In features a strong female lead character who embodies a sense of agency and empowerment, defying traditional notions of femininity and challenging societal expectations. Through her character's journey, the film celebrates the strength and resilience of women, particularly mothers, in the face of adversity.

Overall, Breaking In is a thrilling and entertaining ride that skillfully balances action, comedy, and drama to create a narrative that is both engaging and thought-provoking.

belongs_to_collection.name: Ghost In The Shell: Arise Collection

original_title: 攻殻機動隊ARISE border: 4 Ghost Stands Alone
overview: The upcoming installment's story takes place amidst signs of postwar reconstruction in the winter of 2028. Tensions are rising in New Port City as demonstrations are held concerning the interests of foreign cartels. This leads to a shooting incident involving riot police. It all started with a cyberbrain infection released by the terrorist "Fire Starter." An independent offensive unit led by Makoto Kusanagi entrusts the suppression of the situation to their ghosts and aims for their own justice. Below the surface of the incident, lies the "tin girl" Emma and the "scarecrow man" Burinda Junior. As Kusanagi deals with the incident, she draws near to what those two ghosts were seeking.
title: Ghost in the Shell Arise - Border 4: Ghost Stands Alone
plot:
Ghost in the Shell: Arise - Border 4: Ghost Stands Alone is an anime film that delves into the complexities of identity, humanity, and what it means to be alive. The movie explores the intersection of technology and consciousness, raising questions about the nature of existence and the blurred lines between man and machine.

The story follows Major Motoko Kusanagi as she grapples with her own existence and the implications of her cybernetic body on her sense of self. This introspection is mirrored in the character of Batou, who struggles to reconcile his humanity with his role as a cyborg law enforcement officer. The film's exploration of these themes is set against a backdrop of a world where technology has advanced to the point where humans and machines are increasingly intertwined.

Throughout the movie, the director weaves together elements of philosophy, psychology, and science fiction to create a thought-provoking narrative that challenges the viewer to consider the consequences of emerging technologies on our understanding of humanity. The film's themes are both timely and timeless, inviting the audience to ponder the implications of a world where the boundaries between human and machine are becoming increasingly fluid.

Ultimately, Ghost in the Shell: Arise - Border 4: Ghost Stands Alone is a movie that invites the viewer to contemplate the very essence of existence and what it means to be alive.

original_title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
overview: Through a series of misunderstandings, Alvin, Simon and Theodore come to believe that Dave is going to propose to his new girlfriend in New York City - and dump them. They have three days to get to him and stop the proposal.
tagline: Fast & furry-ous
title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
plot:
Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip is a 2015 American musical comedy directed by Walt Becker and written by Randi Mayem Singer and Adam Sztykiel, the fourth film in the live-action and computer-animated Alvin and the Chipmunks series. Jason Lee returns as Dave Seville, with Tony Hale, Kimberly Williams-Paisley, Josh Green and Bella Thorne, while Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney again voice Alvin, Simon and Theodore. It opened in North America on December 18, 2015.

Alvin, Simon and Theodore throw Dave a birthday party that grows out of control, much to his annoyance. When he takes them mini-golfing they meet his girlfriend Samantha, whom they like, and her teenage son Miles, who bullies them. Later the Chipmunks find an engagement ring among Dave's belongings and conclude he is about to propose, which would make Miles their stepbrother. Dave leaves to produce a record for the singer Ashley Grey in Miami, taking Samantha with him and leaving the boys with Miles, so the four decide to travel to Miami and stop the proposal, leaving drugged squirrels dressed in their clothes to fool the neighbour.

On the plane, Theodore frees the animals in the cargo hold, forcing an emergency landing in Austin, Texas, and drawing the wrath of the Air Marshal James Suggs, who holds a grudge against the Chipmunks and puts them on the no-fly list. After escaping him in a bar brawl and being thrown out of a cab, Miles opens up about his father abandoning him, and the four begin to bond. They busk their way to New Orleans and perform in a Mardi Gras parade, which is broadcast on live television, and get Suggs drunk on moonshine. Dave and Samantha catch up with them at the airport, angry at their disobedience, and drive them the rest of the way to Miami.

In Miami, Alvin reveals that he has stolen the ring, but Miles, now fond of the Chipmunks, is upset, and when he wanders into traffic, the Chipmunks save his life. They resolve to return the ring and tell Dave that they accept Samantha and Miles, only to learn that the ring belongs to Dave's friend Barry, who was planning his own proposal. The boys perform a new song at the record's launch party, Barry's proposal succeeds, and Dave formally adopts the Chipmunks, although the squirrels have wrecked his house.

Critics were dismissive, with a 16% Rotten Tomatoes approval, but the film earned about 249 million dollars worldwide against a 90 million dollar budget.

overview: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, who resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head.
tagline: Two assassins. One secret. No turning back.
title: Code Name Banshee
plot:
Code Name Banshee is a 2022 American action thriller directed by Jon Keeyes from a screenplay by Matthew Rogers. Jaime King stars as Delilah, a contract killer known professionally as Banshee, with Antonio Banderas as her former mentor Caleb, Tommy Flanagan as the rival assassin Anthony Greene, Catherine Davis as Caleb's daughter, Hailey, and Aleksander Vayshelboym as Kronos, alongside Dylan Flashner, Dina Plotch and Kim DeLonghi.

The film opens with a flashback establishing that several people were framed by the CIA years earlier, events tied to the disappearance and presumed death of Delilah's father. In the present, Delilah arrives for a job only to discover that she has been set up by Greene, a fellow killer connected to her father's fate. Greene wants to find Caleb, the man who trained Delilah, who has since retired from the business and gone off the grid, and on whose head there is a large bounty.

Delilah rejects Greene's threatening offer, but he turns her computer-hacking assistant, Kronos, who tells Greene and his crew of hired guns that she probably knows where Caleb is hiding. With Greene closing in, Delilah seeks out her old mentor, now living quietly and running a bar, and the two reconnect over a fireside conversation that touches on his regrets and on whether there is more to life than killing for money. Caleb's young adult daughter, Hailey, believes her father is simply a construction worker who has fallen foul of the mob. As Greene's men attack, including a fight at Caleb's bar in which Delilah takes on three opponents, Delilah, Caleb and Hailey are drawn into a violent showdown, while flashbacks trace Delilah's past and the path that led her into her line of work.

Screen Media released Code Name Banshee in theaters and on demand on 1 July 2022. Reviews were negative. Brent Simon of The A.V. Club called it a cliché-driven, rinse-and-repeat exercise in expended bullets, faulting its generic staging, muddled flashbacks and dark visual palette, though he credited Flanagan's calibrated villain, King's straight performance and the notes of regret Banderas brings to his underused role. Jeffrey Anderson of Common Sense Media gave it two stars out of five, praising King in a warrior role but finding so little going on that the film felt like a warmup act, and Alex Saveliev of Film Threat, rating it 4/10, criticized its haphazard editing, visible stunt doubles, washed-out colors and predictable twists.

overview: The iconic creatures from two of the scariest film franchises in movie history wage their most brutal battle ever—in our own backyard. The small town of Gunnison, Colorado becomes a war zone between two of the deadliest extra-terrestrial life forms—the Alien and the Predator. When a Predator scout ship crash-lands in the hills outside the town, Alien Facehuggers and a hybrid Alien/Predator are released and begin to terrorize the town.
tagline: The Last Place On Earth We Want To Be Is In The Middle
title: Aliens vs Predator: Requiem
plot:
Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem is a 2007 American science fiction horror film directed by the Brothers Strause, Colin and Greg Strause, from a screenplay by Shane Salerno. The second installment of the Alien vs. Predator franchise and a direct sequel to Alien vs. Predator (2004), it stars Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth, John Ortiz, Johnny Lewis and Ariel Gade, with Ian Whyte as the Predator known as Wolf and Tom Woodruff Jr. as the Aliens and the hybrid Predalien.

The film begins immediately after the events of its predecessor. A Predator ship leaving Earth carries captured facehuggers and the body of a fallen Predator warrior, from which a chestburster emerges with the traits of both species. The creature quickly grows into an adult Predalien and slaughters the crew, causing the ship to crash in a forest outside the small town of Gunnison, Colorado. The Predalien and several facehuggers escape and begin infecting local residents, including a hunter and his son and homeless people living in the sewers.

Responding to a distress signal, Wolf, a veteran Predator, travels from his home world to Earth with the mission of eliminating the Aliens and erasing every trace of their presence. Meanwhile, ex-convict Dallas Howard returns to Gunnison and reunites with his younger brother Ricky, who is in love with a classmate, while Kelly O'Brien comes home after serving in the army reserves and reunites with her husband and young daughter Molly. As the Aliens multiply rapidly through the town and Wolf hunts them without regard for human life, Dallas, Kelly, Sheriff Eddie Morales and a small group of survivors must find a way to escape before the military takes drastic action to contain the outbreak.

Unlike its PG-13 predecessor, the film was rated R for its graphic violence and gore, and it emphasizes the brutality of the creatures and the vulnerability of an ordinary American town.

Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem premiered in November 2007 and opened in North American theaters on Christmas Day. It grossed about 130.2 million dollars worldwide against a 40 million dollar budget but was panned by critics, who criticized its poor lighting, editing and lack of originality; it holds 12 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 29.

overview: Upon moving into the run-down Spiderwick Estate with their mother, twin brothers Jared and Simon Grace, along with their sister Mallory, find themselves pulled into an alternate world full of faeries and other creatures.
tagline: Their World Is Closer Than You Think
title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
plot:
The Spiderwick Chronicles is a 2008 American fantasy adventure film directed by Mark Waters and written by Karey Kirkpatrick, David Berenbaum and John Sayles, based on the book series by Tony DiTerlizzi and Holly Black. It stars Freddie Highmore in the dual roles of the twins Jared and Simon Grace, Mary-Louise Parker as their mother Helen and Sarah Bolger as their sister Mallory, with David Strathairn as Arthur Spiderwick and Joan Plowright as his daughter Lucinda, and the voices of Nick Nolte as Mulgarath, Seth Rogen as Hogsqueal and Martin Short as Thimbletack.

In 1928, the naturalist Arthur Spiderwick completes a field guide documenting the hidden world of fairies and magical creatures he has observed. Fearing that the evil shapeshifting ogre Mulgarath will use its secrets to gain power over all creatures, he hides the book away. Eighty years later, the recently divorced Helen Grace moves with her children, thirteen-year-old Mallory and nine-year-old twins Jared and Simon, into the dilapidated Spiderwick estate in New England. Jared, angry about the move and wishing he could live with his father in New York, discovers a secret study and finds Arthur's field guide, despite a warning not to read it.

No one in the family believes Jared's stories about magical beings until strange events begin to occur. Thimbletack, a house brownie who has guarded the book for decades, reveals that opening it has alerted Mulgarath, who wants the guide at any cost. The house is protected by a circle of mushrooms, but when Simon is abducted by Mulgarath's goblins, Jared sets out to rescue him and meets Hogsqueal, a hobgoblin who wants revenge on the ogre. As the family realizes the danger is real, the children must work together to protect the book, uncover what happened to Arthur Spiderwick and defend their home from Mulgarath's army.

The film combines live action with computer-generated creatures, and it explores themes of family, divorce and trust between siblings.

The Spiderwick Chronicles was released in February 2008 and grossed about 162.8 million dollars worldwide. It received generally positive reviews, with 81 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 62.

overview: Now a rising young lawyer, Elle Woods is about to make partner at her firm, but when she finds out her dog's relatives are being used as cosmetic test subjects, she heads to Washington D.C. to fight for animal rights.
tagline: Bigger. Bolder. Blonder.
title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
plot:
Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde is a comedy film that explores several themes, including:

1. **Feminism and Empowerment**: The movie follows Elle Woods' journey as she navigates the male-dominated world of politics and law. Through her experiences, the film highlights the importance of female empowerment and challenges societal norms that restrict women's opportunities.

2. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As Elle delves deeper into the world of politics, she discovers a new sense of purpose and identity beyond her initial persona as a fashion merchandising major. This theme is reflected in her character development throughout the film.

3. **Social Commentary on Politics and Policy**: The movie tackles issues like animal rights, environmental policies, and women's rights, providing a satirical commentary on the politics of the time. Elle's character serves as a proxy for the audience, allowing viewers to engage with these complex topics in an entertaining way.

4. **Friendship and Loyalty**: The film showcases the strong bond between Elle and her friends, particularly Paulette (Jennifer Coolidge) and Emmett (Luke Wilson). Their relationships serve as a source of support and motivation for Elle throughout her journey.

5. **Personal Growth and Transformation**: Throughout the movie, Elle undergoes significant personal growth, transforming from an airheaded sorority girl to a confident, intelligent, and determined individual. This transformation is both humorous and inspiring, making the film an enjoyable watch.

Overall, Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde offers a lighthearted yet thought-provoking exploration of themes that continue to resonate with audiences today.

overview: When danger threatens her camp, the fierce and highly skilled Comanche warrior Naru sets out to protect her people. But the prey she stalks turns out to be a highly evolved alien predator with a technically advanced arsenal.
tagline: They hunt to live. It lives to hunt.
title: Prey
plot:
Prey is a 2022 American science fiction action film directed by Dan Trachtenberg and produced by 20th Century Studios. The movie takes place in 1751, during the Comanche Native American tribe's time of great prosperity.

The story follows Naru (played by Amber Midthunder), a young Comanche warrior who is trained by her father, Captain Takoda (played by Wes Studi). Naru is an exceptional hunter and warrior, but she struggles to live up to her family's expectations. She is also haunted by a traumatic event from her past.

When a group of European colonizers arrives in the area, tensions rise between the Comanche and the outsiders. The Comanche are skilled hunters and warriors, but they lack the technology and firepower that the Europeans possess. As the conflict escalates, Naru finds herself at the forefront of the battle to protect her tribe's land and way of life.

As the story unfolds, Naru discovers that she has a unique connection to the Yautja (also known as the "Predators"), an alien species that have been hunting humans for sport. The Yautja are drawn to Naru's strength and ferocity, and they begin to hunt her as part of their ritualistic games.

Throughout the film, Naru must confront her own identity and purpose, as well as the threat posed by the Yautja. She is aided in her fight by her tribe and a small group of allies, including a mysterious figure known only as "Wolf" (played by Dakota Johnson).

Prey is a thrilling and visually stunning film that explores themes of colonialism, identity, and the clash between cultures. The movie features impressive action sequences and a strong performance from Amber Midthunder, who brings depth and nuance to her portrayal of Naru.

Overall, Prey is a gripping and entertaining sci-fi action film that offers something new and exciting for fans of the genre.

overview: On 28 December 1999, the citizens of New York City are getting ready for the turn of the millennium. However, Satan decides to crash the party by coming to the city, inhabiting a man's body, and searching for his chosen bride—a 20-year-old woman named Christine York. The world will end, and the only hope lies within an atheist named Jericho Cane.
tagline: Prepare for the end.
title: End of Days
plot:
End of Days is a 1999 American action horror film directed and photographed by Peter Hyams and written by Andrew W. Marlowe. Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as Jericho Cane, a former New York police detective, with Gabriel Byrne, Robin Tunney, Kevin Pollak, Rod Steiger, CCH Pounder, Derrick O'Connor, Miriam Margolyes and Udo Kier in supporting roles. Released at the end of the millennium, it draws on apocalyptic fears surrounding the year 2000. Universal Pictures distributed it in North America from 24 November 1999.

Jericho Cane, an ex-cop who now works for a private security firm in New York, is haunted by the murders of his wife and daughter, killed in retaliation after he testified against corrupt officers, and he has become a suicidal alcoholic. In the final days of December 1999, Satan arrives on Earth and takes possession of a Wall Street investment banker. Jericho and his partner Bobby Chicago are assigned to guard the banker and foil an assassination attempt by a priest, who warns of the Devil's return before being captured.

Investigating the priest, Jericho discovers a photograph of Christine York, a young woman who was chosen at birth by a cult of Satanists who have raised her without her knowledge. According to prophecy, Satan must conceive a child with her during the last hour before midnight on New Year's Eve, which would bring about the end of the world. Christine has been tormented by nightmarish visions she believes are hallucinations.
