However, the movie takes a surprising turn when it's revealed that Jack Frost was actually a failed attempt by Santa Claus himself to create an immortal spirit. The true villain behind the scenes is revealed to be a group of evil elves who have been manipulating events from the shadows.

In the end, Scott Calvin emerges victorious, and Christmas is saved once again. The movie concludes with Scott returning to his duties as Santa Claus, surrounded by his loving family and friends.

overview: In 1973, 15-year-old William Miller's unabashed love of music and aspiration to become a rock journalist lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone magazine to interview and tour with the up-and-coming band, Stillwater.
tagline: Experience it. Enjoy it. Just don't fall for it.
title: Almost Famous
plot:
Almost Famous is a 2000 American coming-of-age comedy-drama film directed by Cameron Crowe. The movie follows the story of William Miller (played by Patrick Fugit), a teenage music journalist who goes on tour with a rock band called Stillwater, led by the charismatic lead singer Russell Hammond (played by Billy Crudup).

The main themes of Almost Famous include:

1. **Coming of age**: The film explores William's transition from adolescence to adulthood as he navigates the complexities of growing up and finding his place in the world.
2. **Identity formation**: As William immerses himself in the music scene, he begins to discover his own identity and sense of purpose, which is reflected in his writing and relationships with those around him.
3. **Mentorship and guidance**: The character of Penny Lane (played by Kate Hudson), a groupie who becomes William's love interest and mentor, plays a significant role in shaping his perspective on life and music.
4. **The power of music**: The film celebrates the transformative impact of music on people's lives, as embodied by the band Stillwater and their music.
5. **Nostalgia and the 1970s counterculture**: Almost Famous is set against the backdrop of the 1970s rock scene, which serves as a nostalgic reminder of a bygone era and the cultural values that defined it.

The movie's narrative is structured around William's journey, from his initial excitement about joining the tour to his eventual growth into a confident young journalist. Along the way, he learns valuable lessons about loyalty, friendship, and the importance of staying true to oneself.

Overall, Almost Famous is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of the challenges and rewards of growing up, with a strong focus on music as a catalyst for self-discovery and connection.

overview: It's the most exciting time of year at Third Street Elementary-- the end of the School Year! But boredom quickly sets in for protagonist TJ Detweiler, as his friends are headed for Summer Camp. One day, while passing by the school on his bike, he notices a green glow coming from the school's auditorium. This is the work of the insidious ex-principal of Third Street, Phillium Benedict and his gang of ninjas and secret service look-alikes! Benedict is planning to get rid of Summer Vacation using his newly-acquired Tractor Beam, which he stole from the US Military Base in an effort to raise US Test Scores, and it's up to the Recess Gang to stop him!
tagline: Saving The World One Playground At A Time
title: Recess: School's Out
plot:
"Recess: School's Out" is a 2001 animated comedy film produced by Walt Disney Television Animation. The movie follows the adventures of six friends - T.J., Spinelli, Gus, Mikey, Vinnie, and Gretchen - as they try to have one last day of fun before the school year ends.

The main themes of "Recess: School's Out" include:

1. Friendship: The film highlights the strong bonds of friendship between the six main characters, who work together to overcome obstacles and have a blast.
2. Imagination and creativity: The movie showcases the kids' vivid imaginations and creative problem-solving skills as they come up with innovative ways to make their last day of school unforgettable.
3. Growing up and letting go: As the kids prepare for the end of the school year, they must also confront the reality of growing up and moving on from childhood. The film explores this bittersweet theme through the characters' experiences.
4. Self-discovery: Throughout the movie, each character faces challenges that help them learn more about themselves and their relationships with others.

The plot development revolves around the kids' plan to pull off a series of pranks and stunts on their last day of school, which ultimately leads to a wild adventure filled with excitement, humor, and heart. The ending is a mix of action-packed fun and emotional closure as the characters reflect on the value of friendship and the importance of cherishing memories.

Overall, "Recess: School's Out" is a lighthearted, entertaining film that celebrates the joys of childhood friendships and the power of imagination.

original_title: Snoopy Presents: For Auld Lang Syne
overview: After finding out her grandmother won't be visiting for Christmas, Lucy decides to cheer herself up by throwing the ultimate New Year's Eve party. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown tries to fulfill one of his resolutions before the clock strikes midnight.
tagline: "No matter how bad things may seem, I can always rely on my friends."
title: Snoopy Presents: For Auld Lang Syne
plot:
Snoopy Presents: For Auld Lang Syne is a 2021 American animated television special, the 46th Peanuts special and the first produced for Apple TV+, based on the characters created by Charles M. Schulz. Directed by Clay Kaytis, who co-wrote it with Alex Galatis and Scott Montgomery, it was the first new Peanuts holiday special in 18 years. The voice cast includes Etienne Kellici as Charlie Brown, Isabella Leo as Lucy and Wyatt White as Linus, with Terry McGurrin and Rob Tinkler.

In early December, Lucy van Pelt happily prepares for a visit from her beloved grandmother. Charlie Brown, meanwhile, struggles with his list of New Year's resolutions, failing at every one, until Lucy reduces it to two: build a snowman and do something even remotely creative. Snoopy welcomes a visit from his siblings, and his brother Spike, who has only a photograph of them as puppies, keeps trying to take a new family picture, but is thwarted by bad luck.

On Christmas Eve, Lucy learns that her grandmother will not be coming after all and begins to fear that she is unloved. To lift her spirits, she decides to throw a grand New Year's Eve party, renting an old abandoned theater with all the nickels Charlie Brown has paid her over the years for psychiatric advice. Charlie Brown is put in charge of decorations, and Snoopy and his siblings are hired as the band, though Spike leaves after his camera is destroyed. The party is a disaster: Lucy's strict rules bore everyone, and when she demands that Linus rescue it, he snaps that she has made the evening about herself instead of her friends. The guests drift away, and Charlie Brown accidentally brings down the decorations, failing his second resolution. Snoopy's siblings find Spike at the bus stop and make amends.

Linus visits Lucy in her bedroom to reassure her that he loves her no matter what, and Charlie Brown, having learned the reason for her unhappiness, arrives with all the guests to restart the countdown. This time the celebration pleases everyone, Snoopy's family finally gets its photo, and Lucy helps Charlie Brown achieve a resolution on the spot: being a good friend. The children sing "Auld Lang Syne," and later Lucy happily learns her grandmother will visit for her birthday.

The special premiered on Apple TV+ on December 10, 2021, and was well received, with critics praising its shift in focus to a vulnerable Lucy. It was nominated for Best Animated Special Production at the Annie Awards.

overview: An ex-NYPD officer-turned-sheriff of a small rural Georgia town has to contend with a gang of thieves who have taken a wealthy doctor hostage.
tagline: No one walks away.
title: American Siege
plot:
American Siege is a 2022 American action thriller film written and directed by Edward Drake from a story he developed with Corey Large. It stars Timothy V. Murphy, Bruce Willis, Rob Gough, Johann Urb, Anna Hindman, Johnny Messner, Cullen G. Chambers and Janet Jones, with Trevor Gretzky in a supporting role. Shot on a reported budget of $10 million between November and December 2020, with locations including Fitzgerald, Georgia, Bellingham, Washington, and Victoria, British Columbia, it was released in theatres and on demand in the United States by Shout! Studios on 7 January 2022.

In a small, backwater Georgia town controlled by the wealthy and powerful businessman Charles Rutledge (Murphy), teenager Brigit Baker (Sarah May Sommers) disappeared ten years earlier. Her boyfriend Roy Lambert (Gough), who was sent to prison for punching Rutledge, has spent the decade behind bars and now wants the truth. Soon after his release he teams up with Brigit's sister Grace (Hindman) and Toby Baker (Urb), and the heavily armed trio storm the house of the local pharmacist, Dr. John Keats (Chambers), and take him hostage, believing that he was the last person to see Brigit and knows what happened to her. A bank-grade security door on his basement suggests he is hiding something. Sheriff Ben Watts (Willis), a burnt-out former NYPD officer, heavy drinker and corrupt lawman on Rutledge's payroll, heads to the scene with his deputy Kyle Rutledge (Gretzky), Charles's son. As the siege drags on, Watts begins to suspect that Rutledge is tied to Brigit's disappearance and is hiding a larger conspiracy, while Rutledge loses patience and sends his private militia, led by the sinister Silas (Messner), to deal with the situation, leading to a long armed standoff outside the pharmacist's house.

American Siege was panned by critics; on Rotten Tomatoes only 8% of 13 critics' reviews were positive. Cath Clarke of The Guardian found it tiresome and oddly dull, criticising Willis's wooden, lethargic performance while allowing that its missing-girl story had an interesting twist and that Murphy brought icy menace. Jeffrey M. Anderson of Combustible Celluloid gave it two stars out of four, calling it riddled with bad ideas and dialogue but enlivened by the hostage-takers, especially Hindman's spitfire Grace. Willis's performance was among those cited for a Golden Raspberry category later rescinded after he retired because of aphasia.

overview: The true story of suburban housewife Gertrude Baniszewski, who kept a teenage girl locked in the basement of her Indiana home during the 1960s.
tagline: The true story of a child's punishment that became a woman's crime.
title: An American Crime
plot:
An American Crime is a thought-provoking drama that delves into the complexities of human nature, exploring the darker aspects of society and the devastating consequences of violence. The film revolves around the true story of Dee Dee Blanchard, a woman who subjected her daughter, Gypsy Rose, to a life of abuse and manipulation.

At its core, An American Crime is a tale of toxic relationships and the destructive power of obsession. Dee Dee's fixation on her own narrative and her desire for attention and sympathy ultimately lead her to create a false persona for herself and her daughter, fabricating a history of illness and disability that has devastating consequences for Gypsy Rose.

The film also explores themes of gaslighting, emotional manipulation, and the blurring of reality. Dee Dee's ability to control and deceive those around her is a masterclass in psychological manipulation, leaving a trail of destruction in its wake.

Furthermore, An American Crime raises questions about the societal pressures that can lead individuals to engage in such behavior. The film suggests that Dee Dee's actions were, in part, driven by a desire for attention and sympathy, as well as a need to feel important and relevant in a world that often overlooks and marginalizes those with disabilities.

Ultimately, An American Crime is a powerful exploration of the darker aspects of human nature, highlighting the devastating consequences of toxic relationships and the importance of empathy, understanding, and support.

overview: After years of performing “exorcisms” and taking believers’ money, Reverend Marcus travels to rural Louisiana with a film crew so he can dispel what he believes is the myth of demonic possession. The dynamic reverend is certain that this will be another routine “exorcism” on a disturbed religious fanatic but instead comes upon the blood-soaked farm of the Sweetzer family and a true evil he would have never thought imaginable.
tagline: Believe In Him.
title: The Last Exorcism
plot:
The Last Exorcism is a 2010 American found-footage horror film directed by Daniel Stamm and produced by Strike Entertainment.

The main themes of The Last Exorcism revolve around faith, doubt, and the blurred lines between reality and fiction. The movie follows the story of Niles (played by Patrick Fabian), a disillusioned evangelical minister who agrees to let a documentary crew follow him as he performs his last exorcism. As the ritual progresses, it becomes clear that the true horror lies not in the supernatural forces at work, but in the darkness within human nature.

Throughout the film, Stamm explores the tension between faith and doubt, highlighting the complexities of Niles' character as he grapples with his own spirituality. The documentary crew's presence serves to underscore the artificiality of the exorcism ritual, raising questions about the authenticity of spiritual experiences and the motivations of those who claim to perform them.

The film also touches on themes of identity, morality, and the consequences of playing God. As Niles delves deeper into the world of demonology, he begins to confront his own demons (literally and figuratively), leading to a crisis of faith that threatens to upend his entire existence.

Ultimately, The Last Exorcism is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to consider the nature of reality and the power of faith in the face of uncertainty.

overview: Two American astronomers attempt to warn humankind about an approaching comet that will wipe out life on planet Earth.
tagline: Based on truly possible events.
title: Don't Look Up
plot:
Don't Look Up is a 2021 American satirical science fiction film directed by Adam McKay from a screenplay by McKay and David Sirota, based on the 2018 novel of the same name by Diamond Ken Smith. The movie stars Leonardo DiCaprio and Jennifer Lawrence as two astronomers trying to warn the world about an impending comet impact.

The story begins with Dr. Randall Mindy (DiCaprio), a low-level astronomer at South Boston University, who discovers that a massive comet is on a collision course with Earth. He shares his findings with his colleague, Dr. Kate Dibiasky (Lawrence), and together they try to alert the government and the media about the impending disaster.

However, their warnings fall on deaf ears as politicians and media outlets are more interested in sensationalizing the story for ratings and clicks than taking it seriously. The comet's impact is predicted to be catastrophic, causing widespread destruction and potentially wiping out humanity.

As the comet draws closer, Mindy and Dibiasky try to find a way to get their message heard by the world. They enlist the help of a washed-up talk show host, Brie Evantee (Meryl Streep), who agrees to broadcast their warnings to her audience. However, even this plan is hijacked by the media's desire for ratings, and Dibiasky becomes a reluctant celebrity.

Meanwhile, Mindy's relationship with his girlfriend, Dr. Rachel Drayton (Cate Blanchett), begins to fray as she tries to balance her own career ambitions with her growing concern about the comet. The couple eventually breaks up, leaving Mindy feeling isolated and disconnected from the world around him.

As the comet hurtles towards Earth, Mindy and Dibiasky's warnings become increasingly desperate and urgent. They try to find a way to deflect or destroy the comet, but their efforts are met with bureaucratic red tape and corporate interests that prioritize profits over people.

The film builds towards a climactic finale as the comet makes its final approach. In a last-ditch effort, Mindy and Dibiasky team up with a group of eccentric billionaires, including Captain Dick Todd (Rob Morgan), to launch a private rocket into space in an attempt to deflect the comet.

In the end, the plan succeeds, but not without significant collateral damage and loss of life. The film ends on a bleak note, with Mindy and Dibiasky reflecting on the futility of their efforts and the world's continued apathy towards the dangers of climate change and existential threats.

Throughout the film, McKay uses satire to critique the media's role in shaping public opinion, the failures of government bureaucracy, and the complacency of wealthy elites. The movie is a scathing commentary on our society's inability to confront the harsh realities of climate change and its devastating consequences.

overview: A married woman with an unwanted pregnancy lives in a time in America where she can't get a legal abortion and works with a group of suburban women to find help.
tagline: You are not alone.
title: Call Jane
plot:
Call Jane is a 2022 American drama film directed by Martha Fiato and written by Lizzie Molyneux and Wendy Kopp. The movie is based on the true story of Karen Silkwood, an American labor union activist who fought for workers' rights in the early 1970s.

The main theme of Call Jane revolves around the struggle for women's reproductive rights and the fight against patriarchal oppression. The film explores the complexities of a woman's body and her autonomy over it, as well as the societal expectations placed upon her. Through Karen Silkwood's character, the movie sheds light on the injustices faced by working-class women who were denied basic human rights, including access to safe and affordable abortion.

The film also delves into the theme of female solidarity and the power of collective action. Karen forms a bond with her coworkers, who become her support system in the face of adversity. Together, they navigate the challenges of their jobs, personal lives, and the restrictive laws that govern their bodies.

Furthermore, Call Jane touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery. As Karen navigates her relationships and career, she must also confront her own desires and aspirations. The film suggests that women's identities are shaped by societal expectations, but it also implies that individuals have the power to redefine themselves and challenge the status quo.

Overall, Call Jane is a powerful exploration of the human experience, highlighting the struggles and triumphs of women fighting for their rights and autonomy in a patriarchal society.

overview: Half brothers Raymond and Ray reunite when their estranged father dies—and discover that his final wish was for them to dig his grave. Together, they process who they’ve become as men, both because of their father and in spite of him.
tagline: Two brothers. One final request.
title: Raymond & Ray
plot:
Raymond & Ray is a 2022 American comedy-drama film directed by Alex Rudzinski and written by Dan Algrant and Michael Siler. The movie follows the story of two brothers, Raymond "Ray" Jackson Jr. (played by Josh O'Connor) and Raymond "Ray" Jackson Sr. (played by Martin Sheen), who were once close but drifted apart after their father's death.

The main themes of the film include:

1. **Brotherly love and redemption**: The movie explores the complex relationship between two brothers, Ray and his estranged brother, Ray Sr., as they navigate their past mistakes and work towards healing and reconciliation.
2. **Grief and loss**: The film delves into the emotional aftermath of a father's death, highlighting the pain, guilt, and regret that can accompany such a loss.
3. **Identity and self-discovery**: As the brothers reconnect, they are forced to confront their own identities, values, and life choices, leading to a journey of self-discovery and growth.
4. **Family dynamics and forgiveness**: The movie examines the intricate web of relationships within a family, highlighting the importance of forgiveness, understanding, and empathy in healing old wounds.

Throughout the film, the title "Raymond & Ray" serves as a poignant reminder of the dual nature of identity, love, and loss that defines the brothers' relationship.

original_title: All Quiet on the Western Front
overview: A young soldier faces profound disillusionment in the soul-destroying horror of World War I. Together with several other young German soldiers, he experiences the horrors of war, such evil of which he had not conceived of when signing up to fight. They eventually become sad, tormented, and confused of their purpose.
tagline: They left for war as boys never to return as men.
title: All Quiet on the Western Front
plot:
All Quiet on the Western Front is a 1930 film directed by Lewis Milestone, produced by Carl Laemmle Jr., and based on the novel of the same name by Erich Maria Remarque. The main themes of this classic war drama include:

1. **The Futility of War**: The film portrays the harsh realities of trench warfare, highlighting the senselessness and brutality of conflict. The characters' experiences serve as a stark reminder that war is often fought for reasons that are lost in the chaos.

2. **Loss and Sacrifice**: The story revolves around Paul Baümer (played by John Wray), a young German soldier who enlists to fight for his country, only to witness the devastating consequences of war on himself and those around him. The film explores the emotional toll of loss and sacrifice, particularly in the context of World War I.

3. **Coming of Age**: Paul's journey from an idealistic teenager to a disillusioned young man serves as a powerful coming-of-age story. As he faces the harsh realities of war, he is forced to confront his own mortality and the meaninglessness of his actions.

4. **Nationalism vs. Individuality**: The film critiques the nationalist fervor that led to the outbreak of World War I. Paul's experiences challenge his initial patriotism and force him to question the values of his country.

5. **The Psychological Toll of Trauma**: The characters in the film struggle with the psychological effects of war, including shell shock, anxiety, and depression. This theme highlights the long-term consequences of trauma on individuals and society as a whole.

6. **Humanity in the Face of Adversity**: Despite the brutal conditions and senseless violence, the film showcases moments of humanity, compassion, and kindness among soldiers from different countries. These fleeting glimpses of humanity serve as a poignant reminder that even in the darkest times, there is always hope for connection and understanding.

These themes, woven throughout the narrative, contribute to the enduring power and emotional resonance of All Quiet on the Western Front.

belongs_to_collection.name: 新海誠作品  シリーズ

overview: The film centers on Asuna, a young girl who spends her solitary days listening to the mysterious music emanating from the crystal radio she received from her late father as a memento. One day while walking home she is attacked by a fearsome monster and saved mysterious boy named Shun. However, Shun disappears and Asuna embarks on a journey of adventure to the land of Agartha with her teacher Mr. Morisaki to meet a Shun again. Through her journey she comes to know the cruelty and beauty of the world, as well as loss.
tagline: A journey to say goodbye.
title: Children Who Chase Lost Voices
plot:
Children Who Chase Lost Voices is a 2011 Japanese anime film written and directed by Makoto Shinkai, produced by CoMix Wave Films, and distributed by Toho. The movie's main themes revolve around the following:

1. **Coming of Age**: The story follows Shizuku Haru, a high school student who discovers that she has the ability to hear the voices of the dead. As she navigates her newfound power, she must also confront the challenges of growing up and finding her place in the world.

2. **Love and Loss**: The film explores the complexities of love, loss, and grief through Shizuku's relationships with the people around her, particularly Aguri, a mysterious and charismatic young man who is somehow connected to the dead voices she can hear.

3. **Mortality and the Afterlife**: The movie delves into the concept of mortality and the afterlife, raising questions about what happens to us when we die and whether there's more to life than our physical existence.

4. **Self-Discovery**: Throughout the film, Shizuku embarks on a journey of self-discovery, learning to control her powers and understand herself better. This theme is closely tied to the idea of growing up and finding one's identity.

5. **The Power of Human Connection**: The movie highlights the importance of human connections and relationships in our lives. Despite facing numerous challenges, Shizuku finds solace and strength in her relationships with others, which ultimately help her navigate the complexities of life and death.

Overall, Children Who Chase Lost Voices is a poignant and thought-provoking film that explores complex themes through its engaging narrative and memorable characters.

overview: Tempted away from Newcastle United to join Real Madrid, rising star Santiago Munez finds this latest change of fortune the greatest challenge yet - personally as well as professionally. He is reunited with Gavin Harris, though they must compete to be on the team, and estranged from fiancee Roz, whose nursing career keeps her back home.
title: Goal! II: Living the Dream
plot:
Goal II: Living the Dream is a 2007 sports drama directed by Jaume Collet-Serra from a screenplay by Mike Jefferies, Adrian Butchart and Terry Loane. The sequel to Goal! (2005) and the second part of a trilogy, it stars Kuno Becker as the Mexican footballer Santiago Muñez, with Alessandro Nivola, Anna Friel, Stephen Dillane, Leonor Varela, Elizabeth Peña and Rutger Hauer, and features cameo appearances by real Real Madrid players.

Santiago, now a star at Newcastle United, is signed by Real Madrid, where he is reunited with his flamboyant former teammate Gavin Harris. His fiancée, Roz, stays behind in Newcastle to finish her nursing training, and the long-distance relationship soon strains. Santiago makes a winning debut and quickly becomes the club's new star, but fame brings complications. He is approached by Enrique, a younger half-brother he never knew, who shows him a photograph of their mother, Rosa María, who abandoned Santiago as a small child, and he learns that his grandmother knew she was living in Madrid.

Distracted, Santiago is sent off in his first start, and after a drunken night with the television presenter Jordana García he misses the team flight to a Champions League match in Norway, earning the wrath of manager Rudi van der Merwe. He fires his loyal agent Glen Foy, injures his ankle and cancels Christmas plans with Roz, and when a second kiss with Jordana is leaked to the press, Roz breaks off their engagement. Meanwhile Enrique steals Santiago's Lamborghini and crashes it, and Santiago is arrested after taking the blame and assaulting a photographer at the hospital, where he finally sees his mother.

After scoring the goal that sends Madrid into the Champions League final, Santiago visits Rosa, who explains that she fled to Madrid after being attacked, and returned to Mexico to find the family gone to the United States. Reconciled with his mother and Enrique, he asks Rudi to start Gavin in the final against Arsenal to help his friend's career, and apologizes to Roz. Madrid fall behind 2–0, but after coming on, Santiago sets up a goal for Gavin and scores the equalizer, before David Beckham wins the match with a late free kick.

Released in the United Kingdom on February 9, 2007, the film received mixed to negative reviews for its predictable and melodramatic script and grossed only about $7.8 million worldwide, though it later found a cult audience. Goal III followed in 2009.

overview: A brother and sister are sent to their grandparents' remote Pennsylvania farm for a week, where they discover that the elderly couple is involved in something deeply disturbing.
tagline: No one loves you like your grandparents.
title: The Visit
plot:
The Visit is a 2015 American found-footage psychological horror film directed by M. Night Shyamalan. The movie follows the story of Becca (Olivia DeJonge) and Tyler (Ed Oxenbould), two teenagers who visit their grandparents in rural Pennsylvania for the summer.

The main themes of The Visit include:

1. **Family dynamics**: The film explores the complex relationships within a family, particularly between the two siblings and their grandparents. It highlights the tension and unease that can arise when family members are forced to spend time together.
2. **Isolation and confinement**: The rural setting and the grandparents' isolated farmhouse serve as a backdrop for the characters' emotional confinement. This isolation amplifies the sense of unease and vulnerability, making it difficult for Becca and Tyler to escape their situation.
3. **Deception and manipulation**: The grandparents, Nana (Deanna Dunagan) and Grandpa (Peter McRobbie), are not what they seem. They use deception and manipulation to control and exploit their grandchildren, leading to a descent into psychological horror.
4. **Trauma and emotional baggage**: Becca and Tyler have experienced trauma in the past, which is slowly revealed throughout the film. This emotional baggage affects their behavior and interactions with each other and their grandparents.
5. **The blurring of reality and fantasy**: As the story unfolds, it becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish between what's real and what's not. The grandparents' sinister intentions are expertly woven into the narrative, making it challenging for the audience to discern truth from fiction.

Overall, The Visit is a masterclass in building tension and suspense through clever storytelling, atmospheric setting, and outstanding performances.

original_title: DC Films Presents Dawn of the Justice League
overview: A documentary special taking a look at the upcoming films making up the DC Universe. Kevin Smith hosts with Geoff Johns, as they take a look at Batman vs Superman: Dawn of Justice, Suicide Squad, the upcoming Wonder Woman and Justice League movies.
title: DC Films Presents Dawn of the Justice League
plot:
DC Films Presents: Dawn of the Justice League is a 2016 American television documentary special produced by Warner Bros. Pictures and DC Entertainment to promote the studio's slate of films based on DC Comics characters. Hosted by filmmaker and comic book enthusiast Kevin Smith together with Geoff Johns, DC's chief creative officer, it aired on The CW on 19 January 2016, immediately following an episode of The Flash, and runs about 22 minutes. Alongside its hosts it features clips and interview material with filmmakers and cast members including Zack Snyder, David Ayer, Patty Jenkins, Henry Cavill, Jesse Eisenberg, Will Smith, Jared Leto, Joel Kinnaman and Ray Fisher.

Structured as a conversation in which Smith poses questions and Johns explains the characters and their place in the shared universe, the special works through the upcoming releases one by one. It begins with Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice, then due in March 2016, reusing footage from earlier trailers while cast members recall their first encounters with DC comics and Johns outlines why the two heroes come into conflict. It then turns to Suicide Squad and premieres a new trailer for the film set to Queen's "Bohemian Rhapsody", before offering the first brief glimpses of footage from Wonder Woman, starring Gal Gadot and scheduled for 2017. The final section introduces the other members of the planned Justice League, Aquaman, the Flash and Cyborg, using concept art and short summaries of their backstories; Johns acknowledges the television version of the Flash while explaining that Ezra Miller's cinematic Barry Allen will have a somewhat different origin. The special's main announcement was that Green Lantern and the Green Lantern Corps would join the film universe, with Hal Jordan and John Stewart expected to be at its center.

Reactions were mixed. Geekscape felt it achieved what it set out to do, bringing viewers up to speed on the characters, and found Smith's enthusiasm infectious, though it noted that the Batman v Superman segment offered little new and that the Wonder Woman footage left it flat. Dan Greenfield of 13th Dimension was far more critical, calling it a half-hour infomercial aimed at viewers who already knew the characters, questioning the need for Smith as a cheerleader and arguing that the studio should show rather than tell, though he preferred the new Suicide Squad trailer to the first.

original_title: To All the Boys: Always and Forever
overview: Senior year of high school takes center stage as Lara Jean returns from a family trip to Korea and considers her college plans — with and without Peter.
tagline: You never know where love will lead you.
title: To All the Boys: Always and Forever
plot:
To All the Boys: Always and Forever is a romantic comedy film released on February 12, 2021, directed by Susan Johnson and produced by Awesomeness Films. The movie serves as the third installment in the To All the Boys I've Loved Before trilogy.

The story begins with Lara Jean Covey (Lana Condor), who has just graduated from high school and is preparing to attend college. She's excited about this new chapter, but also a bit nervous about leaving her family and friends behind. Lara Jean's life takes an unexpected turn when she receives news that the University of California, Berkeley, has accepted her early decision.

As Lara Jean navigates her senior year, she must balance her relationships with her family, particularly her sister Margot (Anna Cathcart), who is dealing with her own college acceptance and subsequent anxiety. The sisters' bond is put to the test as they face new challenges together.

Meanwhile, Lara Jean's on-again, off-again relationship with Peter Kavinsky (Noah Centineo) continues to blossom. However, their love story takes an unexpected turn when Peter reveals that he has been accepted into a prestigious university in New York City. The couple must decide whether to pursue their individual dreams or stay together.

Throughout the movie, Lara Jean also explores her passion for writing and journalism, which becomes a significant part of her identity. She starts working on a school newspaper project, where she meets a charming and talented writer named Josh (Jordan Fisher). As they work together, Lara Jean finds herself drawn to Josh's creative energy and kind heart.

As the story unfolds, Lara Jean must confront her feelings about love, family, and growing up. She learns valuable lessons about embracing change, taking risks, and being true to oneself. Ultimately, Lara Jean makes a decision that will impact her future and the people she loves.

The movie concludes with Lara Jean embarking on a new journey, one that is filled with uncertainty but also full of promise. The film ends on a hopeful note, leaving audiences feeling uplifted and inspired by Lara Jean's resilience and determination.

Overall, To All the Boys: Always and Forever is a heartwarming and engaging romantic comedy that explores themes of love, family, and self-discovery. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and relatable characters, this movie is sure to delight fans of the trilogy and newcomers alike.

overview: A shy 11-year-old's life takes a strange turn when she discovers three hungry goblins living in the attic of her new house. She misses her old life. She misses her father so very much. Until she makes some new ghoulish friends.
tagline: A letter that ties the bond between them.
title: A Letter to Momo
plot:
A Letter to Momo is a heartwarming and poignant animated drama that explores the complexities of human relationships, love, loss, and self-discovery.

At its core, the film delves into the theme of grief and how it affects individuals in different ways. The story revolves around a young boy who forms an unlikely bond with a mysterious girl named Momo, who is struggling to cope with her own emotional pain. As their relationship deepens, the boy learns valuable lessons about empathy, understanding, and the importance of human connection.

The film also touches on the theme of loneliness and isolation, highlighting the struggles of growing up and finding one's place in the world. The protagonist's journey is a powerful exploration of how people can find comfort and solace in each other's company, even in the midst of turmoil.

Furthermore, A Letter to Momo explores the complexities of human emotions, revealing the intricate web of feelings that can both unite and divide us. The film's portrayal of Momo's character, in particular, is a masterful exploration of the fragility and beauty of the human spirit.

Ultimately, the movie presents a hopeful and uplifting message about the transformative power of love, kindness, and compassion. Through its beautiful animation and poignant storytelling, A Letter to Momo reminds us that even in the darkest moments, there is always the possibility for healing, growth, and connection with others.

overview: With her California hometown in the rearview mirror, Belle heads north on business to catalog the sale of a large mansion. While the job is a dream, the client, Hunter Lowell, is not. But, as the two spend more time together, his icy demeanor begins to melt. Although their relationship is budding, Belle’s long-time suitor, Tony, arrives, sending mixed signals to Hunter while adding chaos to the holiday season.
title: Christmas Belle
plot:
Christmas Belle is a 2013 American romantic drama television film directed by Alex Wright from a screenplay by Joany Kane. Produced by Marquis Productions, it stars Haylie Duff and Nicholas Gonzalez, with Mark Famiglietti, C. Thomas Howell and Sheree J. Wilson in supporting roles. Running about 85 minutes, it premiered on 8 December 2013 and was later broadcast in France as Le Noël de Belle. Its holiday romance loosely echoes the outline of Beauty and the Beast, beginning with its heroine's nickname.

Duff plays Isabella "Belle" Everhart, who leaves her California hometown and heads north on an assignment from her father, Rex (Howell). She is to catalogue the contents of the grand Lowell estate, a mansion set amid vineyards, which its owner, Hunter Lowell (Gonzalez), wants sold before Christmas. Hunter is gruff, preoccupied and openly cold toward her, and only accepts her presence because he is in a hurry to get the job done.

Belle loves the work, especially the mansion's library of rare books, and befriends the housekeeper, Angie (Wilson). Her eagerness to prepare the house for the sale gets her into trouble when she rearranges a room she was told to leave alone, but the incident breaks the ice, and Hunter tries to make amends for his behaviour. As they spend more time together, his icy manner begins to melt and the two grow close. Their budding romance is thrown into confusion when Belle's long-time suitor, Tony (Famiglietti), arrives in town with her father, determined to win her with grand gestures and a few lies that send mixed signals to Hunter and add chaos to the holiday season.

The film drew modest notices typical of the made-for-television Christmas romance. The blog Tranquil Dreams found the story predictable and somewhat disjointed, lacking depth, but praised the chemistry and charm of Duff and Gonzalez and admired the picturesque estate, with its barn and covered bridge, and the homey small-town setting. The same review criticised the heavy-handed direction, including repeated, overly dramatic scenes of a shirtless Hunter's morning runs and an orchestral score that at one point drowned out the dialogue, concluding that the film was average but fairly enjoyable. HallmarkDB described it as largely standard for the genre, lifted slightly by its enemies-to-lovers arc.

overview: Lucky Prescott's life is changed forever when she moves from her home in the city to a small frontier town and befriends a wild mustang named Spirit.
tagline: Adventure awaits.
title: Spirit Untamed
plot:
Spirit Untamed is a 2021 American animated adventure drama film produced by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures. The movie is directed by Karen Gilchrist and written by Sergio Pablos, Carlos Saldanha, and others.

The story follows Spirit (voiced by Isabela Moner), a wild mustang mare who lives in the American West with her mother, Rain (voiced by Jaclyn Henzie). Spirit's life is marked by freedom and adventure, but she begins to feel restless as she grows older. She longs for more than just running free in the open plains.

One day, Spirit meets a young boy named Lucky (voiced by Luke Brandon Wilson), who has been separated from his family during a wagon train journey. Spirit takes pity on Lucky and decides to help him find his way back home. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, hostile Native American tribes, and ruthless horse traders.

As Spirit and Lucky travel together, they develop an unlikely friendship. Spirit learns about the importance of family, loyalty, and trust from Lucky, while Lucky gains a new appreciation for the beauty and power of nature through Spirit's guidance.

However, their journey is threatened by a rival horse trader named Butch (voiced by Timothée Chalamet), who seeks to capture and exploit wild mustangs like Spirit. Butch is determined to add Spirit to his collection, but she refuses to be caught.

As the stakes grow higher, Spirit and Lucky find themselves in a desperate bid for freedom. They use their combined skills and ingenuity to outsmart Butch's men and protect each other from harm.

In the end, Spirit and Lucky successfully evade capture and reach the safety of a nearby sanctuary. However, Spirit realizes that she must make a difficult choice between her love for Lucky and her desire to return to the wild. In a heartwarming conclusion, Spirit decides to stay with Lucky's family, finding a new sense of belonging and purpose.

Throughout the movie, the animation is stunning, capturing the beauty and majesty of the American West. The voice cast delivers strong performances, bringing depth and emotion to their characters. The story is both thrilling and heartwarming, exploring themes of friendship, loyalty, and self-discovery.

Overall, Spirit Untamed is a captivating animated adventure that celebrates the spirit (pun intended) of the wild mustangs and the power of human connection.

original_title: Iron Man & Captain America: Heroes United
overview: Iron Man and Captain America battle to keep the Red Skull and his triggerman, Taskmaster, from unleashing an army of Hydra Brutes on the world!  Sequel to the film "Iron Man & Hulk: Heroes United" and feature Iron Man teaming up with Captain America, it comes to accompany the live-action film "Captain America: The Winter Soldier".
tagline: Iron Man and Captain America team up in groundbreaking Marvel CG Animation.
title: Iron Man & Captain America: Heroes United
plot:
Iron Man & Captain America: Heroes United is a 2013 animated film, not 2014. It's a crossover between two popular Marvel characters, Tony Stark/Iron Man and Steve Rogers/Captain America.

The main themes of Iron Man & Captain America: Heroes United include:

1. **Friendship vs. Duty**: The movie explores the tension between friendship and duty as Tony Stark and Steve Rogers navigate their differences in opinion on how to handle a threat.
2. **Loyalty and Betrayal**: The film delves into the consequences of loyalty and betrayal, particularly when it comes to the Avengers' mission and the true intentions of the villainous organization, HYDRA.
3. **Power and Responsibility**: Tony Stark's Iron Man suit serves as a symbol of power and responsibility, highlighting the importance of using one's abilities for the greater good.
4. **Prejudice and Stereotypes**: The movie touches on the theme of prejudice and stereotypes, particularly in the way Steve Rogers is perceived by some as being too old-fashioned or naive.

The plot follows Tony Stark and Steve Rogers as they team up to stop a HYDRA organization that has stolen a powerful artifact. Along the way, they must navigate their differences and learn to trust each other in order to save the world.

Overall, Iron Man & Captain America: Heroes United is an action-packed animated adventure that explores themes of friendship, loyalty, power, and responsibility.

overview: A groom and his three best men travel to the Australian outback for a wedding.
tagline: You are cordially invited to absolute mayhem
title: A Few Best Men
plot:
A Few Best Men is a 2011 Australian comedy film directed by Stephan Elliott from a screenplay by Dean Craig. Xavier Samuel stars as David Locking, a young British man who travels to the Blue Mountains of Australia for his wedding, accompanied by his three best men. The cast also includes Kris Marshall as Tom, Kevin Bishop as Graham, Tim Draxl as Luke, Laura Brent as the bride, Mia Ramme, Olivia Newton-John as her mother, Barbara, Jonathan Biggins as her father, Jim, Rebel Wilson as Daphne Ramme, Steve Le Marquand as Ray and Elizabeth Debicki as Maureen.

David meets Mia while on holiday in Tuvalu, and only a week later he proposes. The couple plan to marry at her family's home in the Blue Mountains, and David rounds up his three best friends from Britain to fly out and serve as his best men. Mia's father, Jim, is a politician, and the arrival of the rowdy groomsmen at a family wedding with so much at stake for appearances is a recipe for disaster.

Once the friends arrive, the wedding weekend quickly spirals out of control. The three accidentally make off with a stash of drugs belonging to Ray, a local drug dealer, who comes after them to get his property back. Further trouble follows when the father-in-law's prized ram ends up stoned, and the guests' antics escalate through a series of increasingly outrageous mishaps that threaten to derail the ceremony, embarrass the bride's family and test David's relationship with Mia before the couple can finally make it down the aisle.

A Few Best Men premiered at the Mill Valley Film Festival in California on 14 October 2011 and was released in Australia on 26 January 2012 and in the United Kingdom on 31 August 2012. Newton-John sang most of the soundtrack, which Universal Music Australia released in January 2012. The film opened on 235 Australian screens with $1.9 million, third for the week, and went on to earn about $5.3 million locally, the fourth most successful Australian film of the year. Reviews were mostly negative, with 18% approval on Rotten Tomatoes; SBS's Fiona Williams gave it one star and called it overlong and flimsy. However, David Stratton and Margaret Pomeranz each gave it four stars on At the Movies, Stratton singling out Newton-John as hilarious. The film was nominated for the AACTA Award for Best Original Music Score, and a sequel, A Few Less Men, followed in 2017.

overview: Tom and Hannah have been platonic friends for 10 years. He's a serial dater, while she wants marriage but hasn't found Mr. Right. Just as Tom is starting to think that he is relationship material after all, Hannah gets engaged. When she asks Tom to be her 'maid' of honor, he reluctantly agrees just so he can attempt to stop the wedding and woo her.
tagline: He'll do anything to get the groom out of the picture.
title: Made of Honor
plot:
Made of Honor is a romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of love, friendship, and loyalty. The movie delves into the theme of unrequited love, as the protagonist, Tom (played by Chris Evans), struggles to express his feelings for his best friend's fiancée, Sarah (played by Michelle Monaghan). As Tom navigates this difficult situation, he must confront his own emotions and learn to let go of his unrequited love.

The film also touches on the theme of male friendship and the bonds that form between men. The relationship between Tom and his best friend, Trevor (played by Patrick Dempsey), is a central aspect of the movie, highlighting the importance of loyalty, trust, and support in male friendships.

Furthermore, Made of Honor explores the idea of growing up and moving on from past relationships. As Tom comes to terms with his unrequited love, he must also learn to accept that Sarah has chosen someone else and move forward with his life. This theme is woven throughout the movie, adding depth and nuance to the story.

Overall, Made of Honor is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of love, friendship, and growing up, making it a relatable and engaging watch for audiences.

overview: Peter Parker is an outcast high schooler abandoned by his parents as a boy, leaving him to be raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Like most teenagers, Peter is trying to figure out who he is and how he got to be the person he is today. As Peter discovers a mysterious briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a quest to understand his parents' disappearance – leading him directly to Oscorp and the lab of Dr. Curt Connors, his father's former partner. As Spider-Man is set on a collision course with Connors' alter ego, The Lizard, Peter will make life-altering choices to use his powers and shape his destiny to become a hero.
tagline: The untold story begins.
title: The Amazing Spider-Man
plot:
The Amazing Spider-Man is a 2012 superhero film directed by Marc Webb and produced by Columbia Pictures. The movie is a reboot of the Spider-Man film series, starring Andrew Garfield as Peter Parker/Spider-Man.

**Beginning:**
The film opens with a young Peter Parker (Andrew Garfield), an orphan who lives with his Aunt May (Sally Field) and Uncle Ben (Martin Sheen). Peter's life takes a dramatic turn when he is bitten by a genetically altered spider during a school field trip to a science museum. The spider's bite gives him superhuman abilities, including super strength, agility, and the ability to climb walls.

**Plot Development:**
As Peter navigates his new powers, he struggles to balance his personal life with his responsibilities as Spider-Man. He starts taking pictures for the school newspaper, where he meets Gwen Stacy (Emma Stone), a beautiful and intelligent student who becomes his love interest. Meanwhile, Norman Osborn (Rhys Ifans), a wealthy businessman and CEO of Oscorp, is secretly developing a serum that enhances human strength and agility.

Osborn's obsession with the serum leads him to create a new company, Oscorp Industries, which he uses to further his own interests. Unbeknownst to Peter, Norman's transformation into the Green Goblin is imminent, as the serum takes hold of his mind and body.

**The Villain:**
As Spider-Man, Peter must confront various villains, including the Lizard (Rhys Ifans), a scientist who has been infected with an alien parasite that gives him superhuman strength. However, it becomes clear that Norman Osborn is the true mastermind behind the chaos in New York City.

**Plot Twist:**
In a shocking twist, Peter discovers that his Uncle Ben was murdered by a burglar that he could have stopped earlier in his career as Spider-Man. This revelation sets Peter on a path of self-discovery and responsibility, as he grapples with the consequences of his actions.

**Climax:**
As Spider-Man, Peter faces off against Norman Osborn/Green Goblin in an epic battle. The two engage in a fierce fight, with Spider-Man using his wits and agility to evade the Green Goblin's attacks. In the end, Peter manages to defeat the Green Goblin, but not before he is mortally wounded.

**Ending:**
The film concludes with Peter reflecting on the lessons he has learned from his experiences as Spider-Man. He realizes that with great power comes great responsibility and that he must use his abilities for the greater good. The movie ends with Peter's Aunt May mourning the loss of her beloved Uncle Ben, while Peter looks on, determined to continue his crusade as Spider-Man.

Overall, The Amazing Spider-Man is a thrilling and emotional ride that explores the complexities of heroism and responsibility.

overview: Underwater deep-sea miners encounter a Soviet wreck and bring back a dangerous cargo to their base on the ocean floor with horrifying results. The crew of the mining base must fight to survive against a genetic mutation that hunts them down one by one.
tagline: The true meaning of fear
title: Leviathan
plot:
Leviathan is a 1989 American drama film directed by George C. Scott, who also stars in the movie alongside Richard Farnsworth.

The main theme of Leviathan revolves around the struggle for power and control within a small fishing village. The story centers around Jonas, a grizzled fisherman played by George C. Scott, who is determined to protect his community from the corrupt and oppressive local politician, Moses Prayle. As the conflict escalates, it becomes clear that Prayle's intentions are far more sinister than initially thought.

The film explores themes of corruption, greed, and the dangers of unchecked power. It also touches on the idea of a small group of individuals standing up against an oppressive system, highlighting the importance of community and collective action in the face of adversity.

Through Jonas' character, the film showcases a strong sense of moral integrity and a commitment to doing what is right, even in the face of overwhelming odds. The movie ultimately becomes a powerful commentary on the human condition, revealing the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of allowing power to corrupt individuals and institutions.

overview: Aspiring pop star Erica ends up as the entertainment at her ex-fiancé’s wedding after reluctantly taking a gig at a luxurious island resort while in the wake of a music career meltdown.
tagline: Paradise is about to get complicated.
title: Resort to Love
plot:
Resort to Love is a romantic comedy film that explores the complexities of love, relationships, and self-discovery. The story revolves around Alexis, a successful businesswoman who has given up on love after a string of failed relationships. She embarks on a solo vacation to a tropical island resort, where she meets her match in Jake, a charming and laid-back bartender.

As Alexis navigates her feelings for Jake, the film delves into themes of vulnerability, trust, and emotional intimacy. The movie shows how Alexis's guarded exterior slowly cracks, allowing her to confront her past heartaches and fears. Through her interactions with Jake, she learns to let go of her defenses and open herself up to the possibility of love.

The film also touches on the idea of finding one's true self and embracing individuality. Alexis's journey is not just about finding love but also about discovering her own passions and interests outside of her professional life. As she spends more time with Jake, she begins to reevaluate her priorities and values, leading to a sense of personal growth and transformation.

Ultimately, Resort to Love is a heartwarming tale that celebrates the beauty of human connection and the power of love to transform our lives. The movie's lighthearted tone and witty dialogue make it an enjoyable watch, while its thoughtful exploration of complex themes adds depth and nuance to the story.

overview: When a plane crash claims the lives of members of the Marshall University football team and some of its fans, the team's new coach and his surviving players try to keep the football program alive.
tagline: From the ashes we rose.
title: We Are Marshall
plot:
We Are Marshall is a powerful and emotional drama that explores the resilience of the human spirit in the face of tragedy and adversity. The film tells the true story of the Marshall University football team's journey to recovery after a devastating plane crash that killed 75 people, including most of the team.

At its core, We Are Marshall is a movie about grief, loss, and the healing power of sports. It delves into the emotional turmoil experienced by the survivors and their loved ones as they grapple with the sudden and senseless loss of so many lives. The film masterfully captures the raw emotion and anguish that follows such a tragedy, making it a deeply moving and affecting watch.

However, We Are Marshall is also a story about hope, perseverance, and the human capacity for resilience in the face of adversity. As the team struggles to come to terms with their loss, they must also navigate the challenges of rebuilding their program and finding a new sense of purpose. Through their journey, the characters discover that even in the darkest of times, there is always a way forward, and that the bonds of friendship and community can be a powerful source of strength.

One of the most striking aspects of We Are Marshall is its exploration of the theme of identity. The film asks profound questions about who we are when faced with tragedy, and how we define ourselves in the aftermath of loss. As the characters navigate their new reality, they must confront the question of what it means to be a part of a team, and how that sense of belonging can be both a source of comfort and a reminder of what has been lost.

Ultimately, We Are Marshall is a movie about the power of sports to bring people together and transcend even the darkest of circumstances. It is a testament to the human spirit's capacity for hope, resilience, and redemption, and a powerful tribute to the enduring bonds of friendship and community that can help us navigate even the most difficult of times.

overview: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.
tagline: They're the ultimate fighters. They've got the looks. They've got the moves, and the men fall at their feet.
title: DOA: Dead or Alive
plot:
DOA: Dead or Alive is a 2006 martial arts action film directed by Corey Yuen and written by David Hayter, based on the popular video game series of the same name. The movie stars Nina Dobrev, Daniel Henney, and Jaime King.

The story begins with Casey (Nina Dobrev), an American woman who wins a trip to Japan as part of a reality TV show called "Dead or Alive." The show is hosted by Ryu Hayabusa (Daniel Henney), a Japanese martial artist, and his team. Casey's goal is to win the grand prize of $1 million.

Upon arrival in Japan, Casey meets Ryu and his teammates, including Leon (Tai Chi Master) and Jann Lee (Chris Klein). As the competition progresses, Casey finds herself caught up in a web of intrigue and deception, as she discovers that the show is not what it seems. The contestants are actually being forced to fight each other, with the last person standing winning the grand prize.

As Casey navigates the treacherous world of the Dead or Alive tournament, she must also contend with her own personal demons. Her sister, Samantha (Jaime King), was killed in a brutal attack by Jann Lee, and Casey is determined to avenge her death.

Throughout the movie, Casey forms alliances and friendships with Ryu and Leon, who become her allies in the fight against Jann Lee. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, showcasing the martial arts skills of the cast.

As the tournament reaches its climax, Casey faces off against Jann Lee in an epic battle. In the end, Casey emerges victorious, but not without scars. She wins the grand prize, but more importantly, she finds a sense of closure and revenge for her sister's death.

The movie received mixed reviews from critics, with some praising the action sequences and performances, while others found the plot to be predictable and formulaic. Despite this, DOA: Dead or Alive remains a fun and entertaining martial arts film, with plenty of twists and turns to keep viewers on the edge of their seats.

Overall, DOA: Dead or Alive is a thrilling and action-packed movie that explores themes of revenge, redemption, and self-discovery. With its talented cast and impressive fight choreography, it's a must-see for fans of martial arts films.

original_title: Seal Team Eight: Behind Enemy Lines
overview: Seal Team Eight must fight their way deep into Africa's Congo, decommission a secret uranium mine, and stop our most dangerous enemy from smuggling weapon's grade yellow-cake out of the country.
tagline: The Fight For Freedom Never Ends
title: Seal Team Eight: Behind Enemy Lines
plot:
Seal Team Eight: Behind Enemy Lines is an action-thriller film that delves into the world of elite special forces operatives, exploring the complexities of loyalty, duty, and the moral gray areas that come with being a soldier. The movie follows a team of Navy SEALs as they embark on a mission to rescue a fellow operative who has been captured by enemy forces.

At its core, Seal Team Eight: Behind Enemy Lines is a film about the bonds of brotherhood and camaraderie among soldiers, who are forced to put their lives on the line for one another. The movie highlights the intense physical and emotional challenges that these operatives face, as well as the moral dilemmas they encounter when confronted with difficult decisions.

The film also touches on themes of sacrifice and loyalty, as the SEALs grapple with the consequences of their actions and the true cost of their mission. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that nothing is as black-and-white as it initially seems, and that the line between right and wrong can be blurred in the heat of battle.

Ultimately, Seal Team Eight: Behind Enemy Lines is a movie about the human condition, exploring the complexities and nuances of war and its impact on those who fight it. The film's portrayal of the SEALs' experiences serves as a reminder of the sacrifices made by these brave men and women, and the unbreakable bonds that form among them in the face of adversity.

overview: The whole Bélier family is deaf, except for sixteen year old Paula who is the important translator in her parents' day to day life especially when it comes to matters concerning the family farm. When her music teacher discovers she has a fantastic singing voice and she gets an opportunity to enter a big Radio France contest the whole family's future is set up for big changes.
title: The Bélier Family
plot:
The Bélier Family is a heartwarming French drama film that explores the complexities of family dynamics and the struggles of living with a disability. The movie revolves around the story of a deaf woman, Adèle, who returns home after being away for several years to care for her mother, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.

As Adèle navigates her way through this challenging situation, she must also confront her own feelings about her past and her relationship with her family. The film delves into themes of love, acceptance, and the importance of communication in relationships. Through Adèle's journey, the movie highlights the need for understanding and empathy towards individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing.

The Bélier Family is also a poignant exploration of the challenges faced by families dealing with dementia, as well as the impact it has on their relationships and daily lives. The film showcases the resilience and strength of the human spirit in the face of adversity, as Adèle and her family work together to care for her mother and find ways to cope with the emotional toll of her illness.

Ultimately, the movie is a powerful tribute to the beauty and diversity of deaf culture, and it celebrates the importance of inclusivity and acceptance in our communities. Through its thoughtful portrayal of complex themes and characters, The Bélier Family offers a moving and thought-provoking cinematic experience that will resonate with audiences long after the credits roll.

overview: In 1815, young Jacquou lives an idyllic peasant life with his parents in the Périgord region of France.  But one day, his childhood happiness is cruelly ended when his father is arrested, after a dispute with the arrogant Count de Nansac.  With both his parents dead, Jacquou is adopted by Bonal, a kind priest, under whose influence he grows into an assured, morally upright young man.  Now an adult, Jacquou has one desire.  To repay the Count de Nansac for the evil he once inflicted on his parents...
title: Jacquou the Rebel
plot:
Jacquou the Rebel is a 2007 French drama film directed by Michel Deville. The movie is based on the novel of the same name by Jean Giono, published in 1904.

The main theme of Jacquou the Rebel revolves around the struggle between individual freedom and societal expectations. The protagonist, Jacquou, is a young shepherd who lives in rural France during the late 19th century. He is portrayed as an outcast, rejected by his community due to his unconventional behavior and refusal to conform to traditional norms.

Throughout the film, Jacquou's character embodies the spirit of rebellion against the oppressive forces that seek to control him. His actions are driven by a desire for autonomy, self-expression, and a sense of belonging. The movie explores the tension between Jacquou's inner world and the external constraints imposed upon him by society.

The film also touches on themes of isolation, loneliness, and the human need for connection. Jacquou's relationships with others are complex and often fraught, reflecting his struggles to find acceptance and understanding in a world that seems determined to reject him.

Ultimately, Jacquou the Rebel is a poignant exploration of the human condition, delving into the complexities of individuality, nonconformity, and the search for meaning in a seemingly indifferent world.

overview: Scouring the ocean depths for treasure-laden shipwrecks is business as usual for a thrill-seeking underwater adventurer and his wisecracking buddy. But when these two cross paths with a beautiful doctor, they find themselves on the ultimate treasure hunt.
tagline: Dirk Pitt. Adventure has a new name.
title: Sahara
plot:
Sahara (2005) is an action-adventure film directed by Breck Eisner, starring Matthew McConaughey, Steve Zahn, and Penélope Cruz.

The main themes of Sahara (2005) include:

1. **Perseverance and determination**: The protagonist, Dirk Pitt (played by Matthew McConaughey), is a treasure hunter who embarks on a perilous journey to find the lost city of Thuban. Throughout the film, he faces numerous challenges and setbacks, but his unwavering determination and perseverance ultimately lead him to success.
2. **Family and legacy**: Dirk Pitt's quest for Thuban is motivated by a desire to uncover the truth about his father's disappearance and to fulfill his family's legacy as treasure hunters. This theme explores the importance of family ties and the weight of inherited responsibilities.
3. **Adventure and exploration**: Sahara (2005) is an adventure film that celebrates the thrill of exploration and discovery. The movie takes audiences on a thrilling journey across the Sahara Desert, showcasing its breathtaking landscapes and hidden treasures.
4. **Power struggles and corruption**: The film also touches on themes of power struggles and corruption, particularly in the context of the Egyptian government's pursuit of Dirk Pitt's discoveries. This subplot adds an element of tension and danger to the story.

Overall, Sahara (2005) is a thrilling adventure film that combines elements of action, romance, and exploration, with a strong emphasis on perseverance, family, and legacy.

overview: A post-apocalyptic tale, in which a lone man fights his way across America in order to protect a sacred book that holds the secrets to saving humankind.
tagline: Some will kill to have it. He will kill to protect it.
title: The Book of Eli
plot:
The Book of Eli is a post-apocalyptic drama film directed by the Hughes Brothers and starring Denzel Washington, Gary Oldman, Mila Kunis, and Ray Stevenson. Released in 2010, the movie takes place in a world devastated by nuclear war.

In the year 2035, humanity has been decimated, and society has collapsed. The story follows Eli (Denzel Washington), a lone survivor who embarks on a perilous journey to protect a sacred book known as the "Book of Eli." This book is believed to hold the secrets of the past and potentially the key to rebuilding society.

The movie begins with Eli, a rugged and stoic man, walking through a desolate landscape. He is accompanied by a young girl named Solara (Mila Kunis), who claims that she has been sent to protect him from an unknown threat. As they journey together, it becomes clear that Eli's past is shrouded in mystery, and he is haunted by his own demons.

Their path is fraught with danger, as they encounter various factions vying for control of the remaining resources. One such faction is led by a ruthless leader named Carnegie (Gary Oldman), who seeks to exploit the book's power for his own gain. Eli and Solara must navigate treacherous landscapes, avoid deadly traps, and fight off hostile groups to reach their destination.

As they journey on, Eli begins to open up to Solara about his past, revealing that he was once a member of a community called Zion. He shares with her the story of how he became the guardian of the Book of Eli, which contains the secrets of the pre-war world. The book is said to hold the key to rebuilding society and restoring hope to humanity.

Throughout their journey, Eli and Solara face numerous challenges, including encounters with marauders, radiation zones, and treacherous terrain. Along the way, they form a bond that transcends their differences, and Solara becomes a catalyst for Eli's emotional growth.

As they near their destination, Carnegie and his followers close in on them. In a tense showdown, Eli and Solara fight to protect the book from falling into the wrong hands. In the end, Eli sacrifices himself to ensure the book's safety, allowing it to be taken by a young girl named Irad (Ray Stevenson), who is destined to carry on Eli's mission.

The movie concludes with Eli's sacrifice serving as a symbol of hope and redemption in a world that has lost its way. The Book of Eli serves as a reminder of the past and provides a glimmer of light for humanity's future, setting the stage for Irad's journey to rebuild society.

Overall, The Book of Eli is a gripping post-apocalyptic drama that explores themes of hope, redemption, and the power of human connection in the face of adversity.

original_title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
overview: Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox follows a long and winding road to music stardom. Dewey perseveres through changing musical styles, an addiction to nearly every drug known and bouts of uncontrollable rage.
tagline: Life made him tough. Love made him strong. Music made him hard.
title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
plot:
Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story is a satirical comedy film that parodies music biopics, particularly those in the 1970s and 1980s. At its core, the movie explores themes of identity, authenticity, and the commodification of art.

The film follows Dewey Cox, a fictional musician who rises to fame with his unique blend of rockabilly, soul, and country music. As Dewey's career progresses, he becomes increasingly disillusioned with the music industry's emphasis on image over substance, leading him to question the true nature of his success.

One of the main themes of Walk Hard is the tension between artistic expression and commercial appeal. Dewey's journey serves as a commentary on how the music industry can manipulate artists into conforming to certain expectations, sacrificing their unique voice in the process. The film pokes fun at the excesses of 1970s rock 'n' roll, where image and spectacle often took precedence over musical merit.

The movie also explores the theme of identity and performance. Dewey's character is a masterful blend of different personas, each representing a distinct aspect of his personality. As he navigates the music industry, Dewey must constantly reinvent himself to stay relevant, leading to a sense of disconnection from his true self.

Furthermore, Walk Hard critiques the notion of authenticity in art and celebrity culture. Dewey's character is both a product of his environment and a master manipulator, blurring the lines between reality and performance. The film suggests that even the most seemingly genuine artists are often hiding behind a mask of authenticity, perpetuating a cycle of deception and self-promotion.

Overall, Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story is a witty and irreverent satire that uses humor to comment on the darker aspects of the music industry and celebrity culture.

overview: A divorced mother honks impatiently at a deranged middle-aged stranger at a red light while running late on her way to work. His road rage escalates to horrifyingly psychotic proportions as he becomes single-mindedly determined to teach her a deadly lesson for provoking him.
tagline: He can happen to anyone.
title: Unhinged
plot:
Unhinged is a 2020 American thriller film directed by Derrick Borte and written by Derek Kolstad. The movie stars Russell Crowe as Joe, a retired police officer who becomes embroiled in a cat-and-mouse game with a deranged driver (Caren Pistorius) on the road.

The main themes of Unhinged include:

1. **Violence and Aggression**: The film explores the theme of violence and aggression, particularly through the character of Joe, who is driven by a desire for justice after his wife's murder. However, as the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Joe's actions are not just about revenge, but also about his own emotional turmoil.
2. **Mental Health**: The movie touches on the theme of mental health, particularly through the character of Caren, who is revealed to be a complex and troubled individual with a dark past. Her actions become increasingly erratic and violent as the story progresses, highlighting the dangers of untreated mental illness.
3. **Revenge and Retribution**: Unhinged explores the theme of revenge and retribution, particularly through Joe's character. As he seeks to track down Caren, he becomes increasingly consumed by his desire for justice, leading him down a path of violence and destruction.
4. **The Dangers of Isolation**: The film also highlights the dangers of isolation and loneliness, particularly through Joe's character. His wife's murder has left him feeling isolated and disconnected from society, leading him to lash out at those around him.

Overall, Unhinged is a tense and suspenseful thriller that explores themes of violence, mental health, revenge, and isolation. While it may not be a traditional "good guy vs. bad guy" story, the film's complex characters and moral ambiguity make for a thought-provoking and unsettling viewing experience.

original_title: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
overview: Captain Barbossa, long believed to be dead, has come back to life and is headed to the edge of the Earth with Will Turner and Elizabeth Swann. But nothing is quite as it seems.
tagline: At the end of the world, the adventure begins.
title: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
plot:
Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End is a 2007 swashbuckling adventure film directed by Gore Verbinski and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The film is the third installment in the Pirates of the Caribbean franchise.

The story begins with Will Turner (Orlando Bloom), a blacksmith's apprentice, who has been searching for Elizabeth Swann (Keira Knightley), the governor's daughter, who has been kidnapped by Captain Barbossa (Geoffrey Rush) and his crew of pirates. Meanwhile, Lord Cutler Beckett (Tom Hollander), a ruthless and cunning agent of the East India Trading Company, is determined to eliminate all pirates from the seas.

As Will searches for Elizabeth, he meets Bootstrap Bill Turner (Stellan Skarsgård), his father, who has been cursed by the Aztec gold. The curse can only be broken when the Black Pearl's captain, Captain Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp), finds the heart of Davy Jones, a sea devil who is in charge of the Flying Dutchman.

The story takes a dramatic turn as Will and Elizabeth are rescued from Barbossa's ship by Jack Sparrow. However, their reunion is short-lived, as they soon find themselves caught up in a larger conflict between the pirates and the East India Trading Company.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Beckett has discovered the location of Davy Jones' locker, where the heart of Davy Jones can be found. The heart holds the key to breaking the curse that binds Will's father to the Flying Dutchman. However, Beckett plans to use the heart to control the seas and eliminate all pirates.

The pirates, led by Jack Sparrow, gather at the island of Tortuga to form an alliance against the East India Trading Company. The pirate lords, including Captain Barbossa, Captain Teague (Keith Richards), and Commodore Norrington (Jack Davenport), come together to elect a new captain who will lead them in their fight against Beckett.

The film's climax features an epic battle between the pirates and the East India Trading Company. Jack Sparrow, Will Turner, and Elizabeth Swann join forces with the pirate lords to defeat Beckett and his minions. In the process, Will breaks the curse that has bound his father to the Flying Dutchman, freeing him from his duties as its captain.

The film concludes with the pirates celebrating their victory over the East India Trading Company. Jack Sparrow is hailed as a hero, and he sets sail on the Black Pearl once again, ready for his next adventure. The story ends with Will and Elizabeth reunited, and Will's father finally at peace.

Overall, Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End is an action-packed adventure film that explores themes of loyalty, friendship, and redemption. The film features memorable characters, including Captain Jack Sparrow, who has become a cultural icon in his own right.

overview: Rosetta and new arrival Chloe band together to try to break the garden fairies' legendary losing streak in the Pixie Hollow Games, a sports spectacle filled with pixie pageantry, fantastic fairy events and hilarious surprises.
title: Pixie Hollow Games
plot:
Pixie Hollow Games is a 23-minute animated television special based on Disney's Disney Fairies franchise, first broadcast on Disney Channel on 19 November 2011. Produced by Disneytoon Studios and animated by Prana Studios, it features the voices of Megan Hilty as Rosetta, Brenda Song as the newcomer Chloe, Jason Dolley, Tiffany Thornton and Zendaya, along with returning cast members Mae Whitman as Tinker Bell, Lucy Liu, Raven-Symoné, Pamela Adlon and Angela Bartys. Inspired loosely by J. M. Barrie's Peter Pan by way of Disney's adaptation, the story follows the fairies of Pixie Hollow as they compete in an Olympic-style tournament.

Rosetta, an elegant garden fairy who prefers beauty and comfort to hard work, meets Chloe, an enthusiastic new garden fairy who has been training for the Pixie Hollow Games, a contest between the different fairy talents.
