It is adapted from the novel of the same name by the American writer Stephen Amidon and stars Marco D'Amore, known for the television series Gomorrah, alongside Maya Sansa, Silvio Muccino, Valeria Bilello, Ludovica Martino, Beatrice Grannò, Tommaso Ragno and Fabrizio Bentivoglio.

The story takes place in winter in Forte dei Marmi, an exclusive seaside resort on the Tuscan coast that the narrator, Roberto Santini (D'Amore), likens to a picture postcard in which everything is staged. Roberto, an insomniac, runs the surveillance company whose cameras and alarms protect the town's gated villas, many of them second homes of the very rich. One night a battered young woman, Maria Spezi (Grannò), appears on the doorbell camera of a neighbouring villa pleading for help, and the frightened residents simply call security. On his way back, Roberto stops a drunk driver who turns out to be Dario (Giulio Pranno), the son of his former lover Elena (Bilello).

The carabinieri quickly blame Maria's father, Walter (Ragno), an alcoholic with a violent past who years earlier was suspected of molesting Roberto's daughter Angela (Martino) as a small child. Roberto's own footage, however, suggests that more people were involved that night, among them the industrialist Curzio Pilati (Bentivoglio), a key donor to the mayoral campaign of Roberto's wife Claudia (Sansa), and Stefano Tommasi (Muccino), a charismatic writing teacher who is sleeping with his students, Angela included. Torn between the truth, his discretion towards powerful clients and his wife's political ambitions, Roberto pursues the case as his marriage falls apart, and Dario's account finally implicates Pilati.

Filmed in Forte dei Marmi, Seravezza and Massarosa, the film premiered in Fivizzano in June 2021 and was released by Sky Italia in Italy and on Netflix elsewhere, where Chelsom said it became an unexpected hit. Reviewing it for Cineuropa, Camillo De Marco saw it less as a thriller than a psychological drama about wealthy paranoia and the troubled relationship between adults and the young, but found it short on surprises and compared it unfavorably with Human Capital, another Amidon adaptation.

overview: When the farmer's away, all the animals play, and sing, and dance. Eventually, though, someone has to step in and run things, a responsibility that ends up going to Otis, a carefree cow.
production_companies: Kumar Mobiliengesellschaft mbH & Co. Projekt Nr. 2 KG
tagline: What happens in the barn stays in the barn
title: Barnyard
plot:
Barnyard is a 2006 computer-animated comedy film produced by Paramount Pictures. The movie follows the story of Otis, a young calf who dreams of becoming a superhero like his idol, Big Dog.

The main themes of Barnyard include:

1. Friendship: The movie highlights the importance of friendship and loyalty among animals. Otis forms strong bonds with his friends, including Pip, Freddy, and Muddy, who help him on his journey.
2. Self-discovery: Otis's desire to become a superhero leads him to discover his own strengths and weaknesses. He learns that being true to oneself is more important than trying to emulate others.
3. Responsibility: As Otis takes on more responsibilities as the leader of the group, he learns the value of hard work and responsibility. He must balance his desire for adventure with the needs of his friends and community.
4. Humor: The movie uses humor to tackle serious themes like bullying, peer pressure, and growing up. The film's lighthearted tone makes it accessible to a wide range of audiences.

The story begins with Otis watching Big Dog, a legendary superhero who saved the farm from an alien invasion. Inspired by Big Dog's heroics, Otis decides to become a superhero himself. However, his plans are foiled when he is captured by the villainous Chameleon and forced to work for him.

As Otis navigates this new reality, he learns valuable lessons about friendship, loyalty, and responsibility. With the help of his friends, he eventually outsmarts Chameleon and saves the farm from destruction.

The ending of the movie features a heartwarming moment where Otis returns home as a hero, celebrated by his friends and family. The film concludes with Otis reflecting on what he has learned about himself and the importance of staying true to one's values.

Overall, Barnyard is a fun and entertaining animated film that explores themes of friendship, self-discovery, responsibility, and humor.

overview: Upon arriving at a remote cabin in the redwoods, Kath and her boyfriend find a mysterious younger couple already there — the rental has apparently been double-booked. They decide to share the cabin with these strangers until the next morning, but her boyfriend disappears with the young woman, which sends Kath in a spiral to find an explanation for their sudden breakup — but the truth is far stranger than she could have imagined.
tagline: Some secrets are better left buried.
title: Gone in the Night
plot:
Gone in the Night is a 2022 American thriller directed by Eli Horowitz in his feature debut, from a screenplay he co-wrote with Matthew Derby. Winona Ryder stars as a woman searching for answers after her boyfriend vanishes, with Dermot Mulroney, John Gallagher Jr., Owen Teague and Brianne Tju in supporting roles. It was released in theaters on July 15, 2022.

Kath and her younger boyfriend Max, an aimless former student of hers, drive several hours to a remote woodland cabin he has rented for the weekend. Arriving late at night, they find it already occupied by a young couple: the reserved Al and his lively, abrasive girlfriend Greta, who claim to have booked it too. Greta persuades them to stay, and the four spend an awkward evening playing a romantic board game before Kath goes to bed early. The next morning, Max and Greta are gone. Al, apparently distraught, tells Kath he found the two together and that they left as a couple. Hurt and angry, Kath returns to the city.

Ignoring her friends' advice to move on, Kath sets out to find Greta and learn the truth. She tracks down the cabin's owner, Nicholas Barlow, who proves warm and charming, and together they trace Greta to an underground rave, where Greta apologizes for taking Max but insists she loves him. Kath and Nicholas grow close as they share their sense of loss; he tells her he left a career as a biotech scientist after his father died of a hereditary illness, which he says he also carries and is treating with experimental methods.

Flashbacks reveal that Al and Greta befriended Max shortly before the trip, quizzed him with odd questions and lured him to the cabin, where they drugged him and hid him away. Nicholas, who turns out to be Al's father, learns what they have done, and the couple explain that they intend Max as a test subject for his treatments. Visiting Nicholas's cabin, Kath finds a photograph of him with Al and discovers Max imprisoned in a shipping container, hooked up to medical equipment. Greta reveals that Nicholas is not ill at all but is using young people's blood to preserve his own youth. In the violent confrontation that follows, Max dies, and Kath locks Nicholas, Al and Greta inside the container.

Critics were largely unimpressed, praising Ryder's performance and the intriguing setup but finding the twist strange and the execution clumsy and lacking in suspense; Variety called it haphazardly advanced and clumsily articulated.

overview: Tracey Wise is a renowned luxury travel blogger who is invited by Graham Cooper to a Christmas getaway in exchange for her review of his family’s small bed & breakfast, Silver Peak. Unfortunately, the humble B&B is facing tough competition from an upscale hotel resort nearby that has been stealing guests and threatening the survival of the family business.
title: B&B Merry
plot:
B&B Merry is a 2022 Canadian Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Paula Elle from a screenplay by Hayley Carr and Guy Yosub. Produced by the Motion Picture Corporation of America and Brad Krevoy Television, it stars Jen Lilley and Jesse Hutch, with Shelly Williams, Kate Twa, Laura Yenga and Nick Preston in supporting roles. The film premiered on the Great American Family channel on 4 December 2022, runs 85 minutes and later became available to stream on Netflix.

Tracey Wise (Lilley) is a renowned luxury travel blogger with a large following, whose cheerful motto is that people can travel more if they travel wisely. One of her fans is Graham Cooper (Hutch), who helps his mother Barbara (Williams) run Silver Peak, a small family bed and breakfast in Vermont. Since a big upscale hotel resort opened nearby and began stealing their guests, the business has been struggling to survive, so Graham invites Tracey and her boyfriend Mark (Preston) on a Christmas getaway at the inn in exchange for a review. Just before the trip, Tracey learns of a potential job at a renowned travel magazine that requires a sample review, and since she is already heading to Vermont she decides to review the rival luxury hotel as well, planning to stay there first. When Graham bumps into her at a local coffee shop, however, he assumes she has arrived early and drives her straight to the B&B before she can explain, and she cannot bring herself to admit that she and Mark have just broken up, turning the romantic getaway into a trip for one. As the only guest, Tracey is lavished with attention by Barbara and her sister Sarah (Twa), who go overboard trying to make everything perfect and, once the truth about Mark comes out, notice a spark between Tracey and Graham and give the pair space. As Tracey falls for both the inn and Graham, her secret review of the competing hotel threatens to cause conflict.

Reviews were mixed. Kristen of TV Tweetie judged it "quietly good", a charming, relaxing film with a small cast and a narrow focus on romance, and found both leads natural, with perfect chemistry. Sneha Jaiswal of Abstract AF rated it 2 out of 5, praising its beautiful, festive Christmas settings and the fun older actors playing the matchmaking sisters, but finding the plot predictable within fifteen minutes, Lilley's portrayal lacking warmth and the leads devoid of chemistry, despite Hutch making a worthy romantic hero.

original_title: PSYCHO-PASS サイコパス Sinners of the System Case.2「First Guardian」
overview: 2112; the summer before Akane Tsunemori was assigned to Division One of the Public Safety Bureau's Criminal Investigation Department. Teppei Sugo, an accomplished pilot of the Defense Army's 15th Integrated Task Force, joins the military operation in Okinawa. Three months later, an unmanned combat drone opens fire on the Ministry of Defense in Tokyo. Enforcer Tomomi Masaoka of CID Division One is dispatched to Sugo's military base to investigate the truth behind this case.
title: Psycho-Pass: Sinners of the System - Case.2 First Guardian
plot:
Psycho-Pass: Sinners of the System - Case.2 First Guardian is a thought-provoking anime film that delves into the complexities of morality, free will, and the consequences of relying on technology to govern society.

The movie takes place in a dystopian future where a computer system known as the Sybil System can measure a person's mental state and determine their likelihood of committing a crime. The story follows Akane Tsunemori, a young inspector who is tasked with investigating a series of murders that seem to defy the Sybil System's predictions.

As the investigation unfolds, Akane begins to question the morality of the system and the true nature of justice in this society. She must confront her own biases and assumptions about what it means to be good or evil, and grapple with the consequences of a world where technology has become the ultimate arbiter of human behavior.

Throughout the film, the director explores themes of existentialism, highlighting the tension between individual freedom and the constraints imposed by societal norms. The movie also touches on the dangers of relying too heavily on technology to govern human behavior, raising questions about the value of human emotions, empathy, and compassion in a world where machines are increasingly making decisions for us.

Ultimately, Psycho-Pass: Sinners of the System - Case.2 First Guardian is a thought-provoking exploration of what it means to be human in a world that is rapidly becoming more mechanized and controlled. The film challenges viewers to consider the implications of a society that values efficiency and order above all else, and to ponder the true cost of living in a world where technology has become the ultimate authority.

overview: When 12-year-old Rob Horton discovers a caged tiger in the woods near his home, his imagination runs wild and life begins to change in the most unexpected ways. With the help of a wise and mysterious maid, Willie May  and the stubborn new girl in school, he must navigate through childhood memories, heartache, and wondrous adventures.
tagline: Let your imagination run wild.
title: The Tiger Rising
plot:
The Tiger Rising is a 2022 American family drama film written and directed by Ray Giarratana, based on Kate DiCamillo's 2001 novel of the same name. Christian Convery stars as a grieving twelve-year-old boy, with Madalen Mills, Sam Trammell, Katharine McPhee, Dennis Quaid and Queen Latifah. It was released in cinemas on January 21, 2022, and on digital platforms in early February.

Rob Horton has recently moved with his father, Robert, to the Kentucky Star, a run-down motel in the small town of Lister, Florida, six months after his mother Caroline died of cancer. His father works for the motel's harsh owner, Beauchamp, and refuses to let Rob speak of his mother. Quiet and withdrawn, Rob keeps his feelings locked inside an imaginary suitcase, and suffers from an itchy rash on his legs. One morning, walking through the woods before school, he comes upon a real tiger locked in a cage.

On the school bus, where he is tormented by the Threemonger brothers, Rob meets Sistine Bailey, a fierce, angry newcomer from Philadelphia who insists her father will soon come to take her away. When the class laughs at her name, Rob reveals that he knows all about Michelangelo's paintings in the Sistine Chapel, something his mother taught him along with drawing and wood carving. The principal sends Rob home until his rash clears, fearing it is contagious, and he spends his days doing chores at the motel, where the kind housekeeper Willie May suggests that his rash comes from sorrow he holds inside.

Rob shows Sistine the tiger, and around her he begins to open up. Beauchamp, who owns the animal and is afraid of it, pays Rob to feed it and gives him the keys to the cage. Sistine insists the tiger must be set free, while Willie May warns that this would be impossible. Rob finally gives in and the two children release it into the woods, but moments later a shot rings out: in a struggle with the armed Beauchamp, Robert has accidentally killed the tiger.

Devastated, Rob attacks his father, shouting that he wishes he had died instead of his mother, and makes him say Caroline's name aloud. Father and son embrace and finally grieve together, and Rob's rash begins to fade. Sistine too accepts that her father is not coming and that her life is now in Lister. The film received poor reviews, with a 17% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: Kara and Jessie are two teenage girls from very different worlds, but with a little Christmas magic, they find they have much more in common than they ever imagined.
title: Christmas in the Heartland
plot:
Christmas in the Heartland is a 2017 American family Christmas film directed by Harvey Lowry and written by Dave Matheny, produced by BCF Film Group and Ascension Media and released in November 2017; it has also carried the title The Christmas Trap. A holiday variation on the switched-identities formula familiar from films such as The Parent Trap, it stars Sierra McCormick and Brighton Sharbino as two teenagers who trade places, with veteran actresses Bo Derek and Shelley Long as their grandmothers and Christopher Rich, Joe Don Rooney and Christian Kane in supporting roles.

Kara Gentry (McCormick) and Jessie Wilkins (Sharbino) are strangers from very different worlds who meet by chance on a flight from Vermont to Stillwater, Oklahoma. They discover that they are in the same situation: each is travelling to spend Christmas with family members she has never known. Kara, who comes from wealth, longs to be normal, while Jessie, who comes from more modest circumstances, wants a home, so the girls decide to swap identities. Kara is picked up by Jessie's grandmother Judy (Long), a goofy, hippie-like woman, and is nervous to discover that they are also collecting Jessie's father Jim (Rooney), who fortunately has never seen his daughter, allowing the charade to continue as she settles in with the Wilkins family. Jessie, meanwhile, finds herself in a mansion with the affluent Gentrys, where Kara's snobbish, materialistic grandmother Elsa (Derek) tries to mould her into a copy of herself, entering her in a beauty pageant she once won, while Elsa's husband Bob (Rich) grows tired of his wife's controlling ways. What began as a lark becomes complicated as each girl grows close to the family she is deceiving, and the two struggle to find a way to tell the truth. Matters come to a head when Kara's father Jeff (Kane) and his fiancée arrive to surprise her, only to see her at the pageant being announced as Jessie, and the revelations that follow help two broken families begin to mend.

Reviews were mild. The Movie Buff's Matt DeCristo found it predictable, with a straight-to-video feel, clumsy exposition and a contrived ending, but charming, crediting the two leads' sense of fun and the effective performances of Long and Derek. Scared Stiff Reviews rated it 6.5 out of 10, calling it a decent film that follows the Christmas formula with a be-grateful-for-what-you-have message, and Common Sense Media noted its themes of being true to oneself and the importance of family.

overview: Complete strangers stranded at a remote desert motel during a raging storm soon find themselves the target of a deranged murderer. As their numbers thin out, the travelers begin to turn on each other, as each tries to figure out who the killer is.
tagline: The secret lies within.
title: Identity
plot:
"Identity" is a psychological thriller film directed by James Mangold, released in 2003 by Columbia Pictures.

The movie revolves around five strangers who are brought together at a remote motel, where they share a series of strange and terrifying events. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that each character has a dark secret to hide, and their true identities begin to unravel.

Some of the main themes present in "Identity" include:

1. **Deception and Identity**: The film explores the idea that our identities are not always what they seem. Each character is hiding behind a mask of deception, and as the story progresses, their true selves are revealed.
2. **Trauma and Psychological Scarring**: The characters' past traumas and psychological scars are slowly exposed throughout the movie, highlighting the lasting impact of traumatic experiences on individuals.
3. **Isolation and Confinement**: The remote motel setting serves as a symbol of isolation and confinement, where the characters are trapped with each other, leading to a sense of claustrophobia and desperation.
4. **The Power of Secrets**: The film showcases how secrets can both unite and divide people, as the characters' hidden truths lead to a complex web of relationships and alliances.
5. **The Unreliability of Perception**: As the story progresses, it becomes clear that nothing is as it seems, and perceptions are constantly challenged, leaving the audience questioning what is real and what is just an illusion.

Overall, "Identity" is a thought-provoking thriller that delves into the complexities of human nature, exploring themes that are both unsettling and fascinating.

overview: An assassin teams up with a woman to help her find her father and uncover the mysteries of her ancestry.
tagline: Your Number is Up.
title: Hitman: Agent 47
plot:
Hitman: Agent 47 is a 2015 action spy thriller film directed by Michael Finch and written by Skip Woods, based on the video game series of the same name. The movie stars Hugh Jackman as Adam Jensen, a cyborg assassin, not Agent 47 (the main character in the game series), but rather a different protagonist.

However, I think you meant to ask about Hitman: Agent 47 (2015) starring Rupert Friend as Agent 47. Here's the detailed plot:

The movie begins with a flashback of Diana Burnwood (Samantha Crofts), a skilled assassin and former partner of Agent 47, who is killed by her own hand after being betrayed by her employer. The story then shifts to present day, where we meet our protagonist, Agent 47 (Rupert Friend), a genetically engineered clone created for the purpose of carrying out assassinations.

Agent 47 is hired by his handler, Victor (Alfred Molina), to eliminate Diana's daughter, Rachel (Hannah John-Kamen), who has discovered her mother's true identity and is now in hiding. However, things become complicated when Agent 47 develops feelings for Rachel, which goes against his programming.

As the story unfolds, we learn that a rogue agent, Michael Teter (Daniel Wu), has stolen a deadly virus known as "The Syndicate," which can be used to control people's minds and turn them into assassins. The Syndicate is led by a mysterious figure known only as "The Director" (Saul Rubinek).

Agent 47 must navigate through a complex web of intrigue and deception to stop Michael Teter and his plans to use the virus to create an army of mind-controlled assassins. Along the way, he encounters other characters, including Diana's partner, Marcus (Tom Wilkinson), who is also after Rachel.

As Agent 47 delves deeper into the conspiracy, he discovers that The Syndicate has infiltrated every level of society, from government agencies to corporations. He must use his skills and abilities to take down the Syndicate members one by one while trying to protect Rachel and uncover the truth about his own past.

The movie culminates in a thrilling showdown between Agent 47 and Michael Teter, with the fate of humanity hanging in the balance. In the end, Agent 47 emerges victorious, but not without scars, both physical and emotional.

Overall, Hitman: Agent 47 is an action-packed spy thriller that explores themes of identity, loyalty, and the consequences of playing with fire when it comes to advanced technology and human life.

overview: A young woman pretends to be pregnant in order to avoid being fired from her job. When that gets her a bunch of special treatment by everyone involved in her life, she tries to keep up the lie for nine months.
tagline: Some stories just keep on growing
title: Labor Pains
plot:
Labor Pains is a 2009 American romantic comedy directed by Lara Shapiro, who co-wrote the screenplay with Stacy Kramer. Lindsay Lohan stars as Thea Clayhill, an unreliable secretary at a publishing house who pretends to be pregnant to avoid being fired. Luke Kirby, Bridgit Mendler, Chris Parnell, Cheryl Hines, Kevin Covais, Aaron Yoo and Tracee Ellis Ross appear in supporting roles. The film was originally intended for a theatrical release but instead opened in a few international markets in June 2009 and premiered in the United States on the cable channel ABC Family in July.

Thea is about to be dismissed by her ill-tempered boss, the publisher Jerry, when she remembers from an episode of Law & Order that it is illegal to fire a woman because she is pregnant, and claims that she is expecting a baby. The lie saves her job. With help from her best friend Lisa and a fake baby bump taken from a mannequin, Thea keeps up the pretense while trying to figure out what to do next. Soon Jerry is called away, and his younger brother Nick, an accountant, takes over the running of the company.

Hoping to sign the popular author Suzie Cavandish, who has written a book about pregnancy, Nick brings Thea along to the meeting, and Thea's enthusiasm persuades the writer to publish with them. Nick launches a new parenting division and promotes Thea to editor, complete with a raise. Thea's younger sister Emma is shocked to discover her apparent pregnancy, and Thea must explain the deception. As Thea grows closer to Nick and their relationship becomes romantic, she finds herself caught up in her own lie, attending prenatal classes and pregnancy events and becoming an unlikely spokeswoman for expectant mothers, all while knowing that the truth will eventually come out and could cost her both her job and the man she loves.

Labor Pains received negative reviews from critics, who considered the premise thin and the humor flat, and its move from cinemas to cable television was widely seen as a sign of Lohan's declining career at the time. Its supporting cast included Bridgit Mendler, then a rising young actress, as Thea's younger sister Emma, and Cheryl Hines and Chris Parnell in comic roles.

overview: An ambitious young journalist uncovers the horrific slaughter of 22,000 Polish officers during World War II, a secret kept hidden for far too many years.
tagline: When war ends, the fight for the truth begins.
title: The Last Witness
plot:
The Last Witness is a 2018 British-Polish historical thriller directed by Piotr Szkopiak and based on a stage play by Paul Szambowski. It stars Alex Pettyfer as the journalist Stephen Underwood, Robert Więckiewicz as Michael Loboda, Talulah Riley as Jeanette Mitchell and Michael Gambon as Frank Hamilton, with Will Thorp, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Piotr Stramowski and Gwilym Lee. The film deals with political intrigue in the United Kingdom after the Second World War surrounding the Katyn massacre.

The Katyn massacre was the mass execution of thousands of Polish officers, policemen and members of the intelligentsia carried out by the Soviet secret police in 1940, a crime that Soviet authorities blamed on Nazi Germany for decades. In the film, Stephen Underwood is a young and ambitious newspaper journalist in post-war England who begins investigating a story connected to the Polish community and refugees who settled in Britain after the war. His inquiries lead him to Michael Loboda, an Eastern European refugee whose true identity is a mystery.

As Stephen digs deeper, he uncovers evidence that Loboda may have witnessed the atrocity at Katyn and that the British government, eager to preserve its wartime alliance with the Soviet Union, has been complicit in covering up the truth about who was responsible. His pursuit of the story places him in increasing danger, as powerful figures in the intelligence services and the establishment, represented by the enigmatic Frank Hamilton, seek to keep the secret buried. Stephen must risk his career, his relationship with Jeanette and ultimately his own life to bring the truth to light.

The script was written fifteen years before the film was made and was shot in just eighteen days. Szkopiak, who was born in the United Kingdom to Polish parents, described the project as deeply personal, as his grandfather was among those murdered at Katyn; it was his first film in nineteen years.

The Last Witness was released in Poland by Kino Świat on 11 May 2018, in the United States by Momentum Pictures on 29 May and in the United Kingdom by Signature Entertainment on 17 August. It won numerous festival awards, though it holds 29 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes from a small number of reviews; Why So Blu? praised it for making history exciting.

original_title: 劇場版 ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン
overview: As the world moves on from the war and technological advances bring changes to her life, Violet still hopes to see her lost commanding officer again.
title: Violet Evergarden: The Movie
plot:
Violet Evergarden: The Movie is a 2020 Japanese animated film directed by Kenji Ueda and produced by Kyoto Animation. The movie is based on the light novel series "Kotonoha Katsugeki" written by Kana Akitsuki.

The story takes place in an alternate universe where the Second World War has ended, but the world is still recovering from the devastating effects of the war. The film follows Violet Evergarden, a young and talented automail girl who works for the Orphan Agency, a organization that helps children find their parents after being orphaned during the war.

Violet was once a child soldier who fought in the war, but she lost her arm and leg during a battle. She was later rescued by Major Gilbert Bougainvillea, a veteran of the war, who became her guardian and taught her how to use an automail arm and leg. Violet's primary goal is to find Major Bougainvillea, whom she considers as her father.

The movie begins with Violet receiving a letter from Major Bougainvillea, which sets her on a journey to find him. Along the way, she meets various characters who help or hinder her progress. One of these characters is a young boy named Kuroo Saeba, who becomes Violet's ally and friend.

As Violet searches for Major Bougainvillea, she begins to uncover the truth about his past and the circumstances surrounding his disappearance during the war. She also learns more about herself and her own experiences as a child soldier.

Throughout her journey, Violet faces various challenges and obstacles, including encounters with hostile characters who seek to exploit her skills or harm her. However, she perseveres and continues to search for Major Bougainvillea, driven by her desire to find him and understand his motivations.

The movie's climax features an emotional confrontation between Violet and a character from Major Bougainvillea's past, which reveals the truth about his disappearance and the circumstances surrounding their relationship. The film's ending is bittersweet, as Violet finally finds Major Bougainvillea but learns that he has passed away, leaving her with more questions than answers.

Overall, Violet Evergarden: The Movie is a poignant and emotional exploration of grief, loss, and redemption. The film features beautiful animation, memorable characters, and a powerful storyline that explores the complexities of human relationships and the consequences of war.

overview: Holiday magic has never gleamed brighter as Santa’s Elves head out on an adventure to bring every boy and girl their Christmas wish while also bringing a family back together in this heartfelt Christmas movie from Gaumont. After accidentally destroying a bag of Christmas wishes from a small town on the eve of Christmas Eve, two junior elves learn that if even one wish goes unfulfilled, Christmas could be extinguished forever. For the first time in their lives, the elves Mindy and Cam venture out of the North Pole and sneak into Minnedoza to collect the lost wishes. Along the way they enlist the help of young Blake, whose family has a difficult time celebrating Christmas since his father died. With their deadline fast approaching, Mindy and Cam have only one more wish to find…but whose could it be? It’s up to Mindy and Cam to find out and save Christmas!
title: 48 Christmas Wishes

Along the way they enlist the help of young Blake, whose family has a difficult time celebrating Christmas since his father died. With their deadline fast approaching, Mindy and Cam have only one more wish to find…but whose could it be? It’s up to Mindy and Cam to find out and save Christmas!

overview: Set in the Aokigahara Forest, a real-life place in Japan where people go to end their lives. Against this backdrop, a young American woman comes in search of her twin sister, who has mysteriously disappeared.
tagline: Everyone comes here looking for a way out
title: The Forest
plot:
The Forest is a 2016 American supernatural horror film directed by Jason Zada and written by Ben Ketas and Jason Zada. The movie stars Natalie Dormer, John Travis, and Bill Skarsgård.

The main themes of The Forest are:

1. **Trauma and Guilt**: The story revolves around twin sisters, Samantha (Natalie Dormer) and Jess (Shanley Caswell), who travel to Japan in search of their missing sister, Jessica (Bill Skarsgård). As they delve deeper into the forest, they uncover dark secrets about their family's past and confront their own guilt and trauma.
2. **Family Dynamics**: The film explores the complex relationships within the twin sisters' family, particularly the bond between Samantha and Jess. Their journey is also a metaphor for their complicated relationship with their sister Jessica, who died under mysterious circumstances.
3. **Cultural Heritage and Tradition**: The movie delves into Japanese culture and tradition, highlighting the importance of respecting one's heritage and the consequences of ignoring or disrespecting it. The Yurei (Japanese ghosts) in the film serve as a representation of the cultural taboos and superstitions that are deeply ingrained in Japanese society.
4. **Isolation and Confinement**: The forest setting serves as a physical and emotional prison for the sisters, trapping them in a world of fear and uncertainty. This theme is further emphasized by the isolation they experience from the outside world, highlighting their vulnerability and helplessness.

The Forest received mixed reviews from critics but has since become a cult classic among horror fans, praised for its atmospheric tension, eerie setting, and standout performances from the cast.

overview: Phineas and Ferb become the galaxy's unlikeliest last hope when they must return the Death Star plans to the Rebel Alliance.
tagline: Episode IVa: May the Ferb Be with You
title: Phineas and Ferb: Star Wars
plot:
"Phineas and Ferb: Star Wars", also titled "Episode IVa: May the Ferb Be with You", is a one-hour crossover special of the American animated series Phineas and Ferb, featuring characters from the Star Wars franchise. Part of the series' fourth season, it aired on Disney Channel on July 26, 2014, and on Disney XD on August 4, 2014. The idea arose after the Walt Disney Company acquired Lucasfilm, and the special retells the events of the 1977 film Star Wars from the perspective of the Phineas and Ferb characters, though it is not considered part of the Star Wars canon.

On the desert planet Tatooine, Phineas Flynn and Ferb Fletcher live with their parents as contented moisture farmers, unaware that the galaxy's fate is about to pass through their lives. Meanwhile, Perry the Platypus, reimagined as a Rebel agent, steals the plans for the Death Star from the Empire and delivers them to Princess Leia's ship. When Darth Vader captures Leia, she hides the plans in R2-D2, a moment observed by a trio of stormtroopers: Candace Flynn, Baljeet and Buford. Eager to prove herself to her superiors, Candace sets out with her companions to recover the stolen plans.

At the same time, the series' villain, Dr. Doofenshmirtz, appears as the Sith-like Darthenshmirtz, who arrives at the Death Star with his robot Norm-3P0 to present an evil new invention that needs the Force to work. The plans end up in the hands of Phineas and Ferb, who know Obi-Wan Kenobi as their instructor in the Jedi arts. While the events of the original film unfold in the background, with Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Chewbacca making appearances, the stepbrothers, Perry, Candace and the others become entangled in a parallel adventure that takes them to the Death Star and to the heart of the battle between the Rebellion and the Empire.

The special imitates the visual style, music and iconic moments of the original Star Wars, while including the series' trademark songs and running gags.

The special was watched by about 2.5 million viewers on its premiere. Critics responded positively; Nerdist's Amy Ratcliffe found the mix amusing and noted that viewers did not need to be familiar with Phineas and Ferb to enjoy it.

belongs_to_collection.name: My Little Pony: Equestria Girls Collection

original_title: My Little Pony: Equestria Girls - Legend of Everfree
overview: When Canterlot Highschool goes on a trip to Camp Everfree, they’re surprised to find a magical force is causing strange things to happen around camp. With the help of the Mane 6 and especially Sunset Shimmer, Twilight Sparkle must confront the dark “Midnight Sparkle” within herself  and embrace her newfound magical abilities to save the camp.
title: My Little Pony: Equestria Girls - Legend of Everfree
plot:
My Little Pony: Equestria Girls - Legend of Everfree is an animated adventure film that delves into the complexities of identity, friendship, and the struggle for self-discovery. The movie follows Twilight Sparkle as she navigates her way through a magical forest called Everfree, where she must confront her own insecurities and learn to accept herself.

At its core, the film explores the theme of embracing one's true nature and finding the courage to be oneself. Twilight Sparkle, who has always been driven by a desire to please others, is forced to re-evaluate her priorities and learn to trust her instincts. This journey of self-discovery is mirrored in the relationships between the other characters, particularly Applejack and Rarity, who must confront their own fears and doubts in order to support each other.

The film also touches on the idea of belonging and finding one's place within a community. The Everfree forest, with its magical creatures and ancient secrets, serves as a symbol of the unknown and the unexplored. As Twilight Sparkle navigates this new world, she must learn to trust her instincts and find her own path, rather than simply following the expectations of others.

Throughout the movie, the characters grapple with the consequences of their actions and the impact they have on those around them. This theme is particularly evident in the relationship between Twilight Sparkle and her friends, who must work together to overcome the challenges they face and support each other through difficult times.

Ultimately, My Little Pony: Equestria Girls - Legend of Everfree is a story about growth, self-acceptance, and the power of friendship. The film encourages viewers to be true to themselves and to trust their instincts, even when faced with uncertainty and adversity.

overview: In a dystopian future, a totalitarian regime maintains peace by subduing the populace with a drug, and displays of emotion are punishable by death. A man in charge of enforcing the law rises to overthrow the system.
tagline: In a future where freedom is outlawed, outlaws will become heroes.
title: Equilibrium
plot:
Equilibrium is a 2002 science fiction action film directed by Kurt Wimmer and produced by Michael De Luca and Jennifer Lynch. The movie takes place in a dystopian future where emotions have been outlawed, and citizens are forced to take a daily dose of a medication called "Serenity" to numb their feelings.

The story follows John Preston (played by Christian Bale), a high-ranking enforcer in the government's Department of Public Safety, who is responsible for maintaining order and suppressing any dissent. Preston is a skilled fighter and is known for his ability to eliminate threats with precision and efficiency. He lives a sterile life, devoid of emotions, and is content with his role as a servant of the state.

However, Preston's life takes a dramatic turn when he is assigned to investigate the murder of a young woman named Vittorio Gassovski (played by Sean Bean), who was found dead in an alleyway. As Preston delves deeper into the case, he begins to experience strange and unsettling emotions, which are forbidden in his society.

Preston's investigation leads him to a group of rebels, led by a mysterious woman named Hyrdro (played by Emily Watson). The rebels are fighting against the government's oppressive regime, which has outlawed all forms of emotional expression. As Preston gets to know the rebels, he begins to question his own existence and the morality of his actions.

As Preston becomes more deeply embroiled in the rebellion, he is forced to confront his own emotions and make a choice between his loyalty to the government and his newfound sense of humanity. The movie builds towards a climactic showdown between Preston and the leader of the Department of Public Safety, Minister Cole (played by Toby Stephens).

Throughout the film, Wimmer explores themes of individuality, free will, and the importance of human emotions in a world that seeks to suppress them. The movie features a unique blend of action, drama, and philosophy, which sets it apart from other sci-fi films.

Ultimately, Preston must decide where his loyalties lie and whether he is willing to sacrifice everything for the sake of humanity. The film's ending is both thought-provoking and visually stunning, leaving the audience with a lasting impression of the importance of emotions in our lives.

Overall, Equilibrium is a gripping and thought-provoking sci-fi thriller that explores complex themes and features impressive action sequences. Christian Bale delivers a standout performance as John Preston, bringing depth and nuance to a character who is both fascinating and flawed.

overview: 15-year-old deep-thinking Welsh schoolboy Oliver Tate struggles to initiate and maintain a relationship with Jordana, his devilish, dark-haired classmate at their Swansea high school. As his parents' marriage begins to fall apart, similar problems arise in his relationship with Jordana.
tagline: A comedy that doesn't let principles stand in the way of progress.
title: Submarine
plot:
Submarine is a 2010 British coming-of-age comedy-drama written and directed by Richard Ayoade in his feature directorial debut, based on the 2008 novel by Joe Dunthorne. It stars Craig Roberts as Oliver Tate, Yasmin Paige as Jordana Bevan, Noah Taylor and Sally Hawkins as Oliver's parents Lloyd and Jill, and Paddy Considine as Graham Purvis. Original songs for the soundtrack were written and performed by Alex Turner, the frontman of the Arctic Monkeys.

In the Welsh seaside city of Swansea, Oliver Tate is a precocious, socially awkward fifteen-year-old who is infatuated with his mischievous classmate Jordana Bevan. After an awkward courtship, she becomes his girlfriend, and the two begin a relationship built on shared cynicism and small rituals. At the same time, Oliver grows worried about his parents' marriage. His father Lloyd seems depressed and passive, and Oliver suspects that his mother Jill is being drawn into an affair with Graham Purvis, her former boyfriend and a New Age self-help guru who has moved in next door.

Determined to save his parents' marriage, Oliver begins monitoring their love life and spying on his mother and Graham, while also trying to be a good boyfriend. His intentions are good, but his schemes are clumsy and self-absorbed. When Jordana reveals that her mother is seriously ill with a brain tumour, Oliver struggles to offer her the support she needs, and his preoccupation with his family's problems threatens to destroy their relationship. As both crises come to a head, Oliver has to learn that he cannot control the people he loves.

Ayoade's direction is noted for its stylized visuals and deadpan humor, and Roberts received several awards for his performance.

Submarine premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on 12 September 2010 and was released in the United Kingdom in March 2011. It received positive reviews, with 88 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 76, and it won Best Feature Film at the 2012 BAFTA Cymru awards.

overview: The adventures of teenager Max McGrath and alien companion Steel, who must harness and combine their tremendous new powers to evolve into the turbo-charged superhero Max Steel.
tagline: Unleash your power.
title: Max Steel
plot:
Max Steel is a 2016 American superhero film based on Mattel's action-figure line of the same name, directed by Stewart Hendler and written by Christopher Yost. It stars Ben Winchell as the teenager Max McGrath and Josh Brener as the voice of his alien companion Steel, with Ana Villafañe, Andy García and Maria Bello in supporting roles. It was co-produced by Mattel's Playground Productions with Dolphin Films and Ingenious Media and released by Open Road Films on October 14, 2016.

After years of moving from place to place, Max and his mother, Molly, return to Copper Canyon, the town where he was born and where his father, Jim, died in what was described as a storm. Max discovers that everyone seems to know more about his father than he does, since Molly refuses to discuss him. Jim's old friend Miles Edwards tells Max that his father worked at N-Tek, a research company that Miles now runs. Meanwhile, Max begins to emit a powerful, uncontrollable form of energy that overloads electrical devices. During a date with his classmate Sofia, he feels an overload coming and encounters Steel, a small, wisecracking alien who bonds with him and absorbs the excess energy.

Pursued by mysterious armed men, the two learn to work together, and Max discovers that by merging with Steel he can form an armored suit and control his powers. Glimpses of his father's past, shared through Steel's memories, reveal attacks by hostile aliens called Ultralinks. After Max and Steel defeat one of these beings, which looks like Steel, a memory suggests that Steel was responsible for Jim's death, and Max angrily turns on him.

When Molly is kidnapped, Max learns that Miles is behind everything. At the abandoned N-Tek facility where Jim died, a fuller memory reveals the truth: Jim was himself an alien who naturally produced the energy, Steel was his partner, and Miles, addicted to the power, conspired with the Ultralinks to steal it. Jim sacrificed himself to stop him, asking Steel to protect his son. Wearing an energy-draining suit, Miles attacks, but Max and Steel, now fully united as Max Steel, generate more energy than he can absorb, and he is destroyed in the resulting explosion.

Filmed in Wilmington, North Carolina, in 2014, Max Steel was released without advance press screenings and panned by critics as generic and forgettable, and it grossed only about $6 million worldwide against a $10 million budget.

overview: In an abandoned Tokyo overrun by bubbles and gravitational abnormalities, one gifted young man has a fateful meeting with a mysterious girl.
tagline: Is she a calamity or a blessing?
title: Bubble
plot:
Bubble (Japanese: バブル, Hepburn: Baburu) is a 2022 Japanese animated post-apocalyptic fantasy film produced by Wit Studio. It was directed by Tetsurō Araki and written by Gen Urobuchi, with character designs by Takeshi Obata and music by Hiroyuki Sawano, a team of creators known for their work on series such as Attack on Titan and Death Note. Jun Shison and Riria voice the leads, with Alice Hirose, Mamoru Miyano and Yuki Kaji. The film had early screenings at the Berlin International Film Festival in February 2022, was released worldwide on Netflix on 28 April 2022 and opened in Japanese cinemas in May.

In the near future, mysterious bubbles that defy the laws of physics fall over the world. An explosion at Tokyo Tower concentrates the bubbles over Tokyo, distorting gravity and making the city uninhabitable, and it is cut off from the rest of the world. Despite the restrictions, groups of young people continue to live in the ruined, flooded city, competing in parkour team battles across its collapsed buildings to win supplies. Hibiki, an eighteen-year-old member of a team called the Blue Blazes, is an extraordinarily gifted runner but keeps to himself because of his sensitivity to sound.

Tokyo Tower, surrounded by gravity anomalies, remains impossible to reach. One day Hibiki, drawn by a mysterious song that only he can hear, tries to climb toward the tower but falls into the sea. He is saved by a girl who seems to have been born from the bubbles themselves. She knows nothing about being human but learns quickly from Hibiki and his friends, and because she knows the song that echoes in his head, he names her Uta, meaning "song." Uta joins the Blue Blazes, and together they win parkour matches against rival teams, but she discovers that touching Hibiki causes her body to dissolve into bubbles. The film draws loosely on Hans Christian Andersen's The Little Mermaid, as Uta's connection with Hibiki grows and the bubbles that created her threaten to engulf the city once more.

Bubble received mixed reviews. Critics praised its visual style, its dynamic parkour sequences and Sawano's score, but many found its story thin and its characters underdeveloped given the prestigious team behind it.

overview: A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition into a mysterious zone where the laws of nature don't apply.
tagline: Fear what's inside.
title: Annihilation
plot:
Annihilation is a 2018 American science fiction film directed by Alex Garland, based on the novel of the same name by Jeff VanderMeer. The movie stars Natalie Portman, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Tessa Thompson, and Oscar Isaac.

The story begins with a prologue that shows a catastrophic event known as "the Shimmer," which has been occurring for decades in an area of the United States where the laws of nature do not apply. The Shimmer is a mysterious, alien-infused zone that seems to be alive and constantly changing.

The main character, Lena (Natalie Portman), is a biologist who has lost her husband, Kane, to the Shimmer during one of his expeditions into the area. Lena joins an all-female team, led by Dr. Ventress (Jennifer Jason Leigh), to explore the Shimmer and uncover its secrets.

As they venture deeper into the Shimmer, the team encounters strange and terrifying creatures that defy explanation. They also discover that the Shimmer is not just a physical environment but also a psychological one, where the laws of reality are constantly shifting.

The team's journey takes them through different biomes within the Shimmer, each with its own unique characteristics and dangers. Along the way, they encounter other survivors who have been affected by the Shimmer in different ways, including a mysterious figure known as "the Biologist" (Tessa Thompson).

As Lena delves deeper into the Shimmer, she begins to experience strange visions and hallucinations that blur the lines between reality and fantasy. She also discovers that her husband's body has undergone a transformation, becoming one with the Shimmer.

The team eventually reaches the heart of the Shimmer, where they discover a mysterious structure known as "the Lighthouse." Inside the Lighthouse, Lena encounters a figure who claims to be the Biologist, but it becomes clear that this is not the same person she encountered earlier.

In the end, Lena emerges from the Shimmer with no memory of her past or her identity. She has become one with the alien entity that inhabits the Shimmer, and her body has undergone a transformation that blurs the lines between human and non-human.

The film ends with Lena walking away from the camera, into an unknown future, as the Shimmer continues to expand and change around her. The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to wonder what happened to Lena and whether she will ever be able to return to her old life.

Overall, Annihilation is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of identity, self-destruction, and the unknown. It challenges the viewer to consider the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control and the dangers of delving too deep into the mysteries of the universe.

overview: Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles. He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon. However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa, a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear.
tagline: Sharon and Derek have all they've ever wanted... but someone else wants it more.
title: Obsessed
plot:
Obsessed is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, particularly the theme of obsession and its destructive power. The movie follows Dr. Nathan Connelly (played by Aaron O'Connell), a successful architect who becomes the object of desire for his wife's former nanny, Sharon (played by Alice Braga), who is now obsessed with him.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Sharon's obsession is not just a product of her own desires but also a manifestation of her deep-seated emotional pain and sense of abandonment. Her fixation on Nathan is all-consuming, driving her to extreme measures in an attempt to claim him for herself.

The film expertly explores the blurred lines between love, desire, and possession, raising questions about the nature of obsession and its impact on individuals and relationships. Through Sharon's character, the movie sheds light on the devastating consequences of unchecked emotions, highlighting the ways in which obsession can consume and destroy those around it.

Furthermore, Obsessed touches on themes of class and social status, as Sharon's background and circumstances serve as a catalyst for her fixation on Nathan. The film also delves into the complexities of female desire and the societal expectations placed upon women, particularly in terms of their roles as caregivers and nurturers.

Ultimately, Obsessed is a gripping thriller that masterfully weaves together elements of psychological suspense, drama, and social commentary, creating a thought-provoking exploration of the darker aspects of human nature.

original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ 神速のゲノセクト ミュウツー覚醒
overview: A group of five Genesect have invaded the big city and pose a threat to the supply of electricity, which attracts the attention of the legendary Pokémon Mewtwo. Satoshi, Pikachu and his friends must come to the rescue when the powerful leader, a red Genesect, faces Mewtwo.
tagline: Beyond the limits. Where myth meets legend...
title: Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened
plot:
Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened is an animated adventure film that delves into the world of Pokémon, where a young trainer named Ash Ketchum finds himself entangled in a mysterious plot. The movie's main themes revolve around the concept of evolution, both biological and emotional.

At its core, the film explores the idea of transformation and growth. Genesect, a genetically engineered Pokémon, serves as a catalyst for this theme. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Genesect is not just a machine, but a being with its own desires and motivations. This dichotomy raises questions about what it means to be alive and whether artificial life can truly be considered living.

The movie also touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery. Ash Ketchum, the protagonist, must navigate his relationships with his friends and mentors while confronting his own sense of purpose. His journey is mirrored in Genesect's struggle to understand its place in the world, highlighting the complexities of finding one's true nature.

Furthermore, Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened explores the consequences of playing God and tampering with nature. The creation of Genesect raises questions about the ethics of scientific experimentation and the responsibility that comes with it. This theme is particularly relevant in today's world, where advancements in technology and science often raise concerns about their impact on society.

Ultimately, the film presents a thought-provoking exploration of what it means to be alive, to evolve, and to find one's place in the world. Through its engaging storyline and memorable characters, Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened offers a captivating adventure that will leave viewers pondering the themes long after the credits roll.

overview: Based on Wes Craven's 1977 suspenseful cult classic, The Hills Have Eyes is the story of a family road trip that goes terrifyingly awry when the travelers become stranded in a government atomic zone. Miles from nowhere, the Carter family soon realizes the seemingly uninhabited wasteland is actually the breeding ground of a blood-thirsty mutant family...and they are the prey.
tagline: The lucky ones die first.
title: The Hills Have Eyes
plot:
The Hills Have Eyes is a 2006 American horror film directed by Alexandre Aja, based on the 1977 film of the same name by Wes Craven. The movie stars Ted Levine, Dan Byrd, Vinessa Shaw, and Aaron Stanford.

The story begins with a family of five - Big Bob (Ted Levine), Ethel (Kathleen Quinlan), Bobby (Dan Byrd), Brenda (Vinessa Shaw), and Bobby's girlfriend, Lisa (Emmanuelle Vaugier) - who embark on a road trip from California to New Mexico. The family is excited for their vacation, but they are also dealing with personal issues, including Big Bob's infidelity and Ethel's feelings of resentment towards her husband.

As the family drives through the desert, they become lost due to a series of wrong turns. They eventually stumble upon a secluded valley, which they decide to explore. Unbeknownst to them, this valley is home to a group of mutants who have been living in the area for years.

The mutants, led by the deformed and sadistic Papa (Robert Longstreet), begin to stalk and terrorize the family. The mutants are a result of genetic mutations caused by radiation exposure, which has twisted their bodies into grotesque forms. As the family tries to survive, they realize that they are trapped in the valley with no way out.

The plot thickens as the family members start to disappear one by one, and the remaining survivors must fight for their lives against the mutants. The tension builds up as the family is forced to confront their own personal demons and work together to survive.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Papa has a twisted fascination with the family's dynamics and uses this knowledge to torment them further. The family members are subjected to physical and emotional abuse, which pushes them to their limits.

In the end, only two members of the family - Brenda and Bobby - manage to escape the valley by using a makeshift vehicle to flee. However, they are left with severe psychological trauma and a newfound appreciation for the dangers of the world around them.

The Hills Have Eyes received mixed reviews from critics but was a commercial success, grossing over $60 million worldwide. The movie's graphic violence and gore were widely criticized, but it also sparked a debate about the limits of on-screen violence in horror films.

Overall, The Hills Have Eyes is a tense and unsettling horror film that explores themes of family dynamics, trauma, and survival. While it may not be to everyone's taste due to its graphic content, it is a well-crafted movie that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very end.

overview: After the Cuban Revolution, Che is at the height of his fame and power. Then he disappears, re-emerging incognito in Bolivia, where he organizes a small group of Cuban comrades and Bolivian recruits to start the great Latin American Revolution. Through this story, we come to understand how Che remains a symbol of idealism and heroism that lives in the hearts of people around the world.
tagline: A revolutionary life.
title: Che: Part Two
plot:
Che: Part Two (also released as Che: Part Two – Guerrilla) is a 2008 biographical war drama directed by Steven Soderbergh, the second half of his two-part portrait of Ernesto "Che" Guevara. Shot back to back with Che: Part One, it moves from the Cuban Revolution covered in the first film to Guevara's doomed guerrilla campaign in Bolivia in 1966–67, and is adapted from his Bolivian Diary. The screenplay is credited to Peter Buchman and Benjamin A. van der Veen, and Benicio del Toro again plays Guevara.

The film opens with Fidel Castro publicly reading, in October 1965, the farewell letter in which Che renounces his Cuban posts and citizenship after vanishing from public life. A year later Guevara, disguised as an older Uruguayan official named Ramón, travels with forged papers to La Paz and on into the mountains to join a small band of Cuban veterans and Bolivian recruits. Training and arms deliveries mark the early days, but the Bolivian Communist Party under Mario Monje refuses to back armed struggle, local peasants remain wary or hostile, food runs short and quarrels flare between Cubans and Bolivians. Deserters lead the army to the rebels' base camp, exposing the foreign identity of the group, while President René Barrientos accepts American help and U.S. advisers begin training Bolivian Rangers to hunt them down.

The journalist Régis Debray and the Argentine Ciro Bustos are arrested after leaving the camp, a rear guard that includes the agent Tania is wiped out in an ambush at a river crossing, and Guevara, increasingly crippled by asthma, leads a dwindling column through the forest. Wounded and captured in a firefight near La Higuera, he is held in the village school and executed on 9 October 1967.

Alongside del Toro, the cast includes Catalina Sandino Moreno, Franka Potente, Demián Bichir, Rodrigo Santoro and Joaquim de Almeida, with Matt Damon in a brief role as a priest. The film was shot mainly in Spain, with some scenes in La Paz, using the then-new RED digital camera and natural light. Produced by companies including Wild Bunch, Section Eight, Laura Bickford Productions, Morena Films and Telecinco Cinema, it premiered at the 2008 Cannes Film Festival as part of a four-hour screening of the complete work, where del Toro won the award for Best Actor. Reviews were mixed to positive, and the film was not a commercial success.

original_title: The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel
overview: As the Best Exotic Marigold Hotel has only a single remaining vacancy - posing a rooming predicament for two fresh arrivals - Sonny pursues his expansionist dream of opening a second hotel.
title: The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel
plot:
The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel (2015) is a heartwarming and humorous film that explores several poignant themes, primarily revolving around love, loss, and self-discovery. At its core, the movie delves into the complexities of human relationships, particularly those formed between people from different walks of life.

One of the primary themes of the film is the power of human connection and community. The story follows a group of British retirees who have relocated to India in search of love, adventure, and a sense of purpose. As they navigate their new lives, they form strong bonds with each other, finding solace and support in their shared experiences.

The movie also explores the theme of letting go and embracing change. Many of the characters are forced to confront their own mortality, loss, and the impermanence of life. Through their journeys, they learn to cherish the present moment and find new meaning in their lives.

Furthermore, The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery. As the characters navigate their new surroundings, they are forced to confront their own biases, prejudices, and preconceptions about India and its culture. Through their experiences, they learn to be more open-minded, empathetic, and understanding.

The film also highlights the importance of love in all its forms. Romance, familial love, and platonic relationships are all explored throughout the story, showcasing the complexities and beauty of human emotions.

Ultimately, The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel is a movie about finding one's place in the world, embracing life's uncertainties, and discovering new meaning in the process. With its witty dialogue, engaging characters, and poignant themes, it is a film that will leave audiences smiling, laughing, and perhaps even shedding a tear or two.

overview: Still irrevocably scarred by the trauma he endured as a child at the Overlook, Dan Torrance has fought to find some semblance of peace. But that peace is shattered when he encounters Abra, a courageous teenager with her own powerful extrasensory gift, known as the 'shine'. Instinctively recognising that Dan shares her power, Abra has sought him out, desperate for his help against the merciless Rose the Hat and her followers.
tagline: Dare to go back.
title: Doctor Sleep
plot:
Doctor Sleep is a psychological horror film directed by Mike Flanagan, based on the novel of the same name by Stephen King. The movie follows the story of Danny Torrance, a young man struggling to overcome his traumatic past as "The Boy Who Could See".

The film begins with an elderly Danny (played by Ewan McGregor), who has been living in isolation at a hospice for people with psychic abilities known as "the shine". Danny's shine allows him to see into the minds of others, and he has been using this ability to cope with his past traumas.

As Danny struggles to come to terms with his past, he is visited by a group of supernatural beings known as "the True Knot", who are determined to harvest the shine from his mind. The leader of the group, Rose the Hat (played by Rebecca Ferguson), is a charismatic and ruthless figure who will stop at nothing to achieve her goals.

Danny soon discovers that he has a personal connection to the True Knot, as they were responsible for the death of his mother, Alice (played by Kyliegh Curran) in a tragic accident. This revelation sets Danny on a path of revenge against the True Knot, and he begins to gather a group of allies who possess their own unique abilities.

One of these allies is Abra Stone (played by Zazie Beetz), a young girl with an incredibly powerful shine that makes her nearly untouchable. As Danny and Abra form a bond, they begin to uncover the secrets behind the True Knot's sinister plans.

Throughout the film, Flanagan explores themes of trauma, addiction, and the power of human connection. The movie is a slow-burning build-up of tension, as Danny and his allies prepare for a final showdown with the True Knot.

The climax of the film features an intense confrontation between Danny and Rose, which culminates in a dramatic and emotional showdown. In the end, Danny emerges victorious, but not without scars. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, as Danny begins to rebuild his life and find a sense of purpose.

Overall, Doctor Sleep is a thought-provoking and emotionally charged film that explores the complexities of trauma and recovery. With its slow-burning tension and emotional depth, it is a must-see for fans of psychological horror.

overview: U.S. Marshall John Kruger erases the identities of people enrolled in the Witness Protection Program. His current assignment is to protect Lee Cullen, who's uncovered evidence that the weapons manufacturer she works for has been selling to terrorist groups. When Kruger discovers that there's a corrupt agent within the program, he must guard his own life while trying to protect Lee's.
tagline: He will erase your past to protect your future.
title: Eraser
plot:
Eraser is a 1996 American action thriller film directed by Chuck Russell and starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Vanessa Williams, and Samuel L. Jackson.

The main themes of Eraser can be broken down into several key elements:

1. **Identity and Deception**: The movie explores the theme of identity and deception through the protagonist, U.S. Marshal John Kruger (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who is forced to go undercover as a wealthy businessman to protect his wife, Helen (Vanessa Williams). As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that nothing is as it seems, and both characters are hiding secrets about their pasts.

2. **Power and Corruption**: The villainous character, Gilbert Haines (Samuel L. Jackson), represents the corrupting influence of power and the dangers of unchecked ambition. His actions drive the plot forward and serve as a catalyst for Kruger's transformation from an ordinary marshal to a hero who must fight against corruption.

3. **Marriage and Loyalty**: The movie highlights the importance of marriage, loyalty, and trust in relationships. Helen's character is initially portrayed as a strong-willed and independent individual, but her relationship with John forces her to confront her own vulnerabilities and make sacrifices for the people she loves.

4. **Redemption and Self-Discovery**: Throughout the film, Kruger undergoes a journey of self-discovery, forced to confront his past mistakes and learn to trust himself and others. His transformation from an ordinary marshal to a hero who saves the day is a testament to his growth and redemption.

5. **Government Secrecy and Corruption**: The movie touches on themes of government secrecy and corruption, highlighting the dangers of unchecked power and the importance of accountability within institutions.

Overall, Eraser is a thrilling action film that explores complex themes through its engaging storyline and memorable characters.

overview: Davey Stone, a 33-year old party animal, finds himself in trouble with the law after his wild ways go too far.
tagline: It's naughty. It's nice. It's animated.
title: Eight Crazy Nights
plot:
Eight Crazy Nights is a Christmas comedy film that explores the complexities of family relationships and the struggles of growing up. The story revolves around David York, a young man who is struggling to find his place in the world after being sent to a juvenile reform school for shoplifting.

As David navigates his way through adolescence, he must confront his own identity and learn to balance his desire for independence with the need for love and acceptance from his family. The film delves into themes of loneliness, rejection, and the search for belonging, all set against the backdrop of a festive holiday season.

Through David's journey, the movie sheds light on the often-overlooked struggles of adolescence, where young people are trying to find their footing in a world that can be overwhelming and unforgiving. The film also touches on the idea of redemption and second chances, as David seeks to make amends with his family and prove himself worthy of love and acceptance.

Ultimately, Eight Crazy Nights is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of what it means to be young, to be loved, and to find one's place in the world. The film's use of humor, satire, and pop culture references adds to its charm, making it a unique and entertaining take on the traditional Christmas comedy genre.

overview: A biographical portrait of a pre-fame Jane Austen and her romance with a young Irishman.
tagline: Her own life is her greatest inspiration.
title: Becoming Jane
plot:
Becoming Jane is a 2007 romantic drama film that explores the life of Jane Austen, particularly her early years and her relationship with Tom Lefroy. The movie delves into the complexities of love, identity, and social class in 19th-century England.

At its core, Becoming Jane is a story about the constraints placed on women during that era, particularly those from wealthy families like the Austens. The film highlights the limited options available to young women, who were often expected to marry well and secure their family's financial future. This societal pressure weighs heavily on Jane, as she navigates her own desires and aspirations.

The movie also explores the theme of identity, as Jane struggles to find her place in the world. She is torn between her love of writing and her desire for independence, which sets her apart from the traditional roles expected of women at that time. Through her relationships with Tom Lefroy and others, Jane must confront her own sense of self and decide what she truly wants out of life.

Furthermore, Becoming Jane touches on the theme of social class and its impact on relationships. The film portrays the complexities of love across different social strata, highlighting the challenges faced by those from different backgrounds who dare to defy convention.

Ultimately, the movie presents a nuanced portrayal of Jane Austen's life, one that balances her wit, intelligence, and strong will with the societal expectations placed upon her. Through its thoughtful exploration of these themes, Becoming Jane offers a captivating and romanticized glimpse into the life of this beloved author.

original_title: Tom and Jerry: The Lost Dragon
overview: Tom and Jerry find a dragon egg, and help the baby dragon find its mother.
title: Tom and Jerry: The Lost Dragon
plot:
Tom and Jerry: The Lost Dragon is a 2014 American animated fantasy comedy film produced by Warner Bros. Animation and directed and produced by Spike Brandt and Tony Cervone. It premiered at San Diego Comic-Con on July 27, 2014, before its digital release on August 19 and its DVD release on September 2, 2014. It was the first direct-to-video Tom and Jerry film to be distributed in Japan by Warner Bros. Home Entertainment. The voice cast includes Kelly Stables, Vicki Lewis, Jim Cummings, Laraine Newman and Greg Ellis.

In a magical land, the wizard Kaldorf banishes the wicked witch Drizelda from an elf village for her many crimes. He allows her mistreated young niece, Athena, to remain, but the villagers remain suspicious of the girl, fearing she will grow up to be like her aunt, especially because she keeps company with creatures they dislike: a mouse, Jerry, and a cat, Tom. In this version of the story, Tom and Jerry are introduced as babies who become rivals with each other while both being devoted to Athena.

Years later, the cat and mouse are still chasing one another as usual, while the teenage Athena looks after injured animals. One day the three of them stumble upon a mysterious glowing egg. None of them realises that it was stolen from an enormous fire-breathing dragon. The egg soon hatches into a baby dragon named Puffy, who immediately decides that Tom is his mother, and the trio set about caring for him, with the usual comic chaos that follows from raising a baby dragon.

Meanwhile, Puffy's real mother is furious at the loss of her baby and is determined to get him back, threatening the village. Before Tom, Jerry and Athena can reunite the two, Drizelda returns and kidnaps Puffy. Her plan is to drain the little dragon's fiery power so that she can turn herself into a super-dragon and take revenge on the village that cast her out.

With the help of powerful allies and their animal friends, Tom, Jerry and Athena join forces to defeat the witch and rescue Puffy. In the end Drizelda is turned to stone, Puffy is returned safely to his mother, and the villagers, Kaldorf, Athena and Jerry celebrate with a song, while Tom finds himself chased by Athena's pet crocodile. A post-credits scene hints that Drizelda is still alive inside the statue. Common Sense Media gave it three stars out of five, finding its story more emotionally engaging than most entries in the series.

overview: After the passing of her mother, Nica Pierce, a young woman in a wheelchair, is forced to deal with her sister, brother-in-law, niece and their nanny as they say their goodbyes to mother. But when people start turning up dead, Nica discovers the culprit might be a strange doll she received a few days earlier.
tagline: Fear has a new home.
title: Curse of Chucky
plot:
Curse of Chucky is a 2013 American comedy-horror film directed by Don Mancini, who also wrote the screenplay. The movie serves as a sequel to Child's Play and Bride of Chucky, ignoring the events of Seed of Chucky.

The story begins with Nica Pierce (Alexis Bledel), a young woman living in a psychiatric hospital with her mother, Karen (Christine Elise McCarty). After her mother's death, Nica inherits her estate, including an antique doll named Chucky. Unbeknownst to Nica, the doll is possessed by the vengeful spirit of Charles Lee Ray, also known as Chucky.

As Nica tries to settle her mother's estate, she discovers that Chucky has come back to life and begins to wreak havoc on her life. The doll starts to manipulate Nica, using his charm and wit to get what he wants. Meanwhile, a series of gruesome murders takes place in the town, with the victims all having one thing in common: they had previously owned or interacted with Chucky.

As the body count rises, Nica teams up with her friends, including her boyfriend, Matt (Dylan Minnette), and her friend, Emily (Briana Buckmaster). Together, they try to uncover the truth behind Chucky's return and put an end to his killing spree. Along the way, they discover that Chucky has a personal vendetta against Nica, who had previously tried to get rid of him.

As the plot thickens, Nica and her friends realize that Chucky is not just a simple doll, but a malevolent spirit with a twisted sense of humor. The group must use all their wits and resources to outsmart Chucky and stop his killing spree before it's too late.

In the end, Nica and her friends manage to trap Chucky in a box, but not before he unleashes one final attack on Nica. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Nica had been possessed by Chucky's spirit all along, making her the true culprit behind the murders. The movie ends with Nica being taken away by the authorities, while Chucky's spirit remains trapped in the box.

Overall, Curse of Chucky is a dark comedy-horror film that pays homage to the original Child's Play franchise while also subverting expectations and delivering plenty of twists and turns.

overview: Rendel, a masked superhero, becomes blinded by his desire for revenge against a sinister criminal organization.
tagline: Revenge begets revenge.
title: Rendel
plot:
Rendel, also known as Rendel: Dark Vengeance, is a 2017 Finnish superhero action film written, produced and directed by Jesse Haaja and based on his own original character. It stars Kris Gummerus as Rendel, with Matti Onnismaa, Rami Rusinen and Renne Korppila in the other leading roles and Alina Tomnikov, Tero Salenius, Aake Kalliala, Anu Palevaara and Kristina Karjalainen in the supporting cast.

In the city of Mikkeli, a company called VALA has developed a lucrative vaccine without proper testing. VALA is a front for a criminal organization led by Pekka Erola, whose son Jarno, known as Rotikka, is one of its most violent enforcers. The gang's operations are being disrupted by a mysterious masked vigilante dressed in black, who leaves his victims marked with the name Rendel.

Through flashbacks, the film reveals the story of Rämö, a financial director and devoted family man. After refusing to invest in a scheme proposed by one of VALA's men, he loses his job and struggles to find work, until he is hired by VALA to handle paperwork. There he discovers that the vaccine, made from a tar-like substance that bonds permanently to skin, has not been properly tested and has caused numerous deaths. Fearing that Rämö will become a whistleblower, Erola sends Rotikka and his henchman to kill him. Rämö's wife and daughter are murdered, and he is beaten and left for dead, but he survives. Covering his face with the tar to create a mask and wearing the biker jacket his family gave him, he becomes Rendel, a dark avenger whose name comes from the Hungarian word for order. As his war against the organization escalates, VALA's leaders hire a team of foreign mercenaries to destroy him, while a mysterious woman named Marla offers him help.

The film combines brutal, stylized action with a dark revenge story set in a small Finnish city, offering an independently produced take on the superhero genre.

Rendel won the Best Action Movie award at the Feratum Film Festival in Mexico. A sequel, Rendel 2: Cycle of Revenge, was filmed in the Kainuu region in 2019, and an English-language continuation featuring Gummerus was later announced.
