Ultimately, The Diary of a Teenage Girl is a powerful and thought-provoking exploration of the challenges and triumphs of adolescence, offering a poignant and relatable portrayal of one young woman's journey towards self-discovery and empowerment.

overview: The deconstruction of the Avatar scenes and sets
title: Avatar: Scene Deconstruction
plot: The deconstruction of the Avatar scenes and sets

overview: When carefree Nyles and reluctant maid of honor Sarah have a chance encounter at a Palm Springs wedding, things get complicated when they find themselves unable to escape the venue, themselves, or each other.
tagline: Live like there's no tomorrow
title: Palm Springs
plot:
Palm Springs is a 2020 romantic comedy film that explores the complexities of relationships and personal growth through the lens of an unlikely romance between two characters who meet at a wedding.

At its core, the movie delves into the theme of finding love in unexpected places. The story follows Nyles (played by Andy Samberg), a man who has lost touch with his sense of purpose and connection after a string of failed relationships. His life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Sarah (played by Cristin Milioti) at a wedding, where they both find themselves stuck in a time loop, reliving the same day over and over.

As Nyles navigates this surreal situation, he begins to confront his emotional baggage and reevaluate what he truly wants from life. Through his interactions with Sarah, who is also trapped in the time loop, he starts to open up about his past and desires, leading to a deeper understanding of himself and his place in the world.

The film also explores the theme of escapism and the human desire to break free from routine and monotony. Nyles's initial reluctance to confront his emotions and Sarah's own struggles with commitment serve as a catalyst for their growth and eventual connection.

Ultimately, Palm Springs is a heartwarming exploration of love, self-discovery, and the power of human connection in breaking down our emotional barriers.

overview: Surf's Up is an animated feature that goes behind the scenes of the high-octane world of competitive penguin surfing. The film profiles Cody Maverick, an up-and-coming surfer as he enters his first pro competition.
tagline: A Major Ocean Picture
title: Surf's Up
plot:
Surf's Up is a 2007 computer-animated comedy film directed by Ash Brannon and produced by Sony Pictures Animation and Columbia Pictures.

The movie follows the story of Cody Maverick, an orphaned seal from Shiverpool who dreams of becoming a surfing champion. He enters the Big Z Memorial Surf Off on the island of Pen Gu, where he faces off against the reigning champion, Big Z's protégé, Lani Aliikai, and other talented surfers.

The main themes of Surf's Up include:

1. Perseverance and determination: Cody Maverick's journey is a testament to his unwavering dedication to his passion for surfing, despite facing numerous setbacks and self-doubt.
2. Friendship and camaraderie: The film highlights the importance of forming strong bonds with others who share similar interests and values. Cody forms friendships with other surfers, including Chicken Joe, Big Z's ghost, and Lani Aliikai, which helps him navigate the challenges of competition.
3. Self-discovery and identity: As Cody navigates the world of professional surfing, he must confront his own identity and sense of belonging. He learns to balance his desire for fame with his need for friendship and connection.
4. Overcoming adversity: The film features several characters who face significant personal struggles, including Lani Aliikai's troubled past and Chicken Joe's emotional baggage. Through their stories, the movie shows that even in the face of adversity, it's possible to find strength and resilience.

The movie also explores themes of environmentalism, as the surfing competition takes place on a remote island with a fragile ecosystem. The film subtly critiques the commercialization of sports and the impact of human activity on the natural world.

Overall, Surf's Up is a heartwarming and entertaining film that celebrates the power of friendship, perseverance, and self-discovery in the face of adversity.

overview: Looking for work, Aaron comes across a cryptic online ad: “$1,000 for the day. Filming service. Discretion is appreciated.” Low on cash and full of naiveté, he decides to go for it. He drives to a cabin in a remote mountain town where he meets Josef, his cinematic subject for the day. Josef is sincere and the project seems heartfelt, so Aaron begins to film. But as the day goes on, it becomes clear that Josef is not who he says, and his intentions are not at all pure.
title: Creep
plot:
Creep is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, particularly the theme of vulnerability and exploitation. The film follows Aaron, a filmmaker who creates a viral video featuring his friend Josef, who suffers from a rare skin condition. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Josef's condition is not just physical but also emotional, making him an easy target for manipulation.

The main theme of Creep revolves around the idea of power dynamics and how they can be exploited in various ways. The film explores the concept of "creeping" into someone's personal space, both physically and emotionally, and the devastating consequences that follow. Through Josef's character, the film highlights the vulnerability of those who are perceived as weak or different, making them susceptible to exploitation by those who seek to take advantage of their situation.

The movie also touches on the theme of loneliness and isolation, particularly in Josef's character. His condition has made him an outcast, and he is desperate for human connection. This desperation leads him down a path of self-destruction, as he becomes increasingly dependent on Aaron's attention and validation.

Furthermore, Creep critiques the voyeuristic tendencies of modern society, where people are willing to watch and participate in others' suffering for their own entertainment. The film's use of found footage adds to this theme, making the viewer feel like they are witnessing a private moment that is not meant for public consumption.

Overall, Creep is a thought-provoking film that explores the darker aspects of human nature, highlighting the themes of vulnerability, exploitation, loneliness, and the voyeuristic tendencies of modern society.

overview: As the global economy teeters on the brink of disaster, a young Wall Street trader partners with disgraced former Wall Street corporate raider Gordon Gekko on a two tiered mission: To alert the financial community to the coming doom, and to find out who was responsible for the death of the young trader's mentor.
tagline: Gordon never gives up.
title: Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps
plot:
Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps is a thought-provoking film that delves into the darker aspects of capitalism and the corrupting influence of power. The movie explores the theme of greed and its consequences, as embodied by the character of Jake Moore (played by Shia LaBeouf), who becomes increasingly consumed by his desire for wealth and status.

The film also examines the theme of loyalty and betrayal, particularly in the relationship between Jake and his mentor, Bretton James (played by Michael Douglas). As Jake navigates the cutthroat world of finance, he is forced to confront the moral compromises that come with success and the true cost of his ambition.

Furthermore, Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps touches on the theme of redemption and personal growth. Through Jake's journey, the film suggests that it may be possible to escape the cycle of greed and corruption, but only by confronting one's own flaws and weaknesses.

The movie also critiques the excesses of modern capitalism, highlighting the ways in which the pursuit of wealth can lead to social and economic inequality. The character of Carl Fox (played by Frank Langella), a wealthy investor with a hidden agenda, serves as a symbol of the corrupting influence of power and the dangers of unchecked ambition.

Overall, Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps is a cautionary tale about the dangers of greed and the importance of integrity in the face of temptation. The film's themes are timely and thought-provoking, making it a compelling watch for anyone interested in exploring the complexities of human nature and the darker aspects of capitalism.

overview: On a tiny exotic island, Tuesday, an outgoing parrot lives with his quirky animal friends in paradise. However, Tuesday can't stop dreaming about discovering the world. After a violent storm, Tuesday and his friends wake up to find a strange creature on the beach: Robinson Crusoe. Tuesday immediately views Crusoe as his ticket off the island to explore new lands. Likewise, Crusoe soon realizes that the key to surviving on the island is through the help of Tuesday and the other animals. It isn't always easy at first, as the animals don't speak "human." Slowly but surely, they all start living together in harmony, until one day, when their comfortable life is overturned by two savage cats, who wish to take control of the island. A battle ensues between the cats and the group of friends but Crusoe and the animals soon discover the true power of friendship up against all odds (even savage cats).
tagline: Just because you're stranded... doesn't mean you can't make some friends.
title: Robinson Crusoe
plot:
Robinson Crusoe is a 2018 film directed by Jordan Vogt-Roberts, not 2016, and produced by StudioCanal, but I couldn't find any information about a movie titled "Robinson Crusoe" released in 2016.

However, the 2018 film adaptation of Robinson Crusoe stars Dean-Charles Chapman as the titular character. 

The main themes of this film include:

1. Survival: The movie focuses on Robinson's struggle to survive on a deserted island after his ship sinks.
2. Isolation: The film explores the psychological effects of being stranded alone, with no human interaction for an extended period.
3. Humanity: As Robinson navigates his new life, he grapples with his own humanity and whether he can maintain his sense of self in isolation.
4. Redemption: Throughout the story, Robinson seeks redemption for past mistakes and tries to find a way off the island.

Please note that I couldn't verify any information about a 2016 film titled "Robinson Crusoe" produced by StudioCanal.

overview: A sumptuous and sensual tale of intrigue, romance and betrayal set against the backdrop of a defining moment in European history: two beautiful sisters, Anne and Mary Boleyn, driven by their family's blind ambition, compete for the love of the handsome and passionate King Henry VIII.
tagline: Two sisters divided for the love of a king.
title: The Other Boleyn Girl
plot:
The Other Boleyn Girl is a historical drama film released in 2008, directed by Peter Howitt and produced by Columbia Pictures. The movie is based on Philippa Gregory's novel of the same name.

The story revolves around Mary Boleyn (Natalie Portman), the sister of Anne Boleyn (Scarlett Johansson). The film begins with Mary's arrival at court in 1501, where she catches the eye of King Henry VIII (Eric Bana). Despite her family's objections, Mary becomes the king's mistress, and they have a daughter together.

As time passes, Mary's relationship with the king ends, but she remains at court as a lady-in-waiting to her sister Anne. Meanwhile, Anne catches the eye of the king, and their affair begins. However, Anne is not interested in becoming the king's wife unless he divorces his first wife, Catherine of Aragon.

The plot thickens as Mary becomes embroiled in her sister's rise to power. She uses her connections with the king to try and secure a better position for herself, but ultimately fails. Meanwhile, Anne's relationship with the king deepens, and she eventually gives birth to a daughter, Elizabeth (who would later become Queen Elizabeth I).

As tensions rise between Mary and Anne, their complicated relationships with each other and the king come to a head. The film culminates in a dramatic confrontation at court, where Mary's fate is sealed.

Throughout the movie, the complex web of relationships between the characters is expertly woven. The chemistry between Natalie Portman and Scarlett Johansson as sisters adds depth to the story, while Eric Bana brings a sense of gravitas to his portrayal of King Henry VIII.

One of the standout aspects of the film is its exploration of the themes of power, ambition, and loyalty. Mary's struggles to navigate her relationships with her sister and the king serve as a cautionary tale about the dangers of seeking power at any cost.

Overall, The Other Boleyn Girl is a gripping historical drama that explores the intricate world of 16th-century court politics. With strong performances from its cast and a compelling narrative, the film is sure to captivate audiences interested in this fascinating period of history.

overview: Three young people check into the Meadow View Inn for a night's rest, fully unaware of the inn's sick-minded employees and their nefarious intentions.
tagline: If the camera is on, you're dead.
title: Vacancy 2: The First Cut
plot:
Vacancy 2: The First Cut is a 2008 American slasher film directed by Eric Bross and a prequel to the 2007 thriller Vacancy, which starred Kate Beckinsale and Luke Wilson. Agnes Bruckner, Trevor Wright and Arjay Smith star as young travellers who check into a motel where the staff secretly film their guests, with David Moscow in the cast. The film tells how the deadly snuff-film business of the original came into being, and was released direct to DVD in January 2009.

The staff of the Meadow View Inn have hidden cameras in their rooms and make money by selling recordings of guests having sex. One night a guest named Smith checks in with a woman and brutally murders her in front of the cameras. The staff overpower and tie him up, but instead of calling the police, the manager, Gordon, accepts Smith's proposal: they will go into business together, torturing and killing guests and selling the footage as snuff films.

Some days later, the young couple Jessica and Caleb, driving home with Caleb's friend Tanner, stop at the motel for the night, and Tanner takes the room next door. Switching on the television, Tanner sees live footage of his friends' room and realises they are all being watched. The three try to escape but are cut off by Smith and two masked men. Caleb is caught and stabbed to death, while Jessica and Tanner flee into the woods and find refuge at a nearby farmhouse. The husband refuses to believe their story, and when the killers arrive claiming the pair are thieves, Smith shoots both the husband and his wife.

Jessica and Tanner are recaptured, and Tanner is tortured. Smith then orders the others away so he can kill Jessica himself. Gordon realises that Smith is out of control and quietly plans to let him finish the job and then blame everything on him. Left alone for a moment, Jessica frees herself, stabs Smith in the face and escapes with a gun. At the lake, where Gordon is searching the water, she shoots him dead. Smith tracks her to a trailer, but she starts a fire and leaves him burning inside.

The next morning the police arrive but doubt Jessica's account, since the cameras and the bodies have vanished. At another establishment, the Pinewood Motel of the first film, a badly scarred Smith tells a trucker that the place will be open for business within weeks, once the cameras are installed, and hands him a new tape, setting up the events of Vacancy. Reviews were mediocre.

overview: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.
tagline: They Won't Take Any Shih Tzu.
title: Seven Psychopaths
plot:
Seven Psychopaths is a 2012 black comedy film written and directed by Martin McDonagh. The movie follows the story of Marty Faranan (played by Colin Farrell), a struggling screenwriter who gets caught up in a series of misadventures with his friends, including Billy Bickle (Sam Rockwell) and Hans (Christopher Walken).

The main themes of Seven Psychopaths include:

1. **Friendship and Loyalty**: The film explores the complexities of male friendships and the bonds that tie people together. Marty's relationships with Billy and Hans are central to the story, and their interactions drive the plot forward.
2. **Identity Crisis**: Marty is a struggling screenwriter who feels lost and uncertain about his place in the world. His journey is also one of self-discovery, as he navigates his relationships and tries to find his purpose.
3. **Mental Illness and Trauma**: The film touches on themes of mental illness, particularly Billy's struggles with bipolar disorder. Hans, a veteran, has experienced trauma and violence in the past, which affects his behavior and interactions with others.
4. **Morality and Ethics**: Seven Psychopaths raises questions about morality and ethics, particularly in the context of storytelling and filmmaking. Marty's obsession with writing a screenplay leads him to engage in increasingly absurd and violent behavior.
5. **The Power of Storytelling**: The film highlights the power of storytelling as a way to cope with trauma, find meaning, and connect with others. Through his writing, Marty tries to make sense of his world and find a sense of purpose.

Overall, Seven Psychopaths is a dark comedy that explores complex themes and characters, often using humor and satire to comment on the human condition.

overview: The Grinch hatches a scheme to ruin Christmas when the residents of Whoville plan their annual holiday celebration.
tagline: Scheme big.
title: The Grinch
plot:
The Grinch is a 2018 American animated musical comedy film directed by Scott Mosier and Yarrow Cheney, and produced by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures.

The story takes place in Whoville, where the residents are preparing for Christmas. The main character, the Grinch (voiced by Benedict Cumberbatch), lives on Mount Crumpit with his dog Max. He despises the cheerful Whos and their love for Christmas, which he believes is a noisy and chaotic holiday.

The Grinch decides to take matters into his own hands and steal Christmas from the Whos. He disguises himself as Santa Claus and sets out to sabotage the holiday by stealing all the decorations, gifts, and food. However, as he observes the Whos' kindness and generosity towards each other despite their poverty, he begins to feel a change of heart.

The Grinch's plan is foiled when Max, who has been watching over him from afar, reveals his true identity. The Grinch is forced to confront the true meaning of Christmas, which is not about material possessions or noise, but about kindness, love, and community.

As the story unfolds, the Grinch begins to see the Whos in a new light and starts to appreciate their joy and generosity. He returns all the stolen items and joins the Whos for Christmas dinner, where he is welcomed with open arms.

The film features a star-studded voice cast, including Cameron Seely as Cindy Lou Who, John Legend as Mayor Augustus Maywho, and Pharrell Williams as the narrator. The movie's soundtrack includes original songs by Pharrell Williams, Benj Pasek, and Justin Paul.

Overall, The Grinch is a heartwarming story about the importance of kindness, generosity, and community during the holiday season. It features stunning animation, catchy music, and a talented voice cast that brings the beloved characters to life.

overview: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.
tagline: Unleash the power behind the armor.
title: Iron Man 3
plot:
Iron Man 3 is a 2013 superhero film directed by Shane Black and produced by Marvel Studios. The movie takes place after the events of The Avengers (2012) and follows Tony Stark/Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr.) as he deals with the aftermath of his battle against Loki.

The film begins with Tony Stark, aka Iron Man, struggling to cope with the trauma of being rescued from captivity by the Avengers. He is haunted by nightmares and flashbacks of his time in captivity, where he was subjected to physical and emotional torture by the Ten Rings terrorist organization. Tony's anxiety and PTSD symptoms worsen, causing him to withdraw from his friends and colleagues.

Meanwhile, a terrorist known as the Mandarin (Trevor Slattery) emerges, threatening to destroy the United States with advanced technology. The government asks Tony Stark for help in stopping the Mandarin, but he is hesitant due to his own personal demons. However, when the Mandarin's attacks become more frequent and deadly, Tony reluctantly agrees to take on the mission.

As Tony delves deeper into the mystery of the Mandarin, he discovers that the terrorist is actually a con artist named Trevor Slattery (Ben Kingsley), who has been hired by Aldrich Killian (Guy Pearce), a wealthy businessman with a personal vendetta against Tony Stark. Killian, also known as the Iron Monger, has created advanced technology that allows him to control and manipulate the weather.

Tony's investigation leads him to a series of intense battles against Killian's henchmen and the Mandarin's robotic drones. Along the way, he is aided by his friend James "Rhodey" Rhodes (Don Cheadle) and Pepper Potts (Gwyneth Paltrow).

As the story unfolds, Tony's mental state deteriorates further, causing him to question his own identity and purpose as Iron Man. He also begins to suspect that Killian may be behind the Mandarin's attacks, but he is unable to prove it.

In a climactic showdown, Tony faces off against Killian in a battle of wits and technology. However, just as he thinks he has defeated Killian, he discovers that the terrorist was actually using advanced technology to manipulate his own body, making him appear as the Mandarin.

In the end, Tony is able to defeat Killian and destroy his technology, but not before realizing that his own PTSD symptoms were a result of his own guilt and shame over being rescued by the Avengers. The film ends with Tony reflecting on his experiences and coming to terms with his own identity as Iron Man.

Throughout the movie, Shane Black's direction and Robert Downey Jr.'s performance bring a sense of humor and wit to the story, while also exploring deeper themes of trauma, PTSD, and identity. The film's climax is both intense and emotional, making it a satisfying conclusion to Tony Stark's arc in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

Overall, Iron Man 3 is a thought-provoking and action-packed superhero film that explores the complexities of Tony Stark's character and the consequences of his actions as Iron Man.

overview: The true-life story of boxer-turned-priest. When an injury ends his amateur boxing career, Stuart Long moves to Los Angeles to find money and fame. While scraping by as a supermarket clerk, he meets Carmen, a Sunday school teacher who seems immune to his bad-boy charm. Determined to win her over, the longtime agnostic starts going to church to impress her. However, a motorcycle accident leaves him wondering if he can use his second chance to help others, leading to the surprising realization that he's meant to be a Catholic priest.
tagline: God wanted a fighter… and He found one.
title: Father Stu
plot:
Father Stu is a biographical drama film released in 2021, not 2022, directed by Rosalind Ross and written by Mark Corbett. The movie is based on the life of Stuart Long, also known as Father Stuart Long, an American priest who defied medical odds to survive a terminal brain tumor.

The film begins with Stuart (played by Mark Wahlberg), a young man from a troubled home in Massachusetts, struggling to find his place in the world. He becomes involved with a group of Catholic priests and eventually joins the seminary, where he is ordained as Father Stu. Despite his faith, Father Stu faces personal struggles, including an addiction to painkillers after a car accident.

As Father Stu's career takes off, he meets Acie (played by J.B. Smoove), a wise-cracking friend who becomes his confidant and partner in crime. The two men embark on a series of misadventures, often involving cars, women, and getting into trouble. However, when Father Stu is diagnosed with a terminal brain tumor, he must confront the reality of his mortality.

Father Stu's faith is put to the test as he grapples with the possibility of leaving behind his loved ones, including his wife, Acie, and his fellow priests. Despite the odds against him, Father Stu remains optimistic and determined to live life to the fullest. He becomes an inspiration to those around him, using his platform to spread hope and faith.

As Father Stu's condition worsens, he must come to terms with his own mortality and the legacy he wants to leave behind. The film takes a poignant turn as Father Stu reflects on his life, relationships, and the impact he has had on others. Ultimately, Father Stu finds peace and acceptance, surrounded by those who love him.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Father Stu's story serving as a testament to the power of faith, friendship, and living life with purpose. Mark Wahlberg delivers a powerful performance as Father Stu, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The film is a heartwarming tribute to the human spirit, reminding us that even in the face of adversity, we can find strength and meaning in our lives.

[No information found on Palm Drive Productions being the production company for this movie]

overview: Elite snipers Brandon Beckett and Richard Miller are tasked with protecting a gas pipeline from terrorists looking to make a statement. When battles with the enemy lead to snipers being killed by a ghost shooter who knows their exact location, tensions boil as a security breach is suspected. Is there someone working with the enemy on the inside? Is the mission a front for other activity? Is the Colonel pulling the strings?
title: Sniper: Ghost Shooter
plot:
Sniper: Ghost Shooter is a 2016 American action thriller film directed by Michael Markstein and starring Dan Cade as Chris Walker, a former U.S. Army sniper turned CIA operative.

The main themes of Sniper: Ghost Shooter include:

1. **Loyalty and Betrayal**: The movie explores the theme of loyalty and betrayal through Chris Walker's character. As a former soldier, he is forced to confront his past when he discovers that some of his former comrades have been compromised by the CIA.
2. **Trauma and PTSD**: The film delves into the psychological effects of war on soldiers, particularly those who have experienced traumatic events. Chris Walker struggles with PTSD and flashbacks, which affects his relationships and mission objectives.
3. **Government Corruption and Deception**: Sniper: Ghost Shooter portrays a corrupt government agency that uses its operatives for personal gain and manipulation. This theme highlights the dangers of unchecked power and the blurred lines between right and wrong.
4. **Redemption and Self-Discovery**: Throughout the movie, Chris Walker seeks redemption for past mistakes and tries to find his place in the world. He must confront his own demons and make difficult choices that test his loyalty and integrity.

The plot follows Chris Walker, a former U.S. Army sniper who is recruited by the CIA to take down rogue operatives. As he delves deeper into the mission, he uncovers a conspiracy involving corrupt government officials and must use his skills to survive and bring justice to those responsible.

Overall, Sniper: Ghost Shooter explores mature themes that resonate with fans of action-packed thrillers, including loyalty, trauma, corruption, and redemption.

overview: In 2000, the election of the U.S. Presidential boiled down to a few precious votes in the state of Florida — and a recount that would add "hanging chad" to every American's vocabulary.
tagline: The future of the nation was hanging by a …chad.
title: Recount
plot:
Recount is a 2008 American political drama television film about the Florida vote recount in the 2000 United States presidential election. Directed by Jay Roach and written by Danny Strong, it stars Kevin Spacey as Gore campaign aide Ron Klain, with Bob Balaban, Ed Begley Jr., Laura Dern as Florida Secretary of State Katherine Harris, John Hurt as Warren Christopher, Denis Leary, Bruce McGill and Tom Wilkinson as James Baker. It premiered on HBO on 25 May 2008.

The film follows the five weeks between election night on 7 November 2000, when the presidential race between Texas governor George W. Bush and Vice President Al Gore came down to a razor-thin margin in Florida, and the United States Supreme Court ruling of 12 December that ended the recount. It opens as Gore, having privately conceded to Bush by telephone in the early hours of 8 November, abruptly withdraws his concession when the Florida margin shrinks to a few hundred votes, triggering an automatic machine recount.

The story is told largely through the lawyers and political operatives on each side. Ron Klain, a former Gore chief of staff, and his colleague Michael Whouley lead the Democratic effort, recruiting the veteran diplomat Warren Christopher and later the lawyer David Boies, while former Secretary of State James Baker heads the Bush team's legal and political strategy with fierce discipline. The Gore campaign seeks hand recounts in Democratic-leaning counties where ballots were disputed, including the confusing "butterfly ballot" in Palm Beach County and punch-card ballots with incompletely detached "chads." Republicans pressure Katherine Harris, who also co-chaired the Bush campaign in Florida, to certify the results quickly. The battle moves through county canvassing boards, the Florida courts and the media, with the Florida Supreme Court twice ruling to extend or order recounts, until the case of Bush v. Gore reaches the US Supreme Court, whose decision stops the count and effectively hands Bush the presidency.

Recount received critical acclaim for its screenplay, direction and performances, particularly those of Spacey, Wilkinson and Dern. It was nominated for 11 Primetime Emmy Awards and won three, including Outstanding Made for Television Movie and Outstanding Directing for Roach. It also received five Golden Globe nominations, winning Best Supporting Actress for Dern. Some participants in the events, especially on the Republican side, disputed aspects of its portrayal.

overview: When two married business executives having an affair are blackmailed by a violent criminal, they are forced to turn the tables on him to save their families.
tagline: He never saw it coming.
title: Derailed
plot:
Derailed is a 2005 psychological thriller film directed by Mikael Håfström and starring Clive Owen and Jennifer Aniston.

The movie begins with Daniel Petrie Jr. (Clive Owen), an American executive, who is on his way to Paris for a business meeting. He boards the train at Munich, Germany, where he meets Lucie (Jennifer Aniston), a beautiful and charming French woman. The two strike up a conversation, and Daniel finds himself drawn to her.

As the train journey progresses, Daniel becomes increasingly infatuated with Lucie, and they share a romantic dinner together. However, their relationship is put to the test when Daniel discovers that Lucie has been involved in a tragic accident involving her husband, who was killed by a drunk driver. The incident leaves Lucie emotionally scarred and struggling to cope.

As the train approaches its destination, Daniel becomes more and more obsessed with Lucie, and he begins to see her as an escape from his own troubled past. However, their relationship is complicated by the fact that Daniel has a wife back home, who is unaware of his infidelity.

The plot takes a dark turn when the train is derailed in a remote area, leaving Daniel and Lucie stranded. As they try to survive the night, Daniel's obsession with Lucie reaches a boiling point, and he becomes increasingly aggressive and controlling.

As the hours pass, it becomes clear that Daniel's behavior is not just driven by his infatuation with Lucie but also by a deeper psychological issue. He has a history of violent outbursts, which he has kept hidden from his wife and colleagues.

The movie builds towards a shocking climax as Daniel's true nature is revealed, and the audience is left wondering whether Lucie will escape her captor or become his next victim. The ending is both disturbing and thought-provoking, leaving the viewer to ponder the complexities of human psychology and the blurred lines between love and obsession.

Throughout the movie, Håfström masterfully builds tension through a combination of atmospheric cinematography, eerie sound design, and outstanding performances from Owen and Aniston. The film's themes of love, obsession, and the darker aspects of human nature are both haunting and thought-provoking, making Derailed a gripping and unsettling thriller that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

Overall, Derailed is a masterclass in psychological suspense, with a complex and nuanced plot that explores the darkest corners of the human psyche. With outstanding performances, atmospheric direction, and a thought-provoking theme, this movie is a must-see for fans of thriller and suspense genres.

overview: A book-smart teenager joins his school's wrestling team as a way to reunite his surviving family members, who split apart after the death of his father, a college wrestling legend, 10 years ago.
tagline: Some Legends are born out of Struggle.
title: Legendary
plot:
Legendary is a 2010 American sports drama directed by Mel Damski and produced by WWE Studios. Devon Graye stars as Cal Chetley, a teenage high school wrestler, with professional wrestler John Cena as his older brother Mike, Patricia Clarkson as their mother Sharon, Danny Glover, Madeleine Martin and Tyler Posey. The film was released in the United States in September 2010.

Cal is an intelligent but physically slight and socially awkward teenager in a small Oklahoma town who is regularly bullied at school. His father, a celebrated wrestling coach, died years earlier in an accident, and his older brother Mike, once a star wrestler with a promising future, has drifted into a troubled and aimless life. Mike has been estranged from the family for about a decade, and Sharon, who has raised Cal alone, has had no contact with her elder son.

Cal decides to join his high school's wrestling team, hoping that following in the family tradition will help him reconnect with Mike and bring his broken family back together. Sharon is opposed to the idea, worried that Cal will be hurt and that wrestling will revive old wounds, and she is even more upset when she learns that Cal has secretly sought out Mike for coaching. Mike, who carries guilt over the circumstances of their father's death, is initially unwilling to help, but gradually agrees to train his younger brother. As Cal endures defeats and hard training under his coach and Mike's guidance, and as he befriends a girl named Luli, he grows in confidence and resolve, and his determination slowly forces the family to confront the past. Danny Glover's character, a local fisherman who narrates parts of the story, offers Cal advice along the way, as Cal prepares for a crucial match that will test both his skill and his family's ability to heal.

Critics received the film poorly. It holds a 19 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus described it as maudlin, predictable and clichéd, pinning its talented cast under a heavy layer of formulaic schmaltz, and a Metacritic score of 39. The film was a commercial failure in its limited theatrical release, and it was later marketed on home video largely on the strength of Cena's wrestling fame.

overview: After a powerful billionaire is murdered, his secret adoptive son must race to prove his legitimacy, find his father's killers and stop them from taking over his financial empire.
title: The Heir Apparent: Largo Winch
plot:
The Heir Apparent: Largo Winch is a 2008 adventure film that revolves around the story of Largo Winch, a young and wealthy playboy who inherits a vast fortune from his father. As he navigates his new life, Largo discovers that his inheritance comes with a price - a powerful organization known as the Syndicate, which will stop at nothing to claim the Winch fortune for themselves.

The film explores themes of power, greed, and corruption, highlighting how the pursuit of wealth and control can lead individuals down a dark path. Through Largo's journey, the movie delves into the consequences of playing with fire when it comes to power and the corrupting influence it can have on even the most well-intentioned individuals.

The film also touches on the theme of identity and self-discovery, as Largo struggles to find his place in the world beyond his privileged upbringing. As he becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue and deception, Largo must confront his own demons and learn to rely on himself rather than relying solely on his wealth and connections.

Ultimately, The Heir Apparent: Largo Winch is a thrilling adventure that explores the darker side of human nature, revealing how even the most seemingly carefree individuals can be driven by a desire for power and control.

overview: November 22nd, 1963 was a day that changed the world forever — when young American President John F. Kennedy was assassinated in Dallas, Texas. This film follows, almost in real time, a handful of individuals forced to make split-second decisions after an event that would change their lives and forever alter the world’s landscape.
tagline: November 22, 1963, 12:38 pm - A trauma patient is rushed to Parkland Memorial Hospital in Dallas. His name is President John F. Kennedy.
title: Parkland
plot:
Parkland (2013) is a historical drama film that delves into the events surrounding the assassination of President John F. Kennedy on November 22, 1963. The movie primarily focuses on the experiences of three individuals: Lee Harvey Oswald, Jack Ruby, and Abraham Zapruder.

At its core, Parkland explores the themes of trauma, grief, and the long-lasting impact of violence on individuals and society. Through the characters' perspectives, the film conveys the emotional turmoil that followed the assassination, as people struggled to come to terms with the sudden loss of a leader and the senseless killing of an innocent man.

The movie also examines the role of media in shaping public perception and the way events are remembered over time. The character of Abraham Zapruder, who captured the infamous "Zapruder film" of the assassination, serves as a symbol of the power of documentation and the importance of preserving historical moments.

Furthermore, Parkland touches on the theme of conspiracy theories and the lingering questions surrounding the assassination. The film raises questions about the official narrative and invites viewers to consider alternative perspectives, leaving room for interpretation and debate.

Ultimately, Parkland is a thought-provoking exploration of the human experience in the face of tragedy, highlighting the complexities and nuances that arise when individuals are forced to confront the darker aspects of human nature.

overview: When an experienced thief accidentally makes off with a Van Gogh, his partner is kidnapped by gangsters in pursuit of the painting, forcing the criminal to hatch a rescue plan.
tagline: Timing is everything.
title: 7 Seconds
plot:
7 Seconds is a 2005 crime action thriller directed by Simon Fellows and released direct to DVD. Wesley Snipes stars as Jack Tulliver, a professional thief and former special forces soldier, with Tamzin Outhwaite as the military police sergeant Kelly Anders, Georgina Rylance as Suza, Pete Lee-Wilson as the Russian gangster Alexei Kutchinov, Deobia Oparei as Spanky, and Serge Soric as Mikhail Mercea. The title refers to the seven-second timers seen in the film's opening heist.

Jack leads a crew in a meticulously planned robbery of an armored convoy in Bucharest, a job that should net each member around $3 million. But a rival gang shows up at the same moment, tipped off by a traitor within the operation, and the ambush leaves most of his team dead, among them his partner Frank "Bull" Mercea. Jack escapes with the most valuable piece of the loot, a mysterious sealed case, and makes a getaway through the city by hijacking Anders's car, leaving the sergeant under suspicion from her own colleagues.

The case turns out to hold a Van Gogh painting, which Jack hides in a locker at a bus station as a bargaining chip. One of his crew has been taken hostage by the gang's boss, Kutchinov, a sadistic Russian millionaire who controls the Romanian racketeers behind the ambush and wants the painting. Determined to rescue his colleague, Jack reluctantly joins forces with Anders, and the pair become entangled in a web of shifting loyalties, double-crosses and car chases through Bucharest's streets and nightclubs, as Jack tries to work out who betrayed him. In the end they are saved by Bull's brother Mikhail, a Romanian mobster who avenges his brother by shooting Kutchinov and the traitor, Suza. Afterward Jack and Anders discover that the painting, long thought to be a forgery, is in fact genuine and extremely valuable.

The film was shot over 32 days in the summer of 2004 in Bucharest and at Castel Film Studios in Romania, and Sony Pictures Home Entertainment released it on DVD in the United States on 28 June 2005 and in Britain that September. It was a commercial failure, and critics were largely dismissive. Reviewers found the plot confusing and the script sloppy, though some praised a few energetic car chases and fight scenes and felt Snipes's engaging performance kept it watchable.

overview: Investigative journalist Eddie Brock attempts a comeback following a scandal, but accidentally becomes the host of Venom, a violent, super powerful alien symbiote. Soon, he must rely on his newfound powers to protect the world from a shadowy organization looking for a symbiote of their own.
tagline: The world has enough Superheroes.
title: Venom
plot:
Here's a plot summary of Venom (2018) by Marvel Entertainment:

Venom is a 2018 American superhero science fiction film directed by Ruben Fleischer and written by Jeff Pinkner, Scott Rosenberg, and Kelly Marcel. The movie stars Tom Hardy as Eddie Brock, a journalist who becomes bonded with an alien symbiote.

The film begins with Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy), a hard-hitting investigative journalist working for the Daily Bugle in New York City. He's a rival of Peter Parker (played by a cameo appearance by Jon Bernthal), a photographer and Spider-Man. During a confrontation, Eddie is attacked by a black market dealer who sells him an alien symbiote that bonds with his skin.

The symbiote enhances Eddie's physical abilities, but also amplifies his darker emotions, making him more aggressive and violent. As the symbiote grows stronger, it begins to take control of Eddie's body, leading to a series of gruesome and violent outbursts.

Meanwhile, Dr. Carlton Drake (played by Riz Ahmed), a pharmaceutical executive, is searching for a cure for cancer using the alien symbiotes. He kidnaps Peter Parker and subjects him to the symbiote, which bonds with his skin. However, the symbiote rejects Peter's personality and instead takes control of his body.

Eddie Brock, now bonded with the symbiote, sets out to take down Dr. Drake and his company, who are using the alien technology for their own gain. Along the way, he teams up with Anne Weying (played by Michelle Williams), a lawyer who helps him track down Dr. Drake.

As the story unfolds, Eddie's bond with the symbiote grows stronger, leading to a series of intense battles between him and his enemies. The film culminates in an epic showdown between Eddie and Dr. Drake, with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

Throughout the movie, Tom Hardy delivers a raw and visceral performance as Eddie Brock, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The special effects are also noteworthy, creating a visually stunning representation of the alien symbiote.

Overall, Venom is a thrilling and action-packed ride that explores the darker side of human nature. With its blend of science fiction and superhero elements, it sets the stage for a potential sequel and cements Tom Hardy's status as a leading man in Hollywood.

overview: The Elephant Whisperers follows an indigenous couple as they fall in love with Raghu, an orphaned elephant given into their care, and tirelessly work to ensure his recovery & survival. The film highlights the beauty of the wild spaces in South India and the people and animals who share this space.
title: The Elephant Whisperers
plot:
The Elephant Whisperers is a heartwarming documentary film directed by Paayal Devi Saraf, which premiered at the Sundance Film Festival in 2022. The movie tells the story of a young elephant named Raghu and his unlikely friendship with a stray dog named Manju.

The film begins with the introduction of Raghu, an orphaned elephant calf who is rescued by a kind-hearted couple, Bindu and Sivaraman, from a local temple in India. As Raghu grows up, he becomes increasingly aggressive due to the trauma he experienced as a young calf. The family decides to send Raghu to a sanctuary for elephants, where he meets Manju, a stray dog who has been living on the streets.

Initially, Raghu and Manju do not get along, but over time, they develop an unlikely bond. Manju becomes Raghu's protector and companion, and Raghu learns to trust her. The film showcases their unique friendship, which is both heartwarming and humorous at times.

As Raghu grows older, he begins to exhibit signs of PTSD, including anxiety and aggression. However, with the help of Manju, he slowly starts to overcome his trauma. The film highlights the special bond between Raghu and Manju, who have become inseparable.

The movie also explores the challenges faced by Raghu and Manju at the sanctuary, where they face threats from other animals and humans. Despite these challenges, Raghu and Manju continue to thrive under the care of their human caregivers.

Throughout the film, there are several poignant moments that showcase the deep bond between Raghu and Manju. One such moment is when Raghu's mother returns to the sanctuary after years of separation, and Raghu is initially hesitant to reunite with her. However, with Manju by his side, he slowly begins to trust his mother again.

The Elephant Whisperers ends on a hopeful note, as Raghu and Manju continue to live happily at the sanctuary. The film concludes with a heartwarming scene of Raghu and Manju playing together in the sun, symbolizing their unbreakable bond.

Overall, The Elephant Whisperers is a beautifully crafted documentary that showcases the power of friendship and trust between two unlikely companions. The film is a testament to the human-animal bond and highlights the importance of compassion, empathy, and understanding towards all living beings.

overview: When falling coconuts keep everyone awake all night on vacation, Chip and Potato come up with a plan to help the family get a puggy good night's sleep!
title: Chip and Potato: Chip's Holiday
plot: When falling coconuts keep everyone awake all night on vacation, Chip and Potato come up with a plan to help the family get a puggy good night's sleep!

overview: The adventures of the Lafayette Escadrille, young Americans who volunteered for the French military before the U.S. entered World War I, and became the country's first fighter pilots.
tagline: Inspired by a true story
title: Flyboys
plot:
Flyboys is an action-drama film that revolves around the lives of young American pilots during World War I. The movie delves into the themes of camaraderie, sacrifice, and the psychological effects of war on its participants.

At its core, Flyboys explores the bonds of friendship and brotherhood among a group of pilots who share a common experience in the trenches. As they navigate the dangers of aerial combat, they must also confront their own personal demons and learn to rely on each other for survival. The film highlights the strong sense of camaraderie that develops among these young men as they face the harsh realities of war together.

The movie also touches on the theme of sacrifice, as the pilots are forced to make difficult choices between their duty and their personal lives. Many characters in the film struggle with the moral implications of their actions, and the consequences of their decisions weigh heavily on them.

Furthermore, Flyboys examines the psychological toll that war takes on its participants. The film depicts the physical and emotional scars that result from experiencing the horrors of combat, including the loss of innocence, the breakdown of relationships, and the struggle to cope with trauma.

Overall, Flyboys is a powerful exploration of the human cost of war, highlighting the complexities and nuances of the experiences of those who fought in World War I.

overview: A man returns home for an Easter celebration with his riotous, bickering, eating, drinking, laughing, loving family, in this love letter to the Filipino-American community.
tagline: Home is where the crazy is.
title: Easter Sunday
plot:
Easter Sunday is a 2022 American comedy-drama film directed by Joe Swanberg. The movie revolves around the lives of four couples who are all connected to each other in complex ways, exploring themes of love, relationships, and identity.

At its core, Easter Sunday delves into the complexities of human connections and the ways in which our relationships with others shape us. The film masterfully weaves together multiple storylines, revealing the intricate web of emotions, desires, and conflicts that arise when people are forced to confront their own vulnerabilities and insecurities.

One of the primary themes of Easter Sunday is the exploration of what it means to be alone and to find connection in a world that often values independence over interdependence. The characters in the film grapple with feelings of loneliness, disconnection, and the search for meaning, highlighting the universal human desire for belonging and understanding.

The movie also touches on themes of identity, particularly in the context of relationships and partnerships. As the characters navigate their complex web of connections, they are forced to confront their own desires, fears, and insecurities, leading to a deeper exploration of what it means to be true to oneself.

Ultimately, Easter Sunday presents a nuanced and thought-provoking portrayal of human relationships, one that is both humorous and poignant. Through its intricate character study and masterful storytelling, the film invites viewers to reflect on their own connections with others and the ways in which those relationships shape our understanding of ourselves.

overview: On a flight from Los Angeles to New York, Oliver and Emily make a connection, only to decide that they are poorly suited to be together. Over the next seven years, however, they are reunited time and time again, they go from being acquaintances to close friends to ... lovers?
tagline: There's nothing better than a great romance... to ruin a perfectly good friendship.
title: A Lot Like Love
plot:
A Lot Like Love is a 2005 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Jodie Foster and written by Nancy Meyers. The movie follows the story of Morley Clarkson (played by Ashton Kutcher), a young advertising executive, and Emma Moran (played by Amanda Peet), an artist.

The main themes of A Lot Like Love include:

1. Unrequited love: The film explores the complexities of unrequited love, as Morley falls deeply in love with Emma, but she doesn't feel the same way. This theme is portrayed through their on-again, off-again relationship and the emotional struggles they face.

2. Self-discovery: As Morley navigates his feelings for Emma, he also undergoes a journey of self-discovery, learning to let go of his past relationships and focus on finding himself.

3. Friendship: The movie highlights the importance of friendship in our lives. Morley and Emma's relationship evolves from a casual friendship to something more, but they maintain their bond even when things get complicated.

4. Growing up: A Lot Like Love touches on the theme of growing up and moving on. As Morley and Emma face various challenges, they are forced to confront their own maturity levels and make decisions about their futures.

5. Impermanence: The film also explores the impermanence of relationships and the inevitability of change. Despite their strong connection, Morley and Emma's relationship is subject to ups and downs, ultimately leading to a bittersweet conclusion.

Overall, A Lot Like Love is a poignant and engaging romantic comedy-drama that delves into the complexities of love, friendship, and self-discovery.

overview: A lonely young boy feels different from everyone else. Desperate for a friend, he seeks solace and refuge in his ever-present cell phone and tablet. When a mysterious creature uses the boy’s devices against him to break into our world, his parents must fight to save their son from the monster beyond the screen.
tagline: He's good at taking friends.
title: Come Play
plot:
Come Play is a 2020 American supernatural horror film directed by Jacob Kornbluth and produced by Focus Features. The movie follows the story of Oliver, a young boy who moves into a new home with his mother, only to discover that it's inhabited by a malevolent spirit.

The main themes of Come Play revolve around the idea of childhood innocence and the fragility of human relationships. The film explores how Oliver's experiences in the haunted house affect him emotionally and psychologically, causing him to question the nature of reality and his own sanity.

One of the primary concerns of the movie is the theme of isolation and loneliness. As a new kid in town, Oliver struggles to form connections with his peers, which makes him more vulnerable to the supernatural forces that surround him. The film highlights how these feelings of isolation can be both debilitating and transformative.

Another significant theme present in Come Play is the idea of trauma and its long-term effects on individuals. Oliver's experiences in the haunted house serve as a catalyst for exploring the emotional scars he carries from his past, including the loss of his father. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, adding depth to the story.

The film also touches upon the concept of grief and the complexities of human relationships. As Oliver navigates his new home, he begins to uncover secrets about his family's past, which forces him to confront the reality of his own mortality and the impermanence of life.

Throughout its runtime, Come Play masterfully balances elements of horror, drama, and coming-of-age themes, creating a captivating narrative that lingers long after the credits roll.

overview: A decorated Marine goes on a rescue mission to save his two young sons from an unhuman threat. As their journey takes them in increasingly dangerous directions, the boys will need to leave their childhoods behind.
title: Encounter
plot:
Encounter (stylized as ENCOUИTƎЯ) is a 2021 science fiction thriller and crime drama directed by Michael Pearce, who co-wrote the screenplay with Joe Barton. Riz Ahmed stars as Malik Khan, a former US Marine, with Octavia Spencer, Janina Gavankar, Rory Cochrane, Lucian-River Chauhan and Aditya Geddada. The film premiered at the 48th Telluride Film Festival in September 2021 and was released in a limited theatrical run by Amazon Studios in December 2021 before streaming on Prime Video a week later.

Malik is a decorated Marine veteran whose two young sons, Jay and Bobby, live with their mother Piya and her new partner Dylan. Piya has been feeling ill, which Dylan dismisses as a bug. One night Malik appears at the house unannounced, wakes the boys and tells them they are going on a road trip. As they drive through the desert, Malik grows tense whenever they pass police cars, and when a hostile officer pulls them over, Malik becomes convinced that the man has been taken over by a parasitic organism from another planet. He overpowers the officer and leaves him on the road.

Malik then admits to his sons that this is not a vacation but a rescue mission: alien parasites carried by insects are spreading across the country, taking control of human hosts, and their mother has already been infected. Jay, the older boy, is torn between his admiration for his father and growing doubts about what he is being told, especially as Malik's behavior becomes more erratic. Meanwhile Hattie, Malik's parole officer, and the authorities begin searching for Malik, who is suspected of kidnapping his children. As the journey continues, the film gradually reveals the truth about Malik's mental state, his past, and the trauma he carries from his military service, turning what began as an alien-invasion thriller into an intimate drama about a father's love, mental illness and the bond between parent and child.

Encounter received mixed reviews, with 54 percent of 125 critics' reviews counted as positive on Rotten Tomatoes. Critics widely praised Ahmed's performance and the young actors, particularly Chauhan, while some felt that the film's shift in genre was unevenly handled and that it failed to fully commit to either of its storylines.

overview: In town for a job interview, a young woman arrives at her Airbnb late at night only to find that it has been mistakenly double-booked and a strange man is already staying there. Against her better judgement, she decides to stay the night anyway.
tagline: Some stay for a night. Some stay for a week. Some never leave.
title: Barbarian
plot:
Barbarian is a 2022 American horror film written and directed by Zach Cregger in his solo writing and directing debut. Georgina Campbell, Bill Skarsgård and Justin Long star, with Matthew Patrick Davis and Richard Brake. The story follows a woman who discovers a terrible secret in the house she has rented for the night. The film premiered at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2022 and was released in cinemas by 20th Century Studios on 9 September 2022.

On the night before a job interview in Detroit, Tess Marshall arrives at a rental house in the run-down Brightmoor neighborhood, only to find that it has been double-booked and is already occupied by a man named Keith. Despite her unease, the rain and a lack of other options persuade her to stay, and Keith turns out to be friendly. During the night she wakes to find her door open, though Keith insists he did not open it. The next day her interviewer warns her about the neighborhood, and when Tess returns to the house a homeless man runs toward her shouting at her to leave. Accidentally locked in the basement, she discovers a hidden room containing a camera, a bucket, a stained mattress and a bloody handprint. Keith frees her but insists on investigating, and when he does not return, Tess follows him into a tunnel beneath the house, where a horrifying discovery awaits.

The film then abruptly shifts to AJ Gilbride, a television actor played by Long, whose career is collapsing after he is accused of sexual assault by a co-star. Desperate for money to fund his legal defense, AJ plans to sell some of his properties, among them the Detroit house. When he visits it and finds Tess's belongings, he becomes curious about the extensive underground spaces, which he begins to measure in the hope of increasing the property's value. As the two storylines converge, the history of the house and its former owner, Frank, is gradually revealed, along with the origins of the monstrous figure that lives below.

Barbarian received positive reviews from critics, who praised its unpredictable structure, tonal shifts, humor and performances, especially Campbell's and Long's. It was a surprise box-office hit, grossing about $46 million worldwide against a budget of roughly $4.5 million, and it was widely considered one of the best horror films of the year.

overview: During the 16th century, pirates rule the Chinese coastline, pillaging the small villages and terrorizing the citizens. When maverick leader Commander Yu enlists the help of a sharp young general, they devise a plan to defeat the pirates. A violent clash of wit and weapons will decide who will rule the land.
title: God of War
plot:
God of War (Chinese: Dàng Kòu Fēng Yún) is a 2017 Chinese-Hong Kong historical war film directed by Gordon Chan, based on General Qi Jiguang's campaigns against the wokou pirates who raided China's coast during the Ming dynasty. Vincent Zhao stars as Qi Jiguang, with Sammo Hung as General Yu Dayou and the Japanese actor Yasuaki Kurata as the samurai commander Kumasawa, alongside Wan Qian and Wu Yue.

In the 16th century, Ming forces under General Yu Dayou launch an assault on a coastal fortress held by Japanese pirates, but the attack is repulsed with heavy losses. The so-called wokou turn out to be a mixed force of masterless ronin, disaffected Chinese and a disciplined contingent of samurai led by the veteran commander Kumasawa, who has been sent by his feudal lord on a mission of his own. After the defeat, command passes to General Qi Jiguang, who recruits a new army from tough local villagers. Qi's surprise attack drives the Japanese from their fortress, but because they escape, he is accused by court officials of failing his duty and even of colluding with the enemy, and narrowly escapes arrest.

The Japanese then split into three groups to strike simultaneously at the provincial capital of Taizhou, the town of Ninghai and the town of Xinhe, where the families of Qi's soldiers, including his wife, are living. Kumasawa hopes to overstretch the Ming defenses, while his young ward, Lord Imagawa, argues for a single massive assault. Learning of the plan, Qi first intercepts and destroys the ronin force, then marches to defend Taizhou, knowing that this leaves Xinhe almost unprotected. In his absence, his wife rallies the soldiers' wives and families into an improvised militia that holds off the samurai.

At Taizhou, Qi's army is nearly overwhelmed when Imagawa defies Kumasawa and attacks with the surviving ronin, but last-minute reinforcements turn the tide, and the Japanese retreat toward their ships. Qi relieves Xinhe and then strikes the invaders as they attempt to embark. Kumasawa sends Imagawa to safety and makes a last stand, dueling Qi personally before taking his own life in defeat. The film ends with Qi's wife awaiting her husband's homecoming.

God of War screened at the Seattle International Film Festival in May 2017 and was released in the United States by Well Go USA Entertainment on June 2, 2017, in Mandarin and Japanese with English subtitles.

overview: Peter and Michael, raised on the streets of Philadelphia, are the children of Irish mob members, forever linked by the crimes of their fathers. 30 years later, Michael now runs the criminal organization and lusts for more power, his dangerous antics frequently held in check by his cautious cousin Peter. Haunted by the death of his sister, whose passing destroyed both his parents, Peter is caught between the dreams of childhood and the realities of his life as an enforcer. His only reprieve is a local boxing gym, a sanctuary that is quickly threatened as Michael’s desire for control escalates.
tagline: Loyalty has a price.
title: Brothers by Blood
plot:
Brothers by Blood, originally titled The Sound of Philadelphia, is a 2020 crime drama written and directed by the French novelist and filmmaker Jérémie Guez, based on Pete Dexter's 1991 novel Brotherly Love. A Belgian, French and American co-production involving Killer Films, Brookstreet Pictures, Gapbusters and RTBF, it stars Matthias Schoenaerts and Joel Kinnaman, with Maika Monroe, Paul Schneider, Ryan Phillippe, Nicholas Crovetti, Felix Scott, James Nelson-Joyce and Antoni Corone.

In Philadelphia, cousins Peter (Schoenaerts) and Michael (Kinnaman) grew up as the sons of Irish mobsters, bound together by the crimes of their fathers. Thirty years later, Michael leads the family's criminal organization and craves more power, while the cautious Peter, who works as his enforcer, tries to keep his reckless cousin in check. Peter is emotionally numb, still haunted by the death of his sister, which destroyed both his parents; flashbacks with the young Peter (Crovetti) reveal a painful accident, a catatonic mother and a vengeful father (Phillippe). In the opening scene he calmly steps off a rooftop while joking with Michael and their friend Jimmy (Schneider), and survives the fall. His only refuges are a local boxing gym, where he looks out for a young fighter, and Jimmy's sister Grace (Monroe), whose return to the neighborhood hints at romance. As the Italian mob expands its territory, Michael decides to fight back, and other figures urge Peter to rein him in. Torn between loyalty and self-preservation, Peter is drawn toward an inevitable confrontation with his cousin. Guez keeps most of the violence off screen, using long takes and an understated ending that departs from the novel.

Schoenaerts was cast in 2018 for a shoot planned in Philadelphia, and Kinnaman, Phillippe, Schneider and Monroe joined in early 2019; filming began in New York in March 2019. A premiere planned at the Tribeca Film Festival in April 2020 was cancelled because of the pandemic, and the film instead premiered at the Deauville American Film Festival on 8 September 2020. Vertical Entertainment acquired US rights, retitled it and released it on 22 January 2021. Reviews were largely negative, with 25% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 41; Variety praised the brooding, Method-style performances of the two leads but found the slow, oblique storytelling hard to follow.

overview: Dae-ho, an investigative journalist, seeks to track down the whereabouts of his son who was abducted three years ago. With the help of a detective and a psychiatrist friend, he will retrace his memory of the incident through the use of lucid dreaming techniques.
title: Lucid Dream
plot:
Lucid Dream (Korean: 루시드 드림; RR: Rusideu deurim) is a 2017 South Korean science fiction mystery thriller written and directed by Kim Joon-sung in his directorial debut. Go Soo stars as Dae-ho, with Sol Kyung-gu as Detective Song, Kang Hye-jung as So-hyeon, Park Yoo-chun and Park In-hwan. The film was released in South Korean cinemas on 22 February 2017, and Netflix, which acquired it for distribution in all other countries, premiered it worldwide on 2 June 2017.

Dae-ho is an investigative journalist and single father who has made powerful enemies by exposing corrupt politicians and businessmen. One day his young son is abducted from an amusement park, but no ransom demand ever arrives. Dae-ho is convinced that one of the people he exposed has taken revenge on him, but three years pass without any progress in the case, and the police investigation goes cold.

Desperate, Dae-ho learns about an experimental therapy that uses lucid dreaming to allow patients to revisit and explore their memories in detail. One of the doctors involved in the research is his old friend So-hyeon. With her help, he enters a lucid dream and returns to the day of the kidnapping, where he is able to notice details his conscious mind had missed, uncovering new leads. Detective Song, who was in charge of the original investigation, agrees to help, and their search leads them to a prime suspect who, it turns out, has been lying in a coma. Dae-ho then tracks down a mysterious young man who keeps appearing in all of his dreams and who has discovered a way to enter other people's dreams. Following him into the shared world of dreams, Dae-ho finds a chance to uncover the truth about the abduction and the people behind it, but the deeper he goes, the more dangerous the line between dreams and reality becomes.

The film was a box-office failure in South Korea, grossing about $677,000 against a budget of around $5 million. Critic Min-Ji Jin of the Korea JoongAng Daily wrote that, despite its original premise and star-studded cast, the film failed to make full use of either, criticizing its plot, characterization and forced twist ending and comparing it unfavorably with Inception. It found a wider international audience through its release on Netflix.

overview: After breaking up with her long-term boyfriend just before the holidays, passionate baker Kylie reconnects with her high school sweetheart, Nick. Thanks to their newly rekindled friendship, Kylie uses Nick’s restaurant to prepare for a gingerbread baking competition with a large cash prize that would help her open her own bakery.
title: The Sweetest Christmas
plot:
The Sweetest Christmas is a 2017 American Christmas romance television film directed by Terry Ingram from a screenplay by Erinne Dobson, made for Hallmark Channel. It stars Lacey Chabert as the aspiring pastry chef Kylie Watson and Lea Coco as Nick Mazzanti, with Jonathan Adams as Nick's chef and friend Ralphie, Brenden Sunderland as his young son Bobby, Lane Edwards as Kylie's boyfriend Alex, and Lara Gilchrist, Jill Morrison and Brenda Crichlow in supporting roles.

Kylie, a talented baker working as a temporary receptionist for her boyfriend, the real estate developer Alex Hawkey, learns that she has finally become a semifinalist in the American Gingerbread Competition, whose $25,000 prize could help her open a bakery of her own. Expecting a marriage proposal at their anniversary dinner at a local pizzeria, she is instead offered a promotion to office manager, and realizing that Alex does not support her dreams, she breaks up with him. The pizzeria turns out to belong to Nick, her old boyfriend, whom she has not seen in years; he gave up his ambition of becoming a pastry chef to run the family restaurant and is raising Bobby on his own. When Kylie's oven breaks down, Nick lets her use his industrial pizza oven at night, and as she bakes, helps Bobby make cupcakes for a school party and reminisces with Nick about their youthful dreams, their romance is rekindled. Alex, meanwhile, tries to win her back by sponsoring the celebrated "Godmother of Gingerbread", Ina Bruckner, to compete in the same contest. When he stages a grand gesture at the competition, presenting a gingerbread jewelry store containing an engagement ring, Nick assumes Kylie has accepted and pulls away. Realizing she has lost her creative spark trying to imitate Ina, Kylie spends a twelve-hour marathon building a new entry, a moving gingerbread carousel commemorating her first kiss with Nick, wins the prize and reconciles with him at their old carousel.

The film premiered on Hallmark Channel on 11 November 2017. Matt Mueller of OnMilwaukee found it merely "fine", calling Chabert pleasant but given little to work with, Coco nice but bland and Edwards almost too dopey as the ex-boyfriend, while singling out Adams as the most enjoyable character; he likened the film to a Chips Ahoy cookie, sweet enough but not particularly good.

overview: Two academic teenage superstars realize, on the eve of their high school graduation, that they should have worked less and played more. Determined to never fall short of their peers, the girls set out on a mission to cram four years of fun into one night.
tagline: Getting straight A's. Giving zero F's.
title: Booksmart
plot:
Booksmart is a coming-of-age comedy film directed by Olivia Wilde and written by Emily Halpern, Sarah Haskins, Katie Silberman, and Kate Long. The movie follows the story of two high school friends, Amy (Kaitlyn Dever) and Molly (Beanie Feldstein), who are on the cusp of graduation.

The film takes place over a single night, as Amy and Molly decide to break the rules and have one wild night before they graduate. They've been inseparable since childhood, but their friendship has become stale due to their differing interests and social cliques. Amy is a straight-A student who wants to attend Harvard, while Molly is more laid-back and interested in partying.

As they embark on their adventure, the girls visit various parties, bars, and clubs around Los Angeles, where they encounter a cast of eccentric characters, including a group of rowdy college students, a DJ, and a charismatic bartender (Jason Mantzoukas). Along the way, Amy and Molly confront their own insecurities, fears, and desires.

Throughout the night, the girls face various challenges, including navigating awkward social situations, dealing with peer pressure, and confronting their own identities. They also encounter a series of misadventures, including a wild party at a mansion, a disastrous karaoke session, and a run-in with a group of aggressive frat boys.

As the night wears on, Amy and Molly begin to reconnect and rediscover their friendship. They share heartfelt conversations, laugh together, and support each other through various struggles. The film's climax features an emotional confrontation between the two friends, as they come to terms with their own futures and the end of their high school era.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, as Amy and Molly reflect on the night's events and look forward to their future together. They've learned to let go of their inhibitions, take risks, and prioritize their friendship above all else. The film concludes with a montage of the girls' post-graduation plans, set to a catchy indie-pop soundtrack.

Booksmart features a talented young cast, witty dialogue, and a nuanced exploration of female friendship and identity. The movie has received widespread critical acclaim for its humor, heart, and authentic portrayal of adolescent struggles. Overall, Booksmart is a charming, laugh-out-loud comedy that celebrates the power of female friendship and the importance of embracing one's true self.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Phantom of the Opera Collection

original_title: The Phantom of the Opera at the Royal Albert Hall
overview: A disfigured musical genius, hidden away in the Paris Opera House, terrorises the opera company for the unwitting benefit of a young protégée whom he trains and loves. The 25th anniversary of the first public performance of Phantom of the Opera was celebrated with a grand performance at the Royal Albert Hall in London.
tagline: The 25th anniversary of the first public performance of Phantom of the Opera.
title: The Phantom of the Opera at the Royal Albert Hall
plot:
The Phantom of the Opera at the Royal Albert Hall is a 2011 British concert film of Andrew Lloyd Webber's 1986 stage musical, itself based on Gaston Leroux's 1910 novel. Staged in full to mark the show's 25th anniversary, it stars Ramin Karimloo as the Phantom, Sierra Boggess as Christine Daaé and Hadley Fraser as Raoul, Vicomte de Chagny, with Wendy Ferguson as Carlotta, Liz Robertson as Madame Giry and Daisy Maywood as Meg Giry.

At an auction in Paris in 1905, Raoul buys a music box as a restored chandelier recalls "the strange affair of the Phantom of the Opera". In 1881, as new managers take over the Opéra Populaire, a falling backdrop sends the prima donna Carlotta storming out, and young Christine, secretly tutored by an unseen "Angel of Music", triumphs in her place, catching the eye of her childhood friend Raoul, the company's new patron. The masked Phantom reveals himself as her teacher and leads her through her mirror to his lair across an underground lake, where she unmasks him in curiosity before he returns her to the theater. When the managers defy his demand that Christine take the lead in Il Muto, he reduces Carlotta's voice to a croak and hangs the stagehand Joseph Buquet. On the roof, Raoul and Christine pledge their love, and the eavesdropping Phantom brings down the chandelier in revenge.

Six months later, at a masked ball, the Phantom orders the company to stage his opera Don Juan Triumphant with Christine, now secretly engaged to Raoul, in the lead, and Madame Giry reveals that he is a disfigured prodigy who escaped from a traveling fair. Raoul plans to trap him at the premiere; Christine, torn, visits her father's grave, where the Phantom nearly bewitches her before Raoul intervenes. During the performance the Phantom takes the place of Piangi, who is found strangled, and Christine unmasks him before the audience. He carries her to his lair and threatens to kill the captive Raoul unless she stays, but her compassionate kiss moves him to free them both, and when the mob arrives, Meg finds only his mask.

Three performances were filmed on October 1 and 2, 2011, the last broadcast live to cinemas worldwide, and footage from all three was edited for release. In a grand finale, Lloyd Webber brought out the original creative team and London cast, including Michael Crawford and Sarah Brightman, who sang the title song with four former Phantoms. Home video releases followed in Britain in November 2011 and North America in February 2012.

overview: While on a grand world tour, The Muppets find themselves wrapped into an European jewel-heist caper headed by a Kermit the Frog look-alike and his dastardly sidekick.
tagline: Taking the world by farce
title: Muppets Most Wanted
plot:
Muppets Most Wanted is a 2014 musical comedy film that explores several themes, including identity, loyalty, and the blurred lines between reality and performance.

At its core, the movie delves into the theme of identity, particularly in the context of fame and celebrity. Kermit the Frog, as the leader of the Muppets, struggles to maintain his sense of self amidst the chaos of their world tour. The film also examines the tension between authenticity and artifice, as the Muppets navigate the complexities of their performances and the expectations of their audience.

The movie also touches on the theme of loyalty, particularly in the context of friendship and camaraderie among the Muppet characters. As they face various challenges and setbacks, the Muppets must rely on each other to overcome obstacles and find their way back to themselves.

Furthermore, Muppets Most Wanted explores the idea that reality is often a performance, and that our perceptions of the world are shaped by the stories we tell ourselves and others. The film's use of satire and parody highlights the artificial nature of celebrity culture and the ways in which performers present themselves to the public.

Overall, Muppets Most Wanted is a lighthearted and entertaining film that uses humor and wit to explore deeper themes about identity, loyalty, and the power of performance.

original_title: I Don't Know How She Does It
overview: A comedy centered on the life of Kate Reddy, a finance executive who is the breadwinner for her husband and two kids.
tagline: If it were easy, men would do it too.
title: I Don't Know How She Does It
plot:
I Don't Know How She Does It is a 2011 romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of marriage, relationships, and female identity. The movie delves into the life of Jill Potter (played by Sarah Jessica Parker), a successful businesswoman who appears to have it all - a loving husband, two adorable children, and a high-powered career.

However, as the story unfolds, it becomes clear that beneath the surface, Jill is struggling to balance her personal and professional life.
